description:
Teresa T. C. is 24 years old. About a year ago she was widowed with three young children. Teresa lives in the city of Tecpan and works with her family in weaving güipiles (traditional clothing). Teresa is a strong and enterprising woman and says that although it has been hard since her husband died, she is not afraid. Teresa is the leader of their small family business and she works closely with her father and siblings. The business needs more capital in order for them to purchase thread for the güipiles and for the labor that is invested in creating each one. They also have started making sweaters for babies and hope to grow this business as well. Teresa’s dream is to have enough capital and to be a successful business owner. She also wants her children to have better food, housing and education throughout their lives. 


*********************************************************************************************
Translated from Spanish by Andrea Bouch, Kiva Fellow.
*********************************************************************************************


Doña Teresa T. C. es ahora de 24 años de edad, hace un año se quedo viuda, con tres hijos, de edad pequeña, Vive en el Municipio de Tecpan, desde pequeña a trabajado en elaboración de Güipiles, ella no le teme que esta sola, porque es una mujer emprendedora, su papá es parte de su trabajador, sus hermanos, creen que ella es la líder, por lo que  necesita un capital mas para, comprar, mas hilo para los güipiles, capital para mano de obra; tienen una producción de suéteres para bebes; su sueño es tener el capital propio para salir adelante, cuando crezcan sus hijos puedan tener mejor alimentación, casa, estudios mínimos, ser una microempresaria exitosa.
local_use: Thread and materials for weaving

description:
Lydia D. N. is an old client; in her credit history she has had no delayed payments, which indicates that she is a responsible and committed person. She dedicates herself to purchasing stuffed animals wholesale, to sell retail at the popular market of the 16 D. Julio area in the city of El Alto. She runs her business alone. She does not have a husband, and has one daughter that is currently studying.

Translated from Spanish by Mariela Cedeno, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: She will invest the loan in the purchase of more bundles of stuffed animals.

description:
Doña Martha is 37 years old. She lives at her mother’s house with her husband, Don Bernardo, and their three children. They have their own separate living quarters. Her husband is a blacksmith who works with forged iron to make his finished products. He operates his business out of their home while she works as a traveling street vendor (without a permanent location).

Martha is requesting a loan to buy more merchandise, such as undergarments and toys, before prices go up. She plans to acquire these products in the city of Oruro where a large fair is held for the Christmas and New Year’s seasons.

Translated from Spanish by Ronan Reodica, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Purchase undergarments & toys for the holiday season

description:
Ana is a responsible, dynamic, very hard-working person. Her family is made up of herself and her five, school-age, children. She is currently separated from her husband; a situation that has been very difficult for her but that she is overcoming gradually. Ana has a small, neighborhood grocery store in the Sopocachi neighborhood where she sells all kinds of household items. Her store is well-stocked and the store produces her main source of income to support her household; she has to work very hard to support her 5 children. She will use this loan to buy items to stock her store, especially during the Christmas season, because she will have high demand during this time. Ana is grateful to Emprender and Kiva for trusting her enough to grant the loan. .

Translated from Spanish by Michael Bujazan, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy stock inventory items.

description:
Francisco came to the Institution by recommendation from a long time client. He is a young person who is married to Francisca. They have two school-age children. They take care of the house and prepare their food when they get home from school. Francisco works as a mechanic during the day, and at night he transports passengers. His route is in the southern area. He belongs to the Trufis 1 Union. He lives with his family in the Villa Concepción area in Achumani Alto. His wife works all day as a household employee in the Achumani region. The neighbors say that they recommend him as a client because they know that he is a responsible and very hard-working person. The loan is to repair and expand his house. He wants to make his family more comfortable and improve their quality of life. One of is wishes is to be able to see his children become professionals. The other is to see his house completed. He is grateful to Emprender and Kiva for the confidence shown in granting the loan.

Translated from Spanish by Ginny Kalish, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Repair his house

description:
The board of directors for the PRIMAVERA communal bank group is composed of: Antonia, the president, works selling coca by the taque and raleo (units of measure). She lives in her parent's house and currently is responsible for the family's expenses. She is single and a student; her wish is to become a professional in order to improve her quality of life. The money from the loan is for the purchase of bags of coca with the goal of selling them at a higher price. Maria Esther is the treasurer and sells food in the coca market. Currently, she is providing the family's income. She is a single mother of two children that she is raising alone. She is very hardworking and with the loan money she wants to buy ingredients for the preparation of her food dishes. Nancy is the secretary and works selling new clothing and shoes by order in her house. These three are the board of directors of the PRIMAVERA communal bank group, which is composed of 10 people that mutually guarantee each other's loans because they know each other and know that it is an indivisible community bond. They all live in the Delicias zone located three blocks from Villa Fátima. They are mothers of responsible families and are ready to push ahead their families and businesses. All of the members are grateful to Emprender and Kiva for the confidence shown by the granting of the loan.

Translated from Spanish by Donald Allen, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Purchase of merchandise

description:
Rosa lives in La Gurdia, which is 20 kilometers from the city of Santa Cruz. She is married and has just one son under her care; the others are all adult, married and independent. Rosa works selling clothing because her husband's income is insufficient to meet all household needs. She hopes to have a fixed sales location inside the central market so that she doesn't have to peddle in the streets anymore. She will use the funds to buy merchandise to increase her working capital. She is a responsible, dynamic, very hard-working person. She is grateful to Emprender and to Kiva for the trust placed in her by granting the loan.

Translated from Spanish by Michael Bujazan, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy clothing.

description:
Lucas, age 32, has worked for nine years as a nurse’s aide in the Health Center of the Talolinga neighborhood, 37 kilometers from Nueva Guinea. He is married and has two children, 5 and 2 years old. His wife is also a nurse’s aide, working in the Jacinto Baca neighborhood. Lucas and his wife share the household expenses. Lucas is seeking his third loan with AFODENIC to invest in the construction of a bedroom in his house. This will provide more comfort and better living conditions for the family. Currently, Lucas is studying on weekends at UNAN in Managua for a career as a dental surgeon. He is grateful to AFODENIC, as the previous loans have greatly improved his house. His dream is to have good health and steady work.

Translated from Spanish by jeffrey hersk, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Build a new bedroom

description:
Teodora is married and has children that are still young. She makes and sells regional handicrafts, which she sells on Sagarnaga Street, a picturesque street that is popular among tourists. They come in search of Bolivian souvenirs that are sold in abundance. Articles maD. from the yarn of llamas, alpacas and vicuñas are among the most coveted. There are also a great variety of items maD. from silver. The finer the work is, the more costly the pieces are. There are original pewter articles, from matchboxes to luxurious cutlery. Pewter, finely worked, has an elegant presence and, unlike silver, it does not tarnish over time. Woodcarving, previously the predominant handicraft in Sagarnaga, is no longer as prevalent. It takes time and effort to find such original work any more. With the aim of attracting more potential customers, a number of tourist bureaus have opened in Sagarnaga offering a variety of specialty travel packages: from a basic tour such as “Tiwanaku Complex – Lake Titicaca”, to adventure excursions on the “Camino D. la Muerte”. Each year, there are less and less “traditional tourists”, while those seeking “risk and adventure” tours are growing. The photographic mosaic from Sagarnaga Street shows tourists visiting Bolivia only a remote idea of the treasures hidden within its shops. Teodora carries out her business with the help of family members, who work with her to make blouses, purses, and other items, creating the only source of income for the family. The loan would be used to buy raw materials to make her handicrafts, in order to increase her production and generate more income. She is very thankful to Emprender and Kiva for the confidence they show through the granting of a loan. If you want to learn more about Sagarnaga Street and see pictures of some of the handicrafts sold there, visit the following link: http://www.tiwy.com/pais/bolivia/la-paz/sagarnaga/esp.phtml

Translated from Spanish by Mary Lynn Malaby, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Credit to buy raw materials.

description: Nazirjon S. is a hard-working man who goes to cultivate his fields every morning with great care. Along with that, he tends to his calves, taking them to feed in the mornings. His work demonstrates his dedication to his cows, since one way or another they help solve his household expenses. Early in the morning, his wife milks them and sells the milk at nearby places. Most recently, Nazirjon wants to invest in purchasing another cow so that his wife can take more milk to the cities to sell, helping his business to continue growing economically. He is requesting a loan of 7,500 Somoni for this purpose. More about Tajikistan and IMON International Tajikistan is known for its rich history, which includes being a key post along the Silk Road, and for the end of Alexander the Great's rule. It has also produced great thinkers, philosophers, scientists and poets, including Rudaki, Avicenna, Ferdowsi, Omar Khayyam, Jomi and Rumi. The country is home to communities that still speak the ancient Sogdian language, epic mountain passes, and a civilization that dates back to the 4th millennium BC. And, even today, it is a complex mixture of the Islamic faith, Soviet culture, New West culture and Central Asian traditions. But Tajikistan is also the poorest of the former Soviet republics. The civil war, which ignited soon after its independence from the U.S.S.R., further damaged the already weak economy. In addition, 93% of the country is mountainous and only 7% of the land is arable. These conditions have resulted in high levels of unemployment and have forced hundreds of thousands to seek work in other countries, mainly Russia. While the people of Tajikistan are working to improve its agricultural production and manufacturing sector, nearly two-thirds of the population still live in abject poverty. IMON's History Since December 2007, IMON International has worked closely with Kiva and Kiva lenders to ensure that poor and low-income clients represent a viable business proposition. Funds raised through Kiva have already been distributed to thousands of IMON International's clients and will continue to provide thousands more with permanent access to the varied financial services they need. To learn more about IMON International's work, please visit: www.imon.tj
local_use: Purchasing small cattle for developing business

description:
S. Valijon is a young married man and the father of two children. He travels to different markets in the region in search of heads of cattle to purchase, which he then sells both at retail in the market and wholesale to butchers.

Valijon now needs a loan of 7500 TJS, which he plans to use to purchase more heads of cattle. His dreams are to improve his business, establish his own wealth and improve his home.

local_use: To purchase cattle to resell both in retail and wholesale markets.

description:
The “Hormiguitas” Enterprise Bank is new. It is made up of six women and two men, most of whom have small businesses, where they sell beauty products, clothing, food, and make sweaters and backpacks. Silvia is a young woman who serves as the president of the group. She sells clothing, is single and is also a student. She is anxious to get ahead and complete her studies in order to improve her family’s quality of life. She lives with her mother and sisters, and maintains her own household. She will use the money from this loan to buy jackets and blouses in order to increase her income and working capital. Mabel, who serves as the group’s secretary, sells beauty products and ladies’ hosiery. She is single and studies at the university. She will use the money from this loan to buy products in quantity, now that they are being offered at reduced prices. She will be able to resell them at retail prices and make a good profit. This will allow her to save up her money to be able to continue to cover the cost of her studies. Celia serves as the bank’s treasurer. She is married and has two school-aged children. She makes and sells “silpanchos” in the Tejar zone. She will use the money from this loan to buy tables and chairs for her business and be able to make her customers more comfortable. She plans to save up to buy a rental contract. All of the members are very grateful to Emprender and Kiva for the trust they have placed in them in granting this loan.

Translated from Spanish by Hugo Reyes, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Inventory

description:
Luis is a young man whose job is to offer transportation services with his taxi. He is married with Rosa and has two young children, a girl of 3 and boy of 2 years of age. They live in the San Antonio district, 20 minutes from the city centre. Luis wakes up very early in the morning to go working with his taxi: he prefers working during this time of the day because there is hardly ever any traffic and he can answer to and accept more rides. He returns home at noon for his lunch, then later on he gets back on the roads and keeps on working till 8 pm. He has been a taxi driver since he was 18. He initially drove his father’s minibus, but he has been saving money and has recently bought his own vehicle; however, he still needs a lot of money to complete the payment of his car, and this is the reason why he is requesting a loan. Rosa’s job is to sell flowers: she travels along the Yungas, and then brings the flowers back to the city. This is a young, hard-working family, thankful to Emprender and Kiva for the faith shown in granting the loan.

Translated from Spanish by Emanuela Villa, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To pay the loan of his vehicle.

description:
Brigida is a hard-working and cheerful person who runs a seven-passenger minibus service, which is part of the transport system in Miraflores, Bolivia. Her husband Orlando is a print technician in a small business. They live thirty minutes from the center of town and have two school-age children. Brigida and her husband have decided to start their own printing business to capitalize on his vast experience. They will make signboards, lighted signs, keyrings and other stamped products. Brigida has worked with Emprender for many years and has always been responsible and hard-working. She will use the loan to buy a computer for their printing business. She thanks Emprender and Kiva for their support.

Translated from Spanish by Ross Forman, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy a computer

description:
S. Ehrom is 33 years old. Together with his wife they have 4 children. Ehrom is an experienced bread baker. He has been doing this business for more than 12 years. He bakes the traditional bread “lepeshka” at his home. His family helps him with his business. Having many customers, Ehrom is selling the majority of his products right from his home. However, he is also running a retail shop in the central local market for selling the”lepeshka”. 

Now Ehrom is requesting a loan of 6000 Somoni. He is planning to purchase flour from a wholesaler. Ehrom is grateful for all those supporting him and promises to manage the loan prudently.

local_use: Purchasing flour for baking the traditional bread “lepeshka”.

description:
Martha María is 41 years old. She lives in San Miguel and is a single mother of two children, aged 6 and 7. She sells hotdogs as a street vendor. She is from Nicaragua and immigrated with the dream of staring her own business and to send money to her parents who live in her native country. She sells hotdogs as as a street vendor in a cargo bike. She travels the streets of San Miguel to get better sales. She is asking for a loan to invest in purchasing two bicycles and raw material to make hotdogs (hotdog buns, ketchup, mayonnaise). This will help to improve her business and generate work. Her aspirations are to improve her parents' quality of life, since they depend on her financially, and for her children to be able to go to school so they can have better opportunities in life.

Translated from Spanish by Ellen Donohue, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To purchase two bicyles, hotdog buns, ketchup, mayonnaise.

description:
Santos Emilio R. J. is 37 years old, and he lives in the San Jose neighborhood. He is married, and his wife does the housework. They have a little boy who is one month old. They are farmers, and they have been growing coffee for 18 years. They live in a humble house where they need to make some repairs to the infrastructure. That way they will live in a decent and secure space. One of the main problems with the harvest has been the proliferation of pests, which decreases the production of the crops. This causes financial problems for the family. That is the reason he is requesting a loan. He will buy farming materials like organic and chemical fertilizer and pesticides. These will allow for better maintenance, which will provide the financial stability that they are looking for. They are looking for future projects that will provide better economic conditions for the family.

Translated from Spanish by Ginny Kalish, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: By farming materials like organic and chemical fertilizer and pesticides

description:
Mr. Sinet C., 35, and his wife, Mrs. Savoeun Neang, 36, have been married since 1990 and have three children: two sons and one daughter. They are pictured together above. They are living along national road number one approximately 20 kilometers from Phnom Penh City.

Sinet has been driving a motor remoque taxi for six years, and his wife is a garment factory worker. A remoque is a motorcycle with a trailer attached at the back that is used to carry goods and people. Unhappily, his remoque is old and breaks down. It has disrupted his business, and he spends a lot of money to repair it very often. Hence, Sinet is asking for his first loan of $1,200 to buy a new remoque.
local_use: To buy a new motorbike and trailer

description:
Francisca is a 58 year old lady who dedicates her time to the sale of tortillas, tamales [a local dish made from maize stuffed with meat or vegetables, and cooked in banana leaves] and firewood. She lives in San Francisco Gotera, Morazán, where she lives with her mother and a grandson, who depend upon her financially. She sells tortillas morning and evening, the tamales three times per week, and the firewood everyday, selling it from her home. Today Francisca is seeking a loan to purchase what she needs to make her products, including maize, firewood, chicken and vegetables. With this loan she will buy stock up on ingredients, because when she buys in quantity she can get things cheaper - especially maize-flour and firewood, which will not spoil. This will help improve her earnings so that she can feed her family. Francisca's goal is to be able to give her grandson an education, so that he can do well for himself and have a better quality of life.

Translated from Spanish by Rosa Oswald, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To purchase materials - maize and firewood

description:
Fenehasi is a 30-year-old man living in Fort Portal, Uganda. He is the father to two children, 4 and 2 years old. He lives in a rented house and dreams of having stable family finances one day.

Fenehasi operates a motorcycle transport business and has been in the business for the last three years. He says it is sometimes difficult for his business with bad weather and theft fears being hindering factors.

Fenehasi intends to use the loan to buy another motorcycle for his transport business.
local_use: To buy another motorcycle for his transport business

description:
Patrick is a young man of 26, married with two children aged 4 and 2 years old. He lives with his family of four people in Fort Portal, Uganda. He says he hopes to have a better standard of living in the future for his family. 

Patrick is in the transport business and has been in it for the last seven years starting right after school. This is Patrick’s first cycle loan from HOFOKAM and he intends to use the loan proceeds to buy a car for transport business for income generation.
local_use: Buying a car for transport business

description:
Mr. Oscar is 44 years old, lives in the Jiquilisco department of Usulután and makes a living selling seafood.  He lives with his wife, his children and two nephews.  His children are between the ages of 15 and 25.  Don Oscar has been in the shrimp and fish business for 3 years, working at this on weekends.  During the week he is a painter and his wife sells tamales every day of the week. These are the sources of income for this household.

He is wanting to invest in his business and for this is requesting a loan.  He wants to buy large quantities of seafood because the upcoming season is good for sales and he wants to make sure that he can meet the demand.  This way he will increase his sales and improve the income for his family.
He dreams of growing his business day by day and improve the opportunities for his family.
local_use: Purchase seafood for resale.

description:
Sra. Martha Angelina S. García is 24 years old and has three young children. She says that she started an ice cream business six years ago.

Doña Martha plans to buy more ingredients for making her own ice cream since she produces what she sells. She hopes to move forward with this loan since this business is her only source of income. Martha is able to support her family since her husband’s income is not enough. She is grateful for the support from FAPE and Kiva.
local_use: Purchase ingredients used in making ice cream

description: Peter is twenty years old and a hard-working man living in his own house in Fort Portal, Uganda, with a dream of seeing his siblings educated. He has a retail shop and drugstore with an experience of two years in these businesses which have facilitated his earning money for the family. Peter intends to use the loan to buy soap, sugar and tea leaves to sell in his shop.
local_use: Purchasing soap, sugar and tea leaves for sale

description:
Bernardino, 65, lives in Puerto Díaz, an area 15 kilometers outsider of Juigalpa, with his wife and his three adult children who help him with the daily chores.  He is a lake fisherman.  He sells his catch in Juigalpa and also earns income as a bricklayer.  He owns a power saw that he also uses cutting lumber to earn still more income to support his family and move his wife and children ahead in life.

He is asking for a Kiva loan to replace the zinc metal sheeting on his kitchen’s roof to prepare for next year’s winter that is approaching.

He dreams with providing his family with better living conditions.
local_use: To buy zinc metal sheeting to replace his kitchen's roof.

description: James is a thirty-two-year-old man living in Fort Portal, Uganda, married with five children and living in his own semi-permanent house, with the desire to own a permanent house for residence before the age of forty. He has been in the motorcycle transport business for seven years now and he still finds it worth dealing in. Nevertheless he wishes to own at least five motorcycles on the road. James needs the loan to buy a motorcycle.
local_use: Buying a motorcycle

description:
Yolanda sells beach clothing and beach balls. She is 28 years old and lives in San Miguel where she lives with her aunt. She is a single mother of one daughter. She works on her own from 7:00 a.m. until 6:00 p.m. At the time being she does not have other competition to her business and she wants to invest in merchandise to offer her customers. 

She needs a loan to invest in merchandise such as shorts, shirts and beach balls because after the holidays after Christmas people visit the beaches and for Yolanda it is advantageous to have adequate clothing items to sell during these days. Her goals are to have the inventory to serve her customers in a good way, to generate income to help her daughter and to some day be able to build her own home.
local_use: Purchase shorts, shirts and beach balls.

description: Annet is a thirty-two-year-old single mother of two children.  She lives in a rented house in Fort Portal Uganda.  She has aspirations of building a permanent house for her residence and educating her children. She sells fire wood and has been in this business for three years, reaping commendable profits amidst challenges in transport costs.  Annet intends to use the loan to buy firewood for sale.
local_use: To buy firewood for sale

description:
José lives in Santiago de María, in the Usulután department. He lives with his family, and he has three children, aged 18, 14 and 7, who depend on him economically. José runs a shop and a bakery, an activity he started at 17 years old; he works there Mondays to Sundays from very early in the morning. José is 57 years old.
The loan he is requesting at the moment will be used to buy products such as rice, oil, beans, sugar, soda drinks, bread, juices, soap and milk: these are the items his customers request the most, and this loan will precisely help him buying and offering them to his customers, thus increasing his business potential.
He aims to own a large shop and to have a good customers turnout; he also wishes for his children to continue their studies and do better in life.
local_use: To buy rice, oil, beans, sugar, soda drinks, bread, juices, soap and milk.

description:
Marcial lives in his parents' home in Pacata Baja.  He is a painter.  He started in this business at a very young age as an assistant.  He is now an expert painter and contractor who provides interior and exterior decorating services.  This is his main source of income.

Marcial needs this loan to increase his capital so that he can do his work and buy new scaffolding.  Marcial is very satisfied with the institution and with his Kiva loan.  He is a very hard-working and responsible man and in the future he would like to get married and start a family.  However, right now he is working to save so that he can start to hire staff to paint houses.
local_use: To buy scaffolding for painting buildings

description: Mrs. Jeanette has worked in the production and selling of bread for a year. She is currently single but contributes to her family's household costs, and also to her siblings' education costs. She currently lives in her parents' home. The bread is baked by a baker whom she hires, and she personally attends to the sales. Previously she did the baking and did not have much time for selling. Now she has many customers. She is requesting this loan to purchase supplies for baking bread, as the prices are continually increasing. Thus, she wants to stock up on these items and buy in bulk. She is a very hard-working youth and is profoundly grateful for the support offered.
local_use: the purchase of tools for making bread

description: Enid, a 28-year-old married mother of two children, rents a house in Kasese, Uganda. In the drug shop business for three years, she started her enterprise with capital of one million shillings and eventually expanded to five million. Her main hardship is debtors, and her vision is to have a pharmacy. Enid needs the loan to purchase additional drugs for the business.
local_use: To purchase drugs for her business

description:
Bright, 31 years old, is a hard-working married man with two children. The family lives in their own house in Fort Portal, Uganda.

Bright has been selling firewood for four years now, and with this business he has been able to provide the basics for his family. Bright is requesting a loan to purchase more firewood to sell.
local_use: To purchase firewood to sell

description: Stephen is a 31-year-old married man and a father of four children. He lives in a rented house in Kyenjojo, Uganda. He is a teacher  by profession and his dream is to become a principal of an institution. He is currently studying at the university. Stephen needs the loan to pay school fees for himself and his children.
local_use: Paying school fees

description: Rehema is a thirty-three year-old married woman, with six children.  She owns a house in Kasese, Uganda.  She has been dealing in secondhand clothes for the last eight years.  She saved money from goat-rearing and started the clothes business. Her hardships include losses during the rainy season and high rent.   Rehema needs the loan to buy more clothes to sell.
local_use: To buy clothes to sell.

description: Sonia Elizabeth is married.  She has three children, two of whom live with her in her own home.  They live in a very quiet community.  Sonia started out selling shoes as she inherited that business from her family when she was 15 years old.  She later set up a beauty salon and gave classes in a private school.  Sonia also had a store but she closed it because it was more convenient to travel to the border with Mexico and buy Mexican products.  She currently sells shoes on a weekend in her local market.  Sonia is requesting a loan from FAPE because she has a lot of orders this season but doesn't have enough merchandise to fill her orders.
local_use: To buy footwear wholesale

description: Maritza is 36 years old, is separated, and lives with her two children in a house she owns. She has ten years of experience selling Mexican products which she sells in her home and as a street vendor. Martiza also has a cleaning a multi-services business (cleaning, electricity, and construction) and works at city hall in Puerto D. San Jose. Her goal is to expand her business of Mexican products which is why she is asking for this loan as she would like to buy groceries. Her dream is to give her children a good education and be able to see them become professionals.
local_use: Compra de productos comestibles

description: Edreda is a 39-year-old married woman with seven children. She owns a house in Kasese, Uganda. She has been in the clothing business for the last seven years. She began by selling door-to-door but later put up her own stall. Her hardship is the high taxes and her vision is to create a wholesale business. Edreda needs the loan to buy clothes for resale.
local_use: to buy clothes for resale

description:
Marleni lives in Corinto of the Morazan department. She sells fruits. She is 37 years old and the single mother of Rosaura, 17, Blanca, 16, Luis Antonio 15, Teresa, 14, Maribel, 13, Jose Maria 9, and Sandra, 7.

Marleni's business is to sell fruits and vegetables. She has several years in the business and it provides her with a source of income to provide her children with what they need. She looks after them every day in the city of Corinto. Currently she requires a loan to purchase fruits and vegetables with the goal of strengthening her business. 

Her dream is to support her many children, to send them to school, and to manage her business every day. She hopes to make many sales to be able to save and to not have her family want for anything.
local_use: To purchase fruits and vegetables.

description:
Mirian is an enterprising, hard working woman living in Cusco.  She’s 41 years old, married and has three children.  She is a manual arts teacher and works at “Pukllasuchis” School.  She’s been working at the school for three years now.  She also has a small business selling crafts for social events like weddings, baptisms and confirmations.  She tells us that she makes her crafts in a small workshop she set up at home. Mirian also has a small business selling chickens.

Mirian has been a member of Asociación Arariwa’s “Inti” communal bank for several years.  She needs the loan to buy chickens.  (Inti is a Quechua work that means Sun).

Mirian is grateful for the opportunity provided by this means and commits to repay in a timely fashion.
local_use: To buy chickens.

description:
Morine is a single mother of three children living in Hioma, Uganda. She is the only breadwinner in the family. She lives in a rented home and her family goal is to buy a house for her children.  

For three years Morine has been running a beauty salon business that she started from savings she had made from selling food items. She faces the challenge of customers who don’t pay. Her business dream is to own a beauty parlor. 

Morine needs the loan to buy synthetic hair and hair sprays for her salon.
local_use: To purchase synthetic hair and hair sprays for the salon.

description: Jonathan is a 31-year-old, hard-working man looking after 2 dependents living in a rented house in Fort Portal, Uganda. For 5 years he has been riding a motorcycle (taxi) and operating a retail shop. With the income generated, he has been able to support the family. He started with riding customers and later bought a motorcycle. His future plan is to own a wholesale business. Jonathan needs the loan to buy sugar, soap and salt for his shop.
local_use: To buy sugar, soap and salt to sell

description: Jackline is a thirty-year-old married woman with three children living in her own  permanent house in Fort Portal, Uganda. She is charged with the responsibility of looking after her children with the help of her husband and her desire is to educate them up to university. For five years she has been in the retail trade and she got her initial capital from her husband. Jackline needs the loan to buy cassava flour, cooking oil and maize flour to sell.
local_use: Buying cassava flour, cooking oil and maize flour to sell

description:
Orlando is a hard-working man, honest and responsible. He is married and his wife works as a merchant. He has been a farmer for a long time and started with the support of his parents. They taught him how to cultivate the land.

The main problem he faces is the price increase of agricultural inputs which he needs to maintain and protect his crop. His business plan is to improve the soil of his farm with the incorporation of fertilizers. He is requesting a loan for the purchase of fertilizers to yield a better harvest.
local_use: The purchase of fertilizers

description:
Oscar is 27 years old, and he lives with his wife and children in the Jiquilisco department of Usultan.  Oscar manages a cyber cafe, where he offers computerized services; he has been doing this work for two years since he finished his studies in computing.  He now has many clients, and he is recognized for his work by many members of the community.

Oscar is applying for this loan to purchase more computer equipment, materials such as CDs, USB cables, and also furnitre.  With this investment, Oscar will be able to better receive his clients, and he will have new machines available so that during times when he has a lot of clients he will be able to keep up with the work.  His goals are to improve his service to his clients, expand the physical space where his cafe is located, and maintain the equipment in the best possible condition. These improvements will strengthen his business and in turn will increase his family's income.
local_use: Purchase of equipment, CD, USB cables, and furniture.

description:
Edith lives in Usulután. She is 43 years old and lives with her daughter and grandchildren. She works selling tortillas. She has had this business for 12 years and with her daughter's help has been able to maintain this business. At this time, she needs to invest in purchasing corn, gas and firewood. That is why she is asking for a loan to make this investment. 

With this help, she will have raw material to get ahead in sales. She can also increase production, thus improving her income for her home. Edith's dreams are to stay active and enthusiatic with the business, and guaranteeing her daughter a better future for her grandchildren to grow.
local_use: To purchase corn, gas and firewood

description: Pisi is a thirty-year-old married woman with four children and owns a house in Kasese. She has been in charcoal sales for two years starting with a capital of 500,000 shillings but now it has reached 1,200,000 shillings. Her hardship is lack of enough customers and her vision is business expansion. Pisi intends to use the loan to buy charcoal for resale.
local_use: Buying charcoal for resale

description:
Perpetue M. is a 32-year-old business woman whi lives in the center of Nyanza in the commune Nyanza-Lac in the Makamba province in the south of Burundi. She sells food products such as fruits and vegetables, beans and fresh fish from the lake. She has done this for the past 8 years. She completed primary school up to 6th grade. She is married with 3 children, one of whom goes to school. She is on her 9th credit cycle with Turame Community Finance. 

She is asking for this Kiva loan in order to increase her capital and buy a lot of food products to sell to her clients in the hopes of increasing her savings et grow her business. She thanks Turame for giving loans to poor people since she has seen improvement in her quality of life since starting this business. She is a member of the Komezimbere Group.
local_use: accroitre son capital  en achetant beaucoup de produits alimentaires

description: Joyless is a thirty five year old divorced woman with seven children. She owns a house in Kasese,Uganda. She has been in a retail shop for five years. Her difficuty is limited capital and her vision is to become a wholesale trader. Joyless has requested the loan to buy supplies of sugar, salt , soap and rice.
local_use: To buy sugar, salt, soap and rice

description:
Frizelma is 32 years old, has a live-in partner and two children. She is a nurse by profession but has put her career on hold to look after her children who are still young and depend on her. She makes a living renting out her small house in the province of Apurímac. She would now like to do some work on her home in Cusco, where she actually lives, and this is why she is requesting a loan.
She is requesting a loan to do construction on her home.
She is grateful for the loan and is committed to making her payments on time.
local_use: Construction on her home

description:
Eris, 35, lives in Delicias de Concepción, Morazán Department, with his wife, Rut Elisa and two daughters who are 11 and 6 years of age.  He works for a telephone company repairing and installing cable and posts.  

He is asking for a loan to buy work equipment like shovels, bars, micro presses, drills and sanders.  These are the types of tools he needs for his daily work and having them at his disposal will make it possible for him to do his work better.

Eris’ goals are: to work hard in order to do some home improvements, to help his daughters with their schooling, to buy a car for personal and work use, and to stay together as a family striving toward self improvement.
local_use: to buy work tools.

description: This is 26-year-old Bilkisu. She is single, and has one child aged seven years. She has three additional dependents: her younger brothers and sister. In 2007, Bilkisu established her plastic slippers business. She began her business because she told by her friend that the slippers business is very interesting and profitable. She opens her business six days a week and 10 hours a day. She would like a loan of Le 3,000,000. Bilkisu needs this loan in order to purchase more plastic slippers. She thanks you for your support.
local_use: To buy more plastic slippers for her business.

description: Paul is a hardworking married man with two children living in his own semi-permanent house in Fort Portal Uganda. For two years he has been into poultry farming and the business has facilitated him in running the family. He has a challenge in the high cost of feed. His dream is to set up a shop of poultry feed. Paul needs the loan to buy poultry feed.
local_use: to buy poultry feed

description: Peter is a fifty-four-year-old married man with nine children living in Fort Portal, Uganda. He is involved in a number of activities such as farming, marketing, and training which have helped him in educating his children and meeting the family needs. He has challenges in raising sufficient funds to run his businesses and his desire is to become a commercial farmer. Peter needs the credit facility to cultivate land.
local_use: to use for cultivating land.

description: Rukia is a 36-year-old widow and a mother of four children living in her house in Hioma, Uganda. Her family goal is to pay fees for her children to attain a degree as a minimum qualification. For 6 years she has been operating a retail shop. The business is at its boom-stage despite challenges in price fluctuations. Rukia needs the loan to buy sugar and fresh foods to sell.
local_use: to buy sugar and fresh foods to sell

description: Sedrack is a 30-year-old married man with four children living in his own house in Fort Portal, Uganda. For six years, he has been operating a drug shop and with the proceeds he was able to buy land. He has challenges of limited drugs due to limited finances and his desire is to own a pharmacy. Sedrack needs the loan to buy drugs.
local_use: To buy drugs.

description:
Manuel, 39, lives in the Santa Elena Department of Usulután.  He lives with his wife and their children, who are 13 and 8.  They have their own house, and Manuel has a metal-structures workshop that he opened four years ago, although he's got sixteen years of experience.  He works from his own house, so he doesn't have a fixed work schedule.  

At present Manuel is seeking a loan to buy iron, electrodes, and spare parts for a soldering machine.  The investment will help him do faster, higher-quality work, providing better service to his clients.

Manuel's aspirations for the business are to make it bigger, and able to serve more customers, so he can improve his family's economic conditions.
local_use: to buy iron, electrodes, and spare parts for a soldering machine.

description:
Sudat is 27 years old and a single mother of one child living in her own house in Hioma, Uganda. 

She has no other dependents and her family goal is to be able to provide basic needs for her child. 

For three years she has been running a salon business and hopes that her salon will grow bigger and that she can relocate it to a better place. 

She needs the loan for buying weaves and a hair drier for her salon.
local_use: to pay for weaves and a hair drier for her salon

description: Reina is a 23 year old young woman who lives in San Francisco Gotera, Morazán with her husband and two children.  She sells tortillas and fish four times a week in a mobile cart.  She has requested a loan to invest in fish as she wants to stay in business but does not have enough cash to make the purchase.  She dreams of her children growing up healthy, to work hard and provide for a more hopeful future so that they can study to better themselves.
local_use: To purchase fish

description:
Mrs. Ysabel is 44 years old, single and has a 10 year old son. She works in dressmaking and handicrafts. She does different kinds of work with fabrics and the embroidery of slippers. She is also a cook at the hospital which provides some extra money.

She needs the loan from our institution to buy a new sewing machine because her old one broke recently. She has good credit history, is an old member with on time payments and resides at a known address. She is a hard working person who appreciates the support given by the institution.
local_use: to buy sewing machine and increase capital

description:
Constantino's business is providing an urban transport service.  He has been in this business for eight years.  Constantino is 44 years old and lives in Plan 3000 neighborhood.  He has two school-age children in his care as he separated from his wife five years ago and he supports his family.  One of his children is in high school and the other helps him with the jobs that he acquires throughout the month.

Constantino's work hours are from 7.00pm to 8.00am.  During the day he supervises his children's education and also makes weights which he delivers to gyms near his home.  Constantino currently needs a loan to buy new tires for his vehicle which is his main work tool.  He is a very responsible person who is grateful to the institution for the support they have offered him.
local_use: to buy tires

description:
Carlos is a CD and DVD salesman.  He lives in Santiago de María, in Usulután department, with his wife and two children aged 14 and 6.  He owns his own business which he set up 10 years ago.  His business is located in the town market and he works there from 7.00am to 5.00pm.

Right now, Carlos would like to invest in his business, buying a variety of CDs and DVDs.  He is requesting a loan to cover this expense and he will work and make all his loan repayments.  This investment is very much needed.  His business must remain well stocked so that his customers can find what they need.

Carlos aspires to expand his business, gain more skills and become more financially solvent.  He take care of his children's needs and prepare them for the future.
local_use: to buy a variety of CDs and DVDs

description:
38-year old Ana Luz and her children aged 2 and 8 live in the department of Berlín in Usulután. She earns her living selling footwear. The business is her own and is located in the municipal market of Berlín. She started it four years ago and works there from 7am to 4pm.

Ana Luz is seeking a loan so she can put her business on a stronger footing. She wishes to buy a batch of children’s and adults’ shoes of different types such as dress shoes, runners, and sandals. 

This loan is very important to her as she will have what her customers need and thus increase sales. Her goal as a businesswoman is to serve her customers well and attend to their needs so that she can be sure of having enough income to support her family.
local_use: to buy dress shoes, runners, and sandals.

description: Irene is a twenty-nine-year-old married woman with four children and  she owns a house in Kasese,Uganda. She has been dealing in second-hand clothes for six years and the business is growing steadily. Her hardship is thieves who often break into the shop and  her vision is to relocate to a more secure arcade and become a wholesaler. Irene needs the loan facility to buy clothes for resale.
local_use: To buy used clothes for resale.

description: Slyvia is a twenty-five year old married woman with three children, and she owns a house in Kasese, Uganda. She has been dealing in produce for the last three years and with income generated she has been able to pay school fees for her children. Her hardship is lack of enough capital and her plan is to grow food on a large scale, build a  permanent house and educate her children. Sylvia needs a loan to buy beans and firewood to sell.
local_use: to buy beans and firewood to sell.

description:
Roxana diagnoses and treats diabetes with natural medicine.  She and her husband patented these natural products and have been treating people for more than eight years.  Their children also work in this field.  Their eldest son is in his final year of medical school and he is a great help to the business, which generates an income.  They have plenty of documentation that accredits their products.  They live in their own home.

They will use the money from this loan to buy supplies and some plants to make their treatments.  She is grateful to the institution for its backing.
local_use: to buy supplies

description:
Zoila owns a business where she sells household essentials.  She lives with her husband and two children in Concepción Batres, in Usulután department.  Zoila set up her business, together with her husband, through her own initiative.  She works from 6.00am to 7.00pm and her children help her out in the store.

Zoila is requesting a loan to buy merchandise, especially pasta, sauces, rice, beans and oil.  This purchase will allow her to increase her stock and have available the merchandise her customers need.

Zoila's goals are to stock her business with the merchandise that is in most demand, to better serve her customers and to guarantee financial solvency for her family.
local_use: to buy pasta, sauces, rice, beans and oil

description: Maria Olivia is 23 years old.  She is a single mother and has two dependent children.  Maria Oliva started selling spare parts in her home in the mornings.  She then decided to buy a bundle of used clothing.  She gradually increased her profits.  She bought a 100 pound bundle and managed to hire a sales location near her home from which she currently sells her products.  She tells us that she has been in this business for four years.  She is requesting this loan to buy a bundle of used clothing and to hire an additional sales location.  In this way, she will be able to provide her children with what they need so that, they will enjoy a future of opportunities and become professionals.
local_use: to buy a bundle of used clothing and to hire a sales location

description: Ruth lives in Delicias de Concepción in the department of Morazán.  She makes and sells hammocks.  She is 30 years old, and lives with her husband and two children who are 4 and 11 years old.  She makes hammocks and wallets and embroiders blankets.  The business is 5 years old.  She is asking for a loan to make improvements to her house.  With the money, she will pay off the introduction of potable water.  This will be of great help in improving the quality of life of her and her family.  Ruth's aspiration is to improve her house so that her children can apply themselves to studying and become professionals.
local_use: to pay for the introduction of potable water in her house.

description:
Elvin lives in San Francisco Gotera in Morazán Department.  He sells beverages.  He’s single living with his mother and works to help his parents with household costs.  He sells natural beverages and soft drinks.

He started this business with the aim of helping his parents.  To date, the business has been profitable and he only has to continuously invest the necessary resources in it for the natural beverages.

He needs a loan to buy fruit like melon, apples and pineapple and to buy sugar and soft drinks.  This investment will help him to produce natural beverages always.

His dream is to continue growing in his business as a micro businessman until achieving a well established business.
local_use: to buy fruit like melon, apples and pineapple and to buy sugar and soft drinks.

description:
Blanca lives in Usulután. She produces and sells tortillas and tamales. She lives in her own house with her husband and two nephews aged 15 and 8. She sells tortillas every day, while she sells tamales four times a week only.
She is requesting a loan to buy basic ingredients such as maize, chicken, dressings, vegetables and firewood. This purchase will help her buying the necessary goods to keep on producing tortillas and tamales.
The improvement of her activity is paramount for Blanca, as her family is economically dependent on her job.
local_use: To buy basic ingredients such as maize, chicken, dressing, vegatable and firewood.

description:
Valeria is a longstanding client of the institution and has shown good willingness to pay and kind and courteous behavior during the evaluation that was done on her.

She sells comforter and blankets on Saturdays and Sundays in the heavily populated 16 de Julio zone of El Alto, Bolivia.  She starts work around 5pm.  She delivers her products on credit to party centers that are common in this area and collects payment the next day for completed sales.

From Monday through Friday she works sewing comforters for a private micro firm; she’s been doing this for about 5 years.  Because of this, Valeria has the necessary experience to start this new activity.  Her spouse is employed at a cured meats firm so he contributes to family income.

The loan money will be used to buy fabric because Valeria wants to make comforters to sell.  The efforts they put into having better living conditions is constant.  The family’s greatest wish is to have a stable patrimony so that their children can have professional careers.  They struggle daily to attain this end.
local_use: to buy fabric and fleece to make comforters.

description: Bibisha is a thirty-four-year-old divorced woman with four children, and she rents a house in Kasese, Uganda. The responsibility to look after the family  rests solely on her. Her desire is to educate her children up to University. After divorcing from her husband she realized that the only way to support her family was to sell fish since it has a ready market, and she is proud of her decision. She has been selling dry fish for five years with minimal hardships. Her vision is to be a big supplier plus building her own house. Bibisha needs the loan to buy fish for resale.
local_use: to buy fish for resale.

description: Jane, a 33-year-old divorced woman with four children, rents a house in Kasese, Uganda. She has been dealing in fresh foods for nine months. She started her business with 300,000 UGX and now has 600,000 UGX as working capital. Her hardship is low sales. Her vision is to own a food store and to buy a plot of land in town. Jane needs this loan to buy fresh foods to sell.
local_use: To buy fresh foods to sell.

description:
Cándida is 36 years old.  She is a widow and has two children aged 18 and 12.  She runs a store in which she works full time because her customers come to buy her products at all hours.  She sells basic household products such as bread, snacks, cookies, drinks, etc.

Cándida is requesting a loan so that she can buy merchandise and thereby strengthen her inventory.  She will buy detergents, soap, sugar, corn, beans and rice.  This investment will strengthen her business and she will be able to offer her customers much needed products.

Cándida's goals are to expand her business and see her children become professionals.  She would also like to make some improvements to her home.  For this reason, she works hard to keep her business going.
local_use: to buy merchandise: detergents, soap, sugar, corn, beans and rice

description: Dibaldo is a young, single man who buys, raises, and sells livestock (pigs). It is very important to know that to our satisfaction he works to achieve his goals and he gets up whenever life sends an obstacle, all with the goal of acquiring enough of an income to help his parents. As a second source of income and to cover his personal expenses, Dibaldo works as a taxi driver in the afternoons. It is thanks to this loan granted by the institution that he will be able to purchase construction materials to put up a corral fence for his livestock. He is a very hardworking person and he is thankful to the institution for the support they provide.
local_use: to purchase construction material to set up a corral.

description:
Ana lives with her husband and their two children, who are 25 and 16 years old. Ana is a seamstress. She studied tailoring and then decided to set up her own business, which she runs from 6 in the morning till 7 in the evening.
Ana currently needs to do some maintenance on her sewing machines, and she's requesting a loan to cover the expense so her machines will be in perfect working order.
Ana's goal is to have her whole workshop in good condition, the machines and all her other tools, so she can offer her customers great service.
local_use: to pay for maintaining her sewing machines.

description: Edward is a thirty-seven year-old married man with five children.  He rents a house in Kasese, Uganda. He has been buying and selling coffee for ten years.  He started with capital of 300,000 shillings and now has 8,000,000 shillings. His challenge is bad quality of coffee, which normally leads to losses. His dream is to own a coffee store, to construct a house, and to educate his children.  Edward needs the loan to buy coffee to sell.
local_use: to buy coffee tosell

description: Daphine is a thirty eight year old married woman with three children living in her own permanent house in Fort Portal, Uganda. For ten years she has been selling second hand clothes, which has facilitated her in paying school fees for her children. She has challenges of natural hazards since she operates in the open. Her desire is to rent a sheltered business premise. Daphine needs the loan to buy clothes for sale.
local_use: To buy clothes for sale

description:
Sonia sells clothes and also scrap metal (iron and unusable sheets of metal).  She owns her own home and lives with her husband and her two children aged 14 and 4.  She started her scrap metal business four years ago, buying and selling.  She buys her products by traveling around requesting scraps of iron which she then sells on at a good price.  This business has allows her to make income for her family.

Sonia needs a loan to buy iron, brass, copper and aluminum.  This is the scrap that she buys and she needs to have cash available in order to obtain it.  This will help her to make more sales and sell at a good price.

Sonia's aspirations are to own a strong business, sell her products, make better profits and improve her family's way of life.
local_use: to buy iron, brass, copper and aluminum

description: Jael is a 30-year-old single woman with two children. She lives in Kasese, Uganda. Jael has been in the salon business for ten years. She dreams of having a high class salon and educating her children. As a single mother, she says it is always a difficult task bringing up the children alone. However, through her hard work, Jael feels that she can make it. She intends to use the loan facility to buy cosmetics for her salon business.
local_use: To buy cosmetics

description: Tinah is 27 years old and married with three children. Tina has four dependents that she takes care of. She lives in a house with nine people in Hoima, Uganda.  For three years, Tinah has been running a retail shop selling cosmetics and hair braids. The shop was opened for her by her husband and from it, she has been able to educate her children and earn a living for the family. Tinah faces the challenges of the business being seasonal and a high rate of default from her clients, but hopes for a wholesale bridal and cosmetics shop. Tinah is requesting a loan to purchase hair weaves, braids, cosmetics, bags and shoes to sell.
local_use: To purchase cosmetics, hair braids, weaves and bags

description:
George is a 51-year-old Ugandan who hails from Kyenjojo, Uganda. He is a coffee farmer who is married with six children aged between 25 and 16 years. He lives in a semi-permanent house. He faces a problem of pests and diseases – and expensive pesticides. George has been in this business for 20 years. He began by planting coffee on a small scale – working around one acre. From that he accumulated capital to start a local brew business. In the future, he wants to sell better coffee and have a good nursery bed.
George wants a loan to buy manure and spray his coffee plantation.
local_use: to buy manure and spray his coffee plantation.

description:
Violet is a 37-year-old single woman with two children living in Fort Portal, Uganda. She has been in the restaurant business for eight years. Having started with meager resources, Violet notes that her business has registered some growth over the years. Her main challenge in the business is price fluctuations of foodstuffs, which, in turn, affects her yield from the business. Violet's dream is to build rental houses so as to boost her income.
Violet needs a loan facility in order to buy more crates of beers and sodas to sell at her restaurant.
local_use: to buy crates of soda and beer to sell at her restaurant.

description:
Señora Virginia is a 63-year-old woman and she is a very enterprising person. She lives with two of her children. A year ago she lost her husband and has had to move forward. She is a very active person.

With this loan she will invest in the purchase of merchandise to supply her shop as the busy season is approaching and she needs to stock up. She has had several loans with the foundation, maintaining a good payment history with each of them.

Her goal is to expand her business and install a photocopier. She gets up at six in the morning and does her household tasks after which she opens the shop at 8 and closes at 8. With this loan she will be able to supply her shop and have more working capital to continue working and subsidize her expenses.
local_use: to buy articles for the home, jewelry, and school supplies.

description: Wilson is a 40-year-old married man with five children living in his own house in Fort Portal, Uganda. He has a dream of educating his children up to university. Wilson deals in the sale of fresh foods and has operated this business for seven years now. His main challenge is the ever increasing transport costs and his desire is to own more food stalls in different markets. Wilson intends to use this loan to buy bananas to sell.
local_use: to buy bananas to sell.

description:
Natividad lives with her husband and 24-year old son. She has a sewing business which she runs from her house. She learned about sewing in a dressmaking workshop. Natividad’s hours of work are from 7am to 6pm, and even longer when she has a lot of orders.

She is seeking a loan so she can buy different kinds of material in a range of colours, and notions such as buttons, zippers, and snap fasteners. She also needs spare parts for her sewing machines. With the loan money she will be able to buy what is needed for her business and better respond to her customers’ requests.

Natividad’s main goals are to expand her business, be self-sufficient, and succeed in paying off her loans so that she can earn more money and help her family.
local_use: to buy material and notions such as buttons, zippers, and snap fasteners

description:
María sells tortillas.  She’s 31 years old and lives with her mother and siblings.  She’s been selling for the last five years.  She works every day of the week.  The business has made it possible for her to cover all her needs.

At present, she requests a loan to buy corn.  This loan will be of great help to her because she’ll be able to buy the basic grains for her sales at wholesale and being able to get them at wholesale means a better price.  María’s objective is to work as much as possible to save up in order to form her own family.
local_use: to buy corn to make tortillas.

description: Rodgers is a 33-year-old Ugandan man who needs a loan to buy timber and bananas to sell. He is from Kyenjojo district and is married with four children aged between 13 and 6 years. He lives in a semi-permanent house with 6 people and his dream is to educate his children and buy land to farm. He deals in timber and banana trading and got his start-up capital from growing beans and maize. He is faced with the problem of banana price fluctuations. In future he wants to acquire machines to cut timber and start up a carpentry workshop.
local_use: To buy timber and bananas to sell

description: Ezra, 38, is a married man with four children who owns a house in Kasese, Uganda. He has been in the coffee business for fifteen years and having started with 100,000 shillings, he now has 10,000,000 shillings in working capital. His hardship is prolonged in the rainy season, as it affects the drying period. His dream is to own a coffee store so as to export to other countries. Ezra needs the loan to buy coffee for resale.
local_use: to buy coffee for resale.

description: Melany is married and has 4 adult children.  She is 40 years old.  Six years ago she began selling food from her home.  She then rented space to sell snacks, breakfast, and lunch, and later decided to sell basic foodstuffs as well.  She requests this loan to buy basic foodstuffs.  Her dream is to give her children a better future and be financially well off.
local_use: to buy food products.

description: Robert is a 27-year-old married man with two children living in a rented house in Fort Portal, Uganda. His dream is to buy land to build a commercial house. Robert sells used clothing. He has been doing so for four years now. His main challenge is irregular sales and constant price increases. Despite this, he longs to set up a boutique in town. He needs a loan to buy used clothing to sell.
local_use: To buy used clothing to sell

description:
Eric is a 41-year-old married man with five children living in a residential permanent house in Fort Portal, Uganda.

His family dream is to buy a plot in a town so that he can build and expand his foods store.

Eric has been a farmer for 10 years, and the sector has been beneficial since it has facilitated him in paying school fees for his children. His main challenge is the high cost of transporting his agricultural products and a lack of modern equipment to handle fresh products; nonetheless, he dreams of becoming the leading supplier of fresh foods in the region.

Eric needs the loan to clear land for next season's planting.
local_use: To clear for next season's planting.

description:
Concepcion is 28 years old and she lives together with her three children and her husband. She sells hammocks and she has been in business for 8 years. It is a permanent source of income for the household. 

She requests a loan to purchase silk threads in various colors to make hammocks. This investment will be a great help to help her increase the production volume and sales.

Her aspiration is to increase the sale of hammocks to generate more income. This will help to offer her children with greater comfort and to one day have a house of her own.
local_use: to purchase silk threads of different colors to make hammocks.

description:
Doreen is a 26-year-old single mother of two children living in a rented house in Fort Portal, Uganda.The responsibility for looking after the family rests on her and her dream is to see her children attain degrees since she did not have a chance to do that.

She owns a boutique and she has been in business for five years. Her desire is to own a wholesale textile shop despite challenges with limited funds and  high cost of rent.

Doreen intends to use the loan to buy clothes for resale.
local_use: To buy clothes for resale.

description:
Mary is a thirty-three-year-old married woman with four children. She owns a house in Kasese, Uganda. 

She has been selling cassava flour for seven years, starting the business with the money she had saved from farming. Her hardships are high transport costs and bad debtors. Her vision is to diversify and trade in maize and beans, and to educate her children.
local_use: To buy cassava flour

description: Joan is 34 years old, single and has four children who range in age from two to 18. She owns a home in the town of Hioma, Uganda and has for the last three years earned a living by selling cosmetics. She started her business with 2.5 million Ugandan shillings but her business is now worth more than six million. Her main challenge is high rents, which is why she is determined to eventually own her own store. She is applying for this loan to buy more cosmetics to sell to her customers.
local_use: to buy more cosmetics to sell to her customers.

description:
Grace is a 39 year-old single lady with 3 children, living in her own house in Fort Portal, Uganda.  Grace deals in selling both new and used clothes and has been in this business for three years now. Her major challenge is the untrustworthy customers who fail to pay for clothes taken, and her dream is to own a boutique.

Grace needs the loan to buy new clothes for resale.  Her dream is to get her children into good schools to get the best education.
local_use: To buy new clothes for resale.

description:
Mrs Djénéba is married and a mother of four. Her eldest is 18 and her youngest is four. Three of the children attend school. She has seven dependents in total.

She has been selling children's clothing, clutch bags for ladies and chains with pendants for three years. In parallel, she sells condiments. She gets her supplies from the sector 10 market. Her customers are her friends, some neighbors, and local service agents.

She wants to purchase 1 bundle of clothing for children, three dozen of chains with pendants and one dish of dried okra.

With her profits, she wants to help her husband with the family's expenses. She ambitions to open a department store and to contribute to her children's schooling.
local_use: buy one bundle of children's clothes, three dozen of chains with pendants and one dish of dried okra.

description: Iveth lives with her son and is married.  She receives support from her husband, who is a policeman.  Iveth has worked as an employee of the local city hall for the past 17 months.  She is hardworking and committed to supporting her son.  Iveth seeks this credit in order to pay off debts that she simply cannot pay off with her monthly salary alone.  This will allow her to achieve financial solvency and live with peace of mind.
local_use: to cover personal expenses and pay off debts

description:
Justine is 28 years old and she is the sole bread winner for a family of three living in Hioma, Uganda. For three years she has been selling new clothes. With the income generated she has been able to increase her stock and pay school fees for her younger sister. 

She has limited funds to meet the different tastes of her customers and her desire is to own a boutique. Justine needs a loan to buy clothes to sell.
local_use: To buy clothes to sell.

description: Obita is a trader who sells produce. He has eight children, aged between 16 to 35 and lives in his own house with six rooms in Hioma, Uganda. For five years, Obita has been dealing in the sale of rice and groundnuts. His ambition is to buy a vehicle and run a mobile business. He faces a challenge in the high transport costs to market centers. Obita needs this loan to buy rice and groundnuts for resale.
local_use: to buy rice and groundnuts for resale.

description: Alex, 31, is a married man with four children living in a permanent house with his family in Fort Portal, Uganda. His dream is to buy a big piece of land and start up a ranch. He operates a boutique which mainly sells suits. He has been in business for four years. His major challenge is the high rate of inflation which affects demand. His dream is to set up a fashion house. Alex needs the loan to buy clothes for resale.
local_use: to buy clothes for resale.

description:
Fidel lives with his wife and two children, ages 10 and 8. He is employed but also grows corn and beans. He works as a promoter of social projects for his municipality but he is also a farmer in his free time and does agricultural tasks. 
He wants to use his loan to buy fertilizer thereby strengthening his fields and guaranteeing good development and production.
His goal is for his children to feel they have his support so they will do well in their studies and excel in the future.
local_use: to buy fertilizer for his crops.

description:
José lives with his wife and two dependent children. He sells tires for vehicles and metal structures. José started this business after he studied auto mechanics and learned everything about the trade. His business is open from 8am to 5pm and he has been providing his services for the past three years.

This loan will be invested in the purchase of an order of tires to help resolve this situation. As a result, José will be able to offer better service to his customers. His aspiration is to see his children learn the business and specialize in a trade so that they can fend for themselves by having a job.
local_use: to pay for an order of tires.

description: Selvesta is a Ugandan male, age 67 years, who needs a loan to buy timber for his workshop. He hails from Kyenjojo district, is the father of eight children, and he lives in his own house. He is a carpenter who dreams of acquiring a well furnished carpentry workshop and educating his children. Selvesta is a member of the above mentioned group where by policy each member guarantees the others in accessing credit facilities.
local_use: To buy timber for his workshop.

description: Paul wants a loan to buy alcohol for resale. He is a Ugandan male, aged 29 years, and hails from the Kyenjojo district. He lives in a semi-permanent house. The responsibility of looking after the family solely rests on him, and his desire is to diversify and set up a wholesale shop.
local_use: To buy alcohol for resale.

description:
Isaac is a 30-year-old married man with five children, and he owns a house in Kasese, Uganda. The responsibility of looking after the family is vested in him, and his desire is to educate his children up to university. 

He has been operating a retail shop for three years, and business is still booming. His hardships are debtors and high transport costs and his vision is having a large-scale retail shop and a poverty-free and educated family.

Isaac needs the loan to buy salt, sugar, soap and soda for resale.
local_use: To buy salt, sugar, soap and soda for resale.

description: Brenda is a 26-year-old married woman with one child and she rents a house in Kasese, Uganda. She takes care of the family with the help of her husband who is a businessman. She has been in the retail shop business for two years and she used her monthly salary as a teacher to start up her current business. Her hardship is bad debtors and her vision is a wholesale business plus educating children. Brenda wants the loan to buy sugar and soap to sell.
local_use: To buy sugar and soap to sell.

description: Julius is a thirty-year-old married man with four children and he owns a house in Kasese, Uganda. The responsibility to look after the family is vested in him and his dream is to educate all his children up to University. He has been in the bakery business for one year  and he got his initial capital from the profits he had made from his retail shop. His hardship  is limited funds to meet the different tastes of his customers and his dream is a modern bakery. Julius needs the loan facility to buy wheat and baking powder.
local_use: To buy wheat and baking powder.

description:
Ivan wants a loan to mulch his banana plantation. He is a Ugandan male aged 33, living in Kyenjojo, Uganda. He is a banana grower and he started with an acre of banana plantings, and now has five acres.

The responsibility to look after the family rests on him, and his dream is to buy a pickup to transport his matooke (green bananas) and educating his children.
local_use: to mulch his banana plantation

description: Steven is a 35-year-old man with three children living in his own house in Fort Portal, Uganda. The responsibility of looking after the family falls on him and his desire is to educate his children up to university. For six years he has been operating a retail shop despite the challenges of the current inflation rate, and his dream is to trade in wholesale. Steven needs the loan to buy soap and sugar to sell.
local_use: to buy soap and sugar to sell.

description:
Mme Paul Eva is married and the mother of three children. The oldest is 16 and the youngest is 13. All three go to school. She is responsible for four persons. 

She has been selling "bissaps" (hibiscus flowers), iced water, and "teedo" (a local drink in Burkina) for 10 years. She buys her supplies in Yaar de Pissy (a neighborhood in Ouagadougou). She sells in schools and churches. 

She wants to buy one sack of "bissaps",  one sack of "teedo" (monkey bread) and 50 kg of sugar. 

With her profit, she will help pay the water and electricity bills, and she plans to save the rest. She would like to be able to be responsible for her children's school fees and expand her business.
local_use: to buy one sack of "bissaps" (dried hibiscus flowers used to flavor drinks), one sack of "teedo" (monkey bread) and 50 kg of sugar.

description:
Javier lives with his wife and 3 children who are 6, 12 and 15 years of age. He works as school minibus driver, picking up school students from 6:00 am until 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. He has been doing this work for several years and the students' parents have monthly contracts with him.

He will use the loan for the maintenance of his minibus, paying the mechanic for installing shocks, making an oil change and a number plate change. This loan will be very useful to Javier as with the funds he can count on a form of transport that has been fully reviewed by a mechanic and he will have his papers in order for the change of number plates.

Javier's dream is to have several minibuses in order to make more income so that his family can have a better life and a better quality of life.
local_use: to pay a mechanic for installing shocks and an oil change.

description: Fátima is a single mother. She has three children aged 5, 8 and 13. She runs a pupuseria where she sells chicken and pork pupusas, 'pupusas revueltas' (pupusas filled with cheese, beans and chopped pork), soda, hot chocolate and soft drinks. She sells her products every afternoon and also sells tortillas on Saturdays and Sundays. Fátima will use this loan to buy the basic products she needs (raw materials such as corn, soft cheese, chopped pork and cacao). She will also buy firewood. This will enable her to always have what she needs available so that she can keep her business running. Fátima's dream is to grow and increase her business so that she has what she needs in order to for her family to live more comfortably and peacefully.
local_use: to buy corn, soft cheese, chopped pork, cacao and firewood

description: María is a single mother of two, ages 21 and 27. She sells chicken and bean tamales in her neighborhood every day, since her customers await her Sunday through Saturday.
