She needs the loan in order to purchase basic supplies (leaves for wrapping, corn, chicken, seasonings, and firewood). In this way she will recoup more profits and keep her business going. María's dream is to have a more profitable business and give her children the best, since they depend on her and are continuing their studies so they can better themselves.
local_use: to purchase chicken, corn, seasonings, and firewood, for preparing tamales

description:
Zoila lives in her family home.  She sells clothing for women, men, and children: shorts, skirts, pants, blouses.  Her business is in the city center.  She has been doing this work for five years.  In her spare time, she also sews clothes with her own machine.

She needs the loan to buy more merchandise to stock her business and buy more clothing: pants, shirts, and blouses.  In this way she will increase her profits because she will have more variety to offer her customers.

Zoila's dream is to have a better quality of life and for her daughter to study and be a professional in the future.
local_use: to buy pants, shirts, and blouses for her business.

description:
José lives with his wife and 6 month old child. He sells mattresses, pillows, cushions, chairs and hammocks. He started the business due to lack of employment and the need to work every day. He doesn't have a fixed schedule. He takes his goods to the towns where he already has customers. He needs the loan to increase his inventory and buy (chairs, mattresses, pillows) wholesale as in this way he will have more products and be able to offer his clients variety.

José's goal is to get ahead with his family and offer his daughter a good lifestyle growing up.
local_use: to buy chairs, mattreses and pillows.

description: David requests another loan to plant soya beans.  He used the previous loan to pay workers who cleared land that was used to grow maize.David harvested thirty sacks of grain from the land.  He says that the whole group benefited from the previous loans.  David wants to buy more land for farming.
local_use: to buy soya beans to plant.

description: William is a 45-year-old married man with seven children living in a permanent residential house in Fort Portal, Uganda with a family goal of educating his children up to university. He has a wholesale shop dealing in general merchandise, which he has been operating for the last 15 years. He is faced with a challenge of limited funds to meet the demand and his dream is to own a warehouse. William needs the loan to buy soap, sugar and rice to sell.
local_use: to buy soap, sugar and rice to sell

description: Patrick is married with 2 children, aged 5 and 9, living in his own house in Hoima, Uganda. For 9 years he has been operating an electronics shop and this has facilitated him in providing the basics to his family. He is requesting a loan to buy a new music system. He has the challenge of bad debtors, and his dream is to own a big shop. Patrick needs the loan facility to buy music systems to sell.
local_use: to buy music systems to sell.

description: Sylvia wants a loan to buy sugar and braids to resell. She is a 32-year-old married woman with two children living in her own house in Masindi, Uganda. She has been operating a retail shop for the last three years and her dream is to have a wholesale shop and educate her children.
local_use: to buy sugar and braids to resell.

description:
Reina will use her new loan to buy more merchandise (gold-plated jewelry, bread, and men's and women's clothes) as she now has more customers and would like to continue increasing her profits.

Reina's previous loan helped her to strengthen her business.  Now, with this new loan, she will be able to increase her profits, support her children, continue working with the institution and always have a good credit record.
local_use: to buy gold-plated jewelry, bread and clothes

description: Karina is a single mother with a 2-year-old daughter. She owns a store selling basic products (rice, beans, sugar and corn). She started this business on her own initiative and works every day. She does not work fixed hours. Karina will use her loan to further grow her store and buy more merchandise such as churros (fried-dough snack), cookies, rice, beans, soda and sweet treats. This will enable her to make better income. Karina's dream is to increase her sales, to have a greater variety of products and to cover her daughter's daily needs.
local_use: to buy churros, cookies, rice, beans, soda and sweet treats

description:
Musa is a 26-year-old married man and a father of two children between 3 and 4 years old. He lives in his own permanent residential house at Hoima in Western Uganda. 

Musa has been running a butchery shop for the past seven years. He started with a small amount of capital but now it has now grown considerably. He says he has been able to achieve this with the help of credit from Hofokam. 

He faces a challenge of price fluctuations for goats and cows. Musa is requesting a loan to buy cows and goats for sale at his butcher shop.
local_use: To buy cows and goats for sale at his butcher shop.

description: Having gotten a loan, Saidi was able to grow his business, a thing he feels will make him realize his dream of acquiring a vehicle to enable him to transport his cattle to the city markets. He wants a loan to buy more cattle to resell at a profit
local_use: to buy more cattle to resell at a profit.

description: Julius is a 40-year-old married man with four children. He has been in the electronics business for eight years. He started with 3 million shillings and now has 5 million shillings. His hardship is customers not paying on time, building a permanent house and expanding to new markets. Julius needs a loan to buy solar panels to sell.
local_use: to buy solar panels to sell.

description:
Lendi is a widower with two children. His children are seven and six years old. He has rented out retail space for the past year to supplement his income as a driver. This is his first loan with VisionFund Indonesia and he will use it for renovations to his rental spaces. He also will use some of it to pay school fees for his two children. His business is going well so far but there is other competition for retail space. Therefore his space needs repairs in order for him to keep renting it. 

He hopes that by having income from the rental business and being a driver, he can create a better life for his children.
local_use: to pay for renovations for the retail spaces that he rents to shopkeepers

description:
Iyus is 39 years old and married with one child. His child is two years old but lives in the village away from Jakarta with his extended family. 

Iyus and his wife have been producing and selling krupuk (Indonesian chips) for five years. His favorite part of the business is that he gets to work with his wife. The business has been going well and enables him to send money to the village where his child lives. 

He now wants to expand the business and open another kiosk to sell krupuk out of. His long-term goal for his business is to someday have his own krupuk factory. He hopes that with the income from his expanded business he and his wife can eventually save enough money to live together with their child. 

Some of the other members of the group will use their loans to buy and resell electronics on credit and for their rice and food stalls.
local_use: to pay for more ingrediants and have enough capital to open another kiosk to sell krupuk (Indonesian chips)

description:
Nelson is 40 years old, married, and has four children.  He lives in Kasese, Uganda. He has been a farmer for eight years, focusing on coffee, vanilla, and bananas.  He also raises goats.  He started with a small piece of land but now has three acres. Nelson also does carpentry to supplement his income for the well-being of his family. 

Nelson is requesting for a loan, which he will use to buy more land for his coffee plantation. His hardship is limited capital; his vision is to have more acres of land so that his plantation will be able to generate high levels of produce leading to higher income.
local_use: To purchase land for his coffee plantation.

description:
Rohani is 31 years old and married with two children. They are eight and three years old. The older one, Krisna, is going to school. From Rohani's house, she sells things such as clothes, sandals and Tupperware on credit.  She has been doing this for seven years and her business is going well. By doing this business, she can help her husband to pay for her child's school fees. Now, she gets more orders for Tupperware. With this loan, she will buy more Tupperware to sell on credit. She enjoys promoting her business in her neighborhood.

Her future plan is to begin selling electronic goods on credit. The main problem with this is having enough starting capital. Over time, with her savings and another loan, maybe she can achieve this. Her hopes for her family are that they'll continue to have enough savings to invest in their children's education.
local_use: to buy more tupperware to sell

description: Resty is a 51-year-old married woman with four children. She lives in her own house in Kasese,Uganda. Resty has been in the farming and poultry business for eight years. She began with a small garden of pineapples, twenty coffee trees and  ten chickens but now has two acres of land for pineapples, three hundred coffee trees and two hundred chickens. Resty's hardship is limited financial resources. Her goal is to have five acres of land, to complete her house and to educate her children. Resty needs this loan to buy coffee seedlings for planting.
local_use: To buy coffee seedlings for planting.

description: Robert is a thirty-eight-year-old married man with three children, living in a semi-permanent house in Fort Portal, Uganda. His dream is to educate all his children and see them get jobs. He started with farming and later opened a produce store which he has been operating for the last two years. In this business he has faced a challenge of lack of capital to meet the high demand and his dream is a big food store that can supply the whole region. Robert needs the loan to buy maize, cassava and millet flour to sell.
local_use: to buy  maize, cassava and millet flour  to sell.

description: Saidi wants a loan to buy a local brew for resell. Age 29, he hails from the Kyenjojo district and is a father of five children between the ages of 1 and 11. He wants to see his children get a good education. Having inherited land from his father, he planted tomatoes from which he accumulated capital to start his current business, which he has been operating for two years.
local_use: to buy a local brew for resell.

description: Frank is a 35-year-old married man with three children living in Kasese, Uganda. He has been in the transport business for one year. He was formerly working as a mechanic. His hardships are high fuel, high transport costs and increased capital. His personal goals are educating his children and building a permanent house. His business goal is expanding his business to new markets. Frank needs the loan to buy land.
local_use: to buy land

description:
Beatrice, age 58, has been a farmer for 12 years. She started as a food vendor and now plants and harvests maize to earn a living. 

Beatrice wants to acquire a motorcycle to ease the challenge of transporting her produce. She aspires toward fully educating her seven children. She is a member of a group where each member guarantees the other in accessing their loans.

She is requesting a loan in order to weed her maize garden.
local_use: to weed her maize garden

description:
Eric, age 31, is a maize farmer in Kyenjojo, Uganda. He saved money to start his business and it has grown over the past two years. He and wife have three children.

Eric is requesting a loan to buy maize produce to offer for resale. 

His dream is to educate his children, build a permanent home, and eventually to acquire a motorcycle to ease the challenges of transportation.
local_use: to purchase maize produce to offer for resale

description: Elizabeth is a thirty-year-old married woman living in Fort Portal, Uganda. She used her locally generated savings from her monthly salary to start her transportation business. She faces the hardships of price fluctuation and inflation plus high fuel costs. However, her personal goals are educating her children and building a permanent home. Elizabeth needs the loan to buy another motorcycle for her transport business.
local_use: to buy a motorcycle for her transport business.

description: Jairo decided to acquire another loan because he wants to stay in business and to do so he needs to buy more raw materials like clay, firewood and nacazcol [a black dye] that he needs to make his earthenware.  The previous loan helped him because he bought farm supplies for his basic grain crops and he was able to earn higher income from the sale of the harvest; this allowed him to support his family.
local_use: to buy firewood, clay and nacazcol.

description:
Manuel is a clothing merchant.  He’s single living with his family in a red house.  He’s 19 years old.  He sells clothes and has been in this occupation for four years.  His mother taught him how to work selling clothes and he works every day full-time.

He is currently asking for a loan to buy shirts, blouses, dresses and skirts for men and women.  With this investment he will be able to help himself increase sales and offer new merchandise to his customers.

His goal is to improve each day and to gradually stabilize his condition as a merchant. In the same way, his experience will grow and so will his income.
local_use: to buy clothes.

description:
Ruth has decided to request a new loan because she needs to restock her store.  She plans to buy oil, pork, beef, milk, corn cereal, eggs, and soups.  This will help her have on hand a wider variety of products for customers.

She paid back her previous loan and has kept her business in good shape and improved its economic situation.
local_use: To buy corn, eggs, soup, oil, pork, beef and milk.

description:
Flor lives with her daughter.  She’s a clothing merchant and also provides corn milling service.  She started both businesses on her own initiative and with help from her mother.  She’s been in both these businesses for two years and works from 6am until 4pm.

She is asking for this loan to buy an assortment of clothes for the Christmas season: party dresses, blouses, skirts and pants.  This purchase will help her strengthen the business and earn good profits that will make it possible for her to help out her family even more.

Flor’s goal is to see her daughter grow up with adequate schooling until she completes a university career.
local_use: to buy party dresses, blouses, skirts and pants.

description:
Maria is twenty years old and has a daughter. 

She has worked selling lotions, creams and beauty products for one year. This is how Maria helps her life partner with their household expenses. Previously, she prepared food in the school in her community. 

She takes the beauty products home because they come through orders. Later, she takes them out to sell to the surrounding communities. 

Maria is requesting the loan to invest it in purchasing more beauty products like lotions and creams, among others. During the Christmas season she sells them for better prices, which will help her to obtain a better income. As the products she offers sell sufficiently she can make better offers. Maria expresses that the income she receives she will save to construct her house out of adobe, as the one she has now is made from cane and mud. This will provide a better quality of life for her daughter and will allow her to study. Likewise, she hopes to expand her business as it is profitable.
local_use: to buy more beauty products, like lotions and creams, among others.

description:
John is 27 years old. He is a married father of one child, aged 2 months. He lives in his own house in Hoima, Uganda. He is the only income earner in the family, and hence the responsibility of providing for the family rests on him. 

For the past three years he has been operating a produce business, which he started with 30,000 shillings in capital. Now he has 1,000,000 shillings in capital. He faces challenges of poor roads and inadequate capital. John needs a loan to buy rice, groundnuts, and sorghum to sell. He hopes to move his business to Hoima Town in the near future.
local_use: to buy rice, groundnuts, and sorghum to sell.

description: Agaba is a 28-year-old married man living in Bundibugyo, Uganda. He is currently operating a retail business where he sells sugar, salt and sodas to his customers. His hardships include limited capital to operate on a large scale, high transportation costs and inflation. His goal is to expand the business into new markets and diversifying the business. Agaba wants money to purchase salt, sodas, sugar, soap and beer to sell.
local_use: to purchase salt, soda, sugar, soap and beer to sell.

description:
Willy wants a loan to buy materials to construct rental houses. 

He is a Ugandan male civil servant, age 34, living in Kyenjojo, Uganda.

He dreams of educating his four children and setting up rental houses from which he can earn an extra income to supplement his salary.
local_use: to buy materials to construct rental houses

description: Vannie is a a 29-year-old single, hardworking young woman living in Fort Portal, Uganda. She has a fresh foods food stall that she started four years ago with capital worth fifty thousand shillings but now it is worth two hundred shillings. Her business challenges are price fluctuations and inflation. Her dream is to educate her children and expand her business into a pronounced food grocery in Fort Portal. Vannie needs the loan to buy fresh foods to sell.
local_use: to buy fresh foods to sell.

description: Bonny is a 39-year-old married man with five children living in Kyenjojo, Uganda. He is responsible for taking care of the family, and his dream is to build a permanent house as he currently lives in a semi-permanent house. He has been growing tea for eight months, and he has two acres of land so far. He has challenges of weeds which affect the output of his tea plantation and his dream is to eliminate these weeds and to have a ten-acre tea plantation. Bonny intends to buy herbicides for controlling weeds with the loan.
local_use: to buy herbicides for controlling weeds.

description: Wilson lives in Masindi, Uganda. He is 50 years old, married and has two children. As a civil servant, Wilson saved some money and started up a school ten years ago.  He is requesting a loan to renovate his classrooms.   He dreams of educating his children and expanding his business into new markets.
local_use: renovate the classrooms in his school

description:
Johnbosco is a boutique owner who wants a loan to buy clothes for resale. Aged 28 years, he is the father of two children. He wants to see that they get a good education. 

He started this business with the money he acquired after harvesting and selling his maize produce. He faces a problem of price fluctuations. 

His business dream is to expand his business into new markets.
local_use: to buy clothes for resale.

description:
Nidia is asking for a new loan because she needs to buy more supplies, like clay, nacazcol, firewood, straw, and transportation service for making her products.  She uses these materials daily to make pots, hotplates, and pans.

She considers her experience with these loans to have been good.  Now that the winter is approaching, it’s more difficult to obtain the supplies, but she was able to buy them with the loan and continues to produce.
local_use: to buy supplies

description:
Walter has been working for the council for three years.  He lives together with his wife and two daughters in a house that they own.  Walter provides food for his family and also an education for his daughters.  He is currently requesting a loan because he would like to have electricity installed in his home.  He needs to make a payment to the company and doesn't have the money for this right now.

This loan will help Walter to cover his need for this service in his home.  It will help him to improve his living conditions and to enjoy better development alongside his family.  Walter's aspiration is to work well for the council and to work towards a better salary and a better future for his family.
local_use: to pay to install electricity in his home

description:
Yessica lives with her children and her husband.  She started a business on her own because of problems that she faced and works by herself with no regular schedule.  She raises pigs.
She is requesting a loan to buy pigs to fatten and to enlarge her farm, allowing the pigs to grow and get healthier there.
Her aspiration is to make her business stronger each day with the help from the loans, and to be punctual with the payments.
local_use: to buy pigs

description:
Fred is forty-two years old and a hardworking man with five children living in Kasese, Uganda. His goals are to help his family by educating his children, building a permanent home, and buying a car.

Fred has been running a motorcycle transport business for two years. The hardships of this work are seasonal weather changes and taxes and other fees. Nevertheless, Fred intends to buy another motorcycle and expand his business into new markets. The purpose of the loan is to buy a motorcycle.
local_use: to buy a motorcycle.

description:
Mauricio, vive con su esposa y su hijo de 15 años de edad, él se dedica a vender agua embotellada, este oficio lo inicio hace diez años trabaja de 7: am a 5: pm de lunes a domingo. 
El préstamo lo utilizara para comprar una bicicleta, para poder repartir agua  embotellada y de esa forma podrá tener más facilidad y rapidez con la entrega de la venta.
El sueño de seguir trabajando,tener más clientes, mejorar su negocio y poder darles a su familia lo mejor.
local_use: Para comprar una bicicleta .

description:
Fred is a married man, aged 52 years, with eight children living in Kyenjojo, Uganda. With the previous loan, he was able to earn a profit and used it to construct a permanent house where he now lives with his family. The profits will also allow his children to pursue their education.
In his business he is faced with a challenge of price fluctuations. His business plan is to acquire a lorry truck for the transportation of his produce. Fred wants another loan to buy cattle to resell.
local_use: to buy cattle to resell at a profit

description: Evelyn is a thirty-four-year-old hardworking lady with two children living in Kasese, Uganda. Her personal goal is to build a permanent house. She has been running a clothes-selling business for the last ten years after starting with capital of eighty thousand, and now the business has grown to over two million as working capital. Her major challenges are price fluctuations, inflation and customers not paying on time; however, she has a goal of expanding her business to new areas. Evelyn needs the credit facility to buy clothes for resale.
local_use: to buy clothes for resale.

description: Abdul is a thirty-five-year-old married man with five children living in Kasese Uganda. His goal is to educate his children. He has been a poultry farmer for ten years. He started with capital of UGX one hundred thousand and now has over UGX one million five hundred thousand as his working capital. His major challenge is the high cost of feed. His dream is to have over 2000 birds. Abdul needs the loan to buy birds for poultry keeping.
local_use: to buy birds for poultry keeping.

description:
Hakim is a twenty-one year-old married man with three children living in Kasese,Uganda. His personal goal is to educate his children. He has been running a retail business for ten years which he started with capital of UGX one hundred thousand and now has capital of over UGX two million. 

His major challenge is high fuel and transportation costs. However, he has a vision of expanding his business into new areas. The purpose of the loan is to buy spare parts for resale.
local_use: to buy spare parts for resale.

description:
Oscar lives with his wife and his son.  He has a business selling staple products from his home.  Thanks to customer demand, he opens his store every day from Monday to Sunday.  

He is asking for this loan to increase his products and purchase more merchandise such as rice, beans, sugar, instant soups, and instant coffee.  He will be able to satisfy the needs of his customers and earn a better income.

Oscar's goal is to have a larger business with a variety of products and to be able to provide his family with everything they need.
local_use: to purchase rice, beans, sugar, instant soups, and instant coffee.

description:
Johnson is a forty-year-old hardworking man with four children living in Kasese, Uganda. His personal goals are to educate his children and build a permanent house.

He has been a farmer for the last two years after starting with two acres of land and now he has four and a half acres. His major hardship have been price fluctuations, inflation, high fuel and transportation costs. However, he has a goal of diversifying his farm to include cattle rearing. The purpose for this loan is to pay workers who are weeding his garden and for buying pesticides.
local_use: to weed and buy pesticides for his garden

description:
Melida is a hardworking forty-one-year-old lady with three children. She lives in Kasese, Uganda. Her personal goals are to educate her children and buy a car. 

She has been running a food store for the last ten years. Her major hardships are price fluctuations, inflation and when customers do not pay on time. She has as a business goal to buy land to grow crops and expand her food store so as to serve a wider market.

The purpose of the loan is to buy cassava and maize flour to sell.
local_use: to buy cassava and maize flour to sell.

description:
Gilma wants to make a new investment, so she is requesting a loan to buy bushels of corn and firewood. This will improve the condition of her business so that she will have better production and sales to her customers.

Gilma believes her business has improved since her sales are higher and she is in a better condition to provide for her family’s daily needs.
local_use: to buy corn and firewood.

description:
Christine is  a 31-year-old  married woman living in a semi-permanent house in Fort Portal, Uganda. She owns a grain milling machine which she has operated for over six years.

Christine started with a stationery shop and after realizing that the benefits were not feasible she ventured into a grain milling business. Her goals are educating her children, building a permanent house, and buying herself a car. Her business dream is to buy three more machines since the demand is very high.

Christine needs the loan to purchase a another grain-milling machine.
local_use: to buy a new a grain milling machine.

description: Charles is a hardworking 47-year-old living in Kasese, Uganda. He has been a farmer for the last twenty years, and his major hardships have been price fluctuations, inflation, and seasonal weather variations. He has a vision of venturing into mechanized agriculture and hiring employees to help expand his farm. Charles needs the loan to hire tractors for digging.
local_use: to hire tractors for digging.

description: Jose again needs a loan to invest in household items such as irons, wardrobes, fans, and dressers and in that way have what is necessary and the variety to offer his customers. The last loan helped him because he bought a vehicle to transport the products to sell and his business became more stable and it contributed to improve his economic stability.
local_use: to purchase irons, wardrobes, fans, and dressers.

description: Tadeo is a twenty-eight-year-old, hardworking man living in Fort Portal, Uganda.  For a year he has been operating a bar, after having been a waiter for over six years.  He faces challenges of price fluctuation and high taxes levied on him.  His personal goal is to buy a motorcycle for himself and his business goal is to have a modern bar.  With this loan, Tadeo intends to buy a pool table for his bar.
local_use: to buy a pool table for his bar.

description: Johnson wants a loan to buy soft drinks for selling. He is a 28-year-old man living in Masindi, Uganda. He has been running a bar and with the proceeds, he has been able to look after his wife and children. Price fluctuations and inflation hinder his business and his dream is to own a hotel.
local_use: to buy soft drinks for selling

description:
Joseph is 34 years old, married and together the couple have four children. 

He is a farmer and has been doing it for three years. He started on a small scale and later expanded. However he faces the challenge of seasonal weather variations. 

His personal goal is to educate his children and his business goal is to own at least sixty acres of farm land. Joseph needs the loan facility to buy beans for planting.
local_use: to buy beans for planting.

description: Janet is a 39-year-old hard-working lady with three children living in Kasese, Uganda.  Her personal goals are to educate her children, build a permanent home and buy a car.  She has been in the agricultural sector for the last 20 years and her major hardships are price fluctuations, inadequate capital to purchase stock and seasonal weather changes.  However, she has a vision of buying land to grow more crops and hiring employees to help expand her business.  Janet needs a loan to buy beans and maize for planting.
local_use: to buy beans and maize for planting.

description: Moses is a fifty-eight-year-old married man with thirteen children living in Kasese, Uganda.  His personal goals are to educate his children and build a permanent house.  He has been in cotton farming for the last ten years.  After starting the business with a capital of one million UGX, it has grown to three million.  His major hardships are price fluctuations, inflation and inadequate capital to purchase stock.  Moses wants a loan to buy cotton to sell.
local_use: buy cotton

description: Julio is a taxi driver, he lives with his wife and 2 children who are 18 and 15 years old; they live in their own home.  His family depends on him; he works everyday scouring the streets looking for clients.  He solicits a loan in order to repair the vehicle which is giving him problems and he would like to send it to the mechanic for repairs and so it stays in working order; this way he can assure safety to his passengers.  His aspirations are to acquire a newer model for a taxi and with his earnings, be able to cover the family expenses.
local_use: to pay the mechanic and buy replacement parts.

description:
Sedrack is a 30-year-old married man who has one child. He lives in a semi-permanent house in the district of Kyenjojo in Uganda. 

Sedrack is a farmer who started by doing subsistence farming but later began doing commercial farming. He dreams of building a permanent home and also wants to educate his child. 

Sedrack would like a loan to pay for the cost of mulching coffee and also to prepare his land.
local_use: to pay for the cost of mulching coffee and also to prepare his land.

description: Rita has decided to continue investing in the pork industry, so she is asking for this new loan in order to buy pigs to fatten up. She hopes that this investment with allow her to generate good sales in the future. Through managing her business she has had improved success with her farm, and she has also been able to support her family.
local_use: To buy pigs.

description: Andrew is a 48-year-old married man with seven children living in Kasese, Uganda. His personal goals are to educate his children, build a permanent home, and buy a car. He has been running a bar business for the last 23 years, and his major hardships are price fluctuations, customers not paying on time, and inadequate capital to purchase stock. However, he has a vision of expanding his business to new areas and hiring employees to help expand the business. Andrew needs a loan to buy beers and sodas to sell.
local_use: to buy beers and sodas to sell

description:
John is a twenty-two-year-old married man living in a semi-permanent house in Kyenjojo, Uganda. His desire is to have a family business. He started as a farmer and later started selling produce, something he has done for three years now. 

John intends to invest the loan in buying maize to sell.
local_use: to buy maize to sell.

description:
William is 32 years old and has three children. He lives with his family in Hioma, Uganda. William is a farmer who faces price fluctuations and seasonal weather variations. 

William is requesting a loan to buy maize to plant. His business goal is to buy land and grow more crops to diversify his business so that he can sell produce. His family goal is to educate his children.
local_use: to buy maize to plant

description: Geoffrey is married with children living in Hioma, Uganda. For six years he has been farming despite challenges in price fluctuation and seasonal weather variations. His family goal is to educate his children and build a permanent house. His business goals are to diversify his business and buy land to expand his farm. Geoffrey intends to use the loan to pay workers and also buy farm inputs.
local_use: to pay workers and also buy farm inputs.

description:
Hitayati is married with two children. She is pictured with one of her children. She has been selling fried snacks and "lontong" ( Indonesian food: rice cake made from steamed rice wrapped in banana leaf) since 2010. She sells fried snacks by distributing them to a store near to her house. Her business is running smoothly; now she can buy clothes for her children. 

Hitayati's husband is a security guard. She can contribute to her family by having this business. Even though sometimes it is hard to find banana leaf, she likes to run her business; she enjoys it. In the future she wants to have her own kiosk to sell her fried snacks. 

Other group members will be using their part of the loan to sell clothes on credit and to sell snacks.
local_use: to pay for more ingredients such as flour, eggs, and sugar to make fried snacks to sell

description:
Mrs. BINTOU is the representative of Madjigui Group. She's married and the mother of one child, who is seven and attends school. She has one person to support.

She's been selling galettes (pancakes) for nine years. She gets her supplies at the Zeem Passego market. Her customers are her neighbors.

She wants to buy two sacks of millet, two 20-liter cans of oil, and two 50-kg sacks of sugar. She saves up her profits in order to stock up on millet.

She ambitions to open a grocery store and continue selling galettes, but also stock up sacks of millet, corn, etc.
local_use: to buy two sacks of millet, two 20-liter cans of oil, and two 50-kg sacks of sugar

description:
Orbelina is a saleswoman.  She owns her own home and is the mother of one child who is still dependent on her.  Her business is selling American clothing.  She started her business several years ago, buying clothes by the bundle.

Orbelina is currently requesting a loan to buy three bundles of American clothing including blouses, skirts, dresses and pants (trousers).  This loan will help her to improve her business, stocking it with more garments for her customers.

Orbelina's goal is to pull through in her business, make more profits and take care of her household's needs.
local_use: to buy three bundles of American clothing

description: Asiimwe used the previous loan to buy clothes to sell.  In her business, she faces two main hardships -- price fluctuations and inflation.  Her dream is to educate her children and diversify her business.   Asiimwe needs this loan to pay school fees for her children.
local_use: to pay school fees for her children.

description: John is a 28-year old married man with three children living in Kamwenge Uganda. He owns a produce store which he started nine years ago. He started with capital worth 300,000 shillings and now the business is worth two million. His hardship is price fluctuation and inflation. His dream is educating his children and expanding business into new markets. John needs this loan to buy ground nuts to sell.
local_use: to buy ground nuts to sell.

description:
Jose is is requesting a new loan to buy more merchandise, such as fresh vegetables, carrots, potatoes, güisquiles (also known as chayote squash or vegetable pear)  this investment will help him improve what the business has to offer.
He thinks the previous loan had a positive impact in his business, that's why he is committed to work and position himself in the market.
local_use: To buy fresh vegetables such as carrots, squash and potatoes

description: Edson wants another loan to buy maize to resell.  Having started by growing various crops, he saved money for the produce business that he now runs.  His dream is to export produce and educate his children.
local_use: to buy maize for resale.

description:
Enid is 28 years old and a single mother of two children. She lives in Hoima, Uganda. 

She is a farmer and specializes in growing rice and maize, which are very profitable. She has been farming for four years and she faces a challenge of price fluctuation. Her family goal is to work hard and educate her children. She dreams of buying her own land for growing crops, since she is currently  farming on her parents’ land.

Enid needs the loan to buy rice and maize for planting.
local_use: to buy rice and maize for planting.

description:
Denes is a twenty-six-year-old married man with children. He lives in a permanent house in the district of Kyenjojo, Uganda. He wishes to have all the required gadgets for his salon and run a successful salon. He also has a personal goal of educating his children so that they can have a better future. 

Denes wants a loan to buy shaving machines for his salon.
local_use: to buy shaving machines for his salon

description: Justus is a 30-year-old married man with three children living in Kasese, Uganda. His personal goal is to educate his children and build a permanent home. He has been selling clothes for five years and his major hardships are price fluctuations, inflation, inadequate capital to purchase stock and high fuel and transportation costs. However, he has a vision of diversifying his business to include farming and expanding his business to new areas. Justus needs a loan to buy clothes for resale.
local_use: to buy clothes for resale.

description:
Saul repairs tires and runs a scrapyard. He lives alone and has a 30-year-old son. He buys, sells, and repairs tires and deals in scrap metal. This business sustains him.

He is requesting a loan to buy tires, which will allow him to keep inventory in stock to meet his customers' needs. This investment will also make him more competitive and give him more profit opportunities. Saul's goal is to have a business that serves his customers well. This will ensure that he has enough income to live.
local_use: to buy tires.

description: John is a twenty eight year old married man with two children living in Kasese,Uganda. He has been in shop business for three years. His hardship is inadequate capital to purchase stock, personal goal is to educate children and business goal is to expand business to new markets. John wants the money to buy soap and sugar for sell.
local_use: to buy soap and sugar to sell.

description: Juma is a 34-year-old married man with one child living in Kasese, Uganda. He has been in the coffee business for seven years. The business is very profitable. His hardships are price fluctuations, inflation, and inadequate capital to purchase inventory, as the demand for export is very high. His personal goals are educating his children and building a permanent house. His business goal is to expand the business into new markets. Juma wants money to buy coffee for resale.
local_use: to buy coffee for resale

description:
Julia is a 37-year-old married woman with five children who lives in Kasese, Uganda. She has been in the soda business for three years. She started with 50,000 shillings and now has 200,000 shillings as working capital. Julia's challenges are price fluctuations, inflation and customers not paying on time. 

Her personal goal is to educate her children and her business goal is to expand her business into new markets. Julia is a member of the above-mentioned group where each member guarantees the others when they access a loan. Julia wants the loan to buy sodas to sell.
local_use: to buy sodas to sell.

description: Kunihira needs another loan to add more clothes to sell.The forty-three-year-old hardworking woman is solely charged with the responsibility of looking after her eight children. She still sells clothes despite hardships of price fluctuation, theft and inadequate capital to purchase stock. However, she has a vision of expanding her business into new areas and moving her business to a more permanent location. Her personal goals are educating her children and building a permanent house.
local_use: to add more clothes in her business.

description: Emmanuel is a 43-year-old married man with eight children living in Kasese, Uganda. He has been in the coffee business for 17 years. His hardships are price fluctuation, inflation, and high transportation costs. His personal goals are to educate his children and to build a permanent home. His business goal is to buy land to grow crops and to export coffee to nearby countries. Emmanuel wants money to buy coffee for resale.
local_use: to buy coffee for resale

description: JohnBosco is a 56-year-old married man with ten children living in Kasese, Uganda. He has been in the coffee business for seventeen years and the business is worth the venture. His biggest hardships are price fluctuations, inflation, and having inadequate capital to purchase stock since the demand is high. His personal goals are educating his children and building a permanent home. His business goal is to buy land to grow crops. JohnBosco wants money to buy coffee to sell.
local_use: to buy coffee to sell.

description:
Oscar is requesting a new loan so he can keep working.  He will purchase hybrid seeds and fertilizers to start his new grain crop.  He makes his living in agriculture, and he hopes to have a good harvest.
Oscar had positive results from his previous loan.  He had a good harvest that provided food and income for his family.  Everyone in his home is well and enjoying good health.
local_use: to purchase hybrid seeds and fertilizers.

description:
Oscar is requesting a new loan to make the most of his potential with his customers.  He would like to buy a supply of sorbets, sticks and frozen chocolate bananas, for which he has demand from his customers.

Oscar comments that his previous loan had a positive effect.  He bought a large quantity of frozen treats, increased his profits, and improved his family's living conditions.
local_use: to buy sorbets, sticks and frozen chocolate bananas

description:
Christopher is a 31-year-old married man with three children living in Fort Portal, Uganda. He has personal goals of educating his children and building a permanent house.

Christopher has been in the transportation and agriculture sectors for the last 10 years. He started by renting land to farm on and later on bought his own. He faces hardships of price fluctuation and inflation, high fuel and transportation costs, and seasonal weather changes. Despite these hardships, he has a vision of diversifying his business to include a retail shop and hiring employees to help him expand his business. Christopher needs a loan to buy cows for rearing.
local_use: to buy cows for rearing.

description:
Oscar is requesting a new loan, because he needs to buy farming supplies so he can begin sowing corn. He will purchase compost, insecticide and pesticide, which help him protect his crop from pests and increase his production.
He believes that the previous loan helped him improve production in his crop, because he had a good harvest. This has benefitted his family, who had what they needed for food and for covering some of their needs.
local_use: to purchase compost, insecticide and pesticide.

description: Joel is requesting a new loan to invest in natural medicine to sell, acquiring a variety of medicinal products for different uses by his customers. With this loan he hopes to continue giving good service to his customers by offering products of quality. He says that with the previous loan he fulfilled a good investment with which he has received good earnings through his sales, maintaining a good portfolio of customers who are satisfied with the service. Through Kiva, he hopes to continue to prosper.
local_use: to buy natural medicine.

description:
Asiimwe needs a loan to buy clothes to sell. She faces hardships of price fluctuations, inflation and inadequate capital for buying stock.

Asiimwe has a vision of buying land for growing crops and diversifying her business to include farming. Her dream is to educate her children up to university level.
local_use: to buy second-hand clothes to sell

description:
This is 35-year-old Jestina. She is married and has 4 children, ages 15, 12, 6, and 3 years old. 

In 2005, she established her food sales business. She sales items such as palm oil, Garie, foofoo, and pineapples. She began her business because she dropped out of school and needed to engage herself to avoid being idle at home. Working 6 days a week and 6 hours a day, she earns about 900,000 SLL every month from this business. She would like a loan in the amount of 3,000,000 SLL. Jestina requires a loan in order to buy more local food stuffs for her business. She hopes that this loan will enable her to increase her monthly profits by approximately 250,000 SLL. 

In the future, Jestina plans to have a store on her own and support her children through their university education. She thanks you for your support.
local_use: to buy more local food items for her business

description:
Irma is continuing to work, but no longer in her own general store business.  This is because her investment collapsed when she started to extend credit which wasn't repaid, causing the store to close. So she looked for a regular job. 

She has three children to educate and feed, as well as other expenses, as she doesn't have help from the children's father. She has been working as a domestic for almost a year, but her goal is to keep improving her small house. With this new loan, she will have a side wall built, providing more protection for her property, and keeping her children safe.
local_use: To build a side wall to protect her property.

description:
Marta is a widow and lives with her two daughters in her own home.  She sells medicines and owns a chicken farm.  She inherited the latter business from her husband five years ago.  She currently runs it very well and her daughters help her.  

Marta needs a loan to buy merchandise for her business selling medicines.  She will buy pills, syrups and injections for different illnesses and also vitamins and stimulants.  In addition, she would like to buy concentrated feed for her chicken farm.

Marta is a hard-working woman who is always looking for ways to make progress in her business and help her daughters.  Her goal is to own a profitable business.
local_use: to buy syrups, injections, pills, and also concentrated feed for her chicken farm

description: Abel is a thirty-three-year-old enterprising father of two. He lives in his own house in Fort Portal, Uganda. He is responsible for caring for his children alone and his desire is to see them educated and employed. For three years, Abel has been operating a retail shop. His business has helped him to pay the school fees for his children. His ambition is to become a wholesaler in the next five years. With this loan, Abel intends to purchase sugar, salt, soap and cooking oil to sell in his shop.
local_use: To buy sugar,salt,soap, and cooking oil  to sell

description:
Justa belongs to the “Juntas y Unidas” (Together and United) Communal Bank, of the Arariwa Association, in the city of Cusco, and she lives in that city.  Cusco is an enchanting city that goes back to Inca times.  It is constructed on the base of the ancient Inca city.

Justa is 42 years old, married, and the fruit of this union is 2 children.  She alternates her household activities with her small business selling beauty products independently.  Justa has been dedicated to the business for various years and it is going well, thanks to the effort she puts into her work.  Justa is a hard-working and responsible woman who leads her family forward.  

With this loan, Justa hopes to receive $400 U.S.  At present, she wants to increase business and she is going to buy more cosmetics, including, for example, perfumes, and earrings, etc.  Justa is grateful for the opportunity offered by this means and, also, she is committed to complying with the payments as scheduled.
local_use: BUYING MORE COSMETICS; FOR EXAMPLE, PERFUMES, AND ALSO EARRINGS, ETC

description:
Luis's main job is as a courier. He also sells shoes in Tumusla Street, one of the main commercial streets in the city of La Paz, and he has diversified into other areas. He would like to continue working with this field partner: he is a good customer and this will be his fifth loan with them. He is always on time and keeps careful track of his installments. He wishes to help his family, especially his children so that they can be good students and have a better life. The family always sticks together, and his wife helps out selling shoes when Luis is out working as a courier. He plans to invest the loan in buying tires for his car and adding to his stock of children's shoes. He is very grateful to the field partner Emprender, and to Kiva, for the confidence they have shown by granting the loan.

Translated from Spanish by Rosa Oswald, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Buying stock to sell

description:
Don Grover works as a bartender in the cafe "La Terraza" where a base salary and tips. Aside form his work at the cafe he works among society with his brother, selling capuccino and orange juice by renting stands in the different fairs that occur all over the country. This money will be directed to the buying of a larger coffee maker and a machine for making the foam necessary for capuccino.

Translated from Spanish by Matt Capetola, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: increasing capital

description: Beatrice, a 34-year-old single mother of four children ranging in age from 4 to14 years, lives in Hioma, Uganda where, for the last five years, she has been operating a textile business that she started with 500,000/= but now has inventory worth two million. Beatrice faces the challenge both of rain and too much sunshine but hopes to move into a sheltered premise and set up a boutique. She is now requesting a loan to buy clothes to sell.
local_use: to purchase clothes to sell.

description:
Gregoria belongs to the San Isidro de Yanahuara Communal Bank.  The bank is located in the Urubamba district, Urubamba province, Cusco department.

Gregoria, age 45, has a life partner and three children.  She alternates her daily activities with her business of selling handmade goods.  She sells scarves, gloves, and backpacks.  She sells in the Yanahuara district in the Casa Andina hotel.  She works from 5:00 a.m. until 10:00 p.m.

She wants to expand her business of selling handmade goods.  She is requesting the loan to buy handicrafts and materials to make handicrafts.  She is happy about the loan, and she pledges to make her payments on time.
local_use: to buy handicrafts and materials to make handicrafts

description:
Don Jose Abel is 32 years old and has worked the past 10 years at the National Institute of Technology, Center for Agricultural and Technical Education. He teaches professional training classes. According to his references, he is a humble man who is responsible with his obligations. His wife takes care of the household duties and looks after their son.

He is requesting his eighth loan so that he can add a room to his house, thereby gradually improving his living conditions. In addition to improving his home, Jose Abel dreams of having good health and job stability.
local_use: to add a room to his house.

description:
Ruth Mery was born in the city of Quillabamba in the province of La Convención in Cusco, Peru. She is 27 years old and currently lives in the city of  Urubamba with her two children. She works in construction in the municipality of Urubamba, and she also runs a small restaurant. Ruth Mery has been running this business for a number of years and it is going very well for her. She will use this loan to purchase supplies such as bags of rice and sugar. 

The community bank “Señor de los Milagros de Urubamba” (Lord of Miracles of Urubamba) meets every month in the city of Urubamba in Cusco, Peru. Cusco is known for being a very commercial and touristy area because of its traditional festival, Inti Raymi, and because it is home to the one of the seven wonders of the world, Machu Picchu.
local_use: to purchase supplies

description:
Our member Esther is 29 years old; she has a daughter who is 1 year and 4 moths old and her name is Azumi Nahomi. Esther is originally from the city of Urcos, province of Quispicanchis, department of Cusco and she belongs to the Community Bank “Qori Orcco” of the Arariwa Association. The city of Urcos is located 45 Km from the city of Cusco, approximately 45 minutes of travel time. Esther gets up early to do her household activities such as preparing breakfast for her husband and tending to her daughter. After she is done with her household activities, Esther has to go sell bread at Plaza De Armas (parade grounds) in the city of Urcos. She and her business partners of 2 years now came up with the idea to create a special bread that they called “chuta navideña” which has similar characteristics to the chuta bread (a round, soft bread with a particular aroma and of giant size; traditional bread from the city of Urcos) but they added raisins and fruits. Esther and her business partners only make the “chuta navideña” bread for the Christmas festivities. She is requesting a loan to buy more consumables such as flour, sugar, lard, fruits and raisins to make “chutas navideñas” for this Christmas and New Year, since it is during this season when they sell the most. Esther is grateful for the opportunity afforded by this channel and she is committed to make the payments according to the established time line.

Translated from Spanish by Carlos Morales, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Buy more consumables such as flour, sugar, lard, ruits and raisins.

description:
José is 32 years old and lives in Usulután with his wife and five children.  He has his own home and sells household items out of his truck which he drives to nearby towns.  He also supplies to businesses in the city of Usulután.

This business activity is the sole income for his family, allowing them to cover monthly expenses.  He is requesting a loan to buy merchandise and maintain a high inventory.  The loan will help him strengthen and grow his business and will allow him to offer a variety of products to his customers.  He sells all kinds of sweets and kitchen products such as condiments, vinager, and detergent.

He aspires to improving his income so he can meet his family's priority needs.  He also wants to give his children the necessary education so they can be successful and have a quality lifestyle.
local_use: To buy sweets and kitchen items

description:
Savat (pictured here) is now a garment worker. Her husband, Chea, is a driver. He drives for a company. They live in a suburb of Phnom Penh and have one young son. 

Savat’s husband would like to stop working as a driver in order to become a Tuk Tuk taxi driver. Hence, Savat would like to request another loan of $700 to add to her own money to buy a Tuk Tuk for her husband.
local_use: To buy a Tuk Tuk for her husband.

description: Simon is 38 years old and married with six children, ages 9-1, living in Karuguuza, Uganda. He has no [other] dependents and he lives in his own house. He has a retail shop and has been operating it for eight years. He started as a market vendor and later started a shop. He faces the challenge of bad debtors and hopes to improve his business to a wholesale business. Simon needs money to buy soap, sugar and millet to sell.
local_use: to buy soap, sugar and millet to sell.

description:
Vilma A. lives with her life partner and their four adult children in one of the capital’s neighborhoods. Her partner works as a purchasing agent and contributes to household income; all the children also contribute to the household’s monthly expenses. For the last 33 years Vilma has sold clothes. She started her business with loans and financial help from her partner. The house they currently inhabit needs some repairs so that they may live a bit more comfortably especially because winter is here and every day the rains threaten their security and create discomfort for the whole family. For this reason she is asking for funds to buy building materials and supplies for this project. It has been thanks to Kiva that she has managed to build her house and she is grateful for whatever help she can get now to make improvements to her humble abode because this provides her with much satisfaction as a parent for she knows that she is providing her children with the possibility of a better future for their lives.

Translated from Spanish by Michael Bujazan, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: For home repairs.

description: Silvia continues working as a seamstress, sewing pants, blouses, and skirts as well as other clothes. She also knits men's, women's, and children's sweaters. Because of this business, she can help her children succeed. Her dream is to have a place where she can sell clothes. She is asking for this loan in order to buy fabric and thread. Silvia is receiving an individual loan as a member of the village bank "Solidaridad - Cachimayo," located in the Southern Andean region of Peru. The bank is in its 17th cycle with Asociación Arariwa.
local_use: to buy fabric and thread

description: Mr. Lenin lives in the Ticuantepe municipality with his wife who works in a private corporation. His future plans are to finish building his home; because of his financial situation he is not able to buy all of the materials at once (tiles) since his priority is his son’s health. His son has had allergy problems since birth. He is grateful for the trust given to him by Afodenic and Kiva to be able to improve his home and for the help that they give to low income people.
local_use: buy materials.

description:
Julio is a member of the “Los Diamantes” (Diamonds) community bank which is located in Huanchac district, in Cusco province, in Cusco department.

Julio is 45 years old.  He lives with his partner and has 3 children.  He has worked as a security guard since 2003.  He is also investing in a handicrafts business together with his spouse.  In parallel with his main job, he is also working independently in the handicraft business.  He buys and sells handicrafts.  Julio would like this loan to invest in buying merchandise for the Christmas season.  He is requesting the loan to invest in buying handicrafts.

He is grateful for the loan and appreciates it.  He also pledges to make his repayments in a timely manner.
local_use: To invest in buying handicrafts

description: H. Shermat is a hard-working man who is in agriculture. He has worked at this business for a long time and acquired his abilities in ranching and farming when he was very young. He is a married father with responsibilities for supporting his three children. Shermat is known as being very responsible and hard-working since, every day, very early in the morning, he starts his job taking care of his fields while at the same time raising cattle in his own pen located at his house. IMON International has been the backbone of Shermat’s business because of having granted loans which have allowed him to improve his standard of living through the acquisition of cattle and vegetables for planting. Today, once again, Shermat trusts that his credit will be approved so that he will be able to improve his business with the purchase of cattle and also farm supplies. More about Tajikistan and IMON International Tajikistan is known for its rich history, which includes a key post along the Silk Road and the end of Alexander the Great's rule. It has also produced great thinkers, philosophers, scientists and poets, including Rudaki, Avicenna, Ferdowsi, Omar Khayyam, Jomi, and Rumi.
