To learn more about IMON International's work, please visit: www.imon.tj.
local_use: To purchase seeds, fertilizer and cattle in order to expand his business

description:
This is 52-year-old Magdalene. She is a widow and has five children, aged 22, 18, 14, 10 and 7 years. She has three additional dependents who live with her because they help her with her business and they are her relatives. In 2009, Magdalene established her patient drugs business. Working six days a week and 12 hours a day, she earns about 950,000 Sierra Leone leones (Le) every month from this business. 

She would like a loan in the amount of Le 5,000,000. Magdalene has already received and successfully repaid two loans, and now requires a new loan in order to buy essential patient drugs for her business. She hopes that this loan will enable her to increase her monthly profits by approximately Le 250,000. In the future, Magdalene plans to build a dwelling and educate her children. She thanks you for your support.
local_use: To pay for additional essential patient drugs.

description:
This member belongs to the communal bank "HACIA EL TRIUNFO” [Towards Triumph]; This bank is located in the district of Huanchac, in the province of Cusco, department of Cusco.

The member is Angelica. She alternates her daily activities with her jam making business. She makes all sorts of jams such as strawberry and elderberry among others, which she later sells to her customers who request her products, such as family members and friends. She also works in a public institution, which allows her to get her family ahead. She is a happy and responsible person.

The member requests a loan to buy supplies to make jams, such as sugar and fruit.

The member is happy with the loan that has been provided and she is committed to paying her quotas in the established period.
local_use: to buy supplies to make jams, such as sugar and fruit.

description:
Teresa de Jesús C., age 37, lives in the San Ignacio neighborhood of La Concepción together with her husband, who assists her with household expenses. They have four children, ages 24, 18, 15, and 13, two of which are already married, and two are still at home. She plans to improve the quality of her family's life. She has been in the agriculture business for the last 21 years. Her major difficulties come from pests that affect plant growth and the behavior of the nearby volcano. Teresa de Jesús began farming through the support of her parents. Her future plans are to diversify her crops. With this loan she will buy fertilizer and supplies to improve her harvest.

Translated from Spanish by Sarah Merchlewitz, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy supplies and fertilizers for crops

description: Doña Katia continues with her grocery store business and has been increasing the products she offers with the goal of obtaining better profits.  She is a single mother with a two-year old daughter.  She lives in the house of her mother, who supports her, and this is where she sells her products.  By means of the loans, she has increased sales volume by introducing more merchandise.  With the new loan, she will purchase a quintal of rice, sugar, cans of oil, cereal, dairy products, canned goods, pots of milk, sweets, and other products to generate higher profits.
local_use: to purchase basic grains, sweets, dairy products, and other products that she sells the most

description: Vania is 32 years old and the single mother of one daughter who is one-and-a-half years old. She has just recently started a business in which she sells crafts such as dolls, mirrors, and knitted blankets and hats. She is asking for a loan in order to jump-start her business and purchase various crafts such as blankets, hats, little dolls, and ornamented mirrors. She is excited about her new business and desires for it to be very successful. Vania is committed to making all of the necessary loan payments on time.
local_use: to buy more crafts to sell such as blankets, dolls, and mirrors.

description: Jorge is a young man who is setting up his family life.  He has a sewing business and makes sports clothing on an order contract basis.  Because of a lack of capital he is requesting a loan to buy a cutting machine and fabric so he can become independent.  Jorge lives in a house that belongs to his uncle.  His main goal is to establish his own sewing shop and save for his own house.  He is an entrepreneur who enjoys what he does and wants to have a close-knit family.  His partner helps him make the sports clothing.  Jorge is pictured with his partner in the work area.
local_use: To buy a cutting machine and fabric.

description: Betty is a 35-year-old hardworking woman living in Masindi, Uganda. She buys and sells secondhand clothes and has been in business for five years. Betty wants a loan to buy new clothes to resell. Her challenge is the rainy season which disrupts her business as she operates from open markets. Her dream is to own a boutique.
local_use: to  buy new clothes to resell

description: Claudia has her own business, a pulperia [small grocery store] and she has also been selling Avon cosmetics for five years. She started with very little and with her own money. Her husband works as a service technician at a gas station. Claudia is the mother of two children. Her goal is to be able to give her little ones all the best, which is why she aims to increase her capital, to sell more products, and to add new clothing to capture new customers. This is her second loan cycle with AFODENIC. Thanks to her last loan, she was able to buy more products. She will use this new loan to buy clothing for children, undergarments for women and men, hair products, "masaya"-style sandals, a variety of cosmetics, lipstick, shampoo, deodorant, lip gloss, perfumes, Coca Cola products, juices, dairy products, and basic grains. She hopes to obtain higher sales so that it will become easier to sell her new products because she will already have customers.
local_use: to buy basic grains with 40% of her loan and new clothing and cosmetics with the rest

description: María lives in her own home with her husband and has three older adult children.  María sells roasted plantains and has 4 years in the business, which she started on her own initiative, working Monday to Saturday.  She is requesting a loan to buy a large quantity of oil and green plantains to supply the business.  This will help to improve and increase production.  Her hope is that her business is more prosperous to improve the situation of her family.
local_use: to purchase a large quantity of oil and green plantains.

description:
Paola rents a home and works in order to have a greater income. She lives with her husband and her two young children. She sells stuffed animals, toys and other items but it depends on the  time of year. She also sells comforters during the colder months. Since Christmas is approaching, she travels to Oruro to her stall in the Christmas fair. She does well selling her items during this time of year. The fair only lasts three months, so Paola is taking advantage of this opportunity. The money from the loan will be invested in the purchase of wholesale toys.
Paola is grateful for this organization since the loan will be funded by kiva.
local_use: To buy wholesale toys to sell

description: Patricia lives with her mother.  She’s single and has been selling food for five years; she sells at home since it’s located in a highly commercial sector of the zone.  As far as clientele is concerned, she’s growing because there is a lot of new construction in the area.  Because of this she’s asked for a loan because she needs to acquire more tables and increase working capital.  She works alone from 5am on preparing her delicious meals.  She is a very hardworking woman who feels very grateful for the opportunity she’s being given since this is the only activity she has to support her mother.
local_use: to buy tables and ingredients.

description: Eva is a forty-two-year-old married woman with five children living in Kasese, Uganda. She has been selling baby clothes for four years. With the proceeds she has been able to promptly pay school fees for her children. Her hardship is inadequate capital to meet the different tastes and preferences of her customers. Her personal goal is educating her children and her business goal is expanding her business into new markets. Eva wants money to buy clothes to sell.
local_use: to buy clothes.

description:
Senora Juana Francisca belongs to the "San José de Urubamba" communal bank, which is located in the Urubamba district, Urubamba province, in the Cuzco region.

Senora Juana Francisca is 46 years old, single, and has a son. She combines her daily activities with running a restaurant, where she sells different types of food and also sodas and beers. She works from 8am to 7pm. She wants to improve and expand her restaurant, and is seeking the loan to buy hings for cooking and sodas, which she will buy wholesale.

She is happy that she can access the loan and promises to complete her repayments on time.
local_use: The member of this communal bank is seeking a loan to buy things for cooking, and sodas which she will buy wholesale.

description:
Lorenza was born in the city of Abancay but currently lives in the city of Yucay. (The peruvian district of Yucay is one of the seven districts in the province of Urubamba, located in the Department and Region of Cusco.) Lorenza, age 45, has 5 children as a result of her happy marriage. She has two main areas of work all year round. She sells handicrafts and beauty products from the "Esika" and "Unique" brands. She also makes a variety of woven items, including ponchos, sweaters, hats, table runners, and blankets. She sells her work on foot at the door of one of the most luxurious hotels in the city of Yucay.

Lorenza needs a loan to buy more materials, such as wool for weaving. With the money she makes from her work, Lorenza is able to educate and feed her children, so the loan is very important to her. She is a member of the “Virgen Natividad” Communal Bank, a group formed of 15 members. some of the members live in the city of Huayllabamba and others in the city of Yucay.
local_use: To buy more materials, such as wool

description:
Doña Jeaneth is a 40 year old single mother of three who has always had to work a lot to support her children. She's been working as a doorwoman for years. Slowly, with the help of loans, she has been able to improve her house and living conditions. With her previous loan she bought construction supplies to build an extra room and give her children more comfort. But she never started the construction because it was lacking certain materials, so she asked for another loan to buy the necessary supplies to start builidng the room.

Translated from Spanish by Mariana Dauwe, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Construction Supplies

description: Dalia is a 33-year-old married woman with two children. She owns a house in Kasese, Uganda. She has been dealing in product for 2 years. She started by selling 4 bags of coffee per month and now sells 9 bags of coffee per month. Her challenge is high coffee prices. Her vision is setting up a coffee store. Dalia intends to use the loan to buy coffee.
local_use: to buy coffee

description:
Patricia lives with her husband and 10-year-old daughter.  She sells dairy products.  She started this business 15 years ago.  Since then she’s strengthened it offering the best in cheese, curd and all other milk derivatives.  This business has helped her meet her household needs.

She currently needs to buy cheese, cream, milk, fresh cheese and cottage cheese to stock the business because she buys them already make.  This investment will be of much help for Patricia.

Her goal is to receive financial support to develop in business always striving to maintain a good record.
local_use: to buy cheese, cream, milk, fresh cheese and cottage cheese.

description:
We met Alberto in the small town of Kiteni, in the district of Quillabamba, province of Convención, in Cusco and he told us:
"I was born in the city of Quillabamba, capital of the province of Convención. I'm 29 years old, I have three kids, and now I live in the city of Kiteni, where I am developing my businesses which are: selling food and building houses."
Alberto is a bricklayer and works in the municipality of Kiteni in construction. Alberto is a responsible and enterprising person who is providing for his children. He and his wife opened a family business selling food and they serve breakfast, lunch and dinner. They opened this little business two months ago and it is going very well. With regards to this opportunity, he requires a loan to buy supplies such as, for example, rice, a freezer, and other things that the business needs. Alberto belongs to the community bank "Cholo de Oro de Kiteni."
local_use: to buy rice, a freezer, and other things the business needs.

description:
Elva was born in the district of Quillabamba in the province of Convención, department of Cusco. Presently, she lives in Urubamba with her husband and two children. Elva is an enterprising woman who is always working hard as she believes this is the only way to give her children a better quality of life. She is a teacher at the “2058 de Chichubamba” school which is located 10 minutes from the city or Urubamba. Deciding to improve her quality of life, Elva started a farm where she raises small animals such as guinea pigs and hens and also sells dry goods like wheat, potatoes, and corn. She has had her business for several years and it is going really well thanks to the determination that she puts into her work. With her next loan, Elva hopes to receive S/. 800 nuevos soles. She would like to use the money to buy chickens. The “Señor de Torrechayoc” comunal bank opened in 1994, but Elva has been participating for the past 12 years and the group is doing very well. The communal bank was named in honor of the patron saint of Urubamba.

Translated from Spanish by Eleanor Francoletti-Putz, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy chickens.

description:
Sadridin is a very hardworking and responsible entrepreneur. He lives with his family in Dushanbe, Tajikistan. He is the loving father of 6 children. Sadridin works in the central city market selling men’s clothing, jeans, jackets and shirts. His business is characterized by stability and consistent growth. He has been working in the market for 2 years. His business has been the main source of income for his whole family. Currently, Sadridin is requesting a loan of $800 USD, with which he will purchase inventory from wholesalers and thus increase the assortment of merchandise in his store. We believe that Sadridin’s drive for success will help this young entrepreneur's business thrive. By lending, you can become an important part of the growth of Sadridin’s shop.

More about Tajikistan and IMON International:

Tajikistan is known for its rich history, which includes a key post along the Silk Road and the end of Alexander the Great's rule. It has also produced great thinkers, philosophers, scientists and poets, including Rudaki, Avicenna, Ferdowsi, Omar Khayyam, Jomi, and Rumi. The country is home to communities that still speak the ancient Sogdian language, epic mountain passes, and a civilization that dates back to the 4th millennium BC. And, even today, it is a complex mixture of the Islamic faith, Soviet culture, New West culture and Central Asian traditions.

But Tajikistan is also the poorest of the former Soviet republics. The civil war, which began soon after it became independent from the U.S.S.R., further damaged the already weak economy. In addition, 93% of the country is mountainous and only 7% of the land is arable. These conditions have resulted in high levels of unemployment and have forced hundreds of thousands to seek work in other countries, mainly Russia. While the people of Tajikistan are working to improve its agricultural production and manufacturing sector, nearly two-thirds of the population still live in abject poverty.

IMON's History:

Since December 2007, IMON International has worked closely with Kiva and Kiva lenders to ensure that poor and low income clients are able to borrow money. Funds raised through Kiva have already been distributed to thousands of IMON International's clients and will continue to provide thousands more with permanent access to the varied financial services they need. To learn more about IMON International's work, please visit: www.imon.tj.
local_use: purchasing men’s clothing, jeans, jackets and shirts from wholesalers

description:
María lives with her husband and two children. She sells clothes and medicines. She started this business on her own as she wanted to install a business in order to keep busy and generate income for her family. She doesn't have an established timetable as she is a street vendor.

She is requesting this loan to buy new clothes such as blouses, underwear, shirts and children's clothing. This will allow her to improve and extend her business, letting her attend new areas.

María's dream is that her business grows in order to improve the family income and repay this loan.
local_use: to buy blouses, underwear, shirts and children's clothing.

description:
Oscar is 22 years old and lives in the Villa Venezuela district of Managua, the capital of Nicaragua. He is single and doesn't have any children. His future plans for a family are to establish a solid home and offer a secure asset base. Oscar has a small video game business, with one year of experience renting all types of video games. He started the business with his own savings but his goal is to increase the variety of games, modify the video game consoles and establish a cyber-cafe in his district of Managua. Thanks to the loan from Afodenic he will be able to buy more video games and new game consoles, offering his customers better service and in such a way growing his client base and increasing his income.

Translated from Spanish by Sally Bolton, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To purchase video games and offer maintenance and repair

description: Minkailu, who deals in used clothes and shoes, started his business in 1995 during the war as a displaced person.  After the civil war, he returned back to his home town and continued with the same business.  He is married with five children.  Life has not been easy for him, but he has been able to maintain his business and this will be his third loan with ARD.  He wants to increase his working capital so as to vary his stock and increase sales.  His main focus is to keep his children at school with the proceeds of his business.  He has a good credit history.
local_use: To buy used shoes

description:
Luisa belongs to the Villa Rayanniyoc Community Bank which is part of Kiva partner’s Arariwa Association. She is 50 years old, married, and has eight children, four of whom are independent and the others are in school. The town of Rayanniyoc is located about 30 minutes from Cusco. Luisa gets up very early to do the household chores such as prepare breakfast and get her younger children off to school. Her job is selling grain. On Wednesdays, Fridays, and Sundays she sells the grain in Urubamba market, and on Saturdays she takes it to Cusco and sells in the Molino II market there. She’s been doing this for several years, and all has gone well thanks to the effort she puts in to her work. She requires a loan to buy more products such as wheat, tarwi (Andean bean), and many other grains. Lucia is grateful for the opportunity to get this type of loan and promises to make the repayments according to the schedule.

Translated from Spanish by Jane Agg, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: to buy more grains such as wheat, tarwi etc

description:
Man sells recycling materials. His wife, Satas, now stays at home and does housework. They live along National Road Number Six, about 20 kilometers from Phnom Penh, the capital city of Cambodia. 

Man is asking for a loan of $200 to build a concrete brick room under his house.

Photo: Man is not sitting at his home. He is at his brother’s home.
local_use: To build a concrete brick room under his house.

description:
This member's name is Washington and he belongs to the communal bank "Los Lideres" in the city of Cusco - Perú.  He works in urban public transportation and plans to use the loan to buy tires for his vehicle, for maintenance purposes and to offer better customer service.

Washington is very grateful to KIVA for allowing him to keep his business running and supporting his family.  He is grateful for the loan and committed to paying it back on time.
local_use: To buy tires for his vehicle.

description:
Señora Luz is a new client for the institution.  She came through the referral of a relative, who obtained a loan from the institution which has already been paid back.

Luz works preparing meals in a boarding-house a market.  This loan will be used for purchasing chairs, tables, dishes, a 21 inch TV, a radio, and several utensils for improving the quality of her service and expanding her business.

She has one school-age son, and lives with her husband in his parents' home in the Llojeta area.  She is a young, hard-working woman, whose wish is to expand her restaurant and provide better comfort for her customers.
local_use: to buy tables, chairs, and other things to expand her business.

description:
Vali A. is 43 years old. Together with his wife he has been raising cattle for more than 3 years. This produces the income which allows him to feed his  wife and 3 children . As well as caring for his livestock, Vali also cultivates agricultural crops which helps with the family's diet and provides additional income. Vali has asked for this loan to buy young cattle in order to obtain a better profit. His greatest wish is to be able to improve his farm by constructing enclosures and establishing better grazing for his livestock.

local_use: Purchasing of young cattle

description: Guillermina is 47 years old, a teacher in the suburbs in Rio Rama. She teaches the rural children of this community. She is asking for her second loan in order to buy construction materials and thus little by little to improve the infrastructure of her house. Her life partner works as a brick layer, and helps with the family expenses and loan commitments. This humble teacher is loved by her parents, students and colleagues because of her great love for teaching and being a simple woman. Her dream is to have a better future and stable working conditions so she can provide for her beautiful family.
local_use: to purchase construction materials

description:
Dalia is requesting a new loan to be able to invest in the business and also to make some improvements to her home.  She will invest specifically in the purchase of corn, condiments, fried pork, oil and drinks.  She will also invest in the improvement of the floor of her house, installing bricks.  This loan will be a great help that will allow her to improve the business and also her home.

With the previous loan she managed to have a good investment as she also carried out other improvements in her house.  At this time she has faced a painful situation as four months ago her husband died due to health problems.  She is still facing this situation but she hopes to keep herself busy to be able to overcome it.
local_use: to buy corn, condiments, fried pork, oil and drinks.

S. Rano is 45 years old. She is married and is the mother of 4 children. For many years her husband has worked in Russia. Supporting her family on her own was very difficult. 

To improve her living conditions, Rano decided to start her own business processing dried clingstone apricots and selling them at the local market. The business has gone very well and now Rano needs a loan in order to meet the demand of her customers. She is requesting a loan of $1000 USD to purchase more clingstone apricots. Rano feels this is the only way to earn enough to ensure that her children can stay in school and have a bright future.

description:
Señor Sixto is a member of the communal bank "Perolniyoc" located in the district and province of Urubamba in the department of Cusco. 

Señor Sixto is 38 years old, lives with his partner and has one child.  He alternates his daily activities with his carpentry business.  He makes things like tables, chairs and doors.  He works from 7:00 am until 5:00 pm and then he sells his products independently.  He wants to expand and improve his carpentry business.  He is requesting a loan to buy wood, glue and paint to make tables, chairs and doors.  

He is happy about the loan and is committed to making his payments on time.
local_use: buy wood, glue and paint to make tables, chairs and doors for his carpentry business.

description:
A group of friends and neighbors form the body of the communal bank “Mamacha Rosario” in the district of Huancarani in the province of Paucartambo and department of Cusco. This communal bank is made up of people who are searching continuously for opportunities to get ahead, and to bring a better future to their children through their daily efforts.  The primary business activities of the members are, for example: food sales, creation of wooden furniture, sales of crafts, a grocery store, fuel sales, beer and chicha (a fermented corn drink) sales, farming of small domesticated animals, and much more.

Victoria remains a member of the communal bank and her primary economic success has been in the sales of fuels like gasoline and oil.  She continues to run a shop where she sells fuels and lubricants, but she also does agricultural work and grows potatoes and barley.  She buys fuels from one of the outlets near the city of Huancarani.  IT has now been several years since she began this business, and it is going very well for her, thanks to the effort she puts into her work.  At this time, Victoria is in need of a loan to buy lubricants and additives.  The members as a whole are thankful for the opportunity that has been offered and promise to make payments of each of their different loans on schedule as arranged.  (The people who appear on the left-hand side of the photo arrived late to the meeting of the communal banking group.)
local_use: to buy lubricants and additives.

description:
The member belongs to the “Amauta” communal bank located in Huanchac District, Cusco Province and Department.

She is 67 years old, single and has two children.  She runs a grocery store.  She buys and sells all sorts of basic need items like: rice, noodles, flour, oil and soft drinks, among others.  She also owns a car wash and lubrication service.  She needs the loan to buy rice, sugar, flour, oil and everything related to stocking her grocery store.  She is asking for the loan to buy basic need items.

She is very satisfied and grateful for the support provided and commits to repay her debts in a timely fashion.
local_use: to buy stock items for her store.

description: Estela, 62, is married and has five children.  She is a retired teacher.  Now that Christmas is approaching she sells panettones [traditional Christmas cake] and also sells beauty products like creams, perfume and lipstick.  She requests the loan to buy panettones at wholesale and also to buy beauty products like perfume, creams and lipstick.  She is satisfied with the granted loan and commits to make her payments according to the established payment schedule.
local_use: to buy panettones at wholesale and also to buy beauty products.

Yodgorjon is a taxi driver and travels through the streets of Dushanbe, Tajikistan, in search of customers. He has owned his business for ten years. Currently Yodgorjon’s car needs some repairs and he wants to borrow 5,000 Somoni which will go towards repairs of his vehicle. Part of the loan will also be used to purchase tires. Yodgorjon thanks Kiva and all lenders that make this help possible. description:
This member belongs to the "CUSCO" Communal Bank.  The bank is located in the district of Cusco, which belongs to the province of Cusco and department of Cusco.

The member is Señora Obdulia; she is 57 years old, and is single with three children.  The member combines her daily activities with her business selling underwear; she sells items such as polo shirts and men's briefs.  The member works from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m.  Through this business, the member is able to move her children ahead in life.

The member wants to grow and improve her business selling underwear. The member is requesting a loan to buy underwear items such as polo shirts and briefs at wholesale.  The member is happy about the loan, and promises to comply with the repayments of her share.
local_use: to buy underwear items such as polo shirts and men's briefs at wholesale.

description:
Rahmon is a businessman who successfully combines running his business and taking care of his family of three people. He has two children. Rahmon is originally from Isfara, a city in the south of Tajikistan. He started his business 15 years ago, after a desperate period of unemployment when his family didn’t get enough for their most basic needs. Today, he offers his services as a woodworker. Rahmon has a perfect credit history. He has already repaid one loan from IMON International without any delinquencies. This time, Rahmon is requesting a loan of $1200 USD to purchase wood products like bold timber, plank timber for his production. We believe this loan will also be repaid promptly.

description:
Ruth was born in and lives in the historical city of Cusco in the Cusco, Perú, department. People in the city of Cusco devote themselves to different types of businesses and providing services. The businesses are strongly related to tourism. However, some of them, like Ruth's, is not.  Ruth sells clothes and general products.

Ruth needs the loan to buy more clothes and other products. Ruth belongs to the “Hijas de María” (María’s Daughters) Communal Bank with the Asociación Arariwa in Cusco, Peru. The communal bank is in its third year, and it is going very well for all of the members.
local_use: To buy more clothes and other products

description:
Mrs. Victoria is a long-time member of the institution.  For 13 years she has been operating a stand, where she sells linseed drinks and meat pies, in one of the busiest markets of the city of Cochabamba.  She plans to use the loan to buy construction materials so she can finish the house she is building and set up a store in her home to sell basic needs items in the afternoons.

She is separated and her children are independent but she helps care for her grandchildren.  She lives with her son and is very grateful to the institution for the support she has received.
local_use: To buy construction materials and increase work capital

description:
David belongs to the “San Roque” communal bank located in Andahuaylillas District belonging to Quispicanchis Province and Cusco Department.  He’s 20-year-old and single.

He alternates his daily activities with providing taxi services.  He works for a few hours during the day since he’s also preparing to enter the university to study Economics.  He’s a cheerful, responsible person who very much wants to continue with his studies and working for his future.  He’s requesting a loan to pay for his college-prep course.

The other group members have a grocery store, make chicha [corn-based drink], buy and sell crafts, have a restaurant, raise small farm animals, raise cattle, sell corn and teach.

The member in the inserted photo requested permission to miss the meeting because of his work so his photo was taken later.

David is grateful for the loan he’s being granted and commits to make his payments.
local_use: to pay for his college-prep course.

description:
Jhonny works for a private business as a security guard.  He is married and has two beautiful children.  

His goal for his loans from Afodenic has been to improve his house because he hopes to have a safe home for his family.  Part of the house is still made of corrugated tin, and he will only be able to achieve his goal with these loans.

With this new loan, he would like to continue improving the concrete walls of the house.  He plans to purchase stones, sand, and cement to continue his work.
local_use: Purchase construction materials to continue improvements on his house

description: Mr. Severo lives in San Carlos, 25 km from El Torno where he works. He lives with his wife and children. They plant corn, watermelon and beans. They take everything that they harvest to sell in the El Torno market. He is from Cochabamba and came in search of a better life, which he found in San Carlos. Through the agricultural syndicate, he has his own land which he works. This is his first loan, and he will use it to buy seeds and also to pay the workers for their work preparing the lands. He is a very hard-working person and is grateful to the institution for the support offered.
local_use: for sowing corn

description:
S. Ahliddin is 38 years old. He is married with six children. Ahliddin is selling foodstuffs like macaroni, wheat, buckwheat, cottonseed oil and other products. When Ahliddin started the business two years ago it was only retail sales. Gradually expanding the business, he purchased the goods as a wholesaler and distributed them among the stores. The business became successful and stable.

Currently Ahliddin requests $2,000 US for the term of 12 months. The loan will be spent for purchasing foodstuff to increase the range of goods for selling. Ahliddin thanks all supporting him and promises to pay the loan in a timely manner.

description:
Justina is a member of the communal bank "SR. OF TANTAMARCA". This bank is located in the district of Chicon, in the province of Urubamba, department of Cusco. Justina is 33 years old, she is a single mother of four children, aged 15,13, 9 and 4. She is a farmer and her work is to plant and harvest her land. Justina requests a loan to buy corn and maize seeds as well as potatoes to plant; she will also buy fertilizer for the soil. 
Justina acknowledges and appreciates the loan through this medium and she also takes the commitment to meet the payment deadlines of her rates.
local_use: Purchase seeds and fertilizer

description: Mrs. Nora is married and has four independent children. She lives in the Villa Nueva Potosí area in her parent's home and has been a jewelry maker for 20 years. She has a store in the central area where she sells jewelry such as earrings, chains, corsages and brooches for women who wear skirts. Her husband is also a jewelry maker and they both have many customers because they make beautiful pieces of jewelry. She is also a member of the communal bank Fortuna Tejar. She needs the loan to buy wholesale gold and silver since she is being offered good prices and she wishes to have more materials since she will have more sales during the end of year holidays. She is a woman with a drive to succeed and is thankful for the help being offered by the institution.
local_use: buy wholesale gold and silver.

description:
The partner belongs to the communal bank "GRAN RENOVACION" [Great Renovation]. This bank is located in the district, province, and department of Cusco.

The partner is Nilda. She is 56 years old, is married, and has two children. She alternates her daily activities with the business of selling beauty products. She sells lipstick, perfume, and creams among other beauty products. She sells in an independent way, taking her products to different places such as institutions and the public in general. She wants to improve and enlarge the beauty products sales business. She is asking for this loan to buy wholesale beauty products.

She is happy because of the loan, and she promises to follow through with the payments of her dues.
local_use: to buy wholesale beauty products.

description:
Justina was born in the department of Arequipa and is 62 years old. She now lives in the Imperial City of the Incas (Cusco, Peru). She is a responsible mother who works selling food. She has a restaurant where she sells lunch. At this time, she needs a loan to buy ingredients like rice, sugar, noodles, and other things.

Justina is a responsible person who belongs to Asociación Arariwa's "Ana Jarvis III" communcal bank in the city of Cusco, Peru.
local_use: to buy rice, sugar, noodles, and other ingredients

description: Leeya is a 49-year-old married woman with six children living in her own semi-permanent house in Fort Portal, Uganda. Her main dream is to construct a permanent house for her family and to educate her children to higher levels of learning. She operates a saloon, hires out chairs, provides catering services and is a farmer. She has a challenge of high operational costs involved in the other businesses and her dream is to specialize in farming. Leeya needs the loan to pay the laborers who are clearing land for the next season.
local_use: To pay laborers to clear the land for the next season.

description:
Doña Eugenia is a merchant who sells clothing, cosmetics, and silver jewelry. For the past four years, she has worked for the common good of her family. Her husband works as plumber for the Enacal Company. Her three young children are in school.

Eugenia started out selling ice and fresh “chicha” (a beverage made from corn). Later she obtained financing in order to buy clothing and cosmetics. She was able to attract customers and obtain orders.

Today with the new loan, Eugenia hopes to repair a section of the roof of her house. She also needs to buy windows because the only coverings she has are fiberboards and metal grating. With the funding from AFODENIC, Eugenia hopes to make her home safer.
local_use: to buy windows and repair a section of her roof in order to make her home safer.

description:
Jorge lives with his wife and children.  He has had an electronics repair shop for the last two years.  He repairs all kinds of electrical appliances.  He learned through studies and today does this work to support his family.

He wants to buy parts and clamps for the workshop because he has some unfinished jobs.  He is asking for the loan to do the purchase so that he can have available everything he needs to finish his pending jobs and be ready for the next ones that might arrive.  His objective is to stay in business, enlarge the shop and generate improved income every day for his family.
local_use: to buy parts and clamps for the shop.

description:
Sreymom, age 26, is a garment worker. She and her husband Chamreun, age 29, have been married since 2005 and have two children, both of whom are in school. Sreymom also has one brother and her elderly mother living with her. The family lives in a suburb of Phnom Penh.

Sreymom and her husband are both garment workers, and when rice farming season comes, they also hire fellow villagers to help them grow rice. 

Sreymom is asking for her first loan in the amount of $700 in order to purchase one cow to raise. She will get extra income from selling the cow for beef as well as from selling any calves that the cow may produce. 

She will also use a part of the loan to pay for rice planting.
local_use: to purchase a cow to raise and to pay for rice planting

description: Kadiatu is 42, married, and has four children aged 20, 17, 14 and 8. In 2006, Kadiatu established her business selling foods such as garri (a staple made from cassavas), bulgur, groundnuts, salt and beans. She started this business to help support her husband provide livelihood for their family. Working 7 days a week, 12 hours a day, she earns about Le 600,000 every month from this business. She would like a loan of Le 3,000,000 to help her buy more food stuffs for her business. She hopes that this loan will enable her to increase her monthly profits by approximately Le 200,000. In the future, Kadiatu plans to embark on an international business and educate her children to university level. The current inflation level is her major business challenge. She thanks you for your support.
local_use: To buy more foods to sell

description:
José is 32 years old and has a child. His father taught him how to work on agricultural jobs and he has been working since he was 8 years old. 

The loan that he is requesting to is buy 4 sacks of manure, herbicides, and payment of manual labor to clean and remove the crops for sowing. With the production he will have sufficient for consumption and sale to other people.  He desires to cultivate more products to increase his income and no longer borrow loans.
local_use: to is buy 4 sacks of manure, herbicides, and payment of manual labor to clean and remove the crops for sowing

description:
Mrs. Pastora V. is 42 years old. She is a hard-working woman who, thanks to a microcredit loan, has been selling mixed drinks, soft drinks, and beans for many years. She lives in the neighborhood La Primavera, and has 2 children (11 and 19). Both are in school. Mrs. V. plans to invest this loan from Afodenic in the purchase of fish, shrimp, etc. in order to offer a wider variety of foods and increase her profits since they are popular foods from which one can prepare many delicious dishes. Her plans are to put her business on sure footing so that she can help her children turn out to be upstanding people.

Translated from Spanish by Cyrus Maher, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Purchase of seafood

description:
Sr. Miguel Arcangel is a member of the Communal Bank “Santa Rosita de Ayllupampa” which is located in the District and Province of Urubamba, Department of Cusco.

He is 46 years old, single, and has three children. Miguel divides his time between his daily activities and his business selling wood as an independent vendor in Urubamba Province. This business enables his children to get ahead. He wants to expand his business of selling wood. The loan he is requesting will be used to buy wood in bulk.

Miguel is happy with the loan and promises to complete his payments.
local_use: To purchase wood in bulk.

description:
José has his own business selling dairy products.  He is married, lives with his family, and has no children.  He learned the work on his own and has 14 years of experience.

He has requested a loan with the organization because he needs to buy merchandise such as milk, cheese, cream, curd, soft cheese, and loroco [an edible flower].  The loan will help him improve his business and generate more income for his household.

The dreams he hopes come true for him are, above all, to improve his business and his house, to be able to have a better quality of life.
local_use: to buy milk, cheeses, and curd.

description:
Devote is a 34-year-old merchant from the town of Rutonde in the country's central Gitega Province. She has been selling chickens for 10 years, a job that requires her to make regular trips to the capital Bujumbura, in order to sell them. She was a banana vendor before she started this activity.

She studied up to sixth grade. She is married to Alphonse and they are parents of a 10-year-old currently in fourth grade.

The Kiva loan of 120,000 Burundian francs allows her to increase her capital to buy many more chickens for resale, so she can realize large profits and increase her savings.

She is a member of the "Kenguruka" community group.
local_use: increase her working capital to buy more chickens for resale, so she can realize large profits and increase her savings

description:
Seferina García D. C. has been selling food for many years from a small kiosk in a residential neighbourhood of La Paz, work which brought income for her family. She came to Emprender as a guarantor to her goddaughter who rented her the kiosk. With time, her goddaughter left without a trace, leaving Seferina García with this debt. This is how this woman showed from the beginning a great will to pay and sense of responsibility together with her husband who supports her unconditionally. And so she was introduced to microloans; happily for herself and her family she is now on her third loan cycle and selling food from her little kiosk.

Translated from Spanish by Laure Kwon, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Working capital

description: Luis Alberto was born in the city of Cuzco (Peru) and is 46 years old. At present, Luis Alberto  lives in the same city where he was born together with his two children. Luis Alberto sells natural medicines. He has had this business for 12 years and it is going well for him thanks to the dedication that he brings to his work. At this time, Luis Alberto requires the loan to buy more natural medicines. He is a responsible and hardworking person and it was because of these qualities that the other members invited him to participate in the “Unión Latina” community bank of the Asociación Arariwa.
local_use: to buy more natural medicine.

description: Ana lives with her two children. She is married and works selling tostadas [fried or toasted tortillas]. She started her business on her own initiative because the circumstances made it necessary. She does not have a fixed schedule for tending to her customers. She is requesting a loan to buy cement, sand, brick, stone and more. This purchase will help her to improve her house so that she can have a more tranquil life with her children. Ana intends to keep working so that her family can get ahead and so that she can give her children an adequate education. She would also like to have a more secure house.
local_use: to buy cement, sand, brick and stone to make home improvements

description: Mahbuba has been involved in buying and selling national dishware for over 20 years.  She learned from co-workers about "Imon International" and decided to work with them. She plans to work together with "Imon International" in the future and open her own store.  She wants to obtain a loan in the sum of 4700 Somoni for the purchase of dishware in order to expand her business.
local_use: to purchase dishware

description:
E. Solijon is 36 years old and is married. Together with his wife they have four children, all of whom are still young and attending school. They are farmers who own a plot of land in their village and grow different kinds of crops like, wheat, potato, onion and other vegetables. They have been in this business since 2003. To reduce the hard physical labour and to expand the business, Solijon would like to apply for a loan to purchase seeds, fertilizer, fuels and lubricants.

description: Dania is a single mother; she lives in a community where safety and security are a top concern. Her plans are to prepare her son for a better future. She has an honest and humble occupation which requires a great deal of effort. She has been working as a janitor for a very long time and she also sells ladies' products from a specific commercial brand. She needs to improve the infrastructure of her home in order to provide her family with greater comfort. She previously borrowed to tile the floors in the house. At this stage of the home improvement project she needs to build a bedroom for greater privacy and security. With the loan she will purchase cement, construction blocks, rocks, steel, sand, gravel, sheets of zinc, and other materials.
local_use: to purchase construction materials to build a bedroom.

description:
This member belongs to " Solidaridad-Cachimayo", the bank is located in the District of Cachimayo in the Urubamba province and department of Cusco.

Bermardina is 57 years old, she is married, and has 2 children of ages 23 and 20. She has been working in the village of Cachimayo for several years and starting at 4pm she sells "salchipapas". She has a stand selling "salchipapas", they are prepared with hot dogs and fried potatoes and she works until 9:30PM.  She also works raising small animals like chicks and hens.  On this occasion the member need the loan to invest in the purchase of potatoes and hot dogs in order to increase business.

The member is thankful for the assistance being offered and as such, she commits to fulfill her payments in a disciplined manner.
local_use: to invest towards the purchase of potatoes and hot dogs in order to increase business.

description:
Aquiles lives in the home of his in-laws. He and his wife don't have children yet, but they wish to have children in the future. His principal activity is the internet; he has an internet cafe that he and his wife attend to, and it is going very well. The internet cafe is located in their domicile.

The loan will be invested in improving and furnishing an additional room for their internet cafe, since given the present number of customers, the space seems too small and Aquiles wants to expand the business. He is happy since, thanks to our institution's help, he can expand the business and improve his family's quality of life. This is their only source of income. Aquiles is an enterprising youth with the desire to get ahead. In time, he wants to open another branch of his business.
local_use: refurbish and improve an added room for his internet cafe.

description:
L. Idikhuja is 41 years old. Together with his wife, who works to help pay household expenses, they have five children. His goal for his children is to support them so that they may complete their studies leading to professional careers.

Idikhuja has worked as a farmer for the past five years. The greatest obstacles for him are pests. He began his work with his own efforts, and the help our organization was able to offer led to better production. With this loan Idikhuja will invest in the purchase of fertilizers and high quality seeds to get a better harvest, which he will be able to sell at a better market price. Let’s support this hard-working man so that he can reach his goals! 

More about Tajikistan and IMON International

Tajikistan is known for its rich history, which includes a key post along the Silk Road and the end of Alexander the Great's rule. It has also produced great thinkers, philosophers, scientists and poets, including Rudaki, Avicenna, Ferdowsi, Omar Khayyam, Jomi, and Rumi. The country is home to communities that still speak the ancient Sogdian language, epic mountain passes, and a civilization that dates back to the 4th millennium BC. And, even today, it is a complex mixture of the Islamic faith, Soviet culture, New West culture and Central Asian traditions.

But Tajikistan is also the poorest of the former Soviet republics. The civil war, which ignited soon after its independence from the U.S.S.R., further damaged the already weak economy. In addition, 93% of the country is mountainous and only 7% of the land is arable. These conditions have resulted in high levels of unemployment and have forced hundreds of thousands to seek work in other countries, mainly Russia. While the people of Tajikistan are working to improve its agricultural production and manufacturing sector, nearly two-thirds of the population still live in abject poverty.

IMON's History

Since December 2007, IMON International has worked closely with Kiva and Kiva lenders to ensure that poor and low income clients represent a viable business proposition. Funds raised through Kiva have already been distributed to thousands of IMON International's clients and will continue to provide thousands more with permanent access to the varied financial services they need. To learn more about IMON International's work, please visit: www.imon.tj
local_use: Purchasing of the seeds and mineral fertilizer.

description:
Marlon is a small business owner with more than seven years in the business. He has expanded it thanks to his commitment and thanks to the support of the institution through the three loans that he has received. He has been able to purchase more products and to generate a greater profit.

He started out selling only CDs and today he has increased his products and he has purchased a case where to display his merchandise. He purchase in wholesale at a market in the capital and taking advantage of lower prices he is able to offer his clients more affordable prices.

with this loan he will purchase: cellular phone chargers, cd cleaners, various brands of remote controls, headphones for cellular phones and for radios, calculators, movies, video cameras, and to purchase cosmetics to sell for Mother's Day. Afodenic (Kiva Field Partner) is the way to have a better investment at a lower interest rate.
local_use: to purchase cd's, movies, videos, remote controls, chargers, and other merchandise to increase his sales.

description:
Winfred is a 42-year-old  married woman with six children living in Kyenjojo, Uganda. She has been operating a salon business for eight years and she sold off one of her cows to start the business.

She is being faced with the problem of inadequate capital to meet  the different needs of her customers and well equip her salon.

She has a personal goal of educating her children and building a permanent home and her business goal is expanding her business into new marketplaces.

Winfred wants a loan to buy cosmetics for her salon. She is a member of the above-mentioned group.
local_use: to buy cosmetics for the salon.

description:
Fortunata continues to participate in the Communal Bank "Choquequirao" of the Arariwa Association of the city of Cusco.  She remains dedicated to her profession as a surgeon and continues to work in a public institution.

With her previous loan, Fortunata did very well and was able to get good benefits.  That is why she wants another loan as it helps her a lot in the office.

Fortunata is requesting the loan to buy medical equipment to use in her practice.

Fortunata is grateful for the opportunity afforded by these means and likewise agrees to comply with the payment schedule.
local_use: to purchase medical equipment to use in her practice.

description:
Tomasa is a member of the “MUNAY TIKA” community bank which is located in Urubamba district, in Urubamba province, in Cusco department.

Tomasa is 40 years old, lives with her partner, and has five children.  She divides her time between her daily activities and her business selling food.  She prepares different types of food such as chicken soup which she sells as an itinerant street vendor from 7.00am to 1.00pm.  Through this business, she gets her children ahead in life.  Tomasa would like to expand and improve her food business.  She is requesting a loan to buy products with which to prepare her food such as chicken, meat and vegetables.

Tomasa is happy to be receiving this loan and pledges to make her repayments on time.
local_use: to buy products for making meals such as chicken, meat and vegetables

description: Charles is a twenty-two-year-old married farmer with no children but with one dependent, living in Fort Portal Uganda. He owns a house and his family dream is to have a good family and a God-fearing one. He has been operating his farming business for the last fifteen years, since childhood, but facing a challenge of low prices and thieves who feed on his produce. This still encourages him that he will have a better farming business in future. He now wants to try all commercial methods of farming so as to realize increased and better production on his farmland. The purpose of the loan is to buy fertilizers, modern seeds for planting for the new season, and pay labor for clearing his farmland.
local_use: Buying fertilizers, modern seeds for planting for the new season, and paying labor for clearing his farmland

description: Maritza continues with her business selling building materials and supplies.  She buys building materials like cement, sand, concrete, bricks, stone and gravel, among many others at wholesale.  She’s been in this business 8 years and wants to continue growing.  She already has contracts for materials.  She’s highly sought after in the zone and wants on this occasion to invest the loan to pay off the delivery of materials that will arrive by truck next week.  She has a certain amount available but needs to increase her working capital with the required loan.  She is requesting the loan to invest in building materials like cement, concrete, sand and bricks.  In the near future, she’d like to retire and continue with the building supplies business because she’s gotten to like the business and does not want to fail her customers.
local_use: to buy building materials.

description:
Lidia was born in the city of Puno (Peru) and is 49 years old.  She currently lives in the beautiful city of Cusco (Peru).  Lidia has a small grocery store in her home.  She sells different basic household products to her neighbors such as rice, sugar, noodles, etc.  She has been in this business for 15 years and is doing very well thanks to the effort that she puts into her work.

On this occasion, Lidia needs the loan to buy merchandise such as rice, noodles, sugar, jars of milk, oats, gelatin, flour, etc.  

Lidia is a responsible and hard-working person who, owing to these personal qualities, was invited by her friends to join Asociación Arariwa's "Mosoq Allpa" community bank.
local_use: to buy merchandise

description:
Agnes is the representative of the L’Entente group. She is married and has two children. Her oldest child is 12 and the youngest is 2 years of age. One of her children goes to school, and she has one person under her care.

Agnes has sold disposable diapers and jewelry for one year. She gets her supplies in Ghana, a neighboring country. Her customers are store-owners and women (resellers).


She plans to buy 10 packets of diapers and 50 sets of jewelry. With her profits, she wants to improve her business and save. Her ambition is to care for her children and her brothers.
local_use: To buy 10 packets of diapers and 50 sets of jewelry.

description: He continues working in transportation.  He has a car he uses to provide taxi service in various streets in Cusco.  He works very hard and responsibly.  He’s been in business six years and does very well.  His dream is to own a new car.  He requests the loan to buy tires.  He’s happy with the granted loan and commits to make his payments.
local_use: to buy tires

description:
Gulandom is 27 years old, married, and has 2 children.  Her husband, Nasimjon, makes little money: his salary is not enough to provide his family with all the necessities of life.

For the well-being of her family, Gulandom has decided to help her husband and has enrolled in a course entitled "Achieving success" organized by the Business Women's Association.  She has obtained a certificate.

Since Gulandom is an experienced seamstress, she would like to start a sewing business and make women's clothing. 

She is requesting a loan of 600 somoni to buy the equipment necessary to start her new business.  She is relying on your kindness.
local_use: to buy a sewing machine to start a new business.

description:
Joseph is a 38-year-old businessman who sells clothing and local brew in Karuguuza, Uganda. He is married with eight children and lives in a semi-permanent house of four rooms. His long term plan is to have a general merchandise wholesale shop.

Joseph has been in the clothing and local brew business for ten years and hopes to begin packaging the local brew and purifying it. The purpose of this loan is to buy more of the local brew to sell.
local_use: To buy more local brew to sell

description: Elena has been selling candy, chocolates, etc for parties and restaurants in the evenings for the past twenty-five years.  She lives in a rented place by herself, is separated, and her children are adults and independent.    This is her fourth loan cycle.  She belongs to the Banco de Emprendimiento Principiantes communal bank.  In the second cycle Elena proved that she was a responsible person and she alone supports herself.  She also sells quinoa and once a month she travels to a business in Oruro to buy quinoa to resell in Cochabamba.  She is hardworking and always active.  With the money from the loan she will buy candies and chocolates to have a variety of products to offer her customers.  She is grateful to the institution for the support given her by extending the financing.
local_use: To buy candies, chocolates, and more

description:
Geovanni lives in his own home with his grandmother, sister, and two nephews. He is 26 years old. For ten years, he has managed a household supplies store that he inherited from his mother.

He is requesting a loan to buy merchandise such as snacks, cookies, sugar, rice, oil, and other products to stock the store. By expanding his inventory, he can better serve his customers. He also wishes to improve his financial situation with the support of this loan and continue studying at the university.
local_use: to buy snacks, cookies, sugar, rice, and oil.

description:
Mr. Juan de Dios is 52 years old. His business is running a local store which, with much effort, he was able to build up with savings and loans over the last nine years. He lives in Laureles Sur and he and his wife have 2 children, 7 and 14 years old, who are primary school students. His plan is to be able to buy a vehicle in order avoid paying for a taxi when he goes shopping to fill the inventory of the store because he is not on the route of most of the delivery trucks. With this loan he is going to increase the daily supplies he carries, like canned goods. He hopes to provide better service to his customers and thanks to this loan from Afodenic be able to make his business grow. He hopes later to make it larger, and help his children complete primary school.

Translated from Spanish by Daniel Burke, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Buy canned goods to supply his store.

description:
Alicia is 24 years of age.  She was born in the city of Urubamba in the department of Cusco and lives in the same city. Alicia is dedicated to raising guinea pigs, pigs and chickens.  She also plants vegetables and for this she rents a small farm.  She has been dedicated to this business for two years and it goes well thanks to the effort that she puts into her work.  At this time she requires a loan to buy chickens.  

Alicia belongs to the “Mainique” communal bank of the Arariwa Association and she is thankful for the opportunity offered her through this medium.  She also promises to comply with the payment schedule.
local_use: to buy chickens.

description:
Julio Alberto A. is 75 years old and lives in a neighborhood of Ticuantepe together with his wife, who helps him with the farm work. They are raising two dependent grandchildren, a nine year old girl and a seven year old boy. Their plan for the family is to improve the conditions in which their grandchildren live in order to improve their wellbeing. Julio has been working in agriculture for 25 years. The greatest difficulty he faces is the loss of crops, since the gases from a nearby volcano affect the crops. He started his farming business with his own efforts. He wants the loan in order to buy supplies and fertilizer in roder to improve the quality of his crops, reap a good harvest and sell his products at a better price in the market.

Translated from Spanish by Erin Corcoran, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Purchase of supplies and fertilizers in order to improve his harvest

description:
María lives with her family. She is the mother of two children, aged 4 and 6. She sells bread in the nearby villages every afternoon. She is a hard-working woman and committed to the well-being of her children.

She applies for a loan to buy flour, eggs, firewood and some other ingredients that are needed to make bread. The loan will be very useful to her because she is about to run out of ingredients and she hopes to be able to resolve her situation.

Her dream is to see her children grow up and get a proper education and that she can provide them with a stable home and look after their needs.
local_use: to buy flour, eggs and firewood for her bakery.

description:
Dilia lives in the area of Villa 1ro de Mayo.  She makes aprons, capes and caps to distribute to the hairdressers and beauty schools in Villa 1ro de Mayo.  She is a single mother and has a five-year-old daughter.

Besides her sewing, Dilia rents out costumes and party clothes that she makes and has available for different social events.  Recently she has begun a new project producing graduation events for kindergarteners. 

Dilia is a very responsible and enterprising woman.  She wants the new loan in order to expand her sewing workshop, buying sewing machines and buying fabric for the aprons, capes and caps she makes since at this time of the year the beauty school graduations increase demand for these items.  Dilia is very grateful to the institution for the support given to her.
local_use: Buy fabric, buttons and a sewing machine

description:
Laura is 35 years old and lives in the Fuente neighborhood. She is married and her husband sells costume jewelry. One of her future plans is to totally improve her house. She is and enterprising, hardworking woman with a strong vision of overcoming obstacles. She has had her own business selling cosmetics for a year. She started it through her job. She began selling to her co-workers and in this way she increased her income. She began to have a larger amount of product and obtained more orders and kept herself in the market. Thus far she has not had any difficulties and that has been an advantage to continue increasing sales of her products. Her work plans are to keep expanding, placing her jewelry stores in better locales and making greater earnings. With the loan that she is asking for, she will invest in purchasing Avon product such as: skin creams, women's perfume, men's cologne, blush, baby shampoo and other items in order to have more sales. The institution has been a wonderful door to her investment.

Translated from Spanish by Ellen Donohue, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: She will buy Avon products such as: women's perfume, men's cologne,  blush, baby shampoo, and other products that are big sellers so that she can diversify her small business.

description:
Jockus is a twenty-six-year-old married man with two children living in Kasese, Uganda. He has been operating a retail shop for two years. He started with 100,000 shillings and now has 1,500,000 shillings as working capital. His hardships are customers not paying on time and inadequate capital to purchase enough stock. His personal goals are educating his children and building a permanent home. His business goals are buying land to grow crops and expanding his business to new markets. 

Jockus wants money to pay school fees for his children.
local_use: To pay school fees for his children.

description: Yudis runs a pupuseria [cafe that makes and sells pupusas] for a living. She lives with her family, her husband and their daughter.  She started this business with her mother's help as she needed a source of income.  She is working from her house and right now, things are going well.  She is requesting a loan to buy corn, quesillo [soft cheese], oil and other products that she needs in her pupuseria such as soft drinks and juices.  The loan will help her to have all that she needs and work better with her customers.  Her dream is to have her own house, apart from her family, increase her business and that her family has a more comfortable life.
local_use: purchase corn, quesillo, oil, soft drinks and juices.

description: Farhod is married with three children. He is a market vendor from Khujand where he sells clothing for teenagers. Farhod is very enterprising, has vast experience working as a vendor and is full of creative ideas. A reasonable pricing policy and client-friendly service have always been priorities in his work and have helped to ensure the success of his business. Farhod has been running his business for many years. He has about 11 years of experience selling clothing. Currently, he is requesting a loan of $3,000 USD to increase his inventory. description:
Peter is a hardworking married father of 6 children. He lives in his own house and has no other dependents. His goal for his family is to educate his children.

He is a crop farmer and has been farming for quite some time. He faces a challenge of seasonal variations which affects his crop yields and his dream is to venture into better methods of farming. Peter needs a loan to buy farm inputs (fertilizers, etc.)
local_use: to buy farm inputs (fertilizers, etc.)

description:
Margot is part of the Los Diamantes communal bank. This bank, whose name means “The Diamonds” in English, consists of 32 members all hailing from the Cuzco area. Margot is 38 years old and lives with her spouse and their two children (ages 11 and 15) in the city of Cuzco. Her children are both enrolled in local schools. 

Margot makes her living in the decoration industry. Specifically, she makes and sells curtains. She also installs the curtains in clients’ houses. Margot will use her Kiva loan to further this business, buying more materials to increase her production output. 

Margot is appreciative of and thankful for the loan and promises to pay the monthly payments on time.
local_use: To buy fabric to make and sell curtains

description:
Fred is a 54-year-old married man with 6 children and has 4 other dependents. He lives in his own residential house with 4 family members. His family goal is to have educated children and a farm. His home address is Masindi, Uganda. 

He is into the transportation business and has been running it for one year. He bought the vehicle using his retirement package. He faces a challenge of high fuel prices and obtaining vehicle spare parts. In future he wishes to have a fleet of trucks and he wants the loan to purchase new tyres for his vehicle.
local_use: Buying tyres for his vehicle for transport business

description:
The member belongs to the communal bank "SAN MARTIN DE ZURITE", which is located in the district of Zurite, Anta Province, in Cusco Department.

Encarnacion, the member, is still selling vegetables at the market, working from 7:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.  She sells carrots, squash, tomatoes, onions, etc., Monday through Sunday, and has been in business for quite some time.  Business is going well thanks to her hard work.  She is a responsible, hard-working person who is able to provide for her family this way.

The member is requesting a loan to buy vegetables wholesale, such as carrots.

She is happy about the loan and committed to paying it back on time.
local_use: To buy vegetables wholesale, such as carrots.

description:
Vilma is 35 years old and her business is selling tortillas.  She lives in Jucuapa, in Usulután department, with her husband and daughter.  She started her business with her mother when she was 10 years old.  Her current work day is from 6.00am to 5.00pm.  She works in the town market.

Vilma needs to have a supply of materials in stock and she is requesting a loan to buy corn, firewood and propane gas.  This investment will allow her to maintain a good level of raw materials on hand for her tortilla business and to increase her production.  Her goal is to have a stable business with a lot of customers and to make income for her family.
local_use: To buy corn, firewood and propane gas

description:
Sra. Juana, 52, is a member of the Hacia El Triunfo ("On To Victory") community bank in the Peruvian "departamento" of Cusco.

Sra. Juana is married and has 2 children.  She works as a nurse at the Antonio Lorena hospital.  She is a hard-working, responsible woman and she supplements her nursing income with a clothing sales business.  She set up the business to increase her income so that she could provide a better standard of living for herself and her children.  She will use the loan to buy merchandise for her clothing business.

Sra. Juana is grateful for the loan and committed to repaying it in the agreed-upon time.
local_use: Buy merchandise for clothing business.

description:
Felipa belongs to the “Señor D. Coylloritti D. Corao” community bank.  The bank is located in Corao district, in Cusco province, in Cusco department.

Felipa is 52 years old.  She is divorced and has 3 children.  She divides her time between her daily activities and her business selling meat and agricultural products.  She has a small stall in Corao district.  She would like to have a store so that she can sell her meat and agricultural products such as corn, beans and potatoes.  She would like to expand her stall.  She is requesting this loan to buy agricultural products and meat wholesale.

She is grateful to those who will take part in her dream by funding her loan and pledges to make her repayments in a timely manner.
local_use: To buy agricultural products and meat wholesale

description:
Sra. Marcelina is a member of the Communal Bank “Choquequirao” which is located in the District, Province, and Department of Cusco.

She is 35 years old, in a common law marriage, and has three children. Marcelina divides her time between her daily activities and managing her business selling woven handicrafts. She produces sweaters made of alpaca wool and other types of creations. Marcelina sells at the fairs in the central part of the city on the weekends. She enjoys this business very much since it gives her financial as well as personal satisfaction. Marcelina is a cheerful individual who is eager to succeed on behalf of her family. The loan she is requesting will be used to buy merchandise for her business so that she can have more to offer to her customers.

Marcelina is happy with the loan and promises to complete her payments.
local_use: To purchase merchandise to sell in her craft business.

description:
Mr. Noeun C. assists his wife selling fruit. They buy fruit from Derm Kor market in Phnom Penh for resale in front of a garment factory near their village. Noeun wants to create another business driving a remoque taxi (a motorbike connected to a trailer at the back). He will be able to earn more income to support his family. Hence, Noeun is requesting a loan of $1,200 US to buy a motorbike and a trailer for launching this business.

Noeun, 39, and his wife, Mrs. Chantha Sien, 40, have been married since 1990 and have five children: one son and four daughters. The eldest daughter works in garment factory and the other four children are in school. They live in a small village along National Road No. 5, about 20 kilometers from Phnom Penh.

Mr. Noeun C. is not in the photo; his wife was available instead.
local_use: To purchase a motorbike and a trailer to drive as a remoque taxi

description:
Sarah is a 49-year-old lady and is a single mother of five children. She lives in the small town of Hoima, in Uganda, where she sells dry foods such as beans, maize and groundnuts (peanuts).

Sarah is enjoying her business, she says, with no major hard ships so far, meaning: “so far, so good”. As for her business, she says she would like it to grow, with a big store of her produce, so as to be a large-scale produce dealer with higher returns.

This is Sarah’s second year in the business and she opted to obtain this loan from HOFOKAM so as to purchase more beans and groundnuts to sell at her food stall in Hoima.
local_use: To purchase more beans and groundnuts to sell

description:
María lives in the San Simón department of Morazán.  She sells basic, essential items.  She is 32, married, but does not yet have children.  Her business is more than six years old, and she works from 6am to 7pm.  She now needs to purchase merchandise for inventory.
She requests this loan to invest in merchandise such as rice, sugar, beans, cooking oil, and bathroom tissue.  With this loan, the business will be well-equipped and able to meet the needs of customers.  The goals of María are to make a good investment, supply her business with everything necessary to satisfy her customers, and to have children and care for them.
local_use: Purchase of merchandise such as rice, sugar, beans, cooking oil, and bathroom tissue

description:
Gregoria, age 41, is the single mother of four children, ages 15, 12, 8, and 1.  

Gregoria makes and sells food.  This is her first loan cycle with the institution.  Gregoria will use this loan to buy supplies like rice and potatoes to make her delicious food.  Her reason for requesting this loan is that she wants to take advantage of the benefits of buying supplies for her business in large quantities.

Gregoria faces a challenge in her business; she does not have a fixed sales location.

She will use the profits from the loan to buy a fixed stand at the market in her area.  This is her biggest wish.  

Gregoria is a very hard-working person.  Through this business activity she, alone, gets her children ahead.

She is accompanied in the photo by her eight year old daughter.
local_use: to buy supplies like rice and potatoes.

description:
Since she was young, Ruzigul N.  has enjoyed the countryside. Her family dedicated themselves to cultivating fruits and vegetables and Ruzigul always imagined she’d be in the business of selling produce.  Fortunately she has realized this dream. She began to sell vegetables in small markets.  Little by little, she saved money so she could set up her own shop. Thanks to her efforts and the love she has for this business, Ruzigul’s business has been growing. Now Ruzigul believes it is the time to inject more capital into the business so that she can buy at wholesale and obtain better prices.  She is soliciting a loan of 1500 Somoni. With your help, Ruzigul will be able to move her business forward and offer her family a better future.

description:
Liliana, who is 38 years old, is married and has four children. She was born in the Anta Provincia district of Cusco, and she now lives with her husband in the same city.

Liliana bakes bread and rents her neighbor's oven. She has been working with the oven for two years, and things are going very well.

Liliana hopes to receive a loan of $600 USD, and she will use this money to buy ingredients such as flour, yeast, sugar, salt, etc. Liliana's dream is to buy some land and build her own oven.

Liliana belongs to the Velasco Astete communal bank, of Kiva partner UMF Asociación Arariwa. The communal bank is in its first year of operation, and it is well administered by the board of directors.
local_use: Purchase ingredients. For example: flour, yeast, sugar, salt, etc.

description:
Numon uses his small van as a taxi, transporting passengers around his hometown. He started driving a taxi 15 years ago. He makes around $10-$15 per day, which is enough to support himself, his wife and their two children. Numon is a positive influence on those around him and demonstrates responsibility and a good work ethic. He has requested a loan for $3,000 USD to replace his minivan with a bigger one. We are grateful for this opportunity to assist Numon with his business and to help keep him out on the road earning a living.
