description:
Santos Alberto G. Sánchez is 63 years old and lives in the neighbourhood San José de los Ríos, located in the municipality of Ticuantepe, together with his wife who works as a shopkeeper to support him with home expenses. They have seven children who are all independent. Their plans for their family are to improve their living conditions, because in spite of his age Santo has not finished building his house. For 35 years Santo has worked in agriculture after being left an inheritance by his parents to work the land with his children. During this time the greatest problem he has experienced is the variation in the price of pineapple as there have been seasons where his sales have been very low. He gives thanks to Afodenic for the opportunity of the loans he has previously taken out and technical assistance which he has used to improve his crops and establish another block of pineapples and half a block of pitahayas. However he only managed to do this because of the low interest he paid. With this current loan he will invest in the necessary fertilizers to improve his crops.

Translated from Spanish by Suzanne Grasso, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Purchase fertilizers to add to crops

description:
This member belongs to the ”QOLQUEWASI” communal bank.  This communal bank is located in Huanchac district, in the province of Cusco and department of Cusco.

This member is Señora Lucila; she is 49 years old and single.  She works for a state organization as a public personnel member, and she also works in parallel buying and selling from cosmetics catalogs.  The member offers beauty products for sale to her friends and work colleagues, such as perfumes, lipstick, mascara, and eye-shadow among other things.  Her customers place various orders, and once Lucila has the products, she delivers them and the purchasers pay for them in two installments.  In another two weeks, they get a new catalog with another set of products.

This member wants to invest the loan in purchasing the beauty products that are on offer from her catalogs, so that she can have them in her storeroom and sell them.  The member is requesting the loan to invest in purchasing beauty products.

The member is grateful for the loan and commits to making her repayments on schedule.
local_use: to invest in purchasing beauty products.

description:
Señora Zorayda is the mother of two school-aged children. Life hasn’t been easy for her as a single mother, and she has had to work hard to build a home. It was only made possible through loans that she paid back in installments. Zorayda sells food and cosmetics. She also works as a pharmacist in order to earn more money to cover her expenses since everything is so expensive. With this loan she will buy stones, sand, cement, and metal rods to add another room to her house. Her plans are longterm as the plastering, flooring, and painting still remain to be done, but she hopes one day to enjoy these improvements.

Translated from Spanish by Jane Agg, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: to buy construction materials and add a room to her house

description:
The two members of this group are Natalia and Elsa. The first, Natalia, sells tamales and chuchitos [food similar to tamales] every day in the municipal market. On the weekends, she has various stalls in different locations. This allows her to expand her market.

Elsa embroiders traditional blouses and sells them in the market. The two have worked with Fape for a long time, and have demonstrated their responsibility and punctuality in their payments. They are requesting another loan in order to be able to purchase products for making tamales, since they want their families to prosper along with them.
local_use: the purchase of products for making tamales

description:
Sra. Lidia is a member of the Communal Bank “Nueva Victoria – Chinchero” which is located in the District of Chinchero, Urubamba Province, Department of Cusco.

She is 35 years old, in a common law marriage, and has three children (ages 12, 10, and 1). Lidia is an artisan who makes fabrics out of alpaca wool. Since 2000, she has been making and selling fabrics to all the tourists who visit the beautiful town of Chinchero. Lidia wants to invest her loan in the purchase of materials. She plans to buy alpaca wool, natural dyes, synthetic wool, sheep’s wool, knitting needles, buttons in all sizes, darning needles, and other supplies used for sewing and weaving. Lidia is requesting a loan to invest in the purchase of these materials for making fabrics.

She is happy with the loan being provided and promises to complete her payments on time.
local_use: To invest in materials and supplies for making fabrics.

description:
Guadalupe was born in the city of Cusco and is 34 years of age.  She lives in a common law marriage and has three children. 
 
Currently, Guadalupe lives in the city where she was born and where she works.  She sells wholesale meat in one of the most visited markets in the city of Cusco.  It has already been several years since she started working in this business and it is going very well.

For this opportunity, Guadalupe requires a loan in order to purchase more pork and beef.  Guadalupe's dream is to open an emporium.

The Communal Bank “Comuzone I” meets every 30 days in the city of Cusco (Perú). Cusco is known for its tourism, business and for its traditional celebration of Inti Raymi as well as because it is where you find one of the seven wonders of the world: "Machupicchu”.
local_use: to purchase more pork and beef

description:
Alexander is a 41-year-old father who lives in Los Chiles, located in the Northern region of Costa Rica. Alexander lives with his wife and son. Like many member of the Los Chiles community,  Alexander is a farmer. He dedicates his time to the planting and harvesting of various subsistence and revenue generating crops including chili peppers among others. This loan will be used to finance the production of Habanero chili peppers.  Specifically, Alexander will use this money to purchase seeds, fertilizer, tools, pesticides, and other materials/ingredients necessary to the production of chili peppers. All labor and transportation tasks will be carried out by Alexander and his family. 

Alexander dedicates half of his time to the production of staple foods such as yucca and milk. The rest of his time will be dedicated to the production of chili peppers. Alexander´s goal is to maintain stability in his family, achieve higher production rates, improve his economic situation and offer a better standard of living to his family. A major difficulty and limitation for Alexander has been a lack of access to working capital. He hopes to use this loan effectively to improve life on the farm for everyone.

Piper and Capiscum Processors Compañía Agrícola Industrial, or, PROPICA is an international buyer and seller of chili pepper and ground pepper products. In cooperation with Fundación Mujer, PROPICA has guaranteed to purchase the agricultural products (the peppers) that are to be produced with the help of this loan. PROPICA acts as a guaranteed client for small agricultural producers in the area of Los Chiles, thus ensuring that their products will reach market. The collaboration of Fundación Mujer and PROPICA represents a unique opportunity to Alexander, his family and community. By offering a source of start-up capital, and a guaranteed client to purchase what is produced, this is a chance to improve family and community standards of living. Above all, Alexander wants to take advantage of the current opportunity that has been presented. He wants to profit from this collaboration and see improvements in his neighborhood.
local_use: To purchase seeds and nutrients to produce chili peppers.

description:
Sochea (pictured here) and her husband, Roeung, live in suburb of Phnom Penh about 25 kilometers from the city. They have six children: two sons and four daughters. Three are married and live in separate homes, one is a teacher and another one is in university. 

Sochea and her husband are rice farmers. Roeung is also a retired teacher. Sochea is asking for her first loan in the amount of $200 to pay school fees for her daughter who is in university.
local_use: To pay school fees for her daughter who is in university.

description:
The member is 30 and is a member of the “MADRES TRABAJADORAS” (Working Mothers) communal bank located in Tica Tica District, Cusco Province and Department.

He belongs to this bank, formed initially by women who now invite their spouses and relatives to join. He has a live-in spouse and two children who are 10 and 8 years of age.  He alternates his daily chores with providing taxi services.  He has a car of his own and leaves home at 6am every day.  He takes a break from 1-3pm and then goes out again until 10 at night.  He wants the loan this time to repair his vehicle. He is planning on purchasing spare rims for his car and also to pass the technical revision. He is asking for the loan to invest in vehicle (taxi) repair.

He is satisfied with the granted loan and commits to repay in a timely fashion.
local_use: to pay for vehicle (taxi) repair.

description:
Jenny has been a client of Emprender since 2007, when she began working with an entrepreneurial bank by the name of El Condor. As the years passed she realized she needed to take out an individual loan, and she has never failed to make either of her payments on time, demonstrating punctuality. The economic activity that she engages in daily is selling food at a small place located at the El Condor Plaza in the city of La Paz. She lives with her husband Fernando and her two young daughters. Her husband assists with household expenses since he has a steady job. Jenny will invest the loan in the purchase of groceries for the business and in repairing the upholstery of the seating areas to improve its appearance.

Translated from Spanish by Amanda McDermott, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: It will be invested in repairing the upholstery of the seating at the business location

description:
Paula Lileth is married and has three children who go to school. The two older ones help her in the store where she sells daily consumption products. Five years ago she set up the store because the community where she lives did not have a store. She started selling fruits and vegetables. In time they generated income. That is how she decided to sell products like coffee, rice, beans, and other items that people consume. Paula now needs a loan because she wants to keep investing in her business. She want to be able to fulfill her dream of seeing her children graduate with a better future.

Translated from Spanish by Ginny Kalish, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Sale of daily consumption products

description:
Mrs. Chantha H. (shown in the photo), 40, and her husband, Mr. Vin Khin, 42, live in a suburb about 25 kilometers outside of Phnom Penh. They have been married since 1986 and have three children: two sons and one daughter. One of the children is married and lives outside the family home, one is a garment factory worker and another is still young. 

Chantha has been a garment factory worker for six years. She is asking for her first loan of $800 to build a fence around her house.
local_use: To build a fence.

description:
Mr. U. is single, 42 years old, and has two children, one son lives outside the country and a little girl who is 4 years old. HIs partner works for the health department. He is requesting his 9th loan the he will use to construct approximately seven meters of walkway. His previous loans have been used for improving his home, which is now in good condition. He has worked in the "Adan Barillas" health center for 22 years and tells us that AFODENIC is one of the lenders that has the most flexible policies, which is why he continues to work with the institution. On this occasion he has lowered the amount of his loan request because the current situation is very difficult and he does not want to fall behind.

Translated from Spanish by Laura Jung, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Construction of a walkway

description:
Sharifa is married with four children and lives in Isfara, Tajikistan. She sells groceries — a business she started with the help of her husband 10 years ago. She has built up a good clientele. Sharifa is requesting a 8800 Somoni loan to purchase foodstuffs for her grocery store. She is hoping to see her business expand and grow consistently. Sharifa has a cheerful personality which is always a positive factor in working with customers. She is willing to work really hard to see her business flourish in the future.

local_use: Purchasing foodstuff to increase the range of goods offered

description:
Our member Julio is a member of the "KUKILI" community bank and was born in city of Cuzco.

Our member is 32 years old, is married and the father of a 9 year old son. He is an entrepreneur. He has a pizzeria in the corner of his house in Mateo Pumacauha. He is a chef by trade, dedicating himself to concoct different dishes among them and all types of pastas and pizzas. Our partner has had this business for a year and is happy to have been able to maintain himself in the market due to the quality of his products.

Our member requests the loan to buy more supplies and reinvest in his pizzeria.

The member is thankful and expresses his satisfaction for being able to continue to grow his business. He sends a long-distance hug to the contributors to his dream.

Translated from Spanish by Betyna Almeida-Covarrubias, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Supplies

description: Luis needs a new loan. He will use it to buy herbicides against pests as well as seeds and fertilizer. He grows squash and papaya and is about to plant them again. These crops are very sensitive to damage that can be caused by by some pests and insects. Because of this he always has to incur costs   to prevent damage to his crops. He hopes that his harvests will be abundant and healthy. With the loans, Luis has been able to get ahead, since the products he works with require a lot of care and expense. That is why the financial help he has received has been his best option.
local_use: to buy fertilizer, herbicides, and squash and papaya seeds.

description:
Atulinda is 42 years old and father of eight children aged 10-19 living in Hioma, Uganda. He has other dependents and he lives in his own house with 11 family members. 

For seven years he has been farming and he started with a half an acre of land but now has ten acres. He faces a challenge of bad roads which makes transportation of his produce to the markets difficult and his vision is to start processing juice. Atulinda needs the loan to buy land for farming.
local_use: to buy land for farming.

description:
Emmanuel is 57 years old, married with three children, living in Masindi, Uganda. He got money from repairing motor vehicles and now he deals in the sale of motor vehicle spare parts. His dream is to construct houses for rent and increase his family income. The fact that workers are unreliable hinders his business, and his dream is to expand his shop and also set up a modern garage.

Emmanuel wants a loan to buy motor vehicle spare parts for sell. He is a member of Rapid Women Group where members guarantee each other in order to access a loan. Initially the group was for women and later they agreed to include men but retain their name.
local_use: to buy motor vehicle spare parts to sell.

description:
Baluku is a forty-two-year-old gentle man who has been running a retail shop for a period of two years. He started as a fishmonger then got capital to start a retail shop. Inadequate capital is affecting the business since customers have different tastes and demands. He has personal goals of building a permanent house and expanding his business to new markets. 

Baluku wants a loan to buy sugar and salt to sell.
local_use: to buy sugar and salt to sell.

description:
Luís F. is 34 and lives in the Villa Reconciliación neighborhood in the capital of Managua. His wife is a hairstylist and has two children. One of his short-term plans is to make improvements to his house to provide safety and security. He is knowledeable about construction because he's a construction foreman with 16 years of experience. Luís is going to use his loan to try to achieve his goal of finishing construction on his house to make his family comfortable. Thanks to the loan from AFODENIC he'll be able to buy rolls of construction materials, put in gates, and do the roofing, for the benefit of his family.

Translated from Spanish by Jill Heske, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy building materials to build a porch

description:
José was born in Cochabamba, a small city located in the central region of the country. For more than 15 years, he has settled in the city of Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia. Currently, he has 10 years of experience in the area of public transportation of passengers. For the first few years, he worked as a salaried driver. For the past two years, however, he is the proprietor of a microbus. It’s been only one year since he acquired membership in a transportation syndicate. Almost all his personal assets have been obtained with the help of loans with other institutions. He lives with his family, has a daughter, and they all live in his mother’s house. He is a new client of the institution who has a great desire to supersede.

Translated from Spanish by Mary Lynn Malaby, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To purchase tires.

description:
Murotjon R. is 27 years old and he lives with his wife and three children.  He has grown vegetables and wheat for more than four years.  His small plots are close to his home, which gives him plenty of time to care for his crops, family and children. The hard part is transporting his products into cities to sell, because of the scarcity of buses.  Murotjon gets most of his enthusiasm from his family. He will use his loan to purchase seeds and fertilizer, to increase his production and therefore his income. With your help, Murotjon will get ahead. He is counting on your help.

Janet’s 29-years-old and in a common law relationship; she has two children.  She’s from Calca Province in Cusco Department.  She is an enterprising, responsible mother who supports her family.  She sells food; she has a small restaurant in the city of Coya in Calca Province.  She opened her small restaurant four months ago and does well thanks to the work she does. This group is composed of friends and neighbors who formed the “Señor de Huanca de Coya” communal bank in Calca Province, Cusco Department.  The members are people who are constantly seeking ways to get ahead and by means of their work provide a better future for their children.  As a group they are grateful for the opportunity being provided them and commit go make their various installment payments as scheduled.

Cusco is located in Cusco District and Province belonging to Cusco Department in the very heart of the ancient city of the Incas.  It’s noted for being a tourist destination because of its archaeological sites, historic city center, scenery, history and for being a charming city in the southern region of the country.  Cusco is also known for its traditional Inti Raymi festival and because one of the Seven Wonders of the World, Machupicchu, is located here.
local_use: to buy stock ingredients and supplies.

description: The house, where Ikhtier lives, does not comply with the living standards, and he has to promptly repair his house.  He is 29 years old, married and raising one 4 year-old child.  Ikhtier has been involved in farming for over ten years.  He primarily grows tomatoes, wheat and onions.  His wife helps him with running the business.  Ikhtier must repair his house, but his income from growing agricultural crops is not enough for this.  He is requesting a loan in the amount of 5000 somoni to purchase construction materials to repair his house.  He awaits your kindness.
local_use: to purchase construction materials to repair his house

description:
Haydee belongs to the community bank "Los Solidarios" of the Arariwa Association and is grateful for the opportunity afforded by this medium and thus agrees to complete her payments on schedule.

Haydee is 42 years old and has three children.  She was born in Lima and now lives in the same city.  Haydee is a teacher and works in the Chincheros Educational Institute of Our Lady of Fatima from 7 am until 3 pm.  She has already been in this business for several years and is doing very well, thanks to her effort she puts in.  Haydee is requesting a loan for personal use such as her children's education.  Her dream is to specialize in teaching special needs children.
local_use: to pay for her children's education.

description:
Gisela needs to invest more in the business buying supplies to continue making tortillas like corn and firewood and it would help to buy it in larger amounts to have readily at hand.

She had a positive effect with her previous loan improving her clientele and family income too; they are better now.
local_use: to buy corn and firewood.

description:
José Dolores is 42 years old. He owns a panting and body work shop. He’s married and has two children in school. He installed his shop himself, but he doesn’t have enough equipment to provide a quality service. The infrastructure is not the best, and what he would like the most if to build a better roofing, but he needs to work, because this is his family’s only income. Still he hopes he would be able to improve his shop in the short term to attrack more clients and continue working to support his family. He wants to use this loan to build a wall, so he needs to buy stones, sand, cement and steel to start the works. He wants to use it as a fence to protect this family and crime is increasing every day in the area.

Translated from Spanish by Jimena Lopez, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Purchase stones, sand, cement and steel to build a wall

Mohira, her husband and their three children live in Shahrituz, Tajikistan. With the prime goal of helping her husband with the family expenses, she started her clothing sales business four years ago. Ligia del Socorro Balando, 39, lives in the Reparto Juan Ramón Padilla together with her life mate. He works to help her with the household expenses. She will use the loan to buy new fashion products like clothes, jewelry, and shoes. She will then offer her customers variety.

local_use: Buy clothes, shoes, and jewelry

description:
Rosa is once again requesting a loan because she has decided to purchase products for her business. She will purchase medicines, vitamins and analgesics to build up the business. Thus she will offer a greater diversity so her customers may remain loyal.

local_use: to purchase medicines, vitamins and analgesics.

Her workmanship is very good and she has a good eye for design. She is very organized and with a good head for business. She has had this business for 4 years and this is her second loan from IMON International. With her loan, Sitora is planning to purchase new modern fabrics. description:
Karla is employed, and lives with her two children and husband.  She works Monday through Friday for the municipal government, where she has been for more than a year.  She works Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 pm, and Saturday from 8:00am to noon.

She is requesting a loan to pay for some personal expenses, as she has bought some kitchen equipment and wants to pay for them completely.  This loan will help her to get free from her other debts and have the kitchen equipment and utensils.

Her aim is to work for her children.  She expects to pay back the loan promptly and to improve her family's quality of life.
local_use: to pay for kitchen equipment.

description:
The member belongs to the community bank "Pro Desarrollo" (Pro-Development). The bank is located in the Pisaq district, which belongs to the province of Calca and the department of Cusco.
The member's name is Alfred. He is 44 years old, married, and has 3 children. He mixes his everyday responsibilities with a business buying and selling cattle. He takes cattle to places like Anta and Urumbamba. He also has a motorcycle taxi which he drives in the district of Pisaq. By means of these businesses, he is making a better life for his kids. He wants to grow his cattle business and improve his taxi service. He is requesting a loan to buy cattle and to maintain his motorbike by buying spare parts and tires.

description:
Mr. Samnang B. (in the photo) is 32 years old and his wife, Mrs. Savet Pin, is 42 years old. They live on an island in the Mekong River, about 15 kilometers from Phnom Penh City. They have been married for almost ten years and have three children: two sons are lathe operators and their daughter is a garment factory worker.    

Samnang is a motor taxi driver, while his wife is a garment factory worker. Samnang is asking for a loan of $500 to purchase a new motorbike for his uncle. 

Samnang’s uncle is also a motor taxi driver. Unfortunately, his motorbike is old and breaks down so he spends a lot of money to make repairs often.
local_use: to purchase a new motorbike for his uncle

description: Sra. Lucia has been selling clothes for several years in the crowded streets of the city of Quillacollo - Cochabamba. She is a long-standing member and has always shown herself to be responsible with regards repayments. Her husband does not participate because he works in the department of Oruro as a miner in small mines by the job with no fixed contract. The loan will be used to stock up with more clothing merchandise for the year-end season. Her guarantor, her mother, also sells clothing but she does so near the sports fields. She owns her own house in the northern area of the city. Sra. Lucia is always punctual with her repayments.
local_use: to buy merchandise (sweaters and pants).

description:
Mr. Eustaquio lives in the town of El Torno. He is married and has four school-age children. He is a moto-taxi driver and his wife sells refreshments in the central market; together they support their four children. They own a home in the Naciones Unidas neighborhood which they were able to buy though much hard work. Mr. Eustaquio is a responsible and hardworking person. With the loan he will maintain his motorcycle which has recently begun to have some problems that prevent him from working as he normally would. He is very grateful to Emprender and Kiva for the trust and support given through this loan.

Translated from Spanish by Isabel French, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Motorcycle Maintenance

description:
Mrs. Saroun K. and her husband, Mr. Thorn Chan, have been married since 1998. They live along National Road Number One, about seventeen kilometers from Phnom Penh City. Saroun and her husband have been selling vegetables for more than five years. They buy them from the Dem Kor market, in Phnom Penh, for resale at the Kor Ky market near their village. 

The couple hopes to expand their business, but they do not have enough capital, and so Saroun is requesting a loan of $600. 
Saroun's husband is in the photo, as Saroun was unavailable.
local_use: To purchase vegetables for resale

description:
G. Salohiddin is 44 years old and married. Together with his wife they have four children. Their children are young and attend school. They are farmers who own a plot of land in their village where they grow different kinds of crops like wheat, potatoes, onions and other vegetables. They have been in this business since 1994. These crops are the main source of income for their family. To reduce the hard physical labour and to expand the business, Salohiddin would like to apply for a loan to purchase seeds, fertilizer, fuels and lubricants.

description:
Zoila lives with her three children, all of whom go to school.  She works raising and selling pigs.  She has had her business for 15 years.  With her sales, she has been able to maintain her home and cover her expenses.

She is asking for this loan to purchase 100 pound bags of feed and two pigs.  She wants to make this purchase to improve her animal's diet and to have a sufficient amount of feed for a period of time.

She wants to have a stable farm that will guarantee an income for her family, so that she can provide them with a more comfortable life.
local_use: to purchase feed and two pigs.

description:
Ms. Daniela is a hard working woman. She is 48 years old and for the past 20 years she has run a small home-based grocery store. She has accomplished this with the help of her husband and with financing from Afodenic, which has allowed her to invest in a variety of merchandise. Her husband is a construction worker. They have five children, three of them are adults and two are students. Her earnings have allowed her to make improvements to their home. She recently had it painted so that it would look nicer and so that customers would be more attracted to her store. She will invest the money from this loan in basic items, such as: rice, beans, sugar, cooking oil, soap, toothpaste, canned sardines, tuna, Worcestershire sauce, tomato sauce, chicken, meats, and milk products in order to satisfy the needs of her customers, as these are the things that they use daily. She has used her past loans to increase her inventory and sales. She hopes to do so this season, as her sales have been a bit low. She thanks the institution for approving her past requests and for making it possible for her to say in business.

Translated from Spanish by Hugo Reyes, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Invest in basic food products for resale

description:
Maria is 25 years old and lives in Healeah neighborhood of the capital city of Managua. She is single and has a 2 year old son. Her plans are to provide security for her family, and she does this by selling clothing, shoes, cosmetics and silver. She has been selling for 5 years, and began with her own funds. Her goals for her business are to increase the volume of sales and at the same time increase her usefulness. Thanks to Afodenic’s loans she will be able to buy building materials to build a porch and subsequently have more space and security for her family.

Translated from Spanish by Cindy Kendall, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Buy construction materials to build a porch

description:
J. Yunus is an active 38 year old. He is a talented farmer, and his crops are sought after by many of the local women who would like to sell them. The income he earns from this business allows him to take care of his large family of a wife and 7 children. He would like to increase his harvest in order to maximize his income, and to do so he needs to buy fertilizer, fuels and lubricants. As he lacks the financial means for this, he is requesting a loan of 2000 Somoni to help him with this purchase.

Miguel is a very kind person who works hard to succeed for the well-being of his entire family.
local_use: to buy wood wholesale.

At the present time, he is requesting a loan for car repairs in order to continue his work.  He is relying on your help and charity.
local_use: to repair his car

description:
Doña Maria is a merchant who has been selling cosmetics for more than 11 years as a way of helping her husband and their two children who are students. Her husband is a high-ranking official in the military.

One of her goals focuses on the construction of her home on which she has made many improvements. Maria has participated in thirteen loan cycles, with nearly 95% of the funds dedicated toward infrastructure. Today she is requesting a new loan so that she can lay down the floor on her porch and paint the house to give it a beautiful finish. In order to make these improvements, Maria has had to be flexible in her timetable and accommodate delays.

She plans to buy materials such as red tile, sand, cement, paint, paint thinner, brushes, sponges, as well as pay for labor so that the work can begin.
local_use: to pay for materials and labor for laying down a floor on her porch and painting her house.

description:
Moisés applies for a new loan to invest in medicine for his business. He will buy vitamins, sera and other available medical products which he needs to complete his inventory.

He believes that these loans enabled him to bolster his business, keep products for all kinds of diseases in inventory, and improve his family's living conditions.
local_use: to buy vitamins, sera and medical products.

description:
Marta is requesting a new loan, and plans to invest the funds from the loan in her natural medicine business. She plans to purchase a variety of natural products and chemicals, including vitamins, antihistamines and antibiotics, products which will help her to more thoroughly attend to her clients' needs. 

She is grateful for her previous loan, which allowed her to grow her business and offer her clients higher quality products. The loan also helped her improve her family's quality of life and situation.
local_use: to purchase vitamins, antihistamines and antibiotics.

description:
This is 44 year-old Seray.  She is married, and has 5 children aged 17, 16, 10, 8, and 6 years of age. She has no additional dependents living with her.   In 2010, Seray established her cosmetics business. She began her business to earn a living.  Working 7 days a week and 10 hours a day, she earns about Le 1,000,000 every month from this business. She would like a loan in the amount of Le 4,000,000. Seray requires a loan to buy 10 cartons of assorted cosmetics @Le 3,500,000, with Le 500,000 for transportation. 

She hopes that this loan will enable her to increase her monthly profits by approximately Le 429,000.  Seray is excited for the loan and she is planning to expand her business.  She also hopes to see her only daughter educated to university level.  Honest and hardworking, Seray thanks you for your support.
local_use: To buy 10 cartons of assorted cosmetics

description:
William Enrique C. is 39 years old and lives in Lomas de Guadalupe. His wife is a housewife, and they have 3 teenage children who attend secondary school. They have a mill where William has sold grains for more than 5 years. He is the financial provider for the family. Next year, his eldest son will go to college, and they are afraid they will not have the economic resources to bear the expense this could incur. That is why they plan to strengthen their business and make their sales volume increase so they will have greater economic stability. William is requesting the loan to purchase basic grains which he would be offering for sale later in the markets at the capital. They are a very united and hard-working family. They believe the economic blows that are affecting Nicaraguan families are not sufficient reason to stop seeking a better future for their children.

Translated from Spanish by Danielle Maxson, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Purchase of basic grains to be sold in the capital

Patrick is 36 years old and a hardworking father of 3 children. He owns a produce business, which he has been running for 11 years. He buys and sells rice and maize among other products. Patrick has a challenge of high price flactuations and his family goal is to educate his children. His business goal is to expand to new markets. Patrick intends to use the loan to buy rice and maize to sell.
local_use: to buy rice and maize to sell.

This time, she is going to invest her loan in the purchase of construction materials for the back part since it is very deteriorated since is is made of wood and metal. local_use: To buy construction materials

Florence sells cereals and dry foods in Masindi, Uganda, a business she has done for twenty years. She first started working in a hotel (restaurant), then sold bananas, and finally switched to selling cereals and dry foodstuffs.

Florence dreams of constructing her own residential house which he thinks is possible with profits from her business and credit from HOFOKAM.

This is Florence’s first loan from HOFOKAM which she intends to use to buy posho (a hot, sticky dough made from maize or cassava), beans, and groundnuts (peanuts) for reselling.
local_use: To buy posho, beans, and groundnuts for reselling

She is applying for this loan in order to buy corn for making tortillas, as she needs more working capital. This way she will keep her business growing.
local_use: To buy corn for making tortillas.

She has three additional dependents living with her, because she takes care of them while they attend school in the city. In 2001, Mariama established her gara clothing (locally dyed clothing) business. She began her business, because she wanted to be self-employed in order to have a dependable means of earning income and to help her husband provide livelihood for their children. She made good profits for the upkeep of her family, and that is why she loves this type of business.

Working six days a week and 10 hours a day, she earns about 540,000 SLL every month from this business. She would like a loan in the amount of 4,000,000 SLL. Mariama requires a loan in order to buy one bale of brilliant materials to produce different types of gara cloth, including clothing, bedding, and curtains. She hopes that this loan will enable her to increase her monthly profits by approximately 280,000 SLL.

In the future, Mariama plans to open a big shop and to sponsor her children as they go through their education smoothly. Rises in transportation costs and inflation are her major business challenges. Competition is high, but she offers the best and latest fashion, giving her an edge over her competitors. She supplies customers in Freetown and Makeni Town, offering the latest patterns and designs to fit her customers' needs. She thanks you for your support.
local_use: to buy one bale of brilliant materials to produce different types of gara cloth.

description:
This is 26-year-old Fatmata.  She is married and has 2 children, aged 6 and 3 years.

In 2005, Fatmata established her salon and cosmetics business. It was her husband that encouraged her to engage in business for herself.  Working 7 days a week and 10 hours a day, she earns about Le 600,000 every month from this business. 

Fatmata would like a loan in the amount of Le 3,000,000. She requires this loan in order to buy more quantities of hair products. In the future, Fatmata plans to expand her salon into a cosmetology school to train young girls. She thanks you for your support.
local_use: buy hair products

Our member, Giovanna, belongs to the NUEVA VISION DE URUBAMBA community bank. She lives in the heart of the sacred valley of the Incas, Urubamba, about an hour and 10 minutes from the city of Cusco. Giovanna is 35 years old, married and has 2 children, 15- and 10-years old. She spends part of her day running the family home and part of her day operating her retail business, a small grocery. She has a stand in Urubamba's model market. Our member needs the loan to buy merchadise (rice, sugar, pasta, milk, etc.) that she will resell to her customers. Her income goes to raising her children and feeding her family. Her greatest hopes are that her business prospers and that she can improve her family's quality of life. Giovanna is grateful for the opportunities that micro-lending provides and is committed to repaying the loan in the agreed-upon time.

local_use: Buy products for resale.

Charles is 36 years old, married, with five children living in a semi-permanent house in Fort Portal, Uganda.

He needs the loan to buy tea seedlings and also to pay labor for clearing more land for planting.
local_use: to buy tea seedlings and also to pay labor for clearing more land for planting.

description:
Edgar Antonio B. G. lives with his life partner and their two year old son in the Raúl Roja neighborhood. He works as a master builder, and this is the primary source of income for the family. That is why he is requesting a loan to buy electric materials, which will allow him to make the necessary repairs. This is for the good of the members of his household because a short circuit threatens the safety of his family and the loss of his home. There is a potential threat of fire if the repairs are not done quickly.

description:
One of the members of the group is 22-year old Bertha who is 6-months pregnant and is in a common-law relationship. She was born in the town of Ollyantaytambo but now lives in the beautiful city of Cusco. Bertha is a hardworking and responsible young woman who enjoys looking at archeological remains. She has run a bookstall for a year and the business is doing well. She is now in need of a loan to buy merchandise such as books (in the photo she is the one with her hand raised).

The name of this group is Amigos Emprendedores and is made up of neighbours and friends. They live in the province and department of Cusco. The members seek every opportunity they can to get ahead and make an effort every day to provide their children with a better future. They are involved in a variety of jobs such as selling books wholesale, selling candy, and driving a taxi. The members are grateful for this opportunity and promise to repay the loan according to the schedule. 

(The people in the foreground of the photo arrived late to the community bank’s meeting.)

Cusco is located in the province and department of Cusco and is in the heart of the ancient city of the Incas. It is known for its tourism, its archeological centres, and for being a beautiful city in the southern region of the country. The city is also well known for the traditional festival of Inti Raymi and because one of the seven wonders of the world, Machupicchu, is found there.
local_use: to buy books for her stall

description:
The member is Alejandro.  He continues to sell basic needs in his grocery store, an activity that provides his family's primary source of income and upkeep.

Alejandro is applying for a loan to buy merchandise such as rice, sugar, noodles, milk, drinks and snacks to reinvest in his business.  

Alejandro thanks KIVA for allowing him to continue working and developing his business.  Alejandro belongs to the "Los Lideres" (The Leaders) community bank in the city of Cusco, Peru.
local_use: To buy rice, sugar, noodles, milk, drinks and snacks.

description: Abdumalik is married and has two children. For the last 18 years he has been selling groceries in his store. Abdumalik sells only the freshest groceries and his wife helps him in the store. The two of them are trying hard to improve their living conditions and give their children a good education. Currently Abdumaik wants to take out a loan of 6000 somoni to expand his inventory. He thanks all his lenders for their kindness and charity.
local_use: To expand his business

description:
Armando is a father who is very committed to his work as he wants to help his children with their studies.  He is 39 years old and has worked as a construction worker for twenty years.  It has been his source of income.  He learned the trade because he needed to as he didn't have a job.

Armando has the support of his wife who works as a cleaner.  Together they balance their expenses.

The difficulty is that Armando's work is not regular.  There are times when he doesn't have any jobs for weeks and also times when good jobs come up.  What he would like to do with this loan is improve his bathroom because the doors are in a bad state.  This is something he must fix in order to have better hygiene and privacy.

Thanks to a loan from Afodenic, he will be able to make this improvement and pay in instalments.  This will benefit him as the instalments are monthly and affordable for him.
local_use: To buy building materials to improve his bathroom, achieving better hygiene and privacy

description:
Mukaramakhon K. is 36 years old. She is married and the mother of two children. Mukaramakhon's lack of a stable job and the slow productivity of her husband's business as an ecologist did not leave enough money to meet family expenses. For this reason, 10 years ago, Mukaramakhon decided to start her own business, selling fabrics for local cultural dresses. Little by little she made her business grow and by offering her clients a way to pay in installments greatly increased her revenue. Now her business is running smoothly. However, she would like to continue increasing her business so that her situation would be more stable in the future. She is asking for a loan of $ 800 USD that she will pay back in 6 months. With this money, Mukaramakhon will be able to buy seasonal fabrics for the local cultural dresses. The power to help her business grow is in your hands.

description:
María lives with her 23-year-old daughter and her husband in a house they own. She's a farmer who raises barnyard poultry and cattle. She does the housekeeping work and also tends to the poultry farm. Besides, she also helps her husband with the cattle. Her advantage is the large plot of land, and her drawback is when it's time to sell the cattle, because the prices vary widely.
She requests the loan in order to purchase concentrated feeding for the cattle. This purchase will help her maintain what she needs at a lower cost. It is truly important because summertime is when there's less pasture for the cattle to feed on.
María wishes to improve her living conditions, to work alongside her husband, to expand the livestock business and to get better credit options with the institution.
local_use: to purchase concentrated feeding for the cattle.

description: Godfrey wants a loan to buy cows for rearing. He is a 28-year-old married man living in Masindi, Uganda. He is a farmer and has been rearing cattle for 4 years. Inadequate capital hinders his business and his dream is to own a ranch. He desires to educate children up to the university.
local_use: to buy cows for rearing.

description:
Saodat is the married mother of two children. Her women’s clothing business has been a valuable source of income for her and her family over the past ten years that she’s been in business. In a typical month she makes about $200 in profit from the business.

Saodat is hard-working, polite and communicative entrepreneur. She has an attitude of service and loves being able to help women with their clothing needs. She has requested a loan of $800 USD to purchase new inventory. This loan will help her to continue developing her business and provide a good income for her family.

description: Delphine is a 43-year-old shop keeper who lives in the town of Rutoki in the center of Burundi in the Gitega Province. She has been in the trade of bananas for 3 years. She is also a farmer. She did not attend school. She is married to Stanislas and they have 7 children together 3 of which are in elementary school. The Kiva loan of 150,000 francs burundais that she will obtain will allow her to increase her capital in order to buy a large quantity of bananas to resell in order to realize a large profit. She is a member of the Community group "TWITERITEKA".
local_use: To increase her capital to buy a large quantity of bananas to resell in order to realize a large profit

description:
Señora Victoria is married, she is 29 years old and she has 1 son, aged 7. The member still sells natural products for a living and now she is also working as a cosmetologist doing haircuts, dyes and waves. She works independently and through these small businesses she is getting her son ahead in life. Her dream is to have a premises where she can work as a cosmetologist and also sell natural products. The member is requesting the loan to buy natural products and also to buy materials such as dyes, curlers and scissors for her job as a cosmetologist.

The member values and is grateful for the loan granted to her and promises to be disciplined in the repayments of her debts.
local_use: to buy natural products and also to buy materials such as dyes, curlers and scissors for her job as a cosmetologist.

description: Peter used the previous loan to buy chemicals for spraying his tomatoes and for paying his workers. Alongside his agricultural practices, he offers tailoring services to schools where he faces a challenge of seasonal customers and price fluctuations and inflation. Now that the term has started, Peter needs the loan to buy uniform materials to sew.
local_use: to buy materials to make uniforms  to sell.

description:
Mr. Sao H. (who is in the photo with his wife) is 34 years old and his wife, Mrs. Khum Phary is 24 years old, live along national road number one about seventeen kilometers from Phnom Penh.  They were married in 2006 and they a young daughter.  

Sao has been driving a motordub (motor taxi) for four years.  His wife is hired by villagers to farm.  She gets paid with fees. 
Sao’s motorbike is old and breaks down often, which costs him a lot of money to make repairs.  He could not manage his income to support his family.  Hence he has decided to ask for his first loan of $500 to purchase a new one.
local_use: To replace his motorbike with a new one.

description:
Mrs. Vanny B., 28, and her husband, Mr. Run Kong, 25, live in a small village across the Mekong River about 15 kilometers from Phnom Penh. They were married in 2005 and have two young sons. 
Vanny has been selling mangoes. Her husband is a horse cart driver and wooden house builder. Unfortunately, his horse was old and got sick. Therefore, he decided to sell it. Now, Vanny is asking for her second loan of $300 to purchase another horse for her husband’s business.
local_use: To purchase a horse for her husband’s business.

description:
María is a hard working woman who is devoted to work. She’s a small merchant who has secured a good customer base over the years. She sells prepared meals, various fried foods, sweets, soft drinks, juices, smoothies, fruits in front of her house. She now stocks more items; she used to just sell prepared food. The loans have been an alternative pathway to improve income in that they allow her to meet her personal expenses like utility payments and loan repayments. This loan will be used to buy food items like: meat, chicken, a quintal (equal to 46 kilos) of corn, a large container of cooking oil, lard, fruit, vegetables, sweets among others to start making more food and selling more to improve her family’s economy.

Translated from Spanish by Michael Bujazan, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: She will buy: chicken, a quintal (equivalent to 46 kilos) of corn, fruits and vegetables, sweets and others to increase sales.

description:
Early, 28, is a member of Asociación Arariwa's "COMUZONE" communal bank. He has a one-year-old son, Manuel. He lives in Cusco department, Cusco province, Santiago district. Early has been a police officer patroling Cusco's streets for the last 2 years. Early, his sister Sandy, and their father have a family business that is a restaurant-bar, called "LUCHITO" in the city of Izcuchaca. The restaurant opens on Sundays and serves typical regional dishes like: fried pork rinds, grilled meats, adobo (a marinated meat), etc. Early is a hard-working, enterprising, young father who needs funding to enlarge the family's restaurant. He is grateful for the opportunity offered by this means and pledges to repay in a timely fashion.

Translated from Spanish by Michael Bujazan, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To enlarge his restaurant.

description: Abbas used the previous loan to buy clothes to sell and to set up a boutique. The hardworking 28-year-old man is grateful to his group members who have always guaranteed him in accessing credit from the institution. He dreams of educating his children and moving his business to town. Abbas needs the loan facility to buy clothes to sell ahead of the Christmas season.
local_use: to buy clothes for sell.

description:
Farhod M., 32, is married and has 4 children. He lives in Istaravshan town and works with his brother in agriculture. Five years ago, he decided to begin to cultivate land that he owned. He did so to generate more income that would enable him to support his family.

Farhod grows potatoes and onions, which he must give the proper care so that he can produce a full, healthy harvest. He will use the loan money to buy inputs that will enable him to improve production yield. Farhod has discovered over the years that he enjoys doing this job, and that's why he will continue to use loans in order to improve his farm and become a better farmer.

description: Ruth Meri continues with her business buying and selling fruit.  She continues with it because she’s done very well and continues taking to Puerto Maldonado.  She works hard to continue growing economically.  On this occasion she’s asking for the loan to buy fruit and increase her market.
local_use: to buy fruit.

description:
Rodrigo Antonio J. H. is 32 and married. His wife works as a security guard for the C Y B company. They have two children, and they live in the Laureles Norte neighborhood. This neighborhood is known for the high levels of delinquency, which attacks the community that lives there. They are grateful for the help of the funds that Kiva has given them. This will be their second loan. They are asking for the loan to make improvements to their house. There is a wall of cement board that he wants to rebuild with concrete block. This will give the family better security for all. Thanks to the funds from Kiva, Mr. J. has been able to repair his house little by little.

local_use: Build a cement block wall

description:

For the current planting season, he wants to plant a high quality of potatoes, cucumbers and tomatoes so he can improve the quality of his harvest. With the loan money, Mahmudjon will be able to wisely finance his current farming season to get a better harvest and enable him to repay on schedule. Mrs. Sreymom M., 33 and her husband, Mr. Try Kong, 36, have been married since 1996 and have three children: two daughters and one son. Sreymom has been a construction worker in her village for three years, while her husband has been a working in the administrative headquarters of the province for 10 years. Some part of her house has broken down and that’s why she is asking for her first loan of $500 to repair her house.  She will make a staircase and repair the wall of the house.
local_use: To repair her house

description:
Jenny is 45 years old and is married. She lives in Bo la Fuente, and has two children, aged 18 and 12 years old, both of whom are students. Her husband is a high school teacher. She is also a high school teacher with 25 years' experience. With this loan request she will invest in the repair of the electrical system that has recently been problematic. She wants to protect and provide for her family. Her plans are to be able to keep her Master's degree studies to become a professional and to give her children a good education, and to be able to keep making improvements to their home.


Translated from Spanish by Erika Lindig, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To purchase electrical wiring to repair their home.

description:
Mrs. Chhavy D. (was in the photo) is 44 years old and her husband, Mr. Punleu Sun, is 39 years old.  They sell silk and cotton products. They buy them from weavers in the village and transport them to sell in other villages and districts. This couple is asking for a loan of $600 to purchase more silk and cotton fabrics for resale.

They have been married since 1999 and have four children – one son and three daughters, all of them are in school.
local_use: To purchase silk and cotton products for resale

description:
The group Duo Virgen D. Fatima is comprised of two members who work every day for the success of their business.  Ana Paulina, 34, has two children and tells us that she has been making assorted candies for two years.  She also informs us that her customer base has grown because they've come to know that the candy she makes is of high quality. She gives thanks to God that little by little she has been able to sustain her business.  

Ana, and her fellow group member, are requesting this loan to be able to buy materials for making candy.  Both group members share the dream of growing their business and providing all the best for their children so that they can have a better future.
local_use: buy materials for making assorted candies.

description: Brazio is a 28-year-old hardworking man living in Kyenjojo Uganda. He is a school proprietor and has been in service for 6 years. He started with a nursery school and has over time set up other levels. He has a challenge of limited funds to upgrade the school. His dream is to have a fully operational primary school. Brazio needs the loan facility to renovate the classroom structures.
local_use: To renovate the classroom structures.

description:
I. Hafiza is the loving mother of her son. She is married and her husband is an accountant in a cannery. She is engaged in animal husbandry and she has been in this business for 22 years. She purchases cattle and feeds them for a certain period then sells them at reasonable prices. For this purpose, she has applied for a loan of 4500 Somoni. She will use this loan to purchase cattle and expand her business. Let's help her reach her goals!

Oswaldo belongs to the Virgen Asunta de Oropesa Communal Bank.  This bank is located in the Oropesa district, Quispicanchis province, Cusco department.  

Oswaldo is 32 years old, in a common-law marriage, and has two children.  He works managing his grocery store.  He needs the loan to be able to buy merchandise.  He will buy rice, sugar, noodles, and oil.  He will buy these items wholesale.  He will also buy milk and other basic products.  Oswaldo is requesting the loan to buy merchandise to stock his grocery store.  He is also requesting the loan to buy basic products to supply his store.

He is happy with the loan that was granted, and he pledges to make his payments on time.
local_use: To buy basic products for his store

description:
Chhun Eng and her husband, Sokun, are silk weavers. They have been married since 1990, and they have three children -- one son and two daughters.  One child is a weaver; another one is in school; and another one is still young. They live on an island in the Mekong River about 15 kilometers from Phnom Penh City in Cambodia.

Chhun Eng is requesting another loan of $300 to continue her weaving business by purchasing silk materials.

Photo: Chhun Eng is not pictured with her loom because under her the area is flooded. She needs to move her looms to her mother’s house, the same location where she lives, because that location is not affected by the flood.
local_use: to continue her weaving business by purchasing silk materials.

description:
Albertina, 46, is a member of the “CAMINEMOS JUNTAS” (Let’s Walk Together) communal bank located in Huanchac district, Cusco province, Cusco department.

She is married and has two children.  She makes various articles of clothing out of wool.  She makes wool sweaters at home and on order.  She is very well known and has had her customer base for the last four years.  She makes sweaters and children’s robes.  She works at home and once she finishes an item she home delivers them to her customers.

She needs funds to buy wool and buttons for her pending jobs.  She is asking for the loan to invest in the purchase of wool and buttons.

She is grateful for and appreciates the loan granted by this means and at the same time pledges to repay in a timely fashion.
local_use: To buy wool and buttons.

description: Moses is a 36-year-old gentleman living in Kagadi, Uganda. He deals in metal fabrication, and he has been running the business for 7 years. He started by buying machines with capital he got from his father.  Now the business is at its boom stage. He says that inadequate capital and high transport costs are affecting the business. He would like to educate his children and expand his business to new markets. Moses wants a loan to buy metals for use in his fabrication work.
local_use: to buy metals for use in his fabrication work.

description:
Sra. Rubi Magly, 29, belongs to the GRAN RENOVACION community bank in the Peruvian "departamento" of Cusco.

She is partnered and has 2 children.  She operates two businesses: a travel agency and a marketing company.  She supports her two children with the income from the businesses and now she wants to expand her travel business by adding an Internet site.  She will use this loan to repair her computer and buy a desk.  

She is grateful for the loan and committed to repaying it in the agreed-upon time.
local_use: to repair her computer and buy a desk for an Internet-based travel business.

description:
S. Olimjon is 37 years old, married and has two children. His goals are to grow in his personal life and in his business by offering better service to his customers. He hopes that God will continue to keep him healthy so that he can get ahead in life and fulfill his goals. He makes a living driving a taxi, traveling the streets of Kanibadam in search of customers. He has owned his business for the last four  years. In addition to this job, when the weather is warn he sells soft drinks with the help of his mother. Today, Olimjon’s car needs many repairs, and he has applied for a loan of $1,500 to make this possible.
