description:
Mrs. Lidia del Socorro C. V. is 37 years old, she lives in Barrio Laureles sur, is married and her husband works as a gardener and supports her economically with the monthly family expenses. She works as a helper at a health center. Her economical situation is very poor, but one of her most important aspirations is to finish building her house and therefore she requests a loan to buy building material to build a side wall to divide her land from that of her neighbor giving more security for her son who is at the time of his life when bad influences can cause taking the wrong social path. This support will help the family a lot, making their home stronger and offering better economical conditions.

Translated from Spanish by Lene Struck Christensen, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Building a side wall

description:
Ruben has a shop where he has been selling clothes for three years. He buys the clothes from Lima. Most of the time he has it sent to Cusco, but he still needs to travel every two months in order to look at merchandise. A loan will help Ruben to buy more merchandise such as pants, shirts, and jackets. He sells clothes for adults and children. Ruben’s dream is to expand the size of his shop, which is currently 1 x 3 meters.
 
Ruben is receiving an individual loan as a member of the village bank "Comuzone I" in Cusco, which is located in the Andean mountains at 3,400 meters above sea level. The bank is in its 17th cycle with Asociación Arariwa.
local_use: to buy more merchandise, such as pants, shirts, and jackets

description: Sr. Edgar has been working as a carpenter for four years.  Despite his age, he has already become very knowledgeable about the carpentry business.  His jobs are performed on contract for people he knows.  For this reason, he needs capital to buy materials for making doors and windows.  He lives at home with his wife and one year old daughter.  Edgar is the only one supporting the household.  He is a hard worker and a very responsible young man.  One of his wishes is to buy a plot of land where he can build a house and set up a carpentry workshop.
local_use: Purchase wood

description:
Ramon lives with his mother and three nephews.  He has a business selling shoes for men and children.  He started this business through his friends, who led him to this type of work.  He already has 3 years of experience with the business.

He is requesting a loan, because he thinks that he needs to make an investment in merchandise for his business, buying casual shoes and also exercise shoes of different colors and sizes for men and children.  This loan will help him to have the financial resources he needs to make this purchase so that he can have more goods available to sell.

His aspiration is to expand the business, getting more products and a new sales route, because this will help him to continue to improve the house where he lives with his family.
local_use: to buy casual shoes and exercise shoes

description:
Yoni was born in the city of Lamay and she is 30 years old. She lives in the city where she was born and where she works. She raises small animals such as, for example, guinea pigs and chickens. Yoni’s dream is to open a business where she can sell her guinea pig meat. 

Yoni needs the loan to buy more small animals such as guinea pigs and chickens.

Yoni belongs to the “Virgencita de Fátima de Lamay” communal bank of the Asociación Arariwa, in the province of Calca, in the department of Cusco, Peru.

Yoni is grateful and values the loan and she pledges to pay her monthly repayments.
local_use: to buy more small animals such as guinea pigs and chickens

description:
Joel is a 33-year-old married man with three children living in Masindi, Uganda.

For 5 years, Joel has been operating a retail shop and also farming. With the proceeds from these businesses, he has been able to buy more land and pay school fees for his children.

Inadequate capital to purchase stock is his challenge, because the demand for the goods is very high. He desires to educate his children and expand his business into new markets. Joel needs the loan facility to buy general merchandise, such as soap and sugar, to sell.
local_use: to buy general merchandise, such as soap and sugar, to sell.

description:
This member belongs to the communal bank Los Solidarios. The bank is located in the district of Urubamba, within Urubamba province, in the department of Cusco.

She works for a company where she makes arts and crafts such as paintings, pictures, and necklaces. She works from 8:00 am to 6:00 pm. She wants to be able to get ahead with this work, and her dream is to finish building her home. She is requesting the loan in order to purchase construction materials such as sand, cement, plaster, and nails, so that she can finish building her home. 

She is happy with the loan and committed to paying her installments.
local_use: to purchase construction materials such as sand, cement, plaster, and nails, in order to finish building her home.

description:
Sarapio is a 56-year-old married man with seven children. He lives in Kagadi, Uganda, and he has been operating a retail shop for 20 years. Sarapio got his initial capital from his former farming activities. His challenges include price fluctuation and inadequate capital to meet the high demand for his products. 

Sarapio dreams of buying a car and diversifying his business so as to increase on his income. He needs this loan to buy sugar and beans for sale.
local_use: to buy sugar and beans for sale.

description:
The member is in the “BATAN ORCCO” (To Return  Above) communal bank located in Huaro, Quispicanchis province, Cusco department.

Julia is married and has 4 children.  She is 51 years old.  She sells traditional maicillos (corn flour cookies) and tamales.  She is also the President of this likable group of enterprising, affectionate women.  She has sold maicillos in Huaro and tamales on weekends in Urcos district since the year 2000.  She is asking for funds to buy ingredients like flour and corn.

The other group members alternate their chores with selling tamales, corn drinks, milk and cherries, food, groceries, clothing, farm animals and corn.

Julia is grateful for and values the loan granted this way and at the same time commits to repay in a timely fashion.
local_use: To buy ingredients like flour and corn.

description:
Elisabeth is a member of the Turamirize group and lives in Gitega.  She is 32 years old and married to Celestin, a merchant.  They have five children together, three of whom are in primary school.

She has been selling drinks for the last seven years.  She is on her tenth loan with Turame.  With the Kiva credit she obtains, she will increase her business capital and add a new product, coffee, to her market in order to earn more.

Her business income allows her to pay her childrens' school fees.
local_use: to increase her capital and buy new products to resell.

description:
Five years ago, Nargiza started up her clothing business. Experienced and talented in the business, Nargiza has expanded her business into a successful trade and supports her family through this revenue. 

Throughout the last five years, IMON has provided ongoing assistance to Nargiza’s business through microfinance loans. Committed to growth and successful entrepreneurship, Nargiza has used each loan wisely and has repaid each with a perfect credit history. Currently, she is seeking a loan of 3000 Somoni ($ 900 USD) to replace the autumn inventory with winter clothing. With the rotation of supplies in her business, she plans to repay the loan within 2 months. The well-being of Nargiza’s family and her business are in your hands. Nargiza and her children are sincerely grateful for your support.
local_use: To purchase new clothing for business expansion and to replace her current inventory

description: Abdumanon is a widower and is raising a daughter. He has been doing welding work for 15 years. Has a manufacturing facility, producing stoves in the winter and trolleys in the summer. He has employees who assist him. Besides that, he also takes orders for other welding jobs. Abdumanon would like to get a loan for the purchase of electricity and raw materials.
local_use: To purchase raw materials

description:
Chantha (pictured with her young son) is 30 years old and her husband is 32 year old. They live about seventeen kilometers from Phnom Penh City. They have been married since 2002 and have two young children, one son and one daughter.  
Chantha and her husband are fish sellers. She is asking for her first loan in the mount of $500 to expand her business by purchasing additional fish for sale.
local_use: To purchase additional fish for sale.

description:
Yat (in the photo), 53, is a widow with seven children. Four are married and live outside the family home, one is a garment worker, one has full-time employment, and another one is bicycle repairman. The family lives along National Road Number One, about 35 kilometers from Phnom Penh City. 

Yat is a rice farmer. She is asking for a loan of $300 to purchase seed, fertilizer and pesticide to maintain her rice farm.
local_use: To purchase seed, fertilizer and pesticides to maintain her rice farm.

description:
Juan is the father of two and he is married. His wife works as a secretary and he has been an accountant for many years. His goal has been the construction of a house that he has been building with his own savings. 

He is ready to complete the bathroom and to improve another room. He will purchase construction materials to being and all this is possible thanks to the loans granted through Afodenic (Kiva Field Partner). He has been able to progress more quickly, especially because everything has risen in price. He is ready to make loan payments in order to normalize the expense.
local_use: To purchase construction materials.

description:
Felipe Santiago R. S., 47, is married and the father of two children. His wife is a merchant. Together, they work hard toward providing their children with the comforts required so that they can have a worthy and safe life. To achieve this, since last year, he has asked for funding to bring about some improvements to his home's infrastructure. They will continue with the second phase of their building project but the loan will be used to invest in raw materials for their business, which is a sawmill. This will improve their living conditions and give them the satisfaction of knowing that, as parents, they are offering their children a better future hoping, in the long run, to provide them with a worthy home.

Translated from Spanish by Michael Bujazan, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy raw materials.

description:
María sells hotdogs.  She lives with her husband and a 16-year-old daughter.  She sells every day near her house.  The business came about because she needed to support her family and help her husband cover household expenses.

Her goal currently is to buy a sewing machine to set up a tailor shop.  This is why she’s asking for this loan that will make it possible for her to acquire said machine and start a new business.

With this investment she will be able to increase income because it would be a new business to tend to which she hopes will help her and her family improve and one day be able to buy herself a house.
local_use: to buy a sewing machine.

description: Saviour, 32 years old, is a married man living in a permanent house in Kyenjojo Uganda. He deals in a produce business selling rice, maize and beans at a margin. In his area, this is a common business for those who have capital because if the season is right, then yields are realized fast. Saviour says he would like to have another source of income and that in the future he hopes to have a rental house. He wants a loan to buy rice, maize and beans for reselling.
local_use: To buy rice, maize and beans for reselling.

description:
Blanca lives in Puerto el Triunfo, located in the department of Usulután. She is single and lives with her parents. She runs a store and sells drinks. She started the store 8 years ago, and she has been selling drinks for 3 years.

She currently needs to purchase a freezer and goods such as cookies, snacks, drinks, and more. Purchasing this merchandise will help her increase her inventory and improve sales.

Her goal is to expand her business and to be able to manage both businesses.
local_use: to purchase a freezer and goods like cookies, snacks, drinks, and more.

description:
Don Carlos works as a taxi driver. He is married and the father of three school-age children. His wife works for a market that is owned by a private company.

His goal is to build his house. He is currently in the process of building a room, a bathroom, and replacing the roof since it is in very bad shape. All of these improvements have been made with loans from AFODENIC. Carlos has received seven loans while working with the organization. The loans have made it possible for him to equalize his expenses, feed his family, and pay for the education and clothing of his children.

Carlos plans to buy materials such as sheets of zinc, crossbeams, screws, welding supplies, as well as pay for labor.
local_use: to pay for materials and labor in order to replace the roof of his house.

description:
H. Ravshan is 19 years old. He is a young craftsman. He has a small shop for repairing electronic devices like TVs, radios, CD recorders, tape recorders and others. He was taught this technical skill by his father. Being a good repairman, Ravshan is also able to suggest equipment of a better quality and more attractive price to his clients. His business is very stable and brings significant support for his family. Today Ravshan requests 3000 Somoni in order to purchase spare parts and a diagnostic device for repairing electronics. Ravshan thanks all lenders for their support and wants to ensure them that he will repay the loan with accuracy and on time.  

More about Tajikistan and IMON International

Tajikistan is known for its rich history, which includes a key post along the Silk Road and the end of Alexander the Great's rule. It has also produced great thinkers, philosophers, scientists and poets, including Rudaki, Avicenna, Ferdowsi, Omar Khayyam, Jomi, and Rumi. The country is home to communities that still speak the ancient Sogdian language, epic mountain passes, and a civilization that dates back to the 4th millennium BC. Even today, it is a complex mixture of the Islamic faith, Soviet culture, New West culture and Central Asian traditions.

But Tajikistan is also the poorest of the former Soviet republics. The civil war, which ignited soon after its independence from the U.S.S.R., further damaged the already weak economy. In addition, 93% of the country is mountainous and only 7% of the land is arable. These conditions have resulted in high levels of unemployment and have forced hundreds of thousands to seek work in other countries, mainly Russia. While the people of Tajikistan are working to improve its agricultural production and manufacturing sector, nearly two-thirds of the population still live in abject poverty.

IMON's History

Since December 2007, IMON International has worked closely with Kiva and Kiva lenders to ensure that poor and low income clients represent a viable business proposition. Funds raised through Kiva have already been distributed to thousands of IMON International's clients and will continue to provide thousands more with permanent access to the varied financial services they need. To learn more about IMON International's work, please visit: www.imon.tj
local_use: To buy spare parts and a diagnostic device for repairing electronics

description:
Sr. Gerson lives in the town of La Guardia, which is 20km from the city of Santa Cruz. He lives in a house through an “anticretico” arrangement (in which the property owner pawns the house to the occupant). Gerson is married and has two young children. He works in the transportation sector, but also has a second job in construction since his transport business is not stable. His wife Sra. Magdalena looks after their children so that he can work in the early hours until late into the night to support their family. Gerson is a responsible, dynamic, and hardworking person who puts in tremendous effort to improve the quality of life for his family. He will use this loan to repair and perform maintenance on his vehicle in order to offer better service to his clients. He is grateful to Emprender and Kiva for their trust by providing this loan. If you would like to learn more about the province of El Torno or La Guardia visit the website: http://www.ocasha-ccs.org/Proyecto/Eltorno.htm

Translated from Spanish by Ronan Reodica, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Vehicle repairs

description: Josephine is a 55-year-old widow with four children living in a semi permanent house in Fort Portal, Uganda. Her dream is to educate her children. She has been a farmer for 15 years, growing mainly maize and bananas for sale. Her main constraint has been high labor costs. Her desire is to buy land and practice mechanised farming. Josephine needs the loan to add to her savings so she can buy another piece of land for farming purposes.
local_use: to buy land for farming purposes.

description:
Miriam Eduvina has been the principal at Enmanuel Mongalo y Rubio school for the past 16 years. She lives in Zone 6 of Nueva Guinea with her family, which is composed of her husband and two children. The children study at her school and her husband is a mechanic. He helps her with family expenses. Miriam Eduvina also teaches in the universities that are in the municipality in order to earn extra income that will allow her family to live better. She is asking for her 8th financing from AFODENIC to be used to make home improvements and to finish building her kitchen; currently it's in a corner of the living room. Miriam has always been a fighter, she is responsible, and likes to make progress in life and loves her job. Since they got their house, both she and her husband, have made every effort to have a proper home for the family, one that has all the requisite characteristics that the family needs. Their wish is that their daugthers study in order to become upstanding citizens, that they all have good health and work.

Translated from Spanish by Michael Bujazan, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To finish building her kitchen.

description:
José is applying for a loan again, with the objective of increasing his sales. Because it is the season when more is sold, he wishes to offer his customers a variety of drinks, including liquor of all kinds and quality. That way, he will be able to offer his customers variety. 

The previous loan helped him, because he established his business.  Sales were better and his earnings improved, so he has helped his family with the household expenses.
local_use: To buy liquor of all kinds and quality.

description:
Janett D. is 44 years old. She is a determined woman and works hard to achieve economic stability in her life. She gets up early to work in a kiosk that she has at a highschool where she sells various products to the students, such as: fruit drinks, ice cream, enchiladas, sweets, soft drinks, and other foods that she makes to sell every day. She has been selling at the kiosk for four years and hopes to continue there because sales are good. With this loan she will increase her stock to offer more products and increase her sales. She has been with Afodenic for eight loan cycles and has been able to achieve having a solid business. Her plans are to finish making a few changes to her house and to expand her place of business. She gives thanks to the institution for making her increased sales possible.

Translated from Spanish by Jennifer Day, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy meat, vegetables, and sweets to increase her sales at her kiosk

description:
Toir is a 54 year old, married father of 5 children. Toir owns a grocery store and provides for his family with the revenue generated by the grocery store. He is requesting a loan of $2700 US Dollars to increase his stock. Toir is ready to work even harder, make sacrifices and push every once and awhile to achieve his goal and become a successful entrepreneur. One of his dreams is that his children will progress by means of their studies.  He believes his perseverance and clear vision will become key success factors in his small business.

local_use: Purchasing foodstuffs to increase the range of goods for sale

description:
Mrs. BIBATA is married and the mother of one child, who is five years old and do not go to school. She has four persons to support.

For two years, she's been selling cereals. She gets her supplies in Léo. Her customers are women, men, and resellers. She wants to buy 15 sacks of corn.

Mrs. BIBATA wants to expand her business with her savings and ambitions to improve it. She also wants to bolster her secondary business, which consists in selling dried fish to various services, where she gets payed at the end of each month.

Finally, she wants to help her husband in building their house.
local_use: to buy 15 sacks of corn

description: Sarah is 24 years old and married with one child living in Hoima, Uganda. She owns a retail shop, which she has been running for three years. She faces the challenge of customers not paying on time. Her family goal is to educate her children and her business goal is to expand to new markets. She intends to use the loan to buy sugar, soap and salt to sell.
local_use: to buy sugar, soap and salt to sell.

description:
This member's name is Gilda and she lives in the Kennedy neighborhood of the Huanchac district of Cusco which is located 15 minutes from the city's main plaza. Gilda is 51 years old, is single, does not have children, and works at the National Cultural Institute. She is requesting a loan for personal use. She needs capital to invest in a small business that she has been thinking about starting for a long time now. She is not specifying what her business is yet, because due to her personal beliefs she would like to keep it a secret until her dream is realized. Gilda is happy and appreciates the loan being made to her in this way and she is committed to paying back the total of her debt.

Translated from Spanish by Sarah Shimmin, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Working capital

description:
U. Dada is a very hard-working and enterprising man who works long hours cultivating his farmland. It is to this farm that he owes his daily bread, so he tries to take care of it as best he can. Dada is one of the most dedicated farmers we have ever known, and every morning the people of his town see him walking to his work. He is one of the most respected people in the area and is known for the example he sets for his children and the rest of the town. The courage and devotion he puts into his job as a farmer is what stands out in this man. Nonetheless, he has difficulties and financial problems that are bringing him irregularities and losses. For this reason Dada is requesting your help with a loan to increase his production by buying additional seeds and fertilizer.

description:
Erica is part of the Arariwa Association Communal Bank 'Working Together'. She is from Quillabamba, 30 years old, and lives with her partner. Erica has two children: Ruth who is 7 and Junior, 4 years old. Erica is a hard working, enterprising mother who helps her family get ahead, thinking of them as she started her own business selling vegetables. Erica tells us that she takes her vegetables from the city of Cusco to other cities, for example the city of Puerto Maldonado, Quillabamba, and the mining zone of Puerto Maldonado. This community bank member travels on Sunday at night to the mining camp of Puerto Maldonado in order to be there on Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday, in the market near the camp where she sells her products. On Thursday she takes her produce to sell in the city of Puerto Maldonado. Erica, on returning to the city of Cusco from Puerto Maldonado, does not return with empty hands. She brings products like butter beans, black beans, lentils, and soy beans and sells them in the cities of Cusco and Quillabamba. Her husband is in charge of driving the truck where they carry their products, such as carrots, onions, potatoes, etc. Erica needs a loan to buy more supplies such as butter beans, black beans, and lentils. This member is grateful for the opportunity provided by this means and so has committed to comply with the payments on time.

Translated from Spanish by Daniel Burke, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Erica requests the loan to buy supplies such as butter beans, black beans and lentils.

description:
Brigida is 42 years old, and she was born in the community of Yanahuara, in the province of Urubamba in the department of Cusco, Peru. Brigida is married with three children, and she currently lives in the community where she was born. She raises small livestock animals, such as sheep, pigs, chickens, and guinea pigs, for a living. Brigida hopes to use this loan to buy animals, particularly guinea pigs (a traditional food source in the Peruvian Andes).
      
Brigida belongs to the "Villa Marcelo Virgen del Carmen" community bank, part of the Cusco Arariwa Association, and she is very pleased with the services offered by the association.
local_use: to buy animals such as guinea pigs.

description:
Juana Mercedes A. P. is 59 years old and lives in the La Borgoña neighborhood of Managua. She is a single mother of three girls, all now grown and living independently. She also is raising a 14-year-old granddaughter who helps with the housework after school.

For 15 years Juana has worked as a domestic in a private home in the hills of Santo Domingo. The biggest difficulty has been that her income does not allow her to purchase, at one time, the construction materials she needs to improve her house.

With this, her first loan, she will buy sand and cement to plaster the walls and put tiles on the floor, which is now dirt. If there is enough money, she will also buy metal roofing. She would like to enjoy a proper home with her family, and has worked hard to achieve it.

She thanks the lending institution for allowing many low-income families to achieve their goals through loans.

Translated from Spanish by jeffrey hersk, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Buy sand, cement, and metal roofing to complete her house

description: Mr. German lives in the El Torno area. He is a carpenter and has done this work for 13 years. He was born in the Chuquisaca department but came to the Santa Cruz department 30 years ago. His wife (with whom he has four children, two of whom are under their care and two of whom are independent) works selling food. This loan will be used to buy wood. He is grateful to the institution for the economic support that they have always given him.
local_use: the purchase of wood

description: Karina was born in Perú, but has lived in Bolivia since she was 14. She lives with her mother in Miraflores, just 15 mins. outside of La Paz.  For the past few years, Karina has run a shop selling sweets, chocolates, sandwiches and hamburgers from a kiosk inside a school compound. She has an ample clientele, and is the only shop selling snacks to students in the school. Karina seeks credit to buy more inventory of snacks, sweets and soft drinks.  She is a very hardworking woman and is very grateful for the support she has received.
local_use: to buy inventory of sweets and snacks such as cookies and chocolate

description:
This member continues to manage her business of buying and selling alfalfa and corn. These crops are used as animal feed for guinea pigs and rabbits. She works from 8:00 A.M. to 6:00 P.M. Through this business, she is able to help her children move forward so that they can become professionals. Her dream is to have a shop where she can sell corn and alfalfa.

The member is requesting a loan so that she can buy corn and alfalfa in bulk. She is pleased with the loan and promises to complete her payments.
local_use: to buy corn and alfalfa in bulk to sell as animal feed.

description:
Delfina belongs to the Reyna de los Ángeles Communal Bank. She is a native of Urubamba. She is 48 years old, and she has an 11 year old daughter named Rocio. She is a responsible mother who is every minute looking for opportunities to get ahead. Through her daily effort she looks to give her daughter a better future. Delfina sells alcoholic beverages such as beer and “chicha” (“chicha de jora” is an ancestral drink in Perú and América. The main ingredient is yellow or fermented corn). She only makes chicha on Thursdays, Fridays, and Sundays to sell in her restaurant. She also farms and grows corn and zucchini. She tells us very sadly that due to the strong rains that fell in the city of Urubamba the corn was lost, and she was left with unrecoverable losses. But, in spite of the adversities, she continues working to get her family ahead. She needs the loan to buy fertilizer, seeds, and yellow corn. She wishes to open a store where she could sell blankets and mattresses. She is grateful for the opportunity of the loan, and she promises to pay it on time.

Translated from Spanish by Ginny Kalish, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Buy fertilizer, seeds, and yellow corn

description:
This is 40-year-old Alhaji. He is married and has 2 children. In the year 2002, Alhaji established his clothing business. He raised his initial business capital from the sales-assistant work he was doing. Working seven days a week and 11 hours a day, he earns about 2,000,000 Sierra Leone leones (Le) from this business every month. 

He would like a loan in the amount of Le 5,000,000. Alhaji requires a loan in order to buy more bales of wax cotton. He hopes that this loan will enable him to increase his monthly profits by approximately Le 4,000,000. In the future, Alhaji plans to open a retail outlet in another strategic location. He thanks you for your support.
local_use: to buy bales of wax cotton for his business.

description:
Constance is a 33-year-old single mother of three children living in Bundibugyo, Uganda.
She has a retail shop that she has operated for twelve years. Constance acquired the initial capital to buy the retail shop through photography, her first business venture.
The main hardship Constance faces is price fluctuation. Despite hardships, her personal goal is to build a permanent house. Her goals for her business are to diversify and buy land on which to grow crops. The purpose of this loan is to buy general merchandise, such as soap and salt, to sell in her retail shop.
local_use: to buy general merchandise, such as soap and salt, to sell.

description:
Amandina was born in the province of Calca. She is currently 45 years old, married and has three children.

Amandina lives and works in the same city where she was born. She is a teacher and works at a private school in the city of Calca. She has been teaching primary education at this school for 16 years and it is going very well. She also has a shop in the Calca market.

At this time, Amandina needs a loan to buy cow and pig meat.

The "Millennium III" communal bank meets every 30 days in the city of Calca, which is in the department of Cusco (Peru). Cusco is known as a tourist and commercial zone. It is also known for its traditional festival of Inti Raymi and as the home of Machu Picchu, one of the seven wonders of the world.
local_use: to buy cow and pig meat

description: Joseph is a forty three year old married man with two children living in Kasese, Uganda. He has been teaching for twelve years. His personal goal is educating children, business goal is to start up a business. Joseph wants money to pay school fees for the children.
local_use: to pay school fees

description: Andrew is a 30-year-old man, married to a teacher with four children, living in Fort Portal, Uganda, with a dream of educating his children. He is into motorcycle transport and has been in the sector for six years. He is still reaping tangible results and has an ambition to have at least three motorcycles. Andrew needs the credit to buy a motorcycle.
local_use: To purchase a motorcycle

description:
Martha continues working as a cashier and making income from a room which she rents out.  This helps her to cover her expenses.  Over the years, her goal has been to improve her house and she has been managing this through loans.

Martha would currently like to build higher walls in her home as the council repaired the roads and raised the ground at the same time which meant that the streets became higher and her home was left lower than the level of the road.  She would like to make this improvement before the winter comes and she gets flooded.  She would like her front walls to be level with the street.  In order to achieve this, she will buy building supplies ( stone, sand, cement and iron) and start the work.  This will provide her family with security.

description: Nasriddin is married and has one child. He rents out the land where he sows onions which has been his business for more than thirteen years. His wife helps him in the sowing of the seeds and processing of the land. Nasriddin wants to take out the loan in the amount of 2,000 somoni to buy mineral fertilizer and pesticides. He hopes for your help and kindness.
local_use: to buy mineral fertilizers an pesticides.

description: Ahmad is a kind and honest man. He is married and is raising three underage children. His wife is a homemaker. Ahmad has been cultivating and selling agricultural crops for more than four years. He has a rich experience. His wife and children help him in the business. Ahmad is asking for a loan in the amount of 3,500 somoni to buy seeds and mineral fertilizer. He hopes for your help and kindness.
local_use: to buy seeds and mineral fertilizer.

description:
Gloria wants to buy for and stock her fruit and vegetable business by getting an order that would include potatoes, onions, chayote, apples, grapes, and strawberries.  This will help her so that her customers will be able to find what they need.

Her first loan had positive results, as she made the necessary investment and managed her funds well.  More than anything, it helped her family in a more consistent way with their urgent needs.
local_use: to buy potatoes, onions, chayote, apples, grapes, and strawberries

description:
Iris is a young, hardworking and enterprising woman that looks for opportunities in each moment to get ahead and with her daily efforts, support her family.

Iris is 30 years old, has a live-in partner and is a teacher. Her main economic activity is teaching at the national school “Fortunato Herrera” in the city of Cusco. The educational institution is hiring her for one year. She has already been in the profession for several years and it has gone well for her, thanks to the effort that she puts into her work every day. She is requesting the loan to save and later buy a laptop computer.

Iris belongs to the “Los Diamantes” communal bank of the Asociación Arariwa. She is a new member and shows that she is happy and satisfied with the loan, savings, and training services that the Association provides.

Iris is grateful for the opportunity provided through these means and similarly, she promises to make her loan repayments according to schedule.

Translated from Spanish by Kathleen O'Connell, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To purchase a laptop computer

description:
Since he was a boy, Azimjon has loved animals. He has learned to raise them well so that he can market them. Azimjon is married and has three children to provide for. To support his family, he has to invest in his livestock business and, consequently, he's approached IMON International to apply for a loan that will allow him to purchase young cattle and feed for them and, in turn, increase his income from the milk, meat, horn, etc. that cattle provide.  

More about Tajikistan and IMON International:

Tajikistan is known for its rich history, which includes a key post along the Silk Road and the end of Alexander the Great's rule. It has also produced great thinkers, philosophers, scientists and poets, including Rudaki, Avicenna, Ferdowsi, Omar Khayyam, Jomi, and Rumi. The country is home to communities that still speak the ancient Sogdian language, epic mountain passes, and a civilization that dates back to the 4th millennium BC. And, even today, it is a complex mixture of the Islamic faith, Soviet culture, New Western culture and Central Asian traditions.

But Tajikistan is also the poorest of the former Soviet republics. The civil war, which ignited soon after its independence from the U.S.S.R., further damaged the already weak economy. In addition, 93% of the country is mountainous and only 7% of the land is arable. These conditions have resulted in high levels of unemployment and have forced hundreds of thousands to seek work in other countries, mainly Russia. While the people of Tajikistan are working to improve its agricultural production and manufacturing sector, nearly two-thirds of the population still live in abject poverty.

IMON's History:

Since December 2007, IMON International has worked closely with Kiva and Kiva lenders to ensure that poor and low income clients represent a viable business proposition. Funds raised through Kiva have already been distributed to thousands of IMON International's clients and will continue to provide thousands more with permanent access to the varied financial services they need. To learn more about IMON International's work, please visit: www.imon.tj

The member belongs to the communal bank "Amauta" located in the district and province of Urubamba, department of Cusco.

Mashhura, being a devoted mother, is doing her best to give her children a good education and to make them happy. description: Patrick is a hardworking man and a married father of six children. He runs a motorcycle transport business, which he has been doing for three years. He faces the challenge of high price fluctuations, especially fuel prices. His family goal is to educate his children and his personal goal is to expand to new markets. He intends to use the loan to buy another motorcycle.
local_use: to buy a motorcycle.

description:
Dionisia, 33, and her husband, Sr. Noel Miranda, have two school-aged children.  Dionisia has worked as an assistant budget analyst for the town government of Juigalpa for 8 years. 

Dionisia is applying for this loan to add a room to her house, a project that will greatly contribute to her family's comfort.  She can count on support from her husband who is picking up responsbility for other household expenses.

Dionisia says that she will apply for other loans in the future so that she can continue to improve the house because she wants her daughters to have the best possible living arrangements.
local_use: Add room to house.

description:
Sra. Yolanda is a member of the Communal Bank “Mercamueble”, which is located in the district, province, and department of Cusco.

She is 29 years old and single. Yolanda divides her time between her daily activities and her business of selling furniture. She sells furniture such as chairs, beds, and wardrobes at the city fair of Cusco in a place called San Sebastian. Yolanda works from 9am to 7pm. She wants to expand her business, so she is requesting a loan to buy furniture in bulk.

Yolanda is grateful to those who have helped fulfill her dream and promises to complete her payments by the established deadline.
local_use: Purchase furniture in bulk

description:
This member belongs to the “MANOS JUNTAS” ´Hands Together`community bank. The bank is located in the district of Cuzco, which belongs to the province and department of Cuzco.

Her name is Isabel. She is 37 years old, married and has 3 children. She alternates her daily activities with the transportation business. Her husband works with his car, offering taxi service on different streets in Cuzco. Isabel is a housewife who cooks for her children and husband. She wants to improve the taxi service. She is asking for the loan for car maintenance and to buy replacement parts.

Isabel is happy with the loan and committed to making her payments on time.
local_use: to do maintenance on her car and buy replacement parts.

description:
The lending club member has a restaurant where she makes breakfasts, lunches and dinners. She makes chicken and rice, soups and roasted chicken, working from 8:00am until 6:00pm. She sometimes only makes lunches and dinners because the products are expensive and she can't buy enough. Her dream is to increase the size of her restaurant. She asks for a loan to buy chicken, vegetables and meat.

She is happy about the loan and promises to make her payments according to schedule.
local_use: to buy chicken, vegetables and meat.

description:
The members of the community bank "Patron de San Jeronimo II" are located in the city of Cusco, having their meeting headquarters in the Huanchac district. Our members alternate their various activities between different business and services. Among the members there are taxi drivers, mechanics, members that have grocery stores, a bookstore, a teacher, and members who sell beauty products, wood, anticuchos (grilled meats) and another member who sells candy. Our members are requesting the loan to reinvest in their different businesses and in this way see greater earnings in a smaller amount of time. Our members are thankful and value the loan granted in this manner and at the same time promise to make their repayments on time.

Translated from Spanish by Kate Divjak, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Working capital

description:
Manuel lives with his wife and two children aged 7 and 3.  He has a metalworking workshop, where he works from 5 a.m. till 6 p.m.  He has been doing this for the last 6 years, and he also provides a corn milling service.

He is requesting a new loan for the purchase of spare parts for his grinder, and he will invest a small part of the loan in manure as he is growing corn and wants to improve his plantation.  This loan will be useful to him in making repairs to the grinder, and providing a better service for his customers.

Manuel's aspirations are to continue with his workshop and grinder, so that his income grows for the upkeep of his family and his children's education.
local_use: to buy spare parts for his corn grinder.

description:
Sokkhoeun and her husband, Ley, are vegetable farmers. They have five children- four sons and one daughter. Two are married, one is a modern musician, one attends school and another one stays at home. The family is living in a village about 17 kilometers from Phnom Penh City.

Sokkhoeun is applying for a loan in the amount of 1,000 USD to buy a motorcycle for her son for commuting. He is a modern musician and plays music for a restaurant in Phnom Penh every evening.
local_use: to buy a motorcycle for her son for commuting

description:
Sra. Sonia is a long-time Emprender client. She has remained a widow for two years and has a child of school age. She sells several products in her well-stocked store. She is a very hard worker, since when she was very young she took over the store. Her mother and brother live with her to share some of the family expenses. This last season, she also sold food at night in a rented tent in the same neighborhood. She will use the loan to invest in the purchase of furniture and a refrigerator for the store, as well as food stuffs for meal preparation. Sonia is a very hardworking and responsible person, why is why she is seeking this loan with preferential rates through Kiva.

Translated from Spanish by Angela Yeh, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy a refrigerator and groceries

description:
Fortunata, 59, lives in the city of Cusco with her husband and four children. Fortunata opened a small store in her home where she sells foodstuffs like: rice, sugar, pasta and many other items. She has been in this business for 30 years and does quite well thanks to the efforts she puts into her work. She can be found tending to her store seven days a week from 5am until 10pm or until her bread supply runs out. Fortunata expects to receive $1000 USD in her next loan. She currently has sufficient stock for her stand but would like to use the funds to buy more food items like sacks of sugar and sacks of rice and many other items with which to stock her store. The “Las Leonas D. San Jerónimo” (San Jerónimo Lionesses) communal bank has been in operation for 10 cycles; Fortunata has been participating for several years and does quite well.

Translated from Spanish by Michael Bujazan, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy more foodstuffs like: sacks of sugar and sacks of rice.

description:
Diana is 42 and lives in the district of Laurales Norte. She is married and has two children, 4 and 16. Her plan is to work on the part of her house that needs repairs, and then to partially improve her house. Diana has worked as a caretaker for a transportation company for seven years. Her job involves cleaning, shopping, and serving coffee, among other tasks, and after work she has to go home, a routine she is tired of. She does not earn much, so her goal is to find a new job that pays more so she can provide for her children’s future. Thanks to the loans from AFODENIC, she will be able to buy construction materials such as cement, iron, blocks, and bricks, so she can offer her family security and protection, and above all, a decent home.

Translated from Spanish by Jill Heske, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy construction materials to repair her home

description:
Adela wants to continue to invest in her businesses and this is why she’s once again requesting a loan to continue growing in her fish selling business and in the workshop.  She will buy fresh fish, dried fish as well as iron and other metals for the shop.

The loans have had a positive effect on her businesses working in a responsible way to continue receiving the service.  To date, sales have improved and she has a new experience with these loans.
local_use: to buy fresh fish, dried fish and iron.

description: Gulsara is a smart and hardworking woman.  She is married and is a loving mother of two children.  She is involved in buying and selling fabrics, women's dresses, men's shirts, bedding, soap, detergent, etc.  She opened her own business one year ago and now wants to expand it and increase her revolving capital.  Gulsara wants to purchase a new assortment of merchandise and is requesting a loan in the sum of $700 for this purpose.  She thanks all of you in advance for your kindness and mercy.
local_use: to purchase a new assortment of merchandise

description:
There are 16 members in the Señor de Puquin Community Bank, which is located in the Huanchac district, Cusco province and department. The members have different small businesses. They need working capital to invest in their different small businesses. They sell food. Some of them have stands in schools and work at the students’ break time. Others are asking for a loan to increase their businesses in the fellowship market. Other members are asking for a loan for their small café and grocery store. The members are grateful for and value the loan given through this medium. They promise to make their payments according to the established timeline.

Translated from Spanish by Ginny Kalish, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Working capital

description:
Willian needs to invest in his business selling 'minutas' (shaved ice with fruit syrup).  He is requesting a loan to buy materials such as disposable cups, spoons, jelly, ice and bread, so that he can prepare good-tasting, top-quality 'minutas' for his customers.

Willian's previous loan had a positive effect.  He improved his business and had available the products he needed to make his sales.
local_use: to buy disposable cups, spoons, jelly, ice and bread

description:
Mrs. Sreytoch S. (in the picture) is 46 years old  and her husband, Mr. Vichet Touch, is 42 years old. They have been married since 1991 and have two sons who are mechanics. They live in a small village outside of Phnom Penh City. 

Sreytoch has been a garment factory worker for ten years, while her husband has been a mechanic for two years. She does not have her own transportation so she spends a lot of money for traveling costs. It’s difficult for her to manage their income to support her family. 

That’s why she is requesting her first loan in the amount of US$ 1,000 to purchase a motorbike for commuting. She will be able to cut down on some expenses by not spending so much on traveling costs any more.
local_use: To purchase a motorcycle for commuting.

description:
Idalia is 34 years old and is single. She doesn't have children but looks after her mother who she helps with the household costs. Idalia has worked for the Municipality of Nueva Guinea for 2 years. She is seeking her second loan to invest in the construction of a bedroom and to tile her mother's house, little by little improving her conditions of living for her as well as her mother, who is helping her with this small project. Her biggest dream in life is to have stable work and continue becoming a professional to continue supporting her mother as much as she can, and return the sacrifices that her mother made when Idalia was small.

Translated from Spanish by Jane McCrory, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Build a room in her house

description:
The associate belongs to the “SUMAC WATA” communal bank.  The bank is located in the district of Cusco, which belongs to the province of Cusco and department of Cusco.

The associate is Señora Ruth Vanessa.  She is 26 years of age and lives with her partner and child.  The associate alternates her daily activities with the fruit sale business.  She sells in the market of San Sebastian, where she attends her stall from 6:00 AM to 4:00 PM.  The associate wants to expand and improve her fruit sale business.  She requests a loan to buy fruits such as apples, grapes, plantains, and oranges, among other fruits.  

The associate is happy to receive the loan and she promises to comply with the payments on schedule.
local_use: to buy fruit to resell, such as apples, grapes, plantains, and oranges

description:
Pastora is requesting her third loan to invest in improving her home (adding a room). She works as a teacher at the Rafael Salmerón School. She does not have any children but she helps her mother care for her elderly grandparents and with household expenses. Pastora is a responsible and hard-working young women with a strong desire to better herself and who loves her job because it helps a lot of children in Talolinga, a village 30 km away, learn how to read and write. Every morning she gets up at 4 a.m. because she has to take a bus to Talolinga. Her dream is to complete her Education Sciences degree, have job stability, good health and a home with better living conditions so she can live in more comfort.

Translated from Spanish by Marty Greenstein, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Build a room in her home

description:
Wendy makes a living selling used clothing. She lives with her father and three siblings, and she is also a single mother of one boy. Her business is the sale of used clothing, which she began on her own out of the necessity to have an income to support her family.

She is requesting a loan for the purchase of three bales of clothing, plus the transportation costs that she incurs. This purchase will help her to have a greater availability of inventory and variety of styles that she can offer this to her customers, appealing to their tastes and needs. 

Wendy's aspiration is to develop her sales skills, growing her business so that it is more profitable, and to be able to improve her earnings.
local_use: to purchase three bales of used clothing.

description:
Kereb is a 36-year-old married man with two children. He lives in a rented house in Fort Portal, Uganda. Kereb's dream is to educate his children and to buy land for farming.

Kereb has been selling agro veterinary products for 10 years. His major challenge is lack of enough capital to meet the demands of his customers. Kereb needs this loan to buy agro veterinary supplies to sell.
local_use: To buy agro veterinary supplies to sell.

description:
Mr. Bunthea M. (in the photo), 27, is a driver. His wife, Mrs. Sokheng Phon, 27, is a garment-factory worker. They have been married since 2007 and just have a young son. Nowadays, the couple lives with their parents in a village along National Road Number Four about 20 kilometers from Phnom Penh City. 

They want to live in a separate home, but they do not have money to build a house. Therefore, Bunthea is applying for his first loan in the amount of $1,000 to make the buildings.
local_use: To build a house to live in

description:
Madame Marie Augustine is the representative of the group "DIVINE BONTE". She is married and the mother of 03 children. The oldest is 32 years old and the youngest is 19 months old. One goes to school and she supports one person. 

She has been making and selling soap (liquid and in balls) for the past 2 years. She gets her supplies at Faso Chimie, in the AN III section of town. Her customers are women, men, shop managers and the neighborhood. 

She wants the additional money to buy 20 liters of coconut oil, 1 sack of lye, 1 sack of carbonate and 10 liters of shea butter to make soap. 

She uses her savings to satisfy the orders. She aims to buy a second processing machine and to open a store.
local_use: to buy 20 liters of coconut oil, 1 sack of lye, 1 sack of carbonate and 10 liters of shea butter to make soap.

description:
Mrs. Saren S., age 39, and her husband, Mr. Kunthea Toun, 41, live along National Road Number One, about seventeen kilometers from Phnom Penh City. They have been married since 1993 and have four children: two sons and two daughters. 

Mrs. Saren S. has been selling fish for 16 years. She buys some of the fish from her villagers and her husband is also a fisherman. She sells the fish Korky market. Mr. Kunthea Toun has been a fisherman for 16 years; he catches fish from the lake nearby his house.

The couple hopes to supplement their income by growing vegetables, but they lack the capital. Therefore, Saren is requesting her first loan of $500 to purchase bamboo and nets to build a shelter for her vegetables.
local_use: To towards growing vegetables.

description:
Guillermo is 42 years old.  He is married and has three beautiful children.  His wife is a trader.  “My work is providing a taxi service.  Every day I work in the capital city Managua.  I began as a young man then with my savings I managed to buy a used car which I have been maintaining in order to improve the condition of  its engine”.

Guillermo is requesting a loan because he would like to give his vehicle a paint job and replace some parts.  He does not have enough money to do this but he would like to change his vehicle's physical appearance since it is his means of work.

He is motivated by the support of our organization as it will allow him to proceed with his goal of improving his work and obtain better profits for the well-being of his family.
local_use: To maintain his taxi with a paint job and some spare parts for his engine which will enable him to provide a better service

description:
This communal bank member is Señor Efrain. He belongs to the communal bank "Ricchary Runa" in the city of Cusco, Peru. He continues with his livestock business, which he has had for a long time and with which he has been able to support his family and develop. That is why he will invest the loan he is applying for now to capitalize his business by buying cattle for later sale.

Efrain is very grateful to Kiva for allowing him to maintain and develop his business and for supporting him with the strengthening and economic growth of his family.

He appreciates the loan and promises to make his payments according to the schedule.
local_use: to buy cattle

description:
Yesenia A. R. is 27 years old. She is a young woman who lives in the neighborhood of Las Dispersas, which is located in the town of Ticuantepe. Her husband works as a gardener in the residential district of Campos Azules. They both contribute toward the household expenses and support their two year old son. Their plans include improving their living conditions.

Doña Yessenia has been farming for 15 years. Her greatest challenge has been a lack of financing. She began farming with the help of her mother since both of her parents made their living by planting and harvesting crops. She hopes to diversify her own crops in the future.

With this loan, she plans to buy chemicals, such as fertilizers and herbicides, which she will apply to her crops so that she can improve her production and command better prices at the market. She thanks the Institution for enabling her to make improvements in both her livelihood and her personal development.

Translated from Spanish by Ronan Reodica, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Purchase fertilizers & herbicides to improve her crops

description: Shirley has been managing her business since Fape (Kiva Field Partner) has imparted the trust in her with a loan. She invested in her refried beans business. She tells us that she is thankful for that opportunity. She now requests a second loan to purchase more products, more beans and other materials she needs to make refried beans. Her goal is to keep investing in her business and especially to make it grow. She will continue to help her husband to proviD. for their two children. They are still young and her wish and that of her husband is for them to always have what they need.
local_use: to purchase beans and other ingredients necessary to make refried beans.

description: Lourdes is requesting another loan to improve her business and buy ingredients such as corn, firewood, bags, and paper.  In this way she will be able to increase her sales and give her customers good service.  Her experience with the previous loan helped her a lot because she had everything necessary to serve her customers better, and she managed to help her family with the household expenses.
local_use: to buy corn, firewood, bags, and paper.

description:
Gladis lives alone.  Her children do not live in her house because they are independent.  She is divorced.  She has a business selling dairy products, which she started with her own initiative.  She does not have a fixed schedule for seeing to her customers.

She is requesting a loan to buy milk in order to make cheese.  This purchase will help her to grow in her business.  Thanks to the loan she will expand her customer service.

Her greatest dream is to have a large business.  In addition to the experience in the business, it will help her continue with the business and provide for her necessities.
local_use: to buy milk to make cheese.

description:
Rey David is a hardworking gentleman who is a tailor by profession. He has worked more than two years in the free trade zone. Rey David is the father of three beautiful children. His goals are to provide an education for his children and to make improvements to his home.

Rey David owns a very simple house and has made improvements with the financing he has received over several loan cycles with AFODENIC. He feels that the loans have helped to balance out his expenses.

Rey David wants to replace the roof, so he will purchase sheets of zinc, beams, and wooden frames so that work can begin. He currently experience difficulties on days when it rains. His plan is to continue making improvements to his home since this is the only way possible.
local_use: to purchase materials for replacing the roof of his house.

description:
There are 16 partners of the bank "SANTO DOMINGO" and they all live in the sacred valley of the Inkas, in Urubamba, 1 hour by car from the town of Cusco.

Our partners work as retail dealers which they alternate with their chores. One partner sells food at the plaza of Serrachayoc, another one has a chicken restaurant and wishes to improve her business, another one has a video pub and wishes to buy more glasses, beverages, and music, other partners have restaurant, general store, video sale, food sale. They are all located in the province of Urubamba, and they all require the loan to be able to improve their different small businesses.

The partners are very thankful and state their commitment to repay the total of their debts punctually.

Translated from Spanish by Lene Struck Christensen, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Improve different businesses.

description: Yenny was born in Maranura, Convención Province, Cusco and is 29.  She now resides in Cotowincho, Urubamba, Cusco. Yenny is a teacher in the “Apu Torrechayoc” school in Urubamba. She has been teaching successfully for the last three years. Yenny also raises domestic animals, such as guinea pigs, chickens, and others. She is seeking credit to buy more animals to raise and sell.  Yenny is a member of the “Kuska Llankasun de Rumichaca” community bank, associated with the Arariwa Association.  She has been a member for several years. (Cotowincho is just 10 minutes from Urubamba where members hold professional meetings.)
local_use: to buy domestic animals

description:
The member belongs to the “CAPAC QOYA” community bank. This bank is located in the district of Qoya, province of Calca, departament of Cuzco.

The member is Celia. She is 77 years old. She is a widow and works managing her crop land and making sweaters. She produces the sweaters wholesale and sells them according to the demand. On her land she grows corn, wheat, and potatoes. She harvested her corn crop and need to fertilize her land and move the dirt with tractors. For this, she needs to rent a tractor and buy fertilizer to prepare the land for the next planting. She wants the land to buy seed for the new planting, to prepare the land, for fertilizer and to improve her housing little by little.  

The member is happy with the loan that has been given to her and is committed to making the payments according to the established schedule.
local_use: To invest in preparing the land, buying fertilizer.

description: Shavkat has been involved in animal husbandry for over ten years, with the goal of increasing livestock headcount.  He spent several years working in Russia, and earning that money was not easy.  He returned home and got involved in animal husbandry right away.  Shavkat used his earnings to purchase eight heads of sheep and two heads of cattle and was able to increase livestock headcount over the years like this.  Currently, he has forty heads of sheep and six heads of cattle.  Today, he needs to expand the barn for his livestock because it will not fit there in the winter.  If Shavkat does not build a barn for the livestock, then he would have to sell some of the sheep, which would not be economical, since he is buying sheep at low prices now.  Shavkat is requesting a loan in the sum of 7000 Somoni to purchase construction materials to build a barn, and to use the rest of the money to purchase sheep and fodder for it.  Shavkat relies on your help and thanks you in advance.
local_use: to purchase construction materials to build a barn, and to purchase sheep and fodder

description:
Nidia is a single mother whose daughter helps her financially.  She is an entrepreneurial woman who is self employed.  She has owned a stationery store and photocopying business for some time.  Her project is to improve the infrastructure of her home to make her business and family safer.  She started out with her own money and has plans to expand her business, offering other services such as a fax service, a text preparation service and also a variety of products.

The loan that Nidia has requested will be invested in buying metal sheets, bolts and wooden beams to replace her roof.  She is grateful to the institution for the support they have given her in developing her business.

description:
H. Farogat is an enterprising, capable and very hard-working woman. She lives in Istaravshan, Tajikistan and sells kid’s clothing. She began her business after the death of her husband. Her work is allowing her three children go to school. It is very important to Farogat that her children finish school and become honest, hard-working individuals. She needs 6500 Somoni to buy merchandise in order to increase sales. Farogat wants to continue to support her children and only wishes to work in order to achieve this. Support her!   

More about Tajikistan and IMON International

Tajikistan is known for its rich history, which includes a key post along the Silk Road and the end of Alexander the Great's rule. It has also produced great thinkers, philosophers, scientists and poets, including Rudaki, Avicenna, Ferdowsi, Omar Khayyam, Jomi, and Rumi. The country is home to communities that still speak the ancient Sogdian language, epic mountain passes, and a civilization that dates back to the 4th millennium BC. And, even today, it is a complex mixture of the Islamic faith, Soviet culture, New West culture and Central Asian traditions.

But Tajikistan is also the poorest of the former Soviet republics. The civil war, which ignited soon after its independence from the U.S.S.R., further damaged the already weak economy. In addition, 93% of the country is mountainous and only 7% of the land is arable. These conditions have resulted in high levels of unemployment and have forced hundreds of thousands to seek work in other countries, mainly Russia. While the people of Tajikistan are working to improve its agricultural production and manufacturing sector, nearly two-thirds of the population still live in abject poverty.

IMON's History

Since December 2007, IMON International has worked closely with Kiva and Kiva lenders to ensure that poor and low income clients represent a viable business proposition. Funds raised through Kiva have already been distributed to thousands of IMON International's clients and will continue to provide thousands more with permanent access to the varied financial services they need. To learn more about IMON International's work, please visit: www.imon.tj

description:
This borrower is a member of the "Yahuar Maqui" community bank which is located in Cusco district, in Cusco province and department.

Nematullo requests a loan for the purchase of supplies for his crops, such as seeds, fertilizer, fuels and lubricants. Part of the loan he will use for paying for the partial repair of his lorry. description:
George is a Ugandan male, aged 72 years, who needs a loan to buy cattle for resale.   He has a farm that he has operated for 15 years. He hails from Kyenjojo district, and is the father of nine children.  His wife is a politician in the same area.  He lives in a four room permanent house and he dreams  of acquiring land to set up a good dairy farm and of educating his children. 

George acquired his initial capital from his salary savings as a retired civil servant.
local_use: to buy cattle to resell.

description:
Karina is a 27-year-old biology student at the local university. Upon graduation, she would like to work at a research lab focusing on molecular biology. She says that she is fascinated by science because science holds the answers to many questions; for example, an understanding of DNA has solved many mysteries with respect to heredity and biological development. 

Karina is requesting a loan in order to buy a laptop to aid in her studies. Additionally, she will use part of the loan to help her mother who has a street cart where she sells candy and snacks. Karina hopes to eventually earn a master's degree in molecular biology. She has used her previous Kiva loans in order to invest in micro-businesses to finance her education.

Karina is a member of the village bank Los Diamantes in Cusco, which is receiving its 16th loan.
local_use: to buy a laptop for college and purchase sweets for a street cart.

description:
Mrs. Yun S., 31 ( in the photo), is a widow with one son and one daughter. Her daughter is a garment factory worker and her son attends school. The family lives in a small village in a suburb of Phnom Penh City.  

Yun has been a garment factory worker for more than ten years.  She is applying for a loan of US$ 1,000 to build a concrete brick room under her wooden house. She also will use a part of the loan to build a restroom for the family.
local_use: To build a concrete brick room under her wooden house and a restroom

description:
This man belongs to the communal bank "Tercer Milenio."  This bank is located in the Urubamba district, which is part of Urubamba province and the department of Cusco.

He is 75 years old and is married.  He alternates his daily activities with his business renting rooms.  He also used to work as a teacher.  In his business renting rooms he rents to many different national and international tourists.  Through this business he provided for his children.  He wants to expand his business renting rooms.  He requests a loan to set up his rooms and to buy bed sheets and bedspreads. 

He is pleased to be getting this loan and is committed to making all of the payments.
local_use: to set up rooms to rent and to buy bed sheets and bedspreads

description:
María de los Ángeles M. S. is 55 years old and lives with her husband and two children.  Owing to her financial situation, María couldn't go to university.  She is a very hard-working and responsible person who took the decision to become a saleswoman since her husband lost his job and she had to take responsibility.

This is María's first loan.  She found out about the services that Fundación Mujer offer through a training client.  She plans to invest her loan in buying merchandise so that she has more working capital as she has faced a number of illnesses and had to leave her business for a while.  María started out 25 years ago with 100,000 'colones' in capital from her husband.  María does her housework in the morning and in the afternoon she sells, collects payments and sews.

This loan will be a great help to María's business since she has been without capital and this loan will enable her to improve her quality of life and have more working capital available.
local_use: To have more working capital so that she can keep investing

description:
Jeanine is a member of the Kundana group and lives in Gitega. She is 43 years old and married to Boas, who is a driver. They have seven children aged between one and 21. Six of the children are in school: two at secondary school, three at primary, and one at kindergarten. Her family also cares for three other children.

Jeanine has been selling industrially-produced beer since the age of 15. This is her fourth loan with Turame. With her Kiva loan, she will increase her capital and purchase additional crates of beer for resale, which will increase her income. She hopes for a better future, as she will be able to feed and clothe her children, and pay their school fees.
local_use: to increase her capital and buy extra crates of beer for resale.

description:
Rosalina works selling clothing. She lives with her husband and has a 6-year-old child. Both of them work at home, and they help each other cover the household expenses and necessities. She works in her business every day. This business is located in the city center, in a place where many customers go by. 

Currently, she is requesting a loan to buy clothing for the holiday season: blouses, skirts, shirts and suits. This investment will help her improve the inventory of her business, with the aim of offering her customers better clothing.

Rosalina's aspiration is to grow in her business and improve her family's living conditions.
local_use: to buy blouses, skirts, shirts and suits.

description:
Francisca, 49, belongs to the “Amanecer Anteña” (Anta Dawn) communal bank located in Anta District belonging to Anta Province, Cusco Department.

She’s single and has two children.  She alternates her daily chores with selling breakfasts of chocolate, coffee, teas and sandwiches.  She sells in Anta’s market from 6am until 2pm.  She also sells corn and barley in Anta’s market.  Through these businesses she’s able to support her children.  She wants to expand the business of selling breakfasts and the sales of corn and barley.  She is requesting the loan to buy products like milk, bread, corn and barley at wholesale.

She is happy about the loan and commits to make her installment payments.
local_use: to buy products like milk, bread, corn and barley at wholesale.

description:
Juan is a farmer who lives in San Miguel.  He started his business on his own initiative and works his own lands; he does not have a set work schedule.  He lives with his family, which includes his mother and sisters.  He is single and at this time he needs a loan to buy farming supplies

He will purchase manure, fertilizers and seeds; this loan will help him to have the supplies he needs to get a good yield.  

His vision for the future is to grow his business and improve the living conditions of his family, since they are dependent upon him.
local_use: to buy manure, fertilizer and seeds

description:
The member belongs to the Clorinda Matto de Turner Communal Bank; this bank is located in the Calca district in the Urubamba province in the department of Cusco.

The member is Irami; she is 29 years old, she lives with her partner and has one son, who is seven months old. The member sells groceries in the Calca market; she has a stand where she sells all sorts of groceries. She is a fighter; nothing in her life came easy, but every day she wakes up and sees her baby's smile, which makes her draw energy from places where there is no energy and start a new day with great hope of succeeding. This is how she is living. She wants to stock her stand with groceries so she will have everything her customers looking for so they will be loyal. The member is requesting this loan to purchase groceries (pasta, sugar, flour, condiments, and more).

The member is grateful for this loan authorized through this site, and she promises to make her regular payments in the established time period.
local_use: Purchase products to set up her store

His knowledge and skills allow him to make his business successful and to generate a considerable, stable income for his large family.

description:
Mrs. Lak S. (pictured here), age 30, and her husband, Mr. Phal Leng, age 37, have been married since 1994 and have three children: two sons and one daughter. The family lives along National Road Number One about 15 km from Phnom Penh City.

Lak wants to supplement her income with a new business raising pigs.  She will be able to earn extra income from selling pigs when they grow big enough.  

Hence, Lak is requesting her first loan of $500 to purchase piglets to raise and to buy motorcycle spare parts for her husband’s motorcycle repair business.
