description:
This group is from Sumpango, Sac. Ms. Valentina is a farmer, a business which has been profitable for her because the land that she works has been very fertile. Valentina's daughter, Rosario, sells bread from her home. She hopes to expand her sales and offer other basic commodities. Valentina's youngest daughter, Hilda, weaves traditional bands. They have previously been clients of field parnter FAPE and today are thankful to Kiva for helping them realize their dreams.

Translated from Spanish by Cindy Manzo, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Invest in their businesses

description:
Mr. Pablo López, is 51 years old. He lives in the Laureles Norte neighborhood of the city of Managua. He and his wife have four children. He does very well in his small fruit and vegetable business. The sector where he sells his products is in the streets of Managua as he is a street vendor and provider of several of the supply businesses in the country of varied products. He began as an employee and later launched his own business selling vegetables and fruits. He has had his business for seven years. This is his eighth cycle in Afodenic. He is grateful for the benefits that he has achieved personally as well as for his family. With this loan from Afodenic he will buy larger quantities of fruits and varied vegetables to offer to his customers and be able to sell more to obtain higher profits.

Translated from Spanish by Heather Nicholson, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Purchase fruits and vegetables

description:
Mrs. Savet Vior, age 28, and her husband, Mr. Sinoeun Kloeng, age 23, have been married since 2005 and have a young daughter. The family lives in a small village across the Mekong River about fifteen kilometers from Phnom Penh. 

Savet has been selling fish in her village since 2008. Her husband has been a construction worker since 2002. She is asking for her first loan in the amount of $500. She will use $200 of the loan to build a new staircase and $300 to put an addition on her house.
local_use: To build a new staircase and put an addition on her house.

description:
Maria Dolores was born in the city of Cusco, in Cusco department.  She is 50 years old, has two sons, and lives in the city in which she was born.

Maria Dolores has a large farm called “Vista Florida” where she grows white corn.  She has been working on her farm since 1987.  It is located in Vilcabamba community and Maria Dolores also raises animals such as guinea pigs and hens.  She needs this loan to buy more animals (guinea pigs).

Maria Dolores is a member of Asociación Arariwa's “Mamacha del Carmen” community bank.  The bank is in its third year and is doing very well.
local_use: to buy more animals (guinea pigs)

description: John is a 28-year-old married man with a child living in his own house in Fort Portal, Uganda. His aspiration is to secure enough funds to set up a business for his wife and child. He is into the transport sector and has been in the business for two years now. John’s ambition is to buy a motorcycle so that he can stop remitting part of his daily income to his boss. John needs the loan to buy a motorcycle.
local_use: To purchase a motorcycle for his transport business.

description:
Juana has been selling tortillas and baked goods for five years.  She is working for the common good of her family.  Her husband works as an operator, and her children are in elementary school.  

Juana has been improving her house with loans from Afodenic.  It has been very satisfying because she has, little by little, made good progress in three cycles.  She has built a room, expanded her porch, and she continues to make improvements.

With this new loan she will be able to construct a bathroom in order to obtain improved hygienic conditions and better personal care.

She will buy materials like crossbeams, sand, zinc metal sheeting, cement blocks, and cement to finish the work.
local_use: to buy construction materials to build a bathroom in order to obtain improved hygienic conditions and better personal care.

description:
Young Milagros de Jesus, 28, lives in the Villa Reconciliacion neighborhood. She is single and has no children. She has operated a business selling cosmetics and jewelry for nine years. She started the business with her own money and help from her mother who is also a dressmaker. Milagro de Jesus will use the loan to buy cosmetics and silver jewelry pieces so that she can continue to have stock for her customers and be able to attract new customers. Her plan is to grow her business and set up her own store one day.

Translated from Spanish by Jere Wiseman, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Buy merchandise to resell.

description: Wilfredo works in construction as an experienced contractor. He has a good reputation for doing quality work. Wilfredo lives with his daughters in the Loreto zone. Thanks to his business, which is the family's only source of income, Wilfredo is able to pay for his daughters' university fees and he is very proud to see the fruits of his labor. With this loan, Wilfredo will buy tools to replace ones that have worn out. This will allow him to improve the equipment he uses in his work.
local_use: To buy tools for his business.

description:
Ubaldo was born in the city of Paucartambo (Cusco, Peru). He is 55 years old, married and has six children from this union. Currently he lives and works in the city of Pisaq. He is a bricklayer and performs all types of work, for instance floor covering, street paving, and other tasks. He and his wife have a family business where they sell staple goods, such as rice, sugar, noodles and much more. Ubaldo offers motor taxi services in the city of Pisaq and sells spare parts for motor taxis.

Ubaldo applies for this loan to buy spare parts, such as brakes, oil, clutches, tires and other things.

The members of the communal bank "Mosoq Ñusta" meet at the end of each month in the district of Pisaq in the province of Calca (Cusco, Peru). Cusco is known as a popular tourist resort as well as for its commercial activities and its traditional Inti Raymi festival. One of the Seven Wonders of the World, the Machu Picchu, is nearby.
local_use: to buy spare parts for his motor taxi business.

description:
The member belongs to the community bank "SEÑOR DE TETE CACA". The bank is located in the province of Cusco and the department of Cusco.

The member is Mrs. Nancy Mariuska. She alternates her daily activities with the business of buying and selling underwear like briefs and polos. She has fun in this business, which is going well thanks to the effort she puts forth every day. She is a nice and responsible person, which is the reason that she is successful by herself.

She is asking for a loan to buy wholesale men's briefs.

She is happy because of the loan and promises to pay the payments on time.
local_use: to purchase wholesale men's briefs.

description:
Mr. David is 33 years old and lives in the Villa Reconciliación neighborhood. He is married and his wife works as an operator in the free trade zone. They have two beautiful children, ages 8 and 19, who are in school. Their plans for their family include expanding their home and improving their quality of life for their children. David is a coroner by profession but he has worked as a solderer for nine years. He started by learning from his father, and soon began working independently. In the future David would like to increase his production and buy high quality tools. Thanks to the Afodenic loans, he'll be able to buy tools like: soldering iron, welding, masks and gloves, all of which will create utility and better service for his clients.

Translated from Spanish by Sarah Bishop, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Buy tools like a soldering iron and prime materials

description:
Ileana is 46 years old and is single. She has 4 grown children. Her youngest son Robin, who is 22, lives with her. Currently, Ileana is also caring for her 12 year old grandson Melsin, who is in the first year of high school. Ileana has worked for the Ministry of Education as an elementary school teacher in the Enrique Tierno Galvan School for 23 years. She is asking for a 6th loan from AFODENIC to add a room to her house. This will improve her living conditions and her level of comfort because her house is part of a subsidized construction project and is very small. She hopes to find support through Kiva to finish this small project.

Translated from Spanish by Catherine Fountain, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Construction of a room.

description:
Juvénal is part of the group Buheta and lives in Gitaga. He is a 44 years old and has lost his wife and children.

Juvénal has been selling Primus beer, banana wine, and meat kebabs in his pub for thirteen years. 

He is on his eighth loan with Turame. With this KIVA loan he is obtaining, he is going to increase his capital and purchase many cases of Primus beer, a large quantity of banana wine, and some meat for making kebabs to sell in his pub, so as to earn more. 

In the coming years, thanks to the profit from his business, he would like to start a modern livestock farming enterprise and to buy a motorbike.
local_use: to purchase many cases of Primus beer, a large quantity of banana wine, and some meat for making kebabs to sell in his pub

description:
This is 29-year-old Wuyah, a married mother of three children aged 12, 9, and 6. She has one additional dependent, her mother, who lives with her.

Now requesting a loan of Le 3,000,000 to buy more plastic slippers, Wuyah hopes that this loan will enable her to increase her monthly profits by approximately Le 320,000.

In the future, Wuyah plans to rent a shop, educate her children and support her husband's goal to build a house. She thanks you for your support.
local_use: to buy plastic slippers.

Khumidin lives in Kurgantube, Tajikistan. He is married and lives with his parents. He started his business 4 years ago. His career began with his father and the business investment he received from his father. His father works as a butcher.

Khumidin buys cattle from Kurgantyube, Yavan, Jomi and Khuroson markets. Khumidin believes that that the profit from the resale of the cattle is greater than from the fattening of cattle, as well as providing a constant turnover. description:
Quinto is 52 years old. For the past ten years, he has been a farmer. He began on a subsistence level and later moved to commercial farming. Quinto’s business challenges are inadequate capital and high price fluctuations. 

Quinto is requesting a loan to buy seeds to plant. He wants to take advantage of the new planting season and expand his farm. Quinto’s personal goal is to educate his children and business-wise, he wishes to expand his business into new markets and diversify.
local_use: to buy seeds to plant

description:
This is 46-year-old John. He is married and has three children aged 3, 5, and 9. He has one additional dependent who lives with him to assist his wife with the house chores.  

In 2007, John established his patent drugs business. He started to be self-reliant in the business after dropping out of school. Working 7 days a week and 14 hours a day, he earns about Le 2,341,000 every month from this business. 

He would like a loan in the amount of Le 5,000,000. John has already received and successfully repaid four loans, and now requires a new loan in order to improve on the status of the pharmacy and increase the stock. He hopes that this loan will enable him to increase his monthly profits by approximately Le 749,120. 

In the future, John plans to improve the business from patent drugs to a big drug shop. He thanks you for your support.
local_use: to pay for patent drugs.

description: The member belongs to the Los Heraldos community bank. The bank is located in the Cusco district, belonging to the province and department of Cusco. The member is Mrs Eudiviges. She is 73, married and has 4 children. She alternates her daily activities with her seamstress and weaving business. She makes her weavings in her house with the help of her children. She is retired from a private company where she was an accounting assistant. She now does what she likes to do. She is requesting this loan for the purchase of materials for her business. She is happy to have this loan and promises to honour the payments of the quotas.
local_use: for the purchase of materials for her business.

description:
Mrs. Sroy H. (her daughters are in the photo), is 34 years old and her husband, Mr. Lavi Ly, is 37 years old. They live in a small village along National Road Number Five about twenty kilometers from Phnom Penh City. They have been married since 1998 and have four children--two sons and two daughters. All of them are in school.  

Sroy sells cake at the local school. Her husband is a construction worker. In addition, the couple is hired by their villagers to produce Khmer noodles. They do not have their own transportation for commuting which costs them a lot of money. 

Therefore, Sroy is applying for her first loan of US$ 600 to purchase a motorbike.
local_use: To purchase a motorbike for commuting

description: Born in 1980, N. Saifullo is married and has one child. He is a farmer and agriculture has become his beloved job, and has been the principle source of income for him for the last ten years. On his land he produces different kinds of produce. Thanks to his experiences that he gained during ten years, he gets a rich harvest every year from his land. In light of the current high demand, Saifullo would like to improve his land and production to meet the market. description:
Rosa sells a variety of seafood. She lives with her husband and 15-year-old grandson. Rosa started her business 17 years ago from her home. She has extensive experience in this business and it has allowed her to raise and educate her children using the profits she has earned.

At the moment, she is requesting a loan to buy fish, squid, lobster, and shrimp. This investment will increase the inventory that she offers to her customers. By offering fresh seafood, she will be able to attract more customers.

Rosa aspires to increase her sales and improve her business each day so that she can submit her loan payments on time and acquire everything she needs for her home.
local_use: to purchase fish, squid, lobster, and shrimp.

description:
Manuel lives in his own house. He is a farmer and depends on this work to have what he needs in his home. He has five children who are now able to work and who help him farm every day. He learned how to farm from his father when he was about 10 years old and this has enabled him to have, since he was very young, the experience of planting the earth.  Nowadays he is working hard to teach his own children the same skills.

He is requesting a loan to purchase fertilizer and other materials, such as insecticides and pesticides, which are always used in the process of planting and growing crops. These purchases will help him to have all he needs to improve production.

Manuel’s goal is to improve conditions by increasing his family’s income through the loans that are financed by this institution, which will insure better production of his crops, so that he can market them.
local_use: to purchase fertilizer, insecticides and pesticides.

description:
Mrs. Chantha U. (pictured) is 31 and has been a silk weaver since 1995. Her husband, Mr. Rayut Choun, 35, has been a construction worker for more than six years. They have been married since 2002. 

Chantha is requesting a loan in the amount of $200 to purchase silk materials for her weaving business. The family lives on an island on the Mekong River about 15 kilometers from Phnom Penh City.
local_use: To buy silk materials for her weaving business

description:
Bakhtiyor lives and works in Dushanbe, Tajikistan. He is married and the father of two children. Bakhtiyor sells jewelry, souvenirs and hair clips at the market of “Korvon” in Dushanbe city. He tries to keep his family in a good living condition. That’s why he would like to get a loan of $3000 USD for purchasing jewelry, souvenirs and hair clips in order to expand his business and make a good profit to meet his family's needs.

local_use: To buy jewelry and souvenirs

description:
Sra. Julia has a food store at the Upper San Antonio Market, where she sells chicken, tripe, sausage, and pork, as well as groceries and canned goods. She is from Yunas de La Paz and also has a store in Coripata, which is located in Nor Yungas, north of the district of La Paz. She takes turns with her daughter in managing both locations. Her husband operates a hardware store out of their home, where he sells construction materials. Both of them are well-known in the neighborhood and have done well in their businesses.

Doña Julia will purchase groceries for her two stores. She and her husband have worked with our Institution for one year. They have been inactive for awhile, but they have now returned to continue working with us.

Translated from Spanish by Ronan Reodica, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Purchase groceries (oil, rice, flour, sugar, etc.)

description: Beatrice is twenty-seven years old, married with two children, living in a rented house in Fort Portal, Uganda and her goal is building rentals for the family. She has been operating a salon for three years and this has generated minimal income to help her provide for the family amidst mishaps of bad debts. Beatrice needs the loan to buy synthetic hair and chemicals for the salon.
local_use: Buying braids and cosmetics for her salon

description:
Juan is 22 year old and he lives in the El Transito municipality of the San Miguel region. He is single and he lives with is mother. He sells chickens. He started out his business with his mother's help. She has always sold chickens as a business. He has no fixed work schedule. The challenge he faces is the deficiency of funds to purchase building materials to build another chicken coop, for which reason he requests a loan. He will purchase wood, nails, aluminum sheeting, chicken feeders, and to purchase more chickens. This initiative will help him expand his farm and it will translate into greater sales. He always faces the risk of having his chickens fall ill. His aspirations are to have a large chicken farmer and to be a wholesale distributor. He wishes to keep working and to support his mother and improve the family's living conditions.

Translated from Spanish by Erika Lindig, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To purchase wood, nails, aluminum sheeting, chicken feeders, and chicken livestock.

description: Sandra has a business selling DVDs.  She is separated from her husband, but she lives with her two young daughters.  One of them is sick, but thanks to Sandra's support she is getting better.  They live in the Alto Pampahasi neighborhood, which is 20 minutes from the center of the city.  Sandra has a store where she sells DVDs, and she also sells in the "16 de Julio" market in the city of El Alto, which is the largest market in the city.  Sandra is a  cheerful person who works very hard for her daughters so that they can have a good education, since she hopes that someday they will become professionals.  Sandra and her daughters are currently living in a small apartment, and they hope to save enough money to buy a house.  She requests a loan to buy DVD movies and display cases to exhibit her merchandise.  Sandra is grateful to Emprender and Kiva for their trust in providing her with this loan.
local_use: to buy DVD movies and display cases to exhibit her DVDs

description:
Theresa is a forty-three-year-old married woman with three children. She owns a house in Kasese, Uganda.

Theresa has been in the poultry business for a year. This has enabled her to provide for basic needs for her family. Her challenge is expensive chicken feed.

Theresa needs a loan to pay for her children’s school fees. Her vision is to have a flock of at least 1,000 chickens and to buy more land.
local_use: to pay for her children’s school fees.

description:
Our borrower is YOLANDA, who belongs to the “MUJERES UNIDAS” ("Women United") communal bank. She comes from the city of Cusco. Yolanda is 37 years old and married, with four children who are 14, 13, 4, and 4 months old. She divides her time between her household activities and her retail business. She has a small sales stand where she sells quinua and cakes. Preparing the quinua is an involved process (sorting the grains, washing the quinua in 4 changes of water, placing it in a pot and boiling it for at least 30 minutes). After that, it is processed in a blender with chopped green apple and served hot with milk. It is a nutritious breakfast, and Yolanda also prepares cakes of various flavors and sandwiches to go along with the quinua. This food is sold in various neighborhoods on the corners between 6 and 9 in the morning. The result is a delicious breakfast that provides plenty of energy. Yolanda is requesting a loan so she can reinvest in her small business. Yolanda reports that she is grateful and happy for the opportunity to continue expanding her business, and she is committed to making her loan payments on time.

Translated from Spanish by Patricia Linderman, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Purchasing supplies for her business

description: She continues in the embroidery business.  She does work on cushions, mats and tablecloths.  She embroiders with thread and sells them independently.  She works from 8am until 5pm.  Her dream is to have a store where she can sell her embroidery.  She’s requesting the loan to buy colored thread and needles at wholesale.  She’s happy about the loan and commits to make her installment payments.
local_use: to buy colored thread and needles at wholesale.

description:
Our member is Sr. Juan, who belongs to the "Los Lideres" communal bank in Cusco, Peru. He continues dedicating himself to automobile repair in his shop, and with the requested loan he will purchase parts for the vehicles that he repairs. 

Juan is very grateful to Kiva for allowing him to keep working in his activity and for supporting his family. 

He appreciates the loan and promises to comply with the payments in his payment plan.
local_use: to buy auto parts for his mechanics shop

description:
Patricio was born in the municipality of San Ramón in Puno department, and has resided in the city of Cusco for 15 years. He is the member raising his hand in the photograph. 

Patricio is 51, married, with five children, of whom three are on their own, and two still depend on him. He is a very hard-working and responsible man, who is helping his family get ahead in life.  He is a driver for a city bus company, and in his free time he also operates his own taxi. It's going very well, thanks to the effort he puts into his work. On this occasion, Patricio needs the loan to have maintenance done on his taxi.

The members of the "Real Atahualpa" communal bank meet every 30 days in the city of Cusco. The communal bank is made up of people who are hard-working and enterprising, who at every turn are looking for opportunities to get ahead, and through their daily effort provide a better future for their children. The majority of the members live in the city of Cusco. The rest of the members are involved in money-making activities such as selling groceries, renting cars, cooking, master bricklayer's helper, farming, renting a retail stand and other things.

Cusco is well known for its tourism, commerce, traditional Inti Raymi festival, and because Machu Picchu, one of the Seven Wonders of the World, is located there.
local_use: To have maintenance done on his taxi.

description: Señor Jorge works in passenger transport in the urban area of our city. He works as a taxi driver (metered taxi) and has been doing this job for the last 3 years. He is single and works to support himself. He lives in rented accomodation at an altitude of 6km. The loan he is asking for is for the maintenance and repair of his vehicle which is his only source of income.
local_use: to pay for the maintenance and repair of his car

description:
Melania is a small businesswoman who has grown thanks to her tenacity and the support with which our institution has provided her through nine loans.  Melania's business is a bakery where she works every day making delicious bread to distribute to different parts of the capital city.

Melania has workers who make the bread as well as herself and her husband.  They work toward better production results.

Melania will use this loan to buy ingredients for making bread such as: flour, sugar, oil, butter, cheese, yeast as well as some new pans for preparing the bread.

Melania is happy that she has managed to keep her business steady since everything is costing a lot right now and she has to sell in order to be able to fulfil her responsibilities.
local_use: To buy ingredients for making bread such as: flour, sugar, cheese, yeast, etc. to increase her production

description:
Mrs. Zalissa is the representative of WINDIN GOUDI Group. She's faring well, and so does her family. She was able to buy sewing supplies and is very happy because the loan helped her very much. She's now seeking a new loan and hopes that everything will go well once again.

She's married and the mother of three children. The oldest is 10 and the youngest is 4 years old. Both go to school, and she has three persons in her care.

Mrs. Zalissa has been a seamstress for fifteen years. She gets her supplies at the markets Toecin, Bissighin and Sector 22. Her customers and women and men.

She wants to purchase two rolls of poplin, some double collars, satin fabric, one pack of zippers, and other accessories.

She wants to put some of her profits away and improve the living standard of her family. She ambitions to buy an embroidery machine for her business.
local_use: to buy two rolls of poplin, some double collars, satin fabric, one pack of zippers, and other accessories

description:
Sat (in the photo) is 51 years old; her husband, Buntheun, is 61 years old. They have been married since 1982 and have four sons and one daughter. They live about fifteen kilometers from Phnom Penh City. 

Sat is a garment worker, while her husband is a security guard. She is in the process of building a new house, but lacks some money to finish it. Hence she decided to request her first loan of $1,000 to do the finishing details.
local_use: To finish her house building.

description:
Mrs. Mony N. and her husband, Mr. Moeurn Chea, have been married since 1985.  They have four children -- two sons and two daughters. One is married, one is a garment factory worker and other two are in school. The couple lives along the Tonle Basac River, a tributary of the nearby Mekong River, about fifteen kilometers from Phnom Penn City.

Mony is a flower farmer.  She also buys bananas in her village and transports both flowers and bananas to sell at the Phnom Penh market. A recipient of a previous Kiva loan, she is now requesting another loan of $1,200 to organize her house by laying bricks in order to visually enhance it.
local_use: To organize her house by laying bricks in order to visually enhance it.

description:
Jared lives in the town of Masindi, Uganda, where he operates a bar business selling soft drinks and beers.  He is charged with the responsibility of  looking after three children, all of whom are his biological children.  

Jared needs the loan facility to buy drinks to sell.  Theft and customers not paying on time hinder his business, while his dreams are to build a permanent home and buy land to grow crops.
local_use: To buy more drinks to sell.

description: Bakhtiyor owns a small business in the southern part of Tajikistan.  He is the sole provider for his family.  He has a wife and two children.  He sells men's, women's and children's clothing at the market.  Bakhtiyor has been working in this business for about five years.  He wants to expand his business and open a new sales outlet and, thus, increase his profits.  Bakhtiyor is requesting $2000 for the purchase of clothing for the upcoming season.  He wants to expand his business and achieve successes and, thus, improve his family's quality of life.
local_use: to purchase clothing

description:
Kunthy L., 29, is single and lives on an island in the Mekong River with her grandfather and her mother, who is a silk weaver. Her home is approximately fifteen kilometers from Phnom Penh, the capital city of Cambodia. Kunthy has been a silk weaver since she was fourteen years old, a skill she learned from her mother. She sells her finished products to a middleman in the village, who then takes them to sell in Phnom Penh market.

The space under her house where she weaves is small, which makes weaving difficult for her. Therefore, Kunthy is applying for her first loan of $350 to build a shelter in front of her house. After the renovations, she will be able to weave more comfortably.
local_use: To build a shelter in front of her house where she weaves.

description: This is 48-year-old Bashiru.  He is married, and has three children aged 4, 7 and 14 years old. He has two additional dependents who live with him to help with the house chores.  In 2010, Bashiru established his patent drugs business. He began his business out of the need to care for the needs of the patients within the community. Working six days a week and 14 hours a day, he earns about Le 1,500,000 every month from this business. He would like a loan of Le 3,000,000. Bashiru requires a loan in order to buy additional medical drugs. He hopes that this loan will enable him to increase his monthly profits by approximately Le 300,000. In the future, Bashiru plans to increase the business and improve on the pharmacy.   He thanks you for your support.
local_use: To pay for medical drugs

description:
Piedad was born in the small town of Huayocari, Huayllabamba district, and she still lives there. This district is a part of the Calca province, department of Cusco. She is 27, married, and has two children, fruits of this beautiful relationship.

She sells essential supplies, such as rice, sugar, milk cans, bread and noodles. She is now requesting a loan to buy rice and sugar by the sack and some additional supplies.

She is a responsible and committed person, and that is why she is a member of the communal bank “Pro Mujer de Huayocari”, part of Asociación Arariwa.
local_use: to buy rice and sugar by the sack, and some additional supplies.

description:
Mrs. Djamilatou is married and the mother of five children. The eldest is 20, the youngest is 6. Out of them, four attend school. She has eight persons to support.

She's been selling kabakourou soap (made in Côte d'Ivoire), gari (cassava flour), and aloco (plantain) for five years. She gets her supplies at the Ouagadougou train station. Her customers are both women and men.

She wants to buy two sacks of kabakourou soap, two sacks of gari, and five bunches of aloco.

Mrs. Djamilatou would like to expand her business with her savings, by purchasing larger supply quantities. She ambitions to get her supplies directly in Côte d'Ivoire, in order to sell wholesale and semi-wholesale.

She also wants to help her children study by paying their school expenses.
local_use: to buy two sacks of soaps, two sacks of cassava flour, and five bunches of plantains

description:
Mrs. Mon M., 39, and her husband, Mr. Sengkry Teng, 45, married in 1993 and have four children: three sons and one daughter. Two of them stay at home, one is in school and another one is still young. The family lives on an island in the Mekong River about fifteen kilometers from Phnom Penh, the capital city of Cambodia.

Mon has been a silk weaver for almost 20 years, a skill she learned from her mother. She sells her finished products to a middleman who then takes them to sell in Phnom Penh market. Her husband has been a construction worker for over 10 years. He works in his village.

Mon is requesting a loan of US$ 600 in order to build pillars on her house and purchase silk materials for her weaving business.
local_use: To build pillars of her house and buy silk materials for her silk weaving business

description:
Mr. Remigio Antonio P. Sánchez is 37 years old and lives in the neighborhood of San José de los Ríos, in the municipality of Ticuantepe. Remigio lives with his wife, who works and helps out with the household costs. They have two children who attend secondary school and also assist with the farm work. Remigio hopes to improve his family's living conditions. For almost 20 years he has worked in the agriculture business, starting the venture independently with his own effort. In the future, Remigio hopes to diversify the crops grown on his property, but now the biggest difficulty he faces is that the farm lacks the tools and supplies necessary to cultivate a good harvest. With the loan, Remigio is going to buy fertilizers and other supplies that will allow him to increase his production, which he hopes to sell at a good price to cover the business costs and his family's needs.

Translated from Spanish by Kevin Credo, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy fertilizers and use them on the farm

description: Mario is a native of the city of Urubama and is a father of two children. He is 50 years old and lives with his wife in a house in Urubamba, department of Cusco, Peru. This area is known for being a tourist zone rich with livestock and agriculture, and the skillful and hard-working people identify with the local saying: "Peru's Archaeological Province." Mario has more than six years of experience as Urubamba's chief registrar and can be found fulfilling his duties from 8 a.m. until 4 p.m. Monday through Friday. He also makes a living raising small animals and is requesting a loan of 1,500 soles from Kiva partner Asociación Arariwa that he plans to use to purchase more animals, such as guinea pigs, chickens, ducks and pigs, so he can increase his capital. This will allow him to expand his business and earn more profits he can put toward the well-being of his two children. Mario has a good reputation with Asociación Arariwa since in the past he has repaid his various loans punctually and responsibly.
local_use: to purchase animals such as guinea pigs, chickens, ducks and pigs.

description: Lawrence, a 49-year-old married father of three children, lives in Hioma, Uganda where he has been a primary school teacher for 22 years. His personal goal is to educate his children, and his business goal is to complete the construction of his rental houses.Faced with the challenges of price fluctuations and inflation, Lawrence is requesting a loan to complete building his rental houses.
local_use: to complete building his rental houses.

description:
Amira, 35, is a member of the “Mujeres Unidas” (United Women) communal bank located in San Jerónimo District in Cusco Province and Department.

She’s single and has two children.  She is a clothes merchant.  She buys bundles of American clothes on the border between Chile and Perú and brings them to sell every Saturday.  She rents a small stand to exhibit her clothes.  She wants to use the loan to invest in the trip and to buy two bundles of assorted clothes.  She is requesting the loan to invest in the purchase of bundles of American clothes.

She is grateful for the support she’ll get and at the same time commits to make her installment payments in a disciplined manner.
local_use: to buy bundles of Amercian clothes.

description:
Eugenia is married to Jorge, and they live in the city of La Paz. They have two school-age children.

Eugenia sells food, and her husband works for a public agency. They both work hard and make sacrifices to get ahead and to achieve the family's goals.

She will use the loan she asked for to buy construction materials for repairs on their house because the rainy season is coming and she wants to make the repairs quickly. Eugenia is happy to have the loan because she can use it to make her family more comfortable.
local_use: to buy construction materials to repair her home

description:
José, 39, lives in Jucuapa, Usulután department with his wife and three children who are 18, 14 and 10 years of age.  He has a poultry raising business that his father started and then passed on to José to run.  He has worked Monday through Sunday for the last 12 years.

He is asking for a loan now to buy chicks and concentrated feed because he wants to increase his flock size to have more to offer his area customers. The loan will make it possible for him to increase production for sale.  He also wants to generate higher profits for his household.

His hopes are to set up a new poultry ranch and help his children to continue with their studies.
local_use: To buy chicks and chicken feed.

description:
M. Abdumajid is 33 years old. He is married with two children. From the time he was young, Abdumajid was learning to work in the small business of cattle breeding. After he married, he continued working in the same business, watching the business grow as a result of his sacrifice, and seeing his family progressing more and more. His hope is to continue growing and improving his business to offer a better future for his children, and see them as professional, ethical and hardworking. For this reason Abdumajid is asking for a loan of $1000 USD. He wants this loan to buy additional livestock and is sincerely thankful for your support.

description: Yalila is married and she has three children, two of whom are grown and help her with the business. Her husband also helps with the business. They have a restaurant bar where they server a variety of meals, including soups and other traditional foods. The business is equipped with furniture and dishes that are her own. She previously lived in the district of Saipina near Santa Cruz. For financial reason they came to live to Cochabamba. They have purchased a plot of land to build a house later on. Currently they live in a section of the building where the business is located. The funds from this loan will be used to pay for the plot of land. She is a very hard working person and she is very grateful for the support provided.
local_use: To purchase a plot of land.

description:
Josefina continues to participate in one of the communal banks in the microfinance unit of the Asociación Arariwa in the city of Cusco. Josefina still has her travel agency and things are going very well.

With her previous loan things went very well for Josefina and she was able to attain good benefits. For this reason she wants another loan as it helps her a lot.

Josefina needs the loan to invest in the capital of her travel agency; that is, she wants to buy tourist tickets and desk supplies.
 
Josefina is grateful for the opportunity offered to her through this means, and she is committed to making the repayments according to the timeline.
local_use: to buy tourist tickets and desk supplies.\r\n.

description: Alice is 24 years old with four children. She has no other dependents and lives in her own house in Hoima in western Uganda. For six years she has been operating a produce business and she started as a market vender in a small village market of Katikara. She hopes her business grows to a big produce store in the future and she is requesting for a loan to purchase maize, rice and beans.
local_use: To buy maize and beans for sale.

description:
M. Bahodir is an experienced bread baker. He has been doing this business for more than 6 years. He is baking the national bread “lepeshka” at home. He believes that this business is profitable and is not the subject to the seasonality. He is getting up early and baking the lepeshka and bread so that people have the fresh bread on their tables for breakfast. All the input materials like the flour, salt, yeast he is purchasing in the local market. Now due to high demands Bahodir wants to increase the number of his breads so that he requests for a loan of $1500 USD. The loan will be spend for purchasing the flour, and coal for baking the “lepeshka”. Bahodir deeply appreciates the trust and support you are giving him.

description:
Elaine is 36, married and has three children.  Along with her daily activities, she sells motorcycle spare parts. She works from 8:00am to 7:00pm. 

She no longer has the sweater knitting business, because the motorcycle spare parts business is more profitable. She wants to expand the motorcycle spare parts business. She is applying for the loan in order to buy motorcycle spare parts at wholesale.

She is happy about getting the loan, and promises to make her instalment payments.
local_use: to buy motorcycle spare parts for her business.

description:
Consuelo lives with her husband and children in her own house.  She is a homemaker and also helps her husband grow corn and raise livestock.  For 20 years they have been in the farm business.

She is requesting a loan to begin planting corn for which she must buy fertilizers, weed killers and instecticides.  These are the supplies she needs for the land in order to have a good harvest free of plagues.

Her goal is to use the loan to improve their crop so they can obtain a good profit from selling their harvest.
local_use: To buy fertilizers, weed killers and insecticides.

description:
Urbana devotes herself to the business of selling nougats, which are maD. with a base of rice and honey.  She prepares the nougats, and she later distributes them to different stores or schools.  She works from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.  It is through this business that she gets her children ahead.

She wants to expand and improve her business of selling nougats.  She is requesting a loan to buy rice, honey, and papers to wrap the nougats.

She is happy about the loan, and she pledges to make her payments.
local_use: to buy rice, honey, and papers to wrap the nougats.

description:
Sr. Eddy Arnulfo G. is an older gentleman who lives in the neighborhood of Buena Vista. His wife is a merchant while he operates a woodworking shop where he makes furniture based on orders that he receives. This is how he earns money to meet the daily needs of his family. Eddy has invested 25 years worth of effort into maintaining his business.

In the future, he wants to make improvements to the infrastructure of his workshop. His first loan was used to buy a large inventory of raw materials for making furniture to sell in the capital markets. Subsequent financial support to the G. family will bring about a significant change in their household finances. The development of new investment opportunities represents new sources of income that will help his family become more stable and comfortable.

Translated from Spanish by Ronan Reodica, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Purchase woodworking materials

description:
María lives with her husband and two children who are 17 and 4 years old.  She sells “pupusas” (typical Salvadoran fast food) and basic need items at home.  She does not have a fixed work schedule and she’s been running the business for the last 18 months.

Currently, María needs to buy merchandise for the business so is asking for a loan to buy oil, sugar, cured meats, snacks, soft drinks and soap.  This arises because of the need to strengthen the business and offer customers what they most need in their homes.

For María, the goal is to contribute to her children’s development through the daily effort she puts into her business.
local_use: to buy oil, sugar, cured meats, snacks, soft drinks and soap.

description:
Charles is a 35-year-old married man with two children living in Masindi, Uganda.

He started as a farmer, managed to make some savings, and now he deals in produce selling. 

His dream is to have a big food store that can sustainably supply the vast market available.

Charles needs the loan to buy maize, millet and beans to resell.
local_use: to buy maize, millet and beans to resell.

description:
Omar is a farmer. He lives with his wife and their two children. He only works at home. He began when he was very young with his father who taught him to work. He doesn’t have set work hours. 

He is asking for a loan to buy materials to use in farming, like fertilizers, herbicides, and better seeds. This purchase will help him to have the necessary supplies and be able to boost his harvest. 

Omar’s goal is that his work with the land will be profitable, yielding good production to support his family.
local_use: to buy fertilizer, herbicide, and better seeds.

description:
Her name is Clorinda. She is 43 years old, married common-law, and she has 2 children. Her business is a grocery store from where she sells basic consumer goods such as rice, sugar, milk, flour, and pasta. She works from 6:00 a.m. until 11:00 p.m. She wants to keep expanding and improving her grocery store business. She requests a loan to purchase products such as rice, sugar, milk, and pasta in wholesale for her grocery store. 

She is happy for the loan and she is committed to making her loan payments.
local_use: to purchase products such as rice, sugar, milk, and pastas in wholesale for her grocery store.

description:
The member is 45 is married and has three children. She works as a kindergarten teacher. Her husband has a postcard business. He is a photographer who designs postcards, which he then sells in various touristic sites around Cusco and near Macchu Picchu, the famous Incan ruins. 
The member is requesting a loan to buy postcard materials, such as cardstock, and to pay for printing expenses. In the future, the member and her husband would like to buy a printer in order to reduce the costs of making the postcards.

The member is receiving an individual loan as a member of the village bank "Hatunchaskas" in Cusco, which is located in the South Andean region of Peru. The bank is in its third cycle with Asociación Arariwa.
local_use: to purchase materials for the production of postcards that her husband makes.

description:
Mr Juan, age 51, lives with his wife and four children ages 20, 17, 12 y 10. They live in Lolotiquillo, in the Morazán department. He makes crafts. Specifically, he makes saddles, woven rings and bedrolls. He makes the bedrolls from reeds. This is a full-time business.

He is requesting this loan for the purchase of basic materials to keep making his products. He will purchase reeds and leather in order to have the necessary items to do his work.

He intends to work in order to improve his home and to support his children with their studies.
local_use: the purchase of reeds and leather

description: Marie J. sells provisions at O.I.C road in Makeni. She is hard working and committed to her business. She is married and got her start up capital from her husband, a high school graduate. She has 42 years of business experience. She needs a loan of SLL 4,000,000 to buy additional provisions and groceries. She hopes to use the proceeds of the loan to send her five dependants to the university level and help her husband complete their house. She thanks you for supporting her.
local_use: To buy provisions and grocery products

description:
Neverless is a 50-year-old single mother with four children. She owns a house in Kasese, Uganda. 

She has been operating a retail shop for 16 years. She started her shop with capital of 100,000 UGX, and now she has 1,000,000 UGX as her working capital. 

Her hardship is debtors who take too long to pay. Her vision is to run a wholesale business and to educate her children.

Neverless needs the money to buy sugar, rice and soap for resale.
local_use: To buy sugar, rice and soap to resell.

description:
This is our member, Guillermina.  She belongs to the Sol Naciente Communal Bank in the city of Cusco, Peru.  She cleans hotel rooms for a living.  Guillermina will use the loan she requested to buy utensils and cutlery for the upcoming opening of her restaurant.

Guillermina is very thankful to Kiva for allowing her to open her own business and for helping her support her family.

She is thankful for the loan and promises to make her payments on time.
local_use: to buy kitchenware and cutlery to open her restaurant

description:
This member belongs to the 'Ima Sumac Suncco' community bank which is located in Cusco province and department.

The member is 55-year-old Nicolasa who divides her time between her daily activities and her business raising animals such as guinea pigs.  She raises these animals and then sells them to customers who request them from her.  She is also in the cattle business and sells vegetables such as carrots, onions, squashes, etc.  She has been in this business for a long time and it is doing well thanks to the effort that she puts in every day.  This is how she provides for her family.

Nicolasa is requesting a loan to buy carrots wholesale.  She is happy to be receiving the loan and pledges to make her repayments on time.
local_use: to buy carrots wholesale

description:
Abu Bakarr is 48 years old and is married with three children, ages 7, 10, and 19. He has one additional dependent, who lives with him because he is in school and needs assistance. Abu Bakarr established a cosmetic and artificial hair business in 1996. He began his business to avoid being idle and it is his only source of income. Abu Bakarr works seven days a week and nine hours a day to earn about 950,000 SLL every month. 

Abu Bakarr is requesting a 3,000,000 SLL loan to buy hair extensions and artificial hair products such as Darling and Rihenna. He hopes that his loan will enable him to increase his monthly profits by approximately 250,000 SLL. In the future, Abu Bakarr plans to own a house in Freetown, educate his children, and buy a car. He thanks you for your support.
local_use: to buy cosmetics and artificial hair products

description: Malaika is a thirty-three-year-old single mother of three children living in Fort Portal, Uganda. She has a personal goal of educating her children up to the university. Her main business is a pub, which she has been running for the last year. Her main hardship is customers not paying on time; however, she has a vision of diversifying her business to include farming. Malaika needs a loan to buy sodas for resale.
local_use: to buy sodas for resale.

description: Brian is a married man, 29 years old, with one child. His main business is electrical appliances and he has been doing it for four years. The main challenge in the business is customers not paying back on time. His business goal is to expand his business into new markets and his personal goal is to build a permanent home. Brian needs a loan to procure mobile phones to boost his business.
local_use: To procure mobile phones.

description: Hakim is a hardworking and responsible person.  He is married and has five children.  Hakim is involved in a dekhan (farming) business for over six years.  He grows vegetables, such as onions, potatoes, carrots and others.  Hakim has an extensive experience in this business.  He grows ecologically clean and quality products on his land, and, thanks to this, his products are always in high demand among customers.  Hakim wants to obtain a loan in the sum 6500 somoni for the purchase of seeds and mineral fertilizers.  These means will help him increase harvestability and eliminate harmful insects.  Hoping to get your support, Hakim expresses his gratitude to you.
local_use: to purchase seeds and mineral fertilizers

description:
Ines is an enterprising, modest, hard-working woman who has a small business selling groceries and other products. With the help of the loan, she has succeeded in increasing the variety of her produce, and in bringing in new products.  

Her plan is to expand her shop, gradually improving her standard of living, and her housing conditions for her children's benefit. With this new loan she will buy merchandise such as cosmetics, perfumes, deodorants, body creams, hair treatments, staple grains, rice, beans, sugar, cooking oils, dairy products, cold cuts, vegetables, cereals, oatmeal, soft drinks, juices, canned goods, powdered milk, cookies, candy, costume jewelry, toilet paper, soaps, maggi and maruchan soups, and other products that she sells every day in her small general store, supplying the homes in the surrounding area with food products. 

She is grateful to the institution for their continued support in the development of her business, and the improvement of her standard of living.
local_use: To buy merchandise for daily household use.

description:
Maria del Socorro García is 36 years old, and lives in the Monimbo municipality located in the city of Masaya with her husband and children. Her husband works to help meet the household expenses. Through her own efforts, she has managed to maintain the sale of vegetables for six years now. Her biggest difficulty has been a lack of financing. Maria’s dreams are to provide better living conditions for her children, and to improve her business to generate greater earnings. At the same time, she would like to invest in the purchase of more products. With the request for this loan in Afodenic, which she hopes is very beneficial, she will increase the quantity of her products.

Translated from Spanish by Mary Lynn Malaby, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To purchase fruits and vegetables.

description:
Abduvosit is 34 years old and lives with his wife and two children. He is a humble farmer, dedicated to the production of such crops as potatoes, onions, wheat, and corn. He is encouraged when the harvest of his land is plentiful, and he wants to increase his harvests in order to attain better results. He is also aware that his vegetables have to be of a better quality in order to be able to sell them for more income. However, in order to do that, he needs to invest large amounts of money. In addition to his crops, Abduvosit is also engaged in raising livestock. He has applied to IMON International for a loan in the amount of 5,000 Somoni, which will be used both to increase his crop production and to purchase more cattle to breed.

More about Tajikistan and IMON International

Tajikistan is known for its rich history. It was a key post along the Silk Road and was the site of the end of Alexander the Great's rule. It has produced great thinkers, philosophers, scientists, and poets, including Rudaki, Avicenna, Ferdowsi, Omar Khayyam, Jomi, and Rumi. The country, home to epic mountain passes, contains communities that still speak the ancient Sogdian language, and its civilization dates back to the 4th millennium BC. Even today, it is a complex mixture of the Islamic faith, Soviet culture, New West culture, and Central Asian traditions.

However, Tajikistan is also the poorest of the former Soviet republics. The civil war, which ignited soon after its independence from the U.S.S.R., further damaged the already weak economy. In addition, 93 percent of the country is mountainous and only 7 percent of the land is arable. These conditions have resulted in high levels of unemployment and have forced hundreds of thousands to seek work in other countries, mainly Russia. While the people of Tajikistan are working to improve the country’s agricultural production and manufacturing sector, nearly two-thirds of the population still live in abject poverty.

IMON's History

Since December 2007, IMON International has worked closely with Kiva and Kiva lenders to ensure that poor and low income clients represent a viable business proposition. Funds raised through Kiva have already been distributed to thousands of IMON International's clients and will continue to provide thousands more with permanent access to the varied financial services they need. To learn more about IMON International's work, please visit www.imon.tj.
local_use: To purchase cattle and to increase crop production

description: Barno is married and is a loving mother of four children.  She is a smart and hardworking woman.  She has been involved in fattening up livestock and growing agricultural crops for over 16 years.  Barno primarily grows wheat, onions and corn.  She wants to expand her business in order to make a desired profit.  Barno wants to obtain this loan for the purchase of cattle and onion seeds.
local_use: to purchase cattle and onion seeds

description:
This borrower is 38 years old.  He is married and has 3 children aged 6, 10 and 18. In 2006, he established a pharmacy. He began this business immediately after he left secondary school, which he did because he did not have financial support to continue his schooling.  At that point in his life,  he became involved in business with the aim of generating enough income to continue his schooling.  Unfortunately, he did not continue.  He therefore decided to make business his career and thanks to God, he has achieved greatly in business.  He has been able to build a house, where he presently lives, and can now take good care of his home.  

Working 6 days a week and 10 hours a day, he earns about Le 900,000 every month from this business.  He serves the Makama community, where he sees over 30 customers each day.  His business is popular because he is the only person selling pharmaceutical products in his area.  He would like a loan in the amount of Le 4,000,000 to purchase more pharmaceutical products -- ampicilin (100 cartons @ 120,000), pinoplex (5 cartons @ Le180,000), etc. He hopes that this loan will enable him to increase his monthly profits by approximately Le 300,000.  

In the future, he plans to take this loan, which will help him greatly as additional capital, and realize more profit so that he can give a quality education to his children and take good care of his wife.  He thanks you for your support.
local_use: buy pharmaceutical drugs in bulk

description:
Candida has three children, one an adult, and two under her care. The eldest is a painter, the other son is in 9th grade, and the youngest daughter is in third grade. She has been employed by the Ministry of Education as an elementary school teacher for the last 15 years. This is her 7th loan request which will be used for home improvements, specifically to replace the zinc metal sheeting on the roof which is in such bad state, that during the rainy season much of her belongings are water damaged. It bears mentioning that with her previous loans from AFODENIC she has improved her home and her living conditions. She is a woman who dreams with having a better future, that her children always have their basic needs met, that they study to become excellent professionals, that she have work, and above all, to be in good standing with God; they profess the evangelical faith.

Translated from Spanish by Michael Bujazan, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To replace the roof.

description:
This is Mariatu, who is 46 years old.  She is married and has 5 children, aged 22, 18, 16, 9, and 4.  She also has 4 additional dependents.

In 1980, Mariatu established her local foodstuffs, cooked rice, and palm oil business.  She started her business in order to generate enough income to help her husband provide a livelihood for their family.  Working 7 days a week, 10 hours a day, she earns about 1,118,600 Sierra Leone leones (SLL) per month from her business.

Mariatu has a very good loan repayment history.  She needs a loan of 3,000,000 SLL in order to buy more foodstuffs.  She hopes that this loan will enable her to increase her monthly profits by approximately 380,324 SLL.  She thanks you for your support.
local_use: To buy more local foodstuffs

description:
Marivel was born in the city of Pisaq (Cusco, Perú).  She’s 34 years old, married and has three children.  Currently, she’s living in the city of Pisaq where she carries out her activities.  She makes and sells all sorts of silver crafts.  She’s been in this business for 15 years now and does very well thanks to the effort she puts into her work.  Marivel wants the loan to buy supplies like wire and other things.

The “Mosoq Ñusta” communal bank meets monthly in Pisaq District, Calca Province, (Cusco, Perú). Cusco is known for tourism, commerce, its traditional “Inti Raymi” festival and because one of the Seven Wonders of the World, Machupicchu, is located here.
local_use: to buy supplies like wire and other things.

description:
Manuela sells natural medicines.  She is married and lives with her husband and two children.  Her children work and help her with the household expenses.  Her business is located in the town market.

Manuela would currently like to invest in her business so that she can improve her customer service by having available more medicines for different illnesses.  She is requesting a loan in order to resolve this situation.  This will help her to continue with a stronger business and be able to satisfy her customer demand.

Manuela will buy vitamins, antibiotics and stimulants in the form of pills, syrups and injections.
local_use: to buy vitamins, antibiotics, stimulants and natural medicines

description: Amalia is an old customer and she sells food from her home on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays, but her main activity is making skirts in her home. She lives in anticrético (a special tenant-friendly renting arrangement in Bolivia) on the street between rivers. She lives with her husband, who works at a printing press and with her son, who's in high school. The loan will be for the purchase of cloth for this season. She has contracts to make skirts for which she should buy swaths of fabric. She also needs to buy groceries (rice, noodles, potatoes, and potato flour) wholesale. She's a very nice and hardworking person.
local_use: Purchase of fabric to make skirts and purchase of groceries

description: Mr. Rottanak S., 24 and single, lives with his widowed mother and three brothers and three sisters on an island in the Mekong River about 15 kilometers from Phnom Penh, the capital city of Cambodia.  A motorcycle repairer since 2009, Rottanak operates the business at his shop in front of his house. He is now applying for a loan of $300 to help finance his mother's purchase of silk materials for her weaving business.
local_use: To help finance his mother's purchase of silk materials for her weaving business.

description:
Mrs. Phum K. is 52 years old and her husband Mr. Ruos Sok is 53 years old. They have been married since 1979 and have seven children--six sons and one daughter. Three are married and live separately; two are construction workers and another one assists his parents in the business. The family is living in a small village on National Road Number Two about 25 kilometers from Phnom Penh.

Phum and her husband are farmers. They grow rice on their farmland in the village where they live. Phum is asking for her first loan of $1,000 to purchase a cow. She will use the cow to plow her rice farmland.  

Photo: Mrs. Phum K. is at home, was not at the farm
local_use: To buy a cow for plowing her farmland

description:
Jacqueline lives with her family--her husband, her son, and a sister--all in the same house. She manages a diner at the municipal market that she started with the help of a friend. Jacqueline already has several customers, a stable business, and experience.

She is requesting a loan to purchase the ingredients for preparing her dishes such as meat, chicken, oil, beans, sodas, and condiments. This purchase will improve the availability of supplies at her disposal so that she can continue producing better dishes.

Jacqueline’s goals are to take her business to a new level, grow, and improve the income of her family.
local_use: to buy meat, chicken, oil, beans, sodas, and condiments.

description:
Mercedes lives with her 27-year-old daughter. She sells tortillas and “pupusas”. Mercedes sells her products every day at the municipal market. At night she makes tortillas.

This business has allowed her to generate income to pay for her necessities. Mercedes wants to make a few changes to her vending stall, so she will invest in the purchase of sand and cement with the intent of having a better established location so that her customers will be more comfortable and satisfied with her service.

Mercedes dreams of someday having her own home.
local_use: to buy sand and cement for remodeling the premises of her business.

description:
Dorothy is forty-three years old, married with six children and living in Fort Portal, Uganda. She lives in her own permanent house and her family dream is to educate her children. Dorothy operates a retail shop besides her pasturing and has been operating it for the past ten years. Her business dream is to have her retail shop turned into wholesale. 

Dorothy intends to use this loan to purchase sugar, soap, and cooking oil for resale at her shop.
local_use: Purchasing sugar, soap, and cooking oil for resale

description:
Felix is a very hard-working woman who is dedicated to selling pork products.  She has bought and sold pigs for years.

Felix has 4 children, 1 of whom works with her in the butcher shop.  Another is a seamstress who makes and repairs clothes.

Felix has worked with this institution during 8 loan cycles, making it possible for her to buy more pigs, since often, she lacks the funds to cover the cost of the pigs.  So, the financing has been of great benefit to her business.

With this new investment she will buy 2 pigs, and continue making the “nacatamales” (a local favorite) which day by day she sells, along with fried meat, among other rich dishes of this sort.
local_use: TO BUY TWO PIGS AND INCREASE MEAT SALES

description:
Hilda is 41 years old, married, and has four children.  She continues working in her dressmaking business.  She makes suits, skirts and blouses for men, women and children.  Hilda works from 8.00am to 9.00pm and, through this business, she provides for her children.  Hilda would like to expand and improve her business.  She is requesting this loan to buy buttons, fasteners, clasps and threads for making suits, blouses and skirts.

Hilda is grateful for, and values, this loan.  She pledges to make her repayments according to schedule.
local_use: to buy buttons, fasteners, clasps and threads for making suits, blouses and skirts

description: The member is Gladys, and she now wants to invest her loan to increase her supply of beauty products, which she sells from catalogues. She also wants to buy wallets and shoes, so that she has merchandize to sell to her clients and friends. She will buy wallets, shoes, and increase her supply of beauty products.
local_use: to buy wallets, shoes, and increase her supply of beauty products.

description:
José is employed at a national hospital.  He lives with his family on the property of a friend who has given him some space to live on her plot of land.  He is a very hard-working person who has spent 23 years as an employee of the hospital and tending his position in the warehouse.

He needs the loan for the purchase of a pump for a well, as this will help him to get water from the well more easily and with less effort.

He wants this loan to help him meet his need, as the installation of the pump will help improve his life and relax a little more with his household tasks.
local_use: to buy a pump for his well.

description: Nuriddin is married and is responsible father of three children.  His wife is involved in household work and raising the children.  Nuriddin is involved in passenger transportation.  He recently purchased his own "Gazel" vehicle.  Currently, he needs to make repairs to the body of the vehicle.  This is why he is requesting a loan in the sum of $1000.
local_use: to make repairs to his vehicle

description:
For the past seven years, Dilbarjon has sold women’s dressing gowns and underclothes at “Somon” market in Khujand. Dilbarjon is married and has three children. She is determined to provide a better living for her entire family. Dilbarjon is hard working and kind, giving her the ideal blend of entrepreneurial determination and service. Skilled in trade and abounding in character, Dilbarjon has both a strong business base and a perfect credit history with IMON International. Currently, she is seeking a loan of $800 USD to purchase a new vending facility and to expand her business. With the increased income, Dilbarjon plans to continue growing her business and improving the financial situation of her family.    

More about Tajikistan and IMON International

Tajikistan is perhaps best known for its rich history, which includes a key post along the Silk Road; the end of Alexander the Great's rule; and it’s famous great thinkers, philosophers, scientists, and poets: Rudaki, Ibn Sina (Avicenna), Firdousi, Omar Haiyam, Jomi, Mavlavi Rumi and many others. The country is home to communities that still speak the ancient Sogdian language, epic mountain passes, and a civilization that dates back to the 4th millennium BC.  And, even today, Tajikistan is a complex mixture of the Islamic faith, Soviet culture, New West culture and Central Asian traditions. 

Tajikistan is also the poorest of the former Soviet republics. The civil war, which ignited soon after its independence from the U.S.S.R., further damaged the already weak economy.  In addition, 93% of the country is mountainous and only 7% of the land is arable. These conditions have resulted in high levels of unemployment and have forced hundreds of thousands to seek work in other countries, mainly Russia. While the people of Tajikistan are working to improve its agricultural production and manufacturing sector, nearly two-thirds of the population still live in abject poverty.
