To learn more about IMON International's work, please visit: www.imon.tj
local_use: To expand her business.

description: Cirila continues running her restaurant and preparing delicious typical and homemade vegetable and pulse stews. She wants to earn some more money and expand her activity, and in this occasion she is requesting a loan to invest it in the purchase of ingredients to prepare the different vegetable and pulse stews. She will also invest it in the purchase of cutlery and dishware; she will improve the restrooms and next years she plans on expanding her restaurant. She is requesting a loan to invest it in the purchase of dishware, cutlery and products at wholesale price to improve her activity.
local_use: To buy dishware, cutlery and products at wholesale price to improve her activity.

description:
Vidra is a 55-year-old married man blessed with three children. He is living in his own house in Fort Portal, Uganda.He has had a retail shop for six years, which has facilitated him in supporting his family.

Vidra intends to use the loan to buy sugar, salt and soap for selling in his shop.
local_use: Buying sugar, salt and soap for selling in his shop

description:
Juliana tends to a flock of about 20 sheep and earns a profit by fattening them and later selling them. She is 36 years old and married, with six children between the ages of 1 and 15. She has been raising sheep since she was a teenager, for about 20 years in total. During that time, she has been responsible for ensuring that her sheep are well fed and receive medication when they become sick. Juliana is requesting a loan in order to purchase more sheep. She would like to buy ten more sheep, and her dream is to continue expanding her flock and thereby earn more profits.

Juliana is a member of the village bank “Los Caminantes de Ocongate,” which is receiving its first loan from Asociación Arariwa. The group members live in a fairly remote rural community several hours outside of Cusco city, located at an altitude of 3,800 meters up in the Andean mountains.
local_use: to buy sheep.

description: Suhrobjon comes from a family of bakers and operates a flatbread bakery with his father. Their flatbreads are famous and in demand in the city. Suhrobjon has been in this business for over five years. He is married and has a child. In order to advance his business, Suhrobjon would like to obtain a loan. Baking flatbreads is fun and rewarding. After all, if there is good bread in the house, then all is well. Suhrobjon would like to receive a loan of 10000 somoni to make a bulk purchase of flour and coal. He is hoping for your support in obtaining this loan.
local_use: to purchase flour and coal

description:
Zebokhon has a friendly family. She has three children and a lovely husband. Zebokhon and her husband want to live in a comfortable house with their children. Zebokhon has her own business in animal sales. She loves animals very much, which is why she chose this kind of business. She cares for her livestock very well and she has many customers in the local market. 
Zebokhon wants to repair her house but her income is not sufficient for it. She is requesting a loan to buy building materials.
local_use: to buy building materials for repairing her house.

description:
Lilliam is 37 years old and has two school-aged children and is very thankful for her family.  Her husband works as the director of a radio station and, together, they share the household expenses.  She has worked as the director of the Cesar Augusto Salinas Pinell school for 15 years.  Lilliam is a professional woman who just received her masters degree.  She is a well-loved teacher among her colleagues and students as well as her family because she is very sociable.

She is requesting her ninth loan to improve her home's infrastructure and improve living conditions.  She is grateful to Kiva for the previous loan which allowed her to plaster the walls.

Her dream is to obtain her doctor's degree and that her children follow in God's footsteps and study to be good people.
local_use: To improve home infrastructure

description:
Nelly is 32 years old, married and has two daughters who are both in elementary school.  Nelly has been working for the City of Juigalpa for 7 years.  She is a business management technician.  She has the support of her husband who takes care of their household expenses.

Nelly is requesting her 4th loan so that she can continue improving her house.  She used her previous Kiva loan to improve the roof of her room.  She now plans to build a bathroom in her home (drain, toilet, bath, sink) so that she can provide her family with better living conditions.
local_use: To build a bathroom

description:
Nancy, 27, is a member of the “Siempre Adelante” (Always Forward) communal bank located in Ollantaytambo District belonging to Urubamba Province and Cusco Department.

She is single.  She alternates her daily chores with running a grocery store and bar.  The businesses are her mother’s also and they work together.  She also works in tourism managing a restaurant in Ollantaytambo District that’s an hour and a half from the city of Cusco.  She wants to expand the grocery store and bar and is asking for a loan to buy stock items for the store like, rice, sugar, milk and noodles, and to equip the bar.

She is happy with the loan and commits to make her installment payments.
local_use: to buy stock items for her store and to equip the bar.

description: Seidy is a 54 year-old woman who lives with her common-law husband.  She is hardworking and exerts herself a lot to achieve her goals.  She has a business where she sells goods from a catalog in an itinerant manner.  First, the goods go to her home, and later she goes out to offer them for sale.  She has been getting income this way for a number of years, without neglecting her family.  In her previous loan she was responsible and punctual.  Now she wants to increase her sales so that she can excel as a person and succeed in her business, and to do this she is requesting a loan.  She will invest in a line of shoes, because her customers have requested them and she wants to satisfy them.
local_use: to invest in the purchase of merchandise

description: Beatriz is an old client of Emprender.  She is 49 years old and lives in La Guardia district in the 3 de Mayo neighborhood.  She has lived there for 35 years and is originally from the department of Santa Cruz.  Beatriz has been single for 30 years.  She has one daughter in her care.  Her business is selling chicken, chorizo and duck in the district market.  She has been in this business for 10 years.  She will use her loan to buy pigs and ducks to fatten since she has a lot of orders for the end of the year.  Beatriz is a very hard-working lady who works hard so that her daughter can become a professional.  She is grateful that we are trusting in her again and we are providing her with a loan so that she can invest in what she needs and thereby increase her working capital.
local_use: Working capital and to buy pigs

description:
Raúl is a farmer.  He lives with his wife and three children; he’s the only one who works planting corn and beans, an occupation he learned from his father when he was still single.  He works on leased lands and he does not have a fixed schedule.

He will buy supplies to prepare the soil so is asking for a loan to buy manure and herbicides to be ready to start the seasonal farming tasks.  This purchase will be very good for Raúl.

Raúl's hope is to have a better farming business with abundant harvest to meet his family’s needs while at the same time providing for his customers.
local_use: to buy manure and herbicide.

description:
Lucia belongs to the village bank "Señor de los Milagros de Chimpahuaylla" in the city of Cusco, Peru. She continues raising small animals in her home and also making jewelry - products like earrings, necklaces, bracelets, etc. Lucia is a mother of two children, for whom she sacrifices daily to be able to give them a better education and nutrition. On this occasion she will invest her loan in materials like accessories and wires to make jewelry.

Lucia is very grateful to Kiva for allowing her to give her family a better quality of life and her children a better education.
local_use: to buy materials like accessories and wires to make jewelry.

description:
The members belong to the “KILLA” communal bank. This bank is located in the district of Cuzco, which belongs to the province and department of Cuzco. 

This member's name is Bertha Elena. She is single and 53 years old. She has 4 children. She has her own business buying and selling clothing. She sells pants, sweaters, polo shirts and blouses. She sells independently taking the clothes to different places or to the general public. With this business she gets her family ahead. Bertha Elena wants to grow and improve her business selling clothes. She is asking for the loan to buy pants, blouses, polo shirts wholesale.
 
The members work in selling artisanal crafts, food, hardware, sweaters, in transportation, and providing a telephone calling service.

Bertha Elena is thankful to those who are taking a part in her dream in this way and she is committed to making her payments on time.
local_use: to buy pants, blouses, polo shirts wholesale.

description:
Ahmed is a thirty-seven-year-old married man. He has seven children and lives in a family house in Kasese, Uganda. He has had a retail shop for ten years that he started with 500,000 Uganda shillings of capital but increased to capital of 4,500,000 Uganda shillings. However, his hardships include low demand as a result of a sparsely populated area and increased costs of goods.

Ahmed wants credit to purchase sugar, salt, cooking oil, soap to sell in his shop.
local_use: To buy sugar, salt, cooking oil, soap to sell

description:
Doris is requesting a new loan to buy seasonal merchandise.  This new investment will help her to offer her customers new products in different colors and styles.  She will specifically buy shoes, shirts, pants and blouses.

This type of investment helps Doris to increase her potential and gradually grow in the market.
local_use: to buy shoes, shirts, pants and blouses

description: Patricia decided to take out another loan because she wants to buy cashews because their price is better now and she’ll be able to have on-hand supply to stay in business.  The previous loans helped her because she increased profits which led to better economic stability for her family.
local_use: to buy cashews.

description:
32-year old Marivel is married and has three children. She lives in the town of Pisaq, in Calca province, Cusco department, Peru. After completing her household tasks, Marivel sells crafts. In her house she has a small workshop where she makes crafts. She’s been doing this work for 15 years and all is going well thanks to the hard work she puts in.  She now needs a loan to buy materials such as wire.

Marivel belongs to the Mosoq Ñusta community bank, a part of the Arariwa Association. She is grateful for the opportunity this loan brings and promises to pay back the money according to the established schedule.
local_use: to buy craft supplies such as wire

description:
Mercedes is 60 years old and lives with two grandchildren.  She’s been a merchant for over 20 years and has worked just with her children for the last 11 years.  She learned how to run the business well thanks to training from her husband.  Because he was a cattle merchant he started bringing her a bag of snacks or an arroba of sugar and gradually she started to make progress until her business became strong.

Mercedes has to travel to the city to make her purchases.  She boards a bus that takes her on a trip that takes three hours.  She returns home in a mototaxi (a motorcycle that provides taxi services).  When Mercedes makes larger purchases she travels to a more distant city and takes seven hours to do her shopping and return home.  On these occasions she avails herself of a truck that leaves once a week and transports all the merchants from her community.

She requests a loan from Fundación Campo to improve her store.  Mercedes previously sold on credit to her customers, a common practice in her community, but they delayed paying her which decreased Mercedes’ buying capacity.    The loan will make it possible for her to buy larger amounts of merchandise to meet customer demand thus improving her income.

In the future, Mercedes intends to continue improving her business to always have what’s necessary to survive and not be dependent on others.  Besides, Mercedes wants to leave a legacy for her children and grandchildren: that they know how to earn their livelihood honestly.
local_use: to buy merchandise for her store.

description:
Páula wants to buy basic ingredients for her dining area. For this reason, she is applying for a loan that will help her improve the availability of her cuisine. She will buy meat, shellfish, chicken, beans, rice, and sausages, which are some of the ingredients that she uses daily to make her various dishes.

She hopes that this new investment will give her the desired results, just as she succeeded with the investment of her previous loan, which she considers very successful and which up until now has allowed her to maintain her family, covering all the household expenses.
local_use: to buy meat, shellfish, chicken, beans, rice, and sausages

description: Leonor, 35, was born in Cusco but lives in Urubamba.  She continues in the “Los Solidarios” communal bank and works selling mobile phones and crafts but wants to open a grocery store.  On this occasion she needs the loan to buy merchandise like sacks of rice and sacks of sugar.  She’s happy about the loan and commits to make her payments.
local_use: to buy merchandise like sacks of rice and sacks of sugar.

description: Mohruhsor is twenty nine years old.  She is not married and she lives with her parents.  She is a very kind and hardworking woman.  Her parents are very proud of her.  She started her own business a few years ago, selling stationary.  Because of a lack of opportunity, she was unable to develop her business.  Now, she decided to organize another stationary business.  In preparation, she's taken the course "Bring it On", organized by the Association of Business Women and received a certificate.  Now she has the ability to organize her business and become successful in the trade.  With her revenue, she plans to help her parents improve their quality of life.  She's asking for the sum of 1,000 somoni to purchase inventory to organize her new business. She awaits your kindness.
local_use: To buy stationery to organize a new business

description: Ana María is now 33 years old. She is married and has three children. She lives in Tambo Real, in the province of Anta, whre she produces and dairy products such as milk, cheese, and yogurt and sells them in the markets and shops in the region. Ana María needs more milk to make her products, so she will use the requested loan to buy a milk cow. She is very grateful to Kiva for helping her with her business and is committed to making her payments on time. Ana María belongs to the San Bartolo de Tambo Real village bank in Tambo Real, Anta Province, in Cusco, Peru. Ana María wants to offer her children a better life and education. She makes sacrifices for them and hopes to work hard and save money to pay for their education.
local_use: to buy a cow.

description:
Francine belongs to the  Siyoni group and lives in Bujumbura. She is 24 years old, and is married to Gilbert, who is a driver. Together, they have a 3-year-old child.

For the last five years, Francine has been selling clothing, curtains and sheets. She is on her fifth loan from Turame. 

With the Kiva loan, she is going to increase her capital and buy a large quantity of clothing, curtains and sheets to re-sell, to make more profit. 

In the future, she would like to build her own house and see her child go to school.
local_use: to increase her capital and buy clothing, curtains and sheets to sell, to make more profit.

description:
Sra. Elba is a 38-year-old woman who only has a first grade education. She lives in an area near Puntarenas, Corredores, La Cuesta, Bella Luz de la Vaca, Río Incendio. This location is 300 meters north of the school and has one of the lowest Human Development Index scores in the country.

Elba is the mother of two children who are attending elementary school. She raises livestock, specifically pigs. Elba has been in a common-law relationship with her companion for two years. Even though she and her partner are not married, they have two children as a result of their relationship. For this reason, she has not been able to work outside of the home. She receives a pension in the amount of 70,125 CRC, which is a very small amount for her to provide a decent quality of life for her children. Five years ago, Elba looked for a way to supplement the family income so she decided to raise pigs. She buys the animals when they are small so that she can fatten them. Elba raises them for a period of six months before selling them and starting the process over again. Her business is located in an area behind her house that is well-suited for keeping her pigs. She was able to construct a pig sty by reinvesting the profits from her previous sales.

Doña Elba has a viable business that she can develop from her home. She also has land on which she planted bananas and plantains. Elba will use her loan to buy concentrated feed for her pigs so that she can obtain excellent results.
local_use: to purchase pigs and concentrated feed.

description:
Xiomara Maritza, 42, is married and has two children. She is a primary care doctor, and she works as the head teacher in the Health Center of Juigalpa. She has been doing this for 16 years. Her husband is also a doctor, and he helps with the family expenses. He also supports her in asking for the loan. Xiomara is asking for her fifth loan to improve her house. She wants to install a ceiling and put tile down on the damaged floor. She dreams of having a pretty house with adequate conditions so that her children can grow up in a comfortable and happy atmosphere.

Translated from Spanish by Ginny Kalish, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Put in a ceiling, tile, and paint

description: The member’s children are 24, 20, 17 and 15 years old.  She carries out a variety of activities like buying and selling clothes for women and men, raising animals like chickens, guinea pigs and sheep and now plastic sheeting for the rainy season.  She wants to use the loan to buy plastic at wholesale.  She will buy plastic to resell in her market stand in town.  She buys it at wholesale in Juliaca and then sells it by the meter.  She’d like to be able to buy a piece of farmland to cultivate shortly and sell her crops.  She invests income generated from her sales into her children’s education.  She is asking for the loan to buy plastic sheeting at wholesale.
local_use: to buy plastics at wholesale.

description:
Fidel plants pipian [a squash] and corn. He lives with his wife and 2 children. He has worked in agriculture for 10 years and learned the trade at home from his father. This currently serves as his family's livelihood.

He asks for a loan to buy compost for his pipian and squash plantations, since this is the season to fertilize in order to get a good harvest.

Fidel proposes to have good harvests and improve them each year so that he can also improve his family's earnings.
local_use: to buy compost for the corn and squash plantations.

description:
This is 27-year-old Ibrahim.  He is married and has one child aged three. In 2004, Ibrahim began his assorted goods business selling sardines, soap, batteries, razors, tooth paste, etc. He took over his business from his eldest sister who has relocated to the United States of America.  Working 6 days a week and 10 hours a day, he earns about Le 750,000 every month from this business. He would like a loan in the amount of Le 4,500,000.  

Ibrahim has already received and successfully repaid one loan, and now requires a new loan in order to buy different items -batteries (3 cartons @ Le140, 000), Grafton Drinking Water (40 bundles @ Le3000), soft drinks (150 crates @ Le15,000), candles (10 cartons @ Le50,000), torch lights (1 carton @ Le200,000), toilet soap (1 carton @ Le150,000) and foam surf (cartons @ Le60,000). 

He hopes that this loan will enable him to increase his monthly profits by approximately Le 200,000. In the future, Ibrahim plans to buy both a taxi and a motorcycle and build a house for his family. He thanks you for your support.
local_use: To pay for various goods to stock his store.

description:
Julieta buys and sells young ladies’ and girls’ clothing and has been doing this for 13 years. She buys the clothing from her sister, who makes it, and sells it in the commercial areas of the city of La Paz. She lives with her husband and children, in an “anticrético” apartment, in Bajo Pampahasi. Her children attend school. (In an “anticrético” arrangement, the owner leases property for a lump sum deposit in lieu of monthly rent. At the end of the lease period, the money is returned to the renter. If the owner fails to repay the money, the renter gets to keep the property.) [Julieta] is a very responsible client, and part of a united group, who’s been working with us for some time. She will use the money from this loan to buy embroidered dresses, since she has had some requests and these types of dresses are in high demand. She is very hard working and responsible and is very grateful to Emprender and Kiva for the opportunity they have given her.

Translated from Spanish by Hugo Reyes, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Inventory

description:
Sandra works selling food and drinks.  She lives with her husband and three children, and has worked in the business for the last 8 years.  She is a very hard-working woman, and the business is profitable.  Her husband helps her make the sales.

She will be investing the loan in the purchase of drinks (sodas, juices, natural refreshments), and also ingredients such as oil, spices and meat, to stock up her business with products that will allow her to better meet demand.

Sandra's objective is to invest in her business, expand the variety of dishes, and to continue growing as a micro-enterprise thanks to the loans.
local_use: to buy drinks (sodas, juices, natural refreshments)

description: Abel belongs to the "Granito de mostaza" (Mustard Seed) Community Bank located in Cuzco.  He is 40 years old, lives with his partner, and has four children.  He works in carpentry alongside his wife.  He crafts products such as beds, doors, shelves, wardrobes and others.  He is asking for a loan to start a carpentry business.  He is thankful for all those who help make his dream come true through these means and promises to repay his loan on time.
local_use: To start a carpentry business

description:
Kunthy (shown in the photo), 48, and her husband, Sok, 40, are fishermen and rice farmers. They live along National Road number five, about twenty kilometers from Phnom Penh. They have two sons and one daughter. Two are garment workers and another one is married and lives in separate home.

Kunthy is asking for a loan of $600 to fill-up the land of her house foundation and to bury a highway drainage pipe because the house where she lives needs a more functional water system.
local_use: to fill-up the land of her house foundation and to bury a highway drainage pipe because she needs to arrange a more functional water system for her house.

description:
Elmer, 42, is divorced and has two children.  He has worked in agriculture since he was a child, and he learned the profession from one of his uncles.

To buy the supplies he needs for his crops, Elmer leaves his house at 7 a.m. and has to travel a total of four hours.  To leave his community, he pays for transportation in a pick-up truck, then takes a bus.  Elmer sells 80% of his crop at a market four hours from his house.  He stores the other 20% for home consumption.

Elmer is requesting a loan from Fundación Campo to buy fertilizer, herbicides, and pesticides for his corn and millet crops.  The loan will help him to be able to buy all his supplies at the same time, and so save on the cost of transportation.

Elmer dreams about being able to construct a pond to raise freshwater fish in the future.  In this way he would be able to improve his earnings with a new product.
local_use: to buy fertilizer, herbicides, and pesticides for his crops.

description: Fakhriddin is a kind and responsible husband. He is married and is a loving father of three children. He grows agriculture crops. His wife also helps him in this business and they work together as a team. He uses the profit which he gets from the business for his family needs and for expansion of the business. Fakhriddin wants to receive a loan in the amount of $2,700USD to buy mineral fertilizer. He is grateful to Kiva and its lenders for their kindness in advance.
local_use: to buy mineral fertilizer

description: Wilson wants a loan to buy more land to plant tea. The forty-five-year-old hardworking man lives in Fort Portal, Uganda. He still has challenges of unpredictable seasonal changes and his dream is to own at least forty acres of tea plantation. He used the previous loan to pay workers who were plucking his tea.
local_use: to buy more land to plant tea.

description: Caledonio was born in the city of Quillabamba (Cusco, Peru). He is 44 years old, and now lives in Cusco with his spouse and their three children. Caledonio works in the city as a chauffeur, using his own taxi. He works from 6 AM to 9 PM, seven days a week. He has been driving a taxi for several years now, and thanks to his work ethic, he has done quite well for himself. Caledonio needs a loan so that he can make some repairs to his taxi and pay his children's school fees. Because Caledonio is so responsible and hard-working, he was invited to join the Hatun Rumiyoc community bank, which is part of the Araiwa Association.
local_use: to repair his taxi and pay his children's school fees.

description:
Victoria belongs to the communal bank "Reyna de Los Angeles."  This bank is located in the district of Urubamba, which is in Urubamba province in the department of  Cusco.

Victoria is 48 years old, married, and has 4 children.  She alternates her daily activities with her business raising chickens.  She buys the little chicks and later fattens them and sells them in the different markets that take place in the city of Urubamba.  Victoria wants to expand her business.  She is requesting a loan to buy more chickens at wholesale.

Victoria is grateful for the loan that she is requesting, and she promises to make all of her payments according to the established schedule.
local_use: to buy chickens at wholesale

description:
Reina lives with her husband and three children. She runs a food stall where she sells items such as juice, snacks, and pupusas [a thick corn tortilla stuffed with cheese, fried pork rind, chicken, or refried beans]. Her business is located in the downtown area and she has a good client base.
She is requesting a loan for the purchase of snacks, sweets, and ingredients for making pupusas, such as quesillo [soft Salvadoran cheese], corn, chicharrón [fried pork rind], and oil. This loan will allow her to strengthen her business. The local festival is coming up, and she will now have the capacity to serve customers at this time.
Her goal is to improve her business and help her children with everything they need and with their studies.
local_use: to buy snacks, sweets, quesillo [soft Salvadoran cheese], corn,  chicharrón [fried pork rind], and oil.

description:
Sara belongs to the Perolniyoc Communal Bank.  The bank is located in the Urubamba district, Urubamba province, Cusco department.

Sara, age 37, has a life partner and five children.  She alternates her daily activities with her business, a grocery store.  She works from 6:00 a.m. until 9:00 p.m.  In her free time she does beautician work like cutting hair and dyeing hair.  Through these small businesses she gets her children ahead.

She wants to expand her grocery store business, and she wants to improve her beauty salon service.  She is requesting the loan to buy products like rice, sugar, noodles, oil, and sweets for her grocery store.

She is happy about the loan, and she pledges to make her payments.
local_use: to buy products like rice, sugar, noodles, oil, and sweets for her grocery store.

description:
Here is a member of the communal bank named "Virgen del Carmen de Yuncaypata". It is located in the community of Yuncaypata, in the province of Cusco and the department of Cusco.

Her name is Purificacion. She is 25 years old, separated, and she has 1 child. She alternates her daily activities with her knitting business. She knits wraps, sweaters, scarves, mittens and others. She knits at home to later sell to her clients. She works independently and this ways she is able to have more time for her son. This is something she really enjoys and she puts a lot of effort into her work. She is a responsible person and this is how she is able to provide for her son.

She requests a loan to purchase materials such as yarn, needles, wool and other materials.

She is happy for her loan and she is committed to making her payments.
local_use: to purchase yarn, needles, and wool

description: Marlon is a young man who desires to get ahead. He is a hard worker who has established a small business selling cellular accessories. He achieved this using the funding from Afodenic, as it was an opportunity to grow his small business. He started off just selling movies and music with savings from his job as a mason. Today he only works at his own business, with the help of his wife. She sells enchiladas, tacos, and refreshments in the afternoons, thus sharing the costs. With this loan, he will buy cellular accessories, TV remotes, calculators, movies, and music to augment his stock, improve his sales, and be more profitable.
local_use: Cellular accessories, movies, and videos

description:
Apolinaria needs new financing for her tortilla and tamale business in order to aquire corn and wood. She also needs some condiments which are necessary for her to continue the business.

The past loan allowed her to buy materials for her business and manage to paint another part of her house. Her home is currently doing well, her business is stable, and she is always preparing any type of products for sale.
local_use: to purchase corn and firewood.

description:
Karla Patricia is 27 years old and lives in San Miguel. She is single and lives with her parents and two siblings. She has a store selling products that are basic necessities. She has been running the store for 4 years. She transports the products from the city to the rural area where her business is located. She requests a loan to build a bedroom. She will buy construction materials such as cement, iron, bricks, sand, and gravel. This will improve the home, since she needs to have a bedroom and have her own personal space. Karla aspires to grow her business so that she can cover the basic needs of her parents and herself.

Translated from Spanish by Lisa Grobar, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: to buy construction materials such as cement, iron, bricks, sand and gravel

description:
Rhina lives with her husband and two children. She sells clothing: comforters, bed sheets, shorts, skirts, pants, and blouses for ladies, gentlemen and children. She has her business in her house and two days out of the weeks she sets out to sell in her customer's houses. She has had her business for several years.

She requires the loan to purchase more merchandise to add inventory to her business through the purchase of more clothing: pants, shirts, and blouses. This will increase her profits because she will have a wider variety of items to offer her clients.

Rhina's dream is to have a better quality of life and to keep her children in school so that they will have a career in the future.
local_use: to purchase clothing such as pants, shirts, and blouses.

description:
Manuel is 27 years old.  He lives in Jiquilisco, in Usulután department.  He owns a pharmacy from which he makes profits to cover his household expenses.

Manuel lives with his wife and daughter.  This business used to be run by his grandmother and he recently inherited it so that he could keep it running.

In order to keep his pharmacy running, Manuel is requesting a loan so that he can make some investments in buying medicine for his business.  This will help to strengthen the pharmacy and help him to provide a better service to his customers.

Manuel's goal is to keep the pharmacy running and to keep providing a good service to the customers who he has known for a long time.  By strengthening his inventory of medicines, he is looking to make more profits for his family.
local_use: To buy medicines

description:
Zephanous is a 42-year-old hardworking man with two children who lives in Kasese Uganda. For the past seven years, he has been operating a clothing shop. He started with 400,000 UGX in working capital and now has over 1,500,000 UGX. Zephanous's business hardships are price fluctuations, inflation, and inadequate capital to purchase stock. 

Zephanous is requesting a loan to buy clothes to sell. His personal goal is to educate his children and his business vision is to expand his business into new areas.
local_use: to buy clothes to sell

description: Abduvoris is married and is a loving father of four children. He grows agriculture crops. He mainly grows onion and melons. He has been in this business for more than seven years and continues to have success. Abduvoris wants to get a loan to buy mineral fertilizer and seeds. He wants to expand his business so that he can support his family in good living conditions.
local_use: to buy mineral fertilizer and seeds.

description:
Mrs. Mahamounin is the representative of the Nakimbzanga II group. She is married and the mother of two children, 11 and 5 years of age. Both children are in school. She has two dependents. For the last five years she has been selling soap and  traditional colorful cloth. She stocks up at the Sector 10 market in the city. She sells to both women and men.

She would like to buy 12 sets of simple traditional “pagnes” cloth, five sets of damask-type “bazin” cloth and three boxes of soap.
Mrs. Mahamounin uses her revenues to take care of her family’s needs. Her goal is to open a store for selling traditional cloths at the market of "Pouissière yaar."
local_use: to buy 12 sets of simple traditional “pagnes” cloth, five sets of damask-type “bazin” cloth and three boxes of soap.

description:
Zoraida is 43 years old and lives in the neighbourhood of Sandino, in the capital Managua. She is a single mother of two beautiful children aged 14 and 16. Zoraida has worked as a pharmacist for the past nine years. She began as an assistant pharmacist and now serves as head pharmacist downtown. Her goals are to improve her lifestyle so that her children can have all the necessary comforts. She continues to provide good care to her customers at her workplace and wants to open her own pharmacy. She will use this loan to buy construction materials to improve her home as it is very simple and insecure as well as being very small, so much so that she needs to make improvements and other modifications to her house. She is grateful for Afodenic's loans for the purchase of materials and for providing security, protection and a heritage to her children.

Translated from Spanish by Laure Kwon, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy construction materials to increase the size of her home.

description:
Ana is requesting a new loan, so that she can use it to stock her business by buying new clothing such as blouses, pants, and other articles of clothing as necessary. This is in order to better serve customer demand. This loan will help her to have her business in a better state.

She has had a positive experience with the earlier loan, making a considerable investment in footwear of various styles. To date, her family has supported itself, and the goods in the store are improving, as she is adding other product lines to the business.
local_use: To buy blouses, skirts and pants.

description:
K. Ozodjon is a 43-year-old married man with three children. He is a hard-working man who, while continuing to work another job, started his own business as a source of additional income and savings in case of unemployment. He knew many people who purchased cattle, and this motivated him to start his own business six years ago. Over time, Ozodjon has increased his cattle sales and he is proud to say that the business has been running well. Now Ozodjon needs additional capital to expand his business. Therefore, he is requesting a loan of 5000 Somoni to purchase additional cattle to sell. More specifically, he will reinvest the loan proceeds and grow the business, as he has been doing. Ozodjon and his family thank you very much for the support that you offer them in helping to expand his business and helping them give their children a better quality of life.      


More about Tajikistan and IMON International

Tajikistan is known for its rich history, which includes a key post along the Silk Road and the end of Alexander the Great's rule. It has also produced great thinkers, philosophers, scientists and poets, including Rudaki, Avicenna, Ferdowsi, Omar Khayyam, Jomi, and Rumi. The country is home to communities that still speak the ancient Sogdian language, epic mountain passes, and a civilization that dates back to the 4th millennium BC. local_use: To purchase more cattle

description:
Nelis lives with her husband and 15 year old son.  She and her husband are farmers, raising corn and beans.  Sometimes they hire help to prepare the land.  Their schedule is from 6am to 3pm, or as needed.  

Nelis is requesting a loan to purchase fertilizer and pesticide.  These agricultural products are essential for a successful crop, so the loan will be a great help for them to have the materials they need.  

Her goal is to work to help her son be able to study and get ahead.
local_use: to purchase fertilizers and pesticide.

description:
The member belongs to the “Amauta” communal bank located in Huanchac District, Cusco Province and Department.

She is 65 years old, single and has three children.  She is a former health care worker.  She worked her whole life in the health field but now she is a craftsperson.  She makes costume jewelry: earrings, necklaces and bracelets.  She works with beads, wire, little hooks.  She also makes living room and dining room cushions, all kinds of tablecloths and embroidery.  She is asking for the loan to buy supplies to make the costume jewelry.

She is satisfied and very grateful for the support she’ll get and commits to pay her debts in a timely fashion.
local_use: to buy costume jewelry making supplies.

description:
Mirtha is 25 years old and is separated from her husband.  She was born in the city of Cusco, but she currently lives in the province of Urubamba for work reasons.

Mirtha now works in tourism; she is a hotel receptionist in a hotel in her zone, and she's also been a tour guide for the past year.  Her dream is to continue working hard so that she can open an internet kiosk business very shortly.  She needs a loan to begin buying her computers one by one, at the same time as she studies accounting, which will help her greatly in her business activities.  

Her tenacity and drive led her to start a business buying and selling corn, an activity which she does concurrently with her work at the hotel to pay for her advanced studies and she is trying to start a new relationship, get married, and have her own family.  This is really an example of struggle and perseverance.
local_use: to buy computers.

description: Bahriniso is a divorced mother of two children.  She is an honest and goal-oriented woman.  She supports her children on her own and has a hard time satisfying all of the needs of her children, and always needs support.  She decided to deal with these difficulties by getting involved in buying and selling materials, shoes, food products and agricultural crops.  She travels monthly to other districts to purchase materials and shoes, and travels weekly to buy food products.  Bahriniso wants to obtain a loan in the sum of $2300 for the purchase of materials and school uniforms.  She thanks everyone in advance for the support and mercy.
local_use: to purchase materials and school uniforms

description:
Maria Mercedes is a member of the Immaculada Concepcion Village Bank and lives in the small Peruvian jungle town of Pilcopata. She is 36 years old and lives with her partner and their three children. Two of her children are adolescents, while the youngest is just a year and a half old. Maria Mercedes works on her family farm, where she has been growing yucca and bananas for the past eight or nine years. After harvesting the crops, she sells them at the local market. Though Pilcopata is a very small town and consists of little more than a few blocks of houses and stores along a dirt road, its market is quite new and modern. Pilcopata receives a lot of traffic, since all travelers coming to surrounding towns come into Pilcopata first by bus. 

Maria Mercedes is requesting a loan of 2000 soles. She will use most of the loan money to pay her field hands. She usually employs two to three people during harvest time, and pays each worker 25 soles per day. Part of the money will also go towards her household expenses, and another part will be used to buy wood. She has pledged to repay this loan on time and in full. 

Maria Mercedes has been a member of her village bank ever since it was founded several years ago. Her goal for the future is to open a big store in Cusco and move to the city.
local_use: Pay field hands, buy wood, cover household expenses

description: Lan earns a living by making clothing while her husband Phal teaches in a local university. They have been married since 2001 and have three young children -- two sons and one daughter. They live in a suburb that is located about 25 kilometers outside of Phnom Penh.  Lan has applied for a loan for $800 so that her husband can buy a laptop computer to use when preparing documents and lesson plans.
local_use: to buy a laptop computer for her husband.

description:
The borrower is a member of the communal bank, “CHASKA ÑAHUI”; located in the district of Cusco, in the department of Cusco in the Cusco province.

The borrower is Sr. Percy, 75 years old, who is married with 7 children. He is a doctor, and unemployed surgeon, with a surgery in the center of the city of Cusco where he works afternoons from Monday to Saturday, attending to every patient that comes to see him. He is a very happy person with a strong desire to continue helping people, something which makes him feel happy. He is applying for the loan to equip his surgery. He is very happy about the loan and is committed to fulfilling the repayment schedule.
local_use: The applicant requests a loan to equip his surgery.

description:
Yovanna belongs to the "Tres de Mayo de Poroy" communal bank, located in the Cusco district, which is part of Cusco province and department.  Yovanna is 28, in a  common-law relationship, and has one child.  

She alternates her daily chores with the buying and selling of smaller animals such as guinea pigs, pigs, chickens.  She sells door-to-door, and also carries on her business at different markets. She raises and fattens the animals and then sells them. By means of this business, she is helping her family get ahead in life. She wants to expand and improve her business of selling smaller animals.

She is applying for the loan in order to buy guinea pigs, pigs and chickens and also to buy feed for the animals. She is happy to receive the loan, and is committed to making her instalment payments.
local_use: To buy guinea pigs, pigs, chickens, and animal feed.

description:
Our member is Cecilio. He belongs to the communal bank "Tercer Milenio" in the province of Urubamba in Cusco, Peru. Our member, along with his brother, took a chance on the construction business some time ago. Together they started a business of manufacturing cement blocks or concrete bricks for the construction and building of buildings. Cecilio, thanks to the growth of this business, has been able to increase his economic profits and in this way, improved his family's whole quality of life, giving a better education to his children so that they will have a better future. Cecilio will invest his loan to buy the raw material that will allow him to produce his bricks. In this case, he will buy cement and crushed stone. 
Cecilio's big dream is to grow his business and develop it as a construction consulting firm at a regional level. 
Cecilio thanks KIVA for allowing him to develop his work and to continue growing more each time.
local_use: to buy cement and crushed stone

description:
Niceforo was born in Muñoa in the department of Puno (Peru). He is 56 years old. He is in a common law marriage from which he has 6 children. Currently, he lives and works in the town of Urubamba. He has been a farmer and bricklayer for many years. Niceforo needs the loan to buy more seeds and fertilizer.

The communal bank “Señor de los Milagros de Urubamba” meets every 30 days in the town of Urubamba (Cusco, Peru). Cusco is known as a popular tourist area and commercial centre. It is also known for its traditional festival of Inti Raymi and for being located near one of the seven wonders of the world "Machupicchu".
local_use: to buy seeds and fertilizer.

description:
Susana Jiménez has a small beauty salon. She has been managing it for 18 years. When she was young she studied the program, and it has been her source of income. She has eight grown children, and she is 63. It has been a joy to be able to support her children. Because she is a widow, it was hard to get ahead. She started with her own money, and she sold cosmetics traveling in the market. Due to the crisis in country, unemployment, and low earnings she has not had the usual amount of customers. This worries her because she has to pay her water, light, telephone, and loan monthly. Her hope is that in this month of December when the young people always change their look she will be able to get more customers. She hopes to be able to do a lot of straightening, tints, curling, and other things. That is why she will buy tints, creams, nail polish, and materials to work on the feet and hands. She will do this to increase service and sales. Her plan is to be able to put the business in her house. She would take care of it herself. She is happy because she has maintained her business, and she has not taken money out of the business for the loans. She can buy all of the necessary products for her work.

Translated from Spanish by Ginny Kalish, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Buy products for her beauty salon

description: David wants a loan to buy tires for his vehicle .He is 40 years old and lives in Masindi, Uganda. He started as a farmer, saved money and bought a vehicle, which he uses for a transport business. His family dream is to educate his children and buy another car. The responsibility of taking care of three children and wife solely rests on him, since he is the only income earner.
local_use: buy tires for his vehicle

description:
José lives with his grandparents, his wife and two children.  He is a farmer and construction worker; normally he works growing corn, and when needed, he take on construction work.  His family depends on him, and so every day he strives to give them the best.  

He currently needs to buy manure and pay for workes, by means of a loan.  This will be a great help to José, as he hopes that his corn production will be abundant and he can guarantee food for his family.

His dream he would like to accomplish is to finish building his home.
local_use: to buy manure and pay for workers.

description: Mario is a gentleman who has been selling chemical products for about nine years; this is his main activity.  However, because this work does not generate much income he also buys and sells recyclables aiming at improving his income.  He assures us that gradually and thanks to Afodenic loans he’s been making improvements to his home for him and his wife; this has been one of the great dreams of his life.  With this new loan, he will invest in installing a bathroom at home attaining with this infrastructure one of his most wished-for goals as well as enjoying better living conditions.
local_use: to install a bathroom in his home.

description: Pamela continues in the communal bank “Anna Jarvis III” with the sale of ceviche (marinated seafood cocktail). She is a responsible and friendly person that gets ahead, since she’s already achieved her dream of opening a restaurant where she sells her dishes. It's going very well. For this opportunity, she needs a loan to buy a freezer, which she wishes to use more in her restaurant. Pamela is happy about the loan, and she promises to make the payments of her share.
local_use: buy a freezer.

description:
Here is a member who belongs to the community bank named "San Valentin". The bank is located in the district, province and region of Cusco. 

The member's name is Veruska. She is 33 years old and she is single. Her business is to buy and sell clothing for kids, ladies, gentlmen, and infants. She works together with her mother in the same business. She also works in the hospital where she provides information to insured individuals about their appointments. She is a very optimistic person and this is how she is able to get ahead.

She requests a loan to purchase items of clothing for her business.

She is happy to receive this loan and she is committed to the payment terms.
local_use: To purchase clothing for resale.

description:
Mr. Phirum C., 38, and his wife, Mrs. Sokha Kong, 44, who live in a village about 20 kilometers from Phnom Penh, married in 1994 and have four children: three sons and one daughter. One of their children is married and lives outside the family home.

Phirum and his wife have been farming for eighteen years. They grow many types of vegetables in their farmland in the village. They sometimes sell their products in the village and sometimes sell at Chbar Ampov market, located in Phnom Penh, the capital city of Cambodia. Phirum is requesting a loan of US$ 700 to use for growing vegetables.
local_use: To use for growing vegetables

description:
This member belongs to the communal bank “KAROLL WOKTILA”. THis bank is located in the Huanchac district, which belongs to the province and department of Cuzco. The member, Neyer, is 37 years old. He is married and has been working for 8 years as a manager in the terminal of a transportation business called Civa. He has 3 children and is asking for the loan for his youngest childrens' education as well as for some other household expenses. He is asking for the loan to invest in his youngest children's education. This member is grateful for the loan and is committed to making his payments according to the agreed schedule. .

Translated from Spanish by Ellen Donohue, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To invest in his children's education

description: Anthony is a fifty-five-year-old married man with eight children living in Kamwenge, Uganda. His personal goal is to educate his children. He has been running a cattle trading business for the last ten years after starting with capital of three hundred thousand UGX and it has grown to two million eight hundred thousand. His major hardship is high fuel and transportation costs; however, he has a vision of buying land to grow crops. Anthony needs a loan to buy cattle for resale.
local_use: to buy cattle for resale.

description:
These members belong to the Qorilazo communal bank. This bank is located in the district of Cusco, which is part of the province and department of Cusco.

One of the members is Señora Yeni. She is 27 years old, is in a common-law marriage, and has two children. Her business is a grocery store. She sells rice, sugar, milk, oil and candies. She works from 6:00 am to 10:00 pm. She also sells corn cooked with cheese, which she sells as a street vendor. Through these little businesses she is raising her children. Her dream is to have a shop where she can sell corn with cheese and also to expand her grocery store. She is applying for the loan to buy products such as rice, sugar, milk, and oil wholesale, and also to buy corn and cheese wholesale.

The other members' businesses include selling chicha (a traditional Andean corn-based alcoholic drink), a chicken business, a grocery store, selling food, and selling guinea pigs.

Sra. Yeni is thankful to those who form part of her dream through the loans and she promises to make her payments according to the established schedule.
local_use: to buy products such as rice, sugar, milk, oil, corn, and cheese wholesale.

description:
Susy is a new individual loan client. She sells prepared meals (lunches and breakfasts) near her home. She lives in her parents’ house with her three school aged children. Because of work requirements, her husband is abroad but always sends her money for family expenses. She tends to her business alone although her mother, Eugenia, sometimes helps her. She is asking for funds for groceries, potatoes, cooking oil to make her delicious dishes; this is why she’s asking for this Kiva loan.

Translated from Spanish by Michael Bujazan, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy groceries and cooking oil at wholesale.

description:
Celestina is mother to two children for whom she has worked very hard as a caretaker in order to support them and cover their needs.  Her husband works as a messenger and together they have been saving up to build their own home.

Everything costs a lot right now and it has been difficult buying all the material.  For this reason, Celestina came to Afodenic to take out a loan in order to finish the work.  She will use this loan to build a small perimeter wall which will provide her property and her young children with more security.
local_use: to buy building supplies to build a wall in order to improve the security of her home

description:
Mrs. Herminia del Carmen is 41 years and married. She lives in the Laureles Norte neighborhood of Managua. Her husband is a taxi driver, and they have three children, two of whom are independent and one of whom is still studying. She has been running her own small grocery store for the past six years. Her goals for the future of her family are to improve her home and to continue to support her daughter in her studies. She will use this loan to buy basic grains, canned goods and dairy products so that she will have a wide variety of products to offer her clients. With this investment, she hopes to expand her business and earn more in profits. She thanks Afodenic for giving her the opportunity to take out loans on accessible terms in order to expand her business, which have been very beneficial for her.

Translated from Spanish by Cynthia McMurry, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Buy basic grains, canned goods and dairy products

description:
Zumradkhon is married and a loving mother of two children. Her husband works in Russia. She sells fabric and women’s clothing at the market. Zumradkhon started her business by helping her mother and now has her own outlet and stable customers. Over the past five years of running her own business, she has gained a lot of experience. Zumradkhon would like a loan of 7000 Somoni to purchase new fabric and clothing, which will help her expand her business.

description:
Mauro operates an auto paint and body repair business.  He lives with his wife and their three children, one of whom helps him with the business.  He's operated the shop for 5 years.  He started as an employee of another repair business before opening his own shop two years ago.  He then hired an employee to help him.
Mauro is applying for a loan to buy mastic, paint, tools and other supplies for the business.  The loan will allow him to save money when he buys the supplies he needs because he will get a discount for paying cash.  
Mauro's goal is to draw more customers and grow his business.  The extra income will allow him to better support his family.
local_use: to buy supplies for his paint and body repair business.

description: Gairat is married and is a responsible father of three children.  He earns little money from his craftsmanship work.  His children are growing up, and he needs to place them into good kindergartens and schools.  This is why he started to grow wheat five years ago.  This business brings him a good income, and he wants to expand this business. Gairat plans to make a good profit and wants to hold a hatnatuy (circumcision) ceremony for his son.  Gairat wants to obtain this loan to expand his business and buy wheat seeds for sowing.
local_use: to expand his business and buy wheat seeds for sowing

description: David is in the carpentry and wood carving business.  He is 36 years old and his wife María is 23 years old.  His wife helps him with his carpentry work when he is overloaded with jobs.  They have a little 5 year-old girl.  David sometimes performs wood carving work on furniture from well-known companies in the city.  He begins his work very early in the morning.  He is someone who wants to expand and grow in his business, improving his workshop so that he has people depending on him and also giving opportunities to others.  He hopes thereby to provide for the future well-being of his daughter and his family.  He lives in San Agustín neighborhood of Plan 3000 district.
local_use: To buy raw material (wood) and to expand his workshop roof

description: Orzu is married and is a loving mother of two children. She is 51 years old. Her husband is a driver. Orzu has been breeding and selling cattle for more than six years. At this time she has two heads of cattle. This business brings her good income and she used the received profits to make major remodeling to her house and held a circumcision ceremony (hatnatuyi) for her grandson. She has a plot of land near her house where she grows fodder for the cattle and cultivates plants. Orzu is asking for a loan to buy cattle and seeds for the sowing of fodder.
local_use: to buy cattle and seeds.

description: Sr. Uriel is 33 years old, married, and has a son. As well as his regular daily activities, he runs a business selling televisions, computers, and cell phones, some of which are secondhand. His small store is located in his house. Uriel wishes to expand and improve his business so he is seeking a loan to buy more merchandise.
local_use: to purchase electronics like televisions, computers, and cell phones

description:
Mrs. Foudailatou is the representative of the Z. Group. She is married and the mother of four children ranging from 19 years to 17 months of age. Three of her children  are in school, and she has five dependents. 

She has been selling clothing (traditional color “pagnes” fabric) for the last three years. She stocks up at the Sector 10 market. Her clients are both men and women. She would like to increase her working capital to buy a bale of “pagnes” fabric. She would like to use her savings to help pay for her children’s education and to put money away. Her goal is to open a big store selling “pagnes” and help with the construction of the family home.
local_use: to buy a bale of "pagnes" fabric

description: Abdulhoshim is married and is raising three minor children. His wife is a homemaker.  For over two years he has been growing farm produce. He began his business by growing onions. Abdulhoshim would like to receive a loan to buy mineral fertilizers and cover the cost of manual labor. He hopes for your help and compassion.
local_use: To buy mineral fertilizers

description:
Shalom is a hardworking and enterprising person who gets her family ahead. She owns a small business that consists of selling beauty products such as lotions, perfume, cologne, etc. to relatives and friends who request them. She also distributes goods such as cereals. She works with her husband in distributing the goods to grocery stores and eateries that request them. This is the way she gets her family ahead.
The member requests the loan in order to purchase beauty products such as lotions and cologne for her business.
She's thankful for the opportunity she's being given with the loan. She also pledges to make her repayments according to the schedule.
local_use: to purchase beauty products such as lotions and cologne for her business.

description:
Irene Irma is a member of the community bank Santa Rosita de Ayllupampa, located in the Urubamba district in the Urubamba province and department of Cusco.

Irene Irma is 30 years old, married, and has two children. She balances her daily activities with her business, a grocery store.  She works from 7:00am until 2:00pm.  She sells necessities like rice, sugar, milk, and pasta.  She would like to expand her grocery store. 

She is asking for this loan to purchase products for her grocery store.

She is happy with the loan provided and promises to make her payments on time.
local_use: to purchase products for her grocery store.

description:
Shuhrat A., 32 years old and living with his wife and four children, has dedicated himself to farming barley, wheat, corn, tomato and watermelon for more than 13 years. Shuhrat enjoys being a farmer and finds harvesting his crops especially gratifying. On the other hand, the most tedious part of farming is the preparation of land for planting and protecting crops from insects that could spoil his harvest. This is his first loan request from IMON International, and he will use the money to buy seeds and fertilizer for his plots. Shuhrat thanks all who are supporting him.

description:
Sandra is a Dressmaker; she makes women’s clothing.  She isn’t married but has a spouse and a child and she shares with the institution the satisfaction she’ll feel now that she will be able to work with more work tools to fight for her son’s life and value growth thanks to financing from Emprender and Kiva while at the same time improving her way of life with support from her spouse and being able to overcome whatever obstacle life throws at her.

Sandra’s activity consists in sewing women’s clothes (fabric trousers).  She’s been doing this for several years.  Because of this she felt encouraged to seek a loan to buy machinery that will be an enterprise for this woman’s future.  The effort she puts into it every day of the week is valued so that she, herself, can have economic development as well as a better quality of life for her family.
local_use: to buy sewing machines.

description: Ehsonjon is a hardworking, responsible man who lives with his wife and two children. In order to provide for his children's needs while caring for them, he decided to start his own business processing and selling dried apricots. His wife helped him by sharing her best recipes and processing secrets. Fortunately, his work has paid off, and his business has grown with more orders and new clients coming in every day. Ehsonjon is asking for a loan of US$1,500, which he will use to purchase needed supplies and to remodel his location. He hopes that by doing this he will increase his sales and income. You can be a part of this growth. Ehsonjon and his parents thank you for your generosity and kindness. description:
Jacqueline is an inhabitant of the municipality of Ninidiri with her husband and children.  Her husband works in a private company.  To support him with the household expenses, for several years Jacqueline has worked in business (grocery store).   

With much effort and commitment, her small business is growing thanks to funding obtained from Afodenic through Kiva.  This funding allows Jacqueline to increase her inventory while improving their quality of life.
local_use: to buy groceries.

description:
Gricelda is a mother and a hard-working woman.  Before she was in the situation of not having work but she started a small soft drink business.  With the previous loan she built one of the walls in her house.  Then she left the business to work in a small company as a janitor.  It was a big change that has benefited her family since she has a regular salary.  Her principal plan is to complete building her house in concrete so that she can have all the necessary comforts.  She will use the loan to buy construction materials such as: cement, sand, cement blocks, gravel, stone, nails, brackets, boards,etc to build another outside wall of her house.

She appreciates the financing and constant support in building her house with the idea of a better future for her family with great comfort and security.
local_use: to buy construction materials

description:
Aline M. is a woman merchant, aged 32, who lives in the Musaga districts of Bujumbura, the capital of Burundi.  There in Musaga, she runs a grocery store.  This is a trade that she has been working at for eighteen months.  She has attended the 9th grade.  Her husband has attended the 10th grade.  He is a chauffeur.  

Aline is the mother of three children who are in primary school. DUO LA MONTAÑITA

description:
Problems and money shortages have never defeated Malikakhon, who has always looked for a way to get past obstacles and continue to improve her situation. Malikakhon is an extremely hard-working and energetic woman. She is divorced and the mother of three children. For more than 16 years, she has operated a store where she sells children's and women’s clothing. Her store is well-known, and people love to visit because it's clean, tidy, and run by someone who is very kind and thoughtful. 

Malikakhon hopes that her store will keep growing so that she can maintain a comfortable life for her family. To make that possible, she has applied for a new loan that she will use to buy more clothing to sell. With this purpose, Malikakhon requests $1200 USD. She promises to repay the loan on time and thanks everyone supporting her.     
 

More about Tajikistan and IMON International

Tajikistan is known for its rich history, which includes a key post along the Silk Road and the end of Alexander the Great's rule. It has also produced great thinkers, philosophers, scientists and poets, including Rudaki, Avicenna, Ferdowsi, Omar Khayyam, Jomi, and Rumi. The country is home to communities that still speak the ancient Sogdian language, epic mountain passes, and a civilization that dates back to the 4th millennium BC. And, even today, it is a complex mixture of the Islamic faith, Soviet culture, New West culture and Central Asian traditions.

But Tajikistan is also the poorest of the former Soviet republics. The civil war, which ignited soon after its independence from the U.S.S.R., further damaged the already weak economy. In addition, 93% of the country is mountainous and only 7% of the land is arable. These conditions have resulted in high levels of unemployment and have forced hundreds of thousands to seek work in other countries, mainly Russia. While the people of Tajikistan are working to improve its agricultural production and manufacturing sector, nearly two-thirds of the population still live in abject poverty.

IMON's History

Since December 2007, IMON International has worked closely with Kiva and Kiva lenders to ensure that poor and low income clients represent a viable business proposition. Funds raised through Kiva have already been distributed to thousands of IMON International's clients and will continue to provide thousands more with permanent access to the varied financial services they need. To learn more about IMON International's work, please visit: www.imon.tj

She awaits your generosity.

She has a daughter called Maedy who is studying economics at university. As well as looking after the home, Edith sells clothing. She travels to the border between Peru and Bolivia where she buys clothing such as pants, jackets, blouses, and many other things. She’s been doing this for several years, and the business has done well thanks to all her hard work. Edith is hardworking, enterprising, and is raising her family well. She needs a loan to buy more merchandise such as jackets and pants for the upcoming Christmas season. She is grateful for the opportunity to obtain a loan and promises to make repayments according to the schedule.

She alternates her daily activities with her work as a street vendor selling vegetables such as pumpkin, carrots, tomatoes, herbs and corn in different fairs across a range of districts including Calca, Anta and Chinchero. Through this work Avelina is able to bring up her children. She would like to expand her business, so she is applying for a loan to purchase vegetables such as pumpkin, carrots, tomatoes and herbs in bulk. 

Avelina is happy to be receiving this loan and promises to make all her repayments on time.
local_use: to purchase vegetables such as pumpkin, carrots, tomatoes and herbs in bulk.

description:
The “3 de mayo” Village Bank is made up of 17 members who live in Poroy, a small town on the outskirts of Cusco, Peru, located at 3,670 meters above sea level. The area is often quite chilly, but the surrounding countryside is very beautiful, with rolling green hills as far as the eye can see. 

The group meets once a month in a small adobe house belonging to one of its members, where guinea pigs, chickens, a kitten and two puppies often run underfoot. The group members are involved in a variety of businesses and will use their loans for different purposes. Several women raise small animals (like chickens, guinea pigs or sheep) and will use the money to buy more animals or fatten up animals they already have; two women have market stands, where they sell different varieties of potatoes, corn and beans, and will buy sacks of potatoes to sell; one man is a taxi driver and will use his loan for car repair; another is an electrician and will use his loan to buy more tools and materials; one woman makes prepared meals, which she sells in a local market, and will buy vegetables and a sack of rice; another woman knits sweaters and tablecloths and will use the loan money to buy thread and yarn; and another woman makes dental prosthetics, and will use the money to buy more materials for her work. 

This is the group’s second loan cycle with Asociacion Arariwa. All of the group members are bound by a mutual guarantee, and have pledged to repay this loan in full and on time.
