Celia lives in the city of Huancarani in the province of Huancarani, where she does all types of activities. She works in PRONEI (Programa Nacional de Educación Inicial) as an assistant. She also grows, harvests and sells grains, for example wheat, barley, dried moraya, corn and others. She has had this business for several years and it is going very well for her thanks to the hard work she puts into her work.   

At this time, Celia requires the loan to buy grain seeds. Celia belongs to the “Mamacha Rosario” communal bank of the Asociación Arariwa and she is grateful for the opportunity offered in this way and is committed to making her payments according to schedule. 

The members of the communal bank meet every month in the  Banco district of Huancarani of the province of Paucartambo in the department of Cuzco, Peru. Cuzco is known for being popular with tourists and for having a lot of commerce. It is also known for its traditional festival called Inti Raymi, and because in it is one of the seven wonders of the world  “Machupicchu”.
local_use: to buy grain seeds.

description:
S. Tukhtasun is 59 years old. He is married and the father of 5 children. Tukhtasun is a hard-working man who has fought to provide for his family and educate his children, who today are working adults, thanks to his example. Tukhtasun is an enterprising man who constantly tries to do things better and to improve day after day. He works hard in his fields where he spends as much time as possible providing the necessary care, fertilizing his land, and spraying to prevent diseases that might affect his yields.

Tukhtasun needs seeds and fertilizers to continue his difficult work, tending his crops so that they can be taken to the capital for sale. That's why he's applying for a loan of 2000 Somoni. Let's be the ones who reach out our hands to help Tukhtasun.

More about Tajikistan and IMON International

Tajikistan is perhaps best known for its rich history, which includes a key post along the Silk Road; the end of Alexander the Great's rule; and with its famous great thinkers, philosophers, scientists and poets as: Rudaki, Ibn Sina (Avicenna), Firdousi, Omar Haiyam, Jomi, Mavlavi Rumi and many others. The country is home to communities that still speak the ancient Sogdian language, epic mountain passes, and a civilization that dates back to the 4th millennium BC. And, even today, it is a complex mixture of the Islamic faith, Soviet culture, New West culture and Central Asian traditions.

But, Tajikistan is also the poorest of the former Soviet republics. The civil war, which ignited soon after its independence from the U.S.S.R., further damaged the already weak economy. In addition, 93% of the country is mountainous and only 7% of the land is arable. These conditions have resulted in high levels of unemployment and have forced hundreds of thousands to seek work in other countries, mainly Russia. While the people of Tajikistan are working to improve its agricultural production and manufacturing sector, nearly two-thirds of the population still live in abject poverty.

IMON's History

Since December 2007, IMON International has worked closely with Kiva and Kiva lenders to ensure that poor and low income clients represent a viable business proposition. Funds raised through Kiva have already been distributed to thousands of IMON International's clients and will continue to provide thousands more with permanent access to the varied financial services they need. To learn more about IMON International's work, please visit: www.imon.tj
local_use: Purchasing of mineral fertilizer and fuel and lubricants

description:
This is 43 year-old Ibrahim.  He is married to a trader, and has 3 children aged 16, 13 and 11 years.  He has 1 additional dependent, who lives with him.

In 2001, Ibrahim established his tailoring items business - selling materials, thread, needles, designing threads.   He began his business after he completed his high school.   Unfortunately, his father, who was taking care of his schooling, died and his mother, who was sick died too, so there was nobody to take responsibility for him.   He decided to assist other people in their business until he raised enough capital to start his own business.  

Working 7 days a week and 10 hours a day, he earns about Le 2,900,000 every month from this business.  He is assisted by his wife and treats his customers fairly.  His customers are people around the city center and tailoring shops.   Mr. Ibrahim offers quality goods to satisfy their needs.   He uses public transport to buy  goods in Conakry and Freetown twice a month.  He would like a loan for Le 5,000,000.  Ibrahim has already received and successfully repaid 3 loans, and now requires a new loan in order to purchase popline 1 bale @ Le2,500,000, lace cord 300 pieces @ Le6,000 and stickers 10 rolls @ Le70,000.  He hopes that this loan will enable him to increase his monthly profits by approximately Le 885,000.

He uses his profit to invest in his business as he wants his children to have a very good education.   Instability of foreign exchange rate is his major challenge.   He anticipates using his profit to buy more goods and is planning to open another shop.  He knows he will be able to accomplish this goal.   He thanks you for your support.
local_use: to purchase tailoring supplies.

description:
Sra. Beatriz lives on the Achumani plateau with her two children who are already professionals. One of them travels constantly.

Beatriz spends her time baking. She has been making cookies, donuts, and cakes for more than 20 years. Beatriz distributes cupcakes, cakes, and corn cakes within the central and southern districts. She has been a client of Emprender since 2002 and has demonstrated that she is very responsible and hardworking. In addition to this business, she also sells soft drinks and groceries.

The money she requested will be used to buy flour, yeast, and other ingredients for making cookies. She is grateful to Emprender for the support it has provided.
local_use: to buy flour, yeast, and other ingredients.

description:
Mercedes is a member of the “KANTU DE SAN JERONIMO” community bank which is located in Huanchac district, in Cusco province and department.

Mercedes is 38 years old, married, and has 4 children aged 22, 19, 15 and 4.  Her business is selling breakfasts and lunches.  She has a small family guesthouse in her own home.  Mercedes prepares her breakfasts and lunches and takes them to the building sites where she has her contracts.  Her customers are the workmen.  She leaves her menus on the different building sites where she has her contracts and her customers pay her every fortnight.  She is requesting this loan to invest in buying supplies.

Mercedes is happy to be receiving this loan and she pledges to make her repayments on time.
local_use: To invest in buying supplies

description:
Janeth, 29, is a member of the “Amanecer Anteña” communal bank located in Anta District which belongs to Anta Province, Cusco Department.

She has a spouse and two children.  She alternates her daily chores with livestock sales and also sells dry goods like barley, potatoes, wheat and corn.  She sells in the Anta market and the livestock is sold at various markets in Anta district.  Her husband works in transportation providing urban transport in Huarocondo District.  She supports her children through these businesses.

She wants to enlarge the livestock sales business and the dry goods sales business.  She is asking for a loan to buy animal feed and to buy dry goods at wholesale.  She is happy with the loan and commits to repay.
local_use: to buy cattle feed and to buy dry goods at wholesale.

description:
Olga is an entrepreunerial women requesting her first loan to purchase raw material. She is dedicated to creating nurse uniforms and also school uniforms. She wants and dreams of seeing her children become professionals and having a pretty two story house. It is for this that she has purchased another sewing machine to help her produce more and have greater earnings in her business, the loan is needed to buy raw materials because she works based on orders. In her business she always has the support of her husband and children and it makes them happy because she has done well because she has enough orders and her clients know the quality of her work that she does. With the help of God everything will go well and she will realize her dreams.

Translated from Spanish by Helen Smith, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Purchase fabric and a sewing machine

description:
Maria is still selling cosmetics, as this is how she supports her family. Her two children continue studying for a better future. 

The Avon products that she sells have given her good results and her sales have grown and she is selling a wider variety. She has increased the number of clients that she serves, successfully maintaining her sales. 

This new loan is to buy more cosmetic supplies including body lotions, perfume, cosmetic cases, lipsticks, creams, shampoos, and hair oil, as well as buying underwear for women and men. 

Maria wants to continue achieving high sales. Her goal is to have a better roof, and to continue building the concrete walls that she needs.
local_use: to buy clothes and cosmetics for her business

description:
Victoria sells cosmetics.  She also works as a teacher to cover her household expenses.  She has always been an active woman.

Victoria continues to work as a teacher and, in her spare time, she sells cosmetics from catalogs.  She provides 60% of her merchandise on credit.  She started out with few products but she improved her business with loans from Afodenic.  She started to buy a wider variety of cosmetics and attracted customers.  This helped improve her profits.  These loans have been of great financial benefit to her family.  Victoria will use this new loan (her eleventh) to buy ordered merchandise and additional merchandise such as: hair dyes, women's and men's clothes, underwear and a lot of Avon cosmetics.
local_use: To buy a large variety of cosmetics as well as women's clothes and underwear

description:
Mr. My T. and his wife, Mrs. Eun Y, live on an island in the Mekong River about fifteen kilometers from Phnom Penh. They have three children, one son and two daughters. Two children are married and live outside the family home and the third has full-time employment.  

My and his wife used to be weavers. However, they stopped their weaving business. My now sells finished silk and cotton fabrics. He buys them from his fellow villagers for resale in other provinces that are far from his house. His wife sells Khmer noodle and Num Banh Chok in her village. Khmer noodles are considered the national dish of Cambodia, served with a green curry soup and banana flowers, bean sprouts, water lily stalks and cucumber. 

My is requesting a loan of $500 to supplement his funds to purchase a motorcycle for his daughter to get to work.
local_use: To supplement his funds to purchase a motorcycle for his daughter to get to work.

description: Francis is a 26-year-old hardworking man living in a family house in Fort Portal, Uganda. His dream is to build rental houses since they are on high demand. He sells used shoes that he takes to all surrounding markets, and has been in this business for six years. He has challenges of high transportation costs, and he desires to buy his own transportation means. Francis needs this loan facility to buy used shoes for resale.
local_use: To buy used shoes for resale.

description:
The borrower belongs to the "Tres Barrios de Qoricancha" communal bank. She is 74 years old and lives with her partner. She alternates her daily activities, engaging in farming and livestock-raising. The borrower grows potatoes and corn, to later sell them to her customers who most request them. 

In the same way, she raises her cows to sell them to those that ask to buy them. She works every day from approximately 7:00am to 4:00pm. She takes her cows out to pasture and to see to her crops. She is a responsible and determined person and this the way she is moving forward in life. 

The borrower is requesting the loan to buy seeds and fertilizers for her small farm. 

The other members also work in farming, as well as in livestock-raising, raising small animals and selling food. 

The member shown in the attached photo is one who asked permission to arrive late to the meeting, and the person shown with their face covered does not belong to the communal bank. 

The borrower feels grateful for the loan granted, and promised to make her instalment payments on time.
local_use: To buy seeds and fertilizers for her small farm.

description:
María raises chicks.  She lives with her sons and daughters.  She started her business two months ago.  She raises chickens to be butchered.  She works with her children feeding and caring for the chicks.

She’s asking for a loan to buy more chicks as well as feed for them.  This will help her increase the size of her farm and have more growth opportunities increasing the number of chickens available for butchering and for sale to customers.  The risk she faces is that they may become ill and die if medicine isn’t administered correctly.  Her dream is to become a strong production farm in the area and to expand the chicken sales in the marked and to increase her clientele.
local_use: to buy more chicks and feed for them.

description:
Eduardo, 27, is single and lives in the family home, located at 21 de Septiembre Boulevard, Radial Zone, with his mother and sister. Eduardo trained to be a physical trainer but has worked as an electrical mechanic for the last 7 years, a skill he learned from his father. He has many customers now. Eduardo was granted a loan to pay off his vehicle. He is very grateful and surprised by the speed with which the loan to pay off his vehicle was granted. He is a responsible, hard working person. One of his wishes is to have a well-equipped machine shop with lots of customers.

Translated from Spanish by Michael Bujazan, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To pay off his vehicle.

description: Justus is a thirty-eight-year-old married man with five children living in Fort Portal, Uganda. He takes care of the family with the help of his wife who is also a businesswoman. Their dream is to educate their children up to university, since they did not get the chance to go to school. He has been operating a retail shop for eight years and this has facilitated him in educating his children and building a semi-permanent house, although he still has the challenges of limited finances, making it difficult to meet the demands of his customers. His dream is to become a wholesaler. Justus needs the loan to buy soap and millet flour to sell.
local_use: to buy soap and millet flour to sell.

description: The "Virgen del Carmen" community bank is located in the district of Wanchaq, province and department of Cusco, Peru. One of the members is Maritza, who is a 33-year-old married mother of three. She makes a living selling juices and breakfasts. She has been with the business only a short time, but it is going well thanks to the hard work she puts into it every day. At the same time, she works as a security guard at one of the city markets in Cusco, the same place where she sells her breakfasts. Maritza is a responsible and hardworking person who wants to make headway for her family. She is requesting the loan to purchase ingredients, such as sugar, milk and fruit, for her business. The other members make a living as a teacher, a public worker and selling food, plastics, clothing and CDs. The two people added to the photo are members who requested permission to arrive late to the meeting because of their work. The members thank those who helped them through this medium and promise to make their payments in the established period.
local_use: to purchase ingredients like sugar, milk and fruit.

description:
Mr. Noun P., 40 and his wife, Mrs. Thorn Hean, 47, have been married since 1983 and have 4 daughters. Three of them work in a garment factory and one stays at home. They live along the Tonle Basac River, a tributary of the nearby Mekong, about fifteen kilometers from Phnom Penn City.  
 
Noun has been a construction worker for about 8 years. He works in his village and nearby villages. His wife stays at home and does housework. He is asking for a loan of $1,000 to repair the house where he lives.
local_use: To repair his house.

description:
Sofia Yrene is 41 years old and has an 11-year-old daughter. Her primary job is working as a kindergarten teacher, a position she has held for 13 years. Sofia Yrene has used previous loans to pay for her higher education, and she would like another loan in order to complete her master's degree in education. She has just half a year left to obtain her degree. Sofia’s dream is to have her own house and to secure a better job.

Sofia Yrene is receiving an individual loan as a member of the village bank "Comuzone I" in Cusco, which is located in the Andean mountains at 3,400 meters above sea level. The bank is in its 17th cycle with Asociación Arariwa.
local_use: to pay the tuition for her master's degree in education

description:
Gener is a 37-year-old father of two who lives in Los Chiles, located in the northern region of Costa Rica. Gener lives with his wife and two children.
Like many member of the Los Chiles community, Gener is a farmer. He dedicates his time to the planting and harvest of various subsistence and revenue-generating crops including chili peppers among others. Gener is always busy. When he isn´t tending to the needs of his own land, he hires himself out to other farmers in the region, as a paid laborer. This work helps to complement the money earned from the sale of his own produce. 
This loan will be used to finance the production of Habanero chili peppers.  Specifically, Gener will use this money to purchase seeds, fertilizer, tools, pesticides, and other materials/ingredients necessary to the production of chili peppers. All labor and transportation will be carried out by Gener and his family. 

Gener dedicates six hours per day to his work as a hired hand. During this time, his wife carries out domestic tasks and farm work. In the afternoons, Gener joins his wife to work their own plot of land. Gener´s goal is to maintain stability in his family, achieve higher production rates, improve his economic situation and offer a better standard of living to his family.

A major difficulty and limitation for Gener has been his lack of working capital. He hopes to use this loan effectively to improve life on the farm for everyone. 

Piper and Capiscum Processors Compañía Agrícola Industrial, or, PROPICA is an international buyer and seller of chili pepper and ground pepper products. In cooperation with Fundación Mujer, PROPICA has guaranteed to purchase the agricultural products (the peppers) that are to be produced with the help of this loan. PROPICA acts as a guaranteed client for small agricultural producers in the area of Los Chiles, thus ensuring that their products will reach market. 

The collaboration of Fundación Mujer and PROPICA represents a unique opportunity to Gener, his family and community. By offering a source of start-up capital, and a guaranteed client to purchase what is produced, this is a chance to improve family and community standards of living. Above all, Gener wants to take advantage of the current opportunity that has been presented, he wants to profit from this collaboration and see improvements in his neighborhood.
local_use: To purchase seeds, fertilizer and ingredients for the production of chili peppers.

description:
Orsmak is 22 years old, and her husband, Sothea, is 27 years old. They live in a village approximately twenty kilometers from Phnom Penh City.  They have been married since 2007 and have one young daughter. 

Orsmak and her husband sell rice and soft drinks from their home. They also grow rice during the rice farming season. 

Orsmak is applying for a loan in the amount of $500 to buy seed, fertilizer, and pesticide for her rice farming business.

In the photo, Orsmak and her husband and young daughter are at home.
local_use: to buy seed, fertilizer, and pesticide to maintain her rice farm.

description:
A 48-year-old widow, Mrs. Samnang T. has four daughters, two married, one a silk weaver, and the fourth a student. The family lives on an island of the Mekong River about 15 kilometers from Phnom Penh.

Samnang has been a silk weaver since 1984, a skill she learned from her neighbor. She sells her finished products to the middleman in the village, who then resells them in Phnom Penh. Samnang is now requesting a loan for $500 to purchase more silk material for weaving.
local_use: To purchase silk material for weaving.

description:
Sonia belongs to the “Tesoritos del Manu” communal bank and the bank’s meetings are every thirty days in the city of Salvación in Manu Province, Madre de Dios Department.

Sonia is 34 years old and in a common law relationship; she has four children.  She was born in the city of Salvación and that’s where she carries out her commercial activities.  Her main activity is foodstuffs sales in a home-based grocery store.  She’s been in this business for several years now and does very well thanks to the effort she puts into her work.

On this occasion Sonia needs the loan to buy stock merchandise like rice, sugar, noodles and other things.  Sonia is grateful for and values the loan and commits to make her monthly payments.
local_use: to buy  more stock items for her store.

description:
The member belongs to the communal bank “Tinka.” The bank is located in the district of Cusco, belonging to the province of Cusco, and the department of Cusco.

The member is 62 years old, has a common-in-law wife and 2 children. 

The member divides his daily activities with his roasting business. He tends the business from 8:00AM until 6:00PM. He also works in the administrative area of a university. Through his business and his work the member is able to support his children. 

His dream is to expand the roasting business and to improve each moment in his work. 

The member is asking for a loan to buy supplies to cook such as chickens and potatoes for roasting.

The member is happy for the loan and he promises to make his payments according to the schedule.
local_use: to buy supplies to cook such as chickens and potatoes for roasting

description:
Elsi Varinia is a member of the communal bank Llankachinapac.

She is 34 years old and lives in the Urubamba province, north of Cusco. She alternates her activities between the home and her Internet booth. It has been many years since she started working in this business and it has been successful thanks to her dedication she has put in the business. Our client is a hard working and enterprising mother that wants her family to move ahead. She requires a loan to set up her internet booth, buying computers and furniture so she can increase her business capital and income and give her family a better quality of life.

She is grateful for the opportunity provided by this loan and promises to fulfill her obligation to payback this loan corresponding to the repayment schedule.

Translated from Spanish by karl baumgarten, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: to buy computers and furniture to set up an internet booth

description:
Aminata is the representative of the "Boud Nonguelone" group. She is married and the mother of 7 children. The oldest is 28 years old and the youngest is 1 year old. Four of her children go to school. She has seven people dependent on her.

She has been selling flour and cakes for 10 years. She stocks up at the sector 23 market in town. Her customers are women, men and children.

She would like to purchase 2 sacks of corn to make flour, 1 sack of wheat flour and a can of oil to make cakes.

She is saving up to expand her business. Her goal is to build a dwelling place in their yard and to pay for her children's education.
local_use: to purchase two sacks of corn to make flour, 1 sack of wheat flour and a can of oil to make cakes.

description:
Yary is 36 years old. She is pictured here with her husband, Saveun, who is 33 years old. The couple lives in a village across the Mekong River about 17 kilometers from Phnom Penh City. They have three children, two sons and one daughter, who all attend school. Yary is a construction worker and her husband is a mason. Yary wants to quit construction work and launch a new business selling sugarcane juice. 

Yary is requesting a 1,000 USD loan of to buy a sugarcane juicing machine. She will also use a part of her loan to build a restroom for family use.
local_use: to buy a sugarcane juicing machine and build a family restroom

description: The "Sombrerito" ("Little Hat") communal bank is comprised of ten members, eight women and two men. The leader of the group is Roxana, who's 32 years old and has two children aged 5 and 8. Roxana sells fruits that are in season. She has a regular stand in one of the busiest markets in the town of Santa Cruz, where she sells her products. This loan is her third one with the institution. Roxana will use this loan to purchase in-season fruits by wholesale, such as citrus fruit, in order to fight the winter. That way she'll provide a variety of fruits for her customers and increase her profits. The reason why she requests this loan is to keep on improving her business. Roxana will use the profits to continue buying various fruits according to the season. Roxana is a very hardworking person. She feels happy for the opportunity that she and her fellow group members are getting, since in some cases they support their families single-handedly.
local_use: to purchase in-season fruits.

description:
Ada is 39 years old and lives in Jiquilisco, in Morazán department, together with her husband and children.  Her business is selling shoes, sandals and tortillas.  She also has a corn mill.  She started out with her mill and selling tortillas two years ago and has only recently started selling shoes and sandals.

Ada needs a loan to invest a percentage in each business, buying firewood and corn for her tortillas, and also shoes and sandals if the money stretches far enough.  With this purchase, she hopes to improve her businesses and make more sales.  Ada's aspirations are to expand her businesses, to have a lot of customers and, in the future, to have savings so that she can improve her situation.
local_use: To buy firewood, corn, shoes and sandals

description:
This is 44 year-old Ya Umu.  She is married and has 5 children, aged 15, 17, 22, 25 and 29 years. In 1991, Ya Umu established her jeans, skirts, shirts, shoes, travelling bags, school bags, polo, lacost etc. business. She began her business because her father didn't allow his girl children to attend school.  She was sent to school by her step-mother and at Class 2, her father stopped her.  Her step-mother introduced her to business. After she was fully matured, her parents gave her hand in marriage to a businessman. Her husband established a business for her. 
 
Working 7 days a week and 10 hours a day, Ya Umi earns about SLL 1,500,000 every month from this business. She would like a loan in the amount of SLL 4,500,000. Ya Umu has already received and successfully repaid 4 loans, and now requires a new loan in order to buy school bags - 4 dozen @ SLL 300,000, shoes - 3 dozen @ SLL 360,000, jeans (men) - 2 dozens @ SLL 408,000, jeans (women) - 3 dozens @ SLL 336,000, travelling bags - 1 dozen @ SLL 360,000.  The balance of SLL 36,000 will be used for transportation costs. 

In the future, Ya Umu plans to open another shop, to provide quality education for her children, and to become an international businesswoman. She thanks you for your support.
local_use: To buy school bags - 4 dozens @ SLL300,000, shoes - 3 dozens @ SLL360,000, jeans (men) - 2 dozens @ SLL408,000, jeans (women) - 3 dozens @ SLL336,000, travelling bags - 1 dozen @ SLL360,000.  The balance SLL36, 000 will be used for transport.

description:
This borrower is called Julio, and he continues with his business renting computers for internet use in an internet café that he set up in his home. This space also serves as a stationery store, where he sells stationery items. He has requested this loan to buy merchandise such as ballpoint pens, paper, notepads, etc. for his stationery business.

Julio is very grateful to Kiva for helping him to keep his business going. He is part of the Kanchary communal bank, which is located in the city of Cusco in Peru.
local_use: to buy pens, paper and notepads for his stationery store

description: Silver needs this loan to buy iron sheets for roofing his commercial house. He is a 40-year-old married man with three children, living in Bundibugyo, Uganda. The responsibility of looking after the family is vested in him, and his desire is to set up an income-generating project that is sustainable. He deals in buying and selling cocoa and has been in business for ten years. His major challenge has always been inadequate capital to purchase adequate supplies. His dream is to directly export to other countries without using middlemen and also to complete his rental houses.
local_use: to buy iron sheets for roofing his commercial house.

description:
Rosa lives with her parents.  She operates a retail business, selling clothing and cosmetics, at a local market.  She has operated the business for 5 years, working from 7:00am to 4:00pm.
Rosa is applying for a loan to buy blouses, skirts, dresses, clothing for children, lotions and cosmetics to stock her business.  She will have a better chance of increasing her income if she has more merchandise to sell.  
Rosa wants to build a strong, thriving business, one that meets the expectations of her customers, that is profitable and that generates the income she needs to live from day to day.
local_use: Buy merchandise for her retail clothing business.

description:
Martha Patricia is 33 years old, married, and has a 14 year old daughter in high school. She is an elementary school teacher, but is not currently working because her family just moved to Juigalpa. Her husband bought their house in the residential development of Bosques de Juigalpan, and they wish to make some improvements.

Martha Patricia is requesting her first loan and wants to complete the ceramic tiling in her house because the floors are already finished. She will purchase tiles for her bathroom and install metal guards to provide security for her home.

Martha Patricia’s husband works abroad and sends money for the family’s living expenses and house payments. Part of that money will also be used to repay this loan. She dreams of continuing the improvements to her house by adding a room for greater privacy and building a kitchen that has more space.

Translated from Spanish by Ronan Reodica, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Purchase ceramic tiles & metal guards

description:
Doris and her partner have a carpentry studio where they manufacture and sell wooden furniture. They produce tables, chairs, beds, doors, and dining room sets among other things. They have had this business for about three years, operating from a rented location. Doris is requesting a loan in order to purchase wood and finishings such as lacquer and wood stain. Her dream is to have a large store to display and sell furniture.

Doris is a member of the village bank "El Amanecer" in Cusco, which is receiving its 22nd loan from Asociación Arariwa.
local_use: To purchase wood, lacquer, and wood stain

description: This is 46-year-old Sidratu. She is married and has three children who are 22, 17, and 15 years old. She has one additional dependent, a relative who lives with her. In 2007, Sidratu established her beverage business, selling soft drinks, rum, gin and water. She began her business because she realized that her salary was not enough to provide for her children. Working seven days a week and ten hours a day, she earns about 1,285,000 SLL every month from this business. She needs a loan of 4,000,000 SLL in order to buy more drinks for resale. She hopes that this loan will enable her to increase her monthly profits by approximately 205,600 SLL. In the future, Sidratu plans to expand her business to a bar and restaurant. She thanks you for your support.
local_use: To buy more drinks for resale

description: Leonia is a 49-year-old single mother of three children. She lives in her own permanent house in Fort Portal, Uganda. Her dream for her family is to educate her children to the university level. For the past 20 years, she has been selling clothes. She continues to reap tangible benefits from her business, even with the challenge of limited capital. Leonia needs the loan to buy clothes to sell.
local_use: To buy clothes to sell

description:
Rosa is a single mother of a son who is in school. Her plans include improving her standard of living. Rosa is a merchant and has plans to buy a vehicle for transporting her products, which will be of great help.

Her greatest need is to improve the infrastructure of her home. With this loan, she will buy construction materials such as cement, sand, iron, blocks, gravel, floor tiles, buttresses, screws, and other supplies so that she can build a room and expand her home. This will provide greater comfort and security.
local_use: to buy construction materials for building a room.

description:
Doña Mildred is 46 years old and lives in Hialeah with two sons, 18 and 20 years old. Her husband is a construction contractor. Ms. Mildred's business of 10 years is the sale of soft drinks and other beverages and a variety of foods in her small store. She also sells cosmetics products which she got started in with her own savings. With this loan request, her seventh with Afodenic, she will invest in buying basic grains and other products which are for consumption by her clients to satisfy their needs. Her plans are to remodel her home and market other products that generate a good income.

Translated from Spanish by Daniel Burke, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Buy basic grains and products for daily consumption for her store

description: Shafoat is married and has no children.  She has been involved in sewing services for 15 years.  She cuts and sews national dresses and has loyal clients.  Tailoring and sewing services are in high demand and profitable.  At the present time, computerized embroidery on national dresses is in high demand.  Shafoat uses other seamstresses' services for embroidery, which is expensive.  She want to buy a current programmable embroidery machine.  She wants to obtain this loan to achieve her dream.  Shafoat thanks you for the support and awaits loan approval.  Thank you.
local_use: to purchase an embroidery machine

description:
Jackson is 41 years old, married and a father of 5 children living in Hoima, Uganda. 

For 11 years he has been in the carpentry business. He started by being employed by someone but later on saved enough to start his own workshop. Now Jackson faces a challenge of late payments by his clients after his work is completed. He wishes to have a big showroom in the future. Jackson needs a loan to buy timber.
local_use: to buy timber.

description:
William is an employee.  He is single and lives with his mother and sister.  This young man works for the council.  He has been working for six years and is a big support to his family, covering some of their household expenses.

William currently needs to cover his sister's education expenses.  He is requesting this loan because it is difficult for him to have this sum of money available in one go from his work.

William's goal is to support his family and their needs and above all his sister as he would like her to succeed academically.
local_use: to cover his sister's education expenses

description:
Carlos has decided to request a new loan to buy farming supplies to use in planting, as he is starting to use a new planting process.  He will buy herbicides, fertilizer, and improved seed.

He believes his previous loan allowed him to get what he needed to perform his work in his medicine business, which improved his finances and his ability to feed his family.
local_use: to buy herbicides, fertilizer, and improved seed

description:
Dinora is a woman of 46 years of age. She is married and her family group consists of: her husband, two daughters who are 24 and 26 years old, the husband of one of her daughters, and two grandchildren. They all live in El Transito D. San Miguel. She has a business that she runs with her daughters. They developed the business through their own initiative, working from 6 in the morning until 6 at night. The business is currently small and they don't have sufficient capital to invest in supplies. Dinora is requesting a loan that she needs to buy merchandise to supply her business and to offer her clients a greater variety of products. This will help her to offer her clients everything necessary for the home and satisfy their demand for products and will achieve better sales and greater income that will meet the needs of Dinora's own home. Her dreams are to have a strong and stable business that will offer economic stability and a better standard of living.

Translated from Spanish by Alison Hynd, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy home products

description: Meresi is a 32-year-old married woman with ten children who owns a house in Kasese, Uganda. She has been in the produce business, specifically selling groundnuts and beans, for two years. She started out with 200,000 UGX and now has 500,000 UGX as her working capital. Her hardship is the high prices for agricultural commodities, making her fail to purchase enough to meet her customers' demands. Her dream is to own a food store. Meresi needs this loan to purchase beans and groundnuts to sell.
local_use: To buy beans and groundnuts

description: Sofia, 32, belongs to the “Perolniyoc” communal bank located in Urubamba District in Urubamba Province and Cusco Department.  She has a spouse and a 10-year-old son.  She works as a retailer.  She gathers products like corn and sell it at wholesale.  She’s been selling corn for 8 years.  She has fields where she grows corn and she also raises small farm animals.  She needs the loan on this occasion to buy small farm animals.  She wants to buy guinea pigs to add to the ones she already has and will also buy chicks to raise and sell.  She’s asking for the loan to buy small farm animals like guinea pigs and chicks.  She is grateful for the loan and commits to make her payments according to the payment schedule.
local_use: to buy small farm animals like guinea pigs and chickens.

description:
Wilfredo René C. G., a long time client of Emprender, was originally part of the Santiago Felix group for 12 loan cycles from 2002 to 2005. Subsequently, he took out individual loans, and he is now in his 10th loan cycle. He owns a home in the Pedregal area, but due to his work, he and his wife live and work in the Cotacota area. He and his wife sell lubricants and he is a car mechanic. They have two school-aged daughters. He is a good client and responsible with his payments.

Translated from Spanish by Michele Magrino, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Purchase an engine for his car

description:
Mrs. Vannoeun P. is 38 years old and her husband, Mr. Bunly Ouch, is 48 years old.  They have been married since 1992 and have three children – one son and two daughters, all of them are in school. The family lives along National Road Number One about 18 kilometers from Phnom P. City. 

Mrs.Vannoeun P. is a scarf weaver. Her husband is a soldier. She is asking for a loan of $600 to purchase cotton thread for her business.
local_use: To purchase cotton thread for scarf weaving business

description:
Paulina is a member of the Virgen de los Angeles Village Bank, which meets once per month in the town of Huayllacocha, where she lives. Paulina is forty-seven years old and married with six children. Her children are all adults, and three of them still live at home with her. Paulina and her family have a farm where they grow potatoes, barley, wheat and broad beans (“habas”). She has been working on the farm for many years, and is now preparing for the upcoming barley harvest in June. She and her husband also raise a handful of cows and sheep. 

Paulina is requesting a loan to invest in livestock. She plans to buy either sheep or a cow; the money would be enough to buy one cow or five sheep, she says. She would raise the animals and eventually sell them for meat. 

Paulina has been a client of Asociacion Arariwa for the past six years, and is grateful for the loans available to her because it is the only institution that works in her town. She has pledged to repay her Kiva loan in full and on time.
local_use: Buy sheep or a cow

description:
Maria is a member of the "Imasumac II" community bank which is located in Huanchac district, in Cusco province and department.

Maria is 55 years old, married, and has seven children.  Five of her children are still in school and she continues supporting them in their education.  Maria works together with her husband in a family business but she also continues working as a civil servant.  Maria sells jewelry maD. by her husband in the institution in which she works.  She would like to invest her loan in buying materials for making jewelry.  She will buy wire, stones, beads, hooks and other items she needs for making pieces of jewelry such as earrings, necklaces, bracelets, etc.

Maria is grateful for her loan and pledges to make her repayments according to schedule.
local_use: to invest in buying materials for making jewelry

description:
Sonia was born in the city of Paucartambo (Cusco, Peru) and is 46 years old. Currently, Sonia lives in the city of Cusco together with her only child. Sonia's main activity is selling breakfast, mate [tea], hot and cold drinks, and other items. She has a small cafe where she sells her products. She has operated this business for 5 years, and it is going very well for her, thanks to the dedication she puts into her work. At this time, Sonia needs a loan to buy sugar, bread, cakes and other items. 

The borrower is a responsible and hard-working person, and thanks to these qualities, her fellow members invited her to participate in the “Mosoq Allpa” communal bank of the Arariwa Association.
local_use: to buy sugar, bread, cakes and other items.

description: Fidel is 58 years old and married with one son. He works as a taxi driver in the city of Cusco. Fidel works everyday driving throughout the city and he really enjoys his job. He is asking for a loan in order to improve his taxi. He plans to purchase new tires and fix any scratches or smashes on his taxi. He is very proud of his car and this loan will help him to continue to take great care of it. Fidel is committed to making all of the necessary loan payments on time.
local_use: to pay for new tires and repairs to his taxi

description:
Karina was born in the city of Lamay.  She is 24 years old and lives with her partner and son.  Her business is selling silverwork.  She has a small workshop in her home.  On this occasion, Karina needs a loan to buy materials such as raw silver.

Karina is a member of Asociación Arariwa's "Virgen de Fátima de Lamay” community bank which is located in Calca province, in Cusco department, Peru.

Karina is grateful for this loan and appreciates it.  She pledges to make her monthly repayments on time.
local_use: to buy materials such as raw silver

description:
Visal is a motor taxi driver, while his wife is a garment-factory worker. They live in a village along National Road Number One, about twenty kilometers from Phnom Penh City, and have three children--one son and two daughters.

Visal hopes to expand and organize his house to make it easier for family members to stay. Hence he is asking for a loan of $500.
local_use: To expand and better organize the house where he lives.

description:
Joseph is a 43-year-old married man with 7 children between the ages of 22 and 5 years, living in Karuguuza, Uganda. He lives in his own house where he stays with 6 people, and his desire is to educate his children up to university. 

For 15 years, Joseph has been operating a retail shop business, and from this business he has been able to build a house for the family. He faces the challenge of the high rate of inflation but hopes to make it a wholesale shop. Joseph needs a loan to buy soap, sugar and cooking oil for resale.
local_use: To buy soap, sugar and cooking oil.

description:
America is 35 years old, married, and has two children ages eight and nine months. She is a member of the “Unidos para el Truinfo” (United for Triumph) community bank. America makes a living selling candles. These include “cirios”, which are large candles normally used in street processions for local saints in the Catholic religion here in Cuzco. She has owned this business for seven years, but says that business is somewhat slow right now. 

America is hoping that business will pick up with the help of a loan in the coming months, and says she will use the Kiva loan to sustain and improve her candle business. Specifically, she will buy wax to make the candles with the Kiva loan money. America is appreciative of and grateful for the loan, and promises to pay the monthly payments on time.
local_use: Wax to make candles

description: Susana continues to work in her small grocery store; the member is doing very well and has increased the number of her customers. Susana hopes to use the loan once more to buy basic household goods that are used daily like rice, sugar, milk, spaghettis, oil and other items; she will use them to have more sales in her store.
local_use: buy basic household goods.

description:
The borrower continues to make her living at her grocery store business.  She sells basic need items like rice, sugar, milk, and crackers.  She works from 5am until 10pm.  She's been in this business for several years, and her dream is to expand her grocery store business.  

She is requesting this loan to buy rice, sugar, milk, and crackers.  She is happy with this loan granted to her and commits herself to paying the installments.
local_use: to buy rice, sugar, milk, and crackers.

description:
Sra. Felicia is a member of the Communal Bank “Qorimankacha”, which is located in the District of Wanchaq, Province and Department of Cusco.

She is 56 years old and a single mother with three children. Felicia divides her time between her daily activities and her business selling clothes and cosmetics as an independent merchant. She also has a few small rooms available for rent. Thanks to these small businesses, she is able to move her children forward. Felicia has a store where she sells clothing for adults and children. She is requesting a loan to buy merchandise for her retail clothing business.

Felicia is grateful to everyone who made this dream possible, so she promises to complete her payments by the established deadlines.

Translated from Spanish by Ronan Reodica, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Purchase merchandise for her clothing store

description:
The members of the “VIRGEN NATIVIDAD D. LARES” bank are from the Lares district, in the province of Calca, located within the region of Cusco. Our members alternate between agricultural activities, like planting potatoes, corn, wheat and barley, and home-based businesses in which the women sell food in the main town plaza on Saturdays and Sundays, while the men take products like dry grains and sell them in other districts around and within the city of Cusco. The members need this loan to reinvest in their various crops and to buy products like dry noodles, rice, oil, flour, vegetables and other ingredients. The members are grateful for the support they have received and for the approval of their loan, which they hope will help them realize their dreams. They promise to repay this loan according to schedule.

Translated from Spanish by Zev Lowe, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Selling food in the main town plaza

description:
James is a thirty-two-year-old man who is married with three children and lives in a rented house in Fort Portal, Uganda.

As a civil servant working with local government for five years now, James has been able to upgrade his qualifications. However, as a salary earner, he needs some income-generating activities to boost his income to meet the needs of his family.

James wants to construct a house for his domestic and commercial needs so that he saves rent while, at the same time, he earns it from the tenants he will have.

James intends to use the loan to purchase a plot on which to construct a house for domestic and commercial purposes.
local_use: To purchase a plot on which to construct a house for domestic and commercial purposes

description:
Digna sells snacks and drinks.  She lives with her children; they go to school and are dependents.  She learned the business on her own.  She has had the business for three years, and it supports the household necessities.

She is requesting a loan to buy ingredients to make food, bananas, oil, yucca, sugar, soft drinks, and juices.  With this loan she will be able to improve her business, and her sales will increase.  She wants to have a profitable business, add other items in order to vary her products, and have her own sales location in order to succeed alongside of her family.
local_use: to buy bananas, oil, yucca, sugar, soft drinks, and juices.

description:
Sra. Siliva lives at her sister’s house in the Plan 3000 District. She has a one-year-old son and her husband is a locksmith. Silvia has a grocery store in her home.

The loan she is requesting will be used to buy noodles, flour, greens, meat, fruit, vegetables, sodas, and beverages to increase her inventory. A new market opened where she lives, so she wants to have more merchandise to sell so that she can provide better service to her customers. Sra. Silvia and her husband are hardworking people who want to succeed so that they can provide a future for their son. She is grateful for the opportunity that has been given to her.
local_use: to buy more merchandise for her store.

description: Isabel is still a member of the "MUJERES UNIDAS" communal bank.  She is still the manager of a transportation service business.  She is an enterprising woman who is raising her family.  She has worked in this business for several years and it is going very well.  Isabel is now requesting a loan to maintain her cars.  Isabel is grateful and satisfied to be able to continue growing her own business, and commits to making her payments according to the established schedule.
local_use: to maintain her cars.

description:
Mr. Oeun S. (pictured here), 44, and his wife, Mrs. Born Man, 40, live in a small village on National Road Two about 20 kilometers south of Phnom Penh. They have been married since 1990 and have three daughters. Two of them are garment factory workers and another one is in school.  

Oeun is a motor taxi driver. He also assists his wife’s  fish selling business. He is applying for his first loan of $1,000 to purchase a motorbike for his daughters to drive to work.
local_use: To purchase a motorcycle for his daughters to drive to work.

description:
Claudio is a member of the Communal Bank "Siempre Juntos" (Always Together), a group that conducts its meetings every 30 days in the District of Huanchac in Cusco Province, Department of Cusco.

Claudio raises small animals, such as guinea pigs, and still has a pen with a special area for raising the guinea pigs. He learned everything related to the care, diet, reproduction, and gestation of these animals. Claudio is requesting a loan in order to buy more animals, such as guinea pigs, and the appropriate feed.

He appreciates the opportunity to access a loan so that he can invest in his business and grow financially.
local_use: to buy more guinea pigs and the appropriate feed.

description:
Vilma is a member of the "Imasumac II" community bank which is located in Huanchac district, in Cusco province and department.

Vilma is 28 years old, married, and has two children.  She makes items from clay and also buys handicrafts which she sells.  Vilma buys some of her handicrafts ready made.  She buys blankets which are knitted from alpaca and sheep wool.  She also makes beads and gives them their finishing touches so that they can be used in making earrings, bracelets, etc.  She needs this loan to buy materials for making handicrafts and to buy pre-made items.

Vilma is grateful for the support that she is being given and pledges to make her repayments in a disciplined manner.
local_use: to buy materials for making handicrafts and to buy pre-made items

description:
José Luis A. Quisbert makes leather shoes and has worked in this activity for 20 years. He has a son to support and a wife who sells the shoes that he produces. He learned this profession from his father. He began as an apprentice and later used his savings to buy his own equipment and machinery. Now he works independently and is thinking about taking out more loans to grow his business. Don Jose Luis A. has worked with the institution since 2007. He has always been punctual with his payments and responsible with his work.

Translated from Spanish by Rebecca Towle, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Purchase leather

description:
Forferio, 73, is a member of the “NUEVA VICTORIA-CHINCHERO” (New Victory-Chinchero) communal bank located in Chinchero district in Urubamba province, Cusco department.

He’s married and has six children (all independent).  He is an artisan.  He was born and grew up in the beautiful Valle Sagrado and is considered in the whole town as one of the most recognized and longstanding landscape painter.  He is currently painting perfect works in oil.  He represents Andean scenes depicting everyday life of Andean people: their values, ideologies, work and much more.  He participated in National Geographic documentaries and in August, 2010 was invited to exhibit his and his daughter’s work in Lima’s Suizo Hotel by the Minister of Tourism.

He has his stand in Awanawasi which is also in the town of Chincheros.  He would be very happy if people from all over the world were to come visit him soon so that he can tell his town’s history to them.  He is a very charismatic, low-key person who is full of talent.

He is asking for a loan to buy supplies he needs: brushes, canvases, oil paint and frames.  He is asking for the loan in order to buy materials for his paintings. He is happy with the granted loan and pledges to repay in a timely manner.
local_use: To purchase materials for his paintings.

description:
Maria belongs to the "SEÑOR DE LA AGONIA DE TARAY" communal bank. The bank is located in the district of Taray, which belongs to the province of Pisac, department of Cuzco.   

She is 57 years old and has 5 children. Only the youngest, who is 18, lives with her. She works buying and selling artisanal crafts. She has her stand three days a week in the tourist lookout in Taray. There area artisans are governed by the union and only sell three days a week. That way, all the artisans take turns and all of them have a chance to sell their wares. On this occasion, this member wants to invest the loan in buying artisanal crafts and materials such as clay, natural oxides, brushes and other materials to do her works. 

She is grateful for the loan and committed to making her payments according to the established schedule.
local_use: to invest in buying artisanal crafts and materials such as clay, natural oxides and brushes, among other things to do her work.

description:
Sandra lives with her two children.  She is widowed, and works selling snacks, enchiladas, and bread with chicken among other things.  She makes these sales from 7 in the morning, going to health locations to offer her products for sale.

She is requesting a loan to purchase corn, plantains, oil, bread, and chicken, to be able to have product availability for her sales.

Her goal is to offer good products for sale to her customers.  She also hopes to have a fixed premises where she can offer her products for sale.
local_use: to purchase corn, plantains, oil, bread, and chicken.

description: Guadalupe is 31 years old and lives in a common law marriage but does not yet have any children.  She lives in the beautiful city of Cusco, where she engages in different types of work.  She has a primary line of work which consists of the creation of art.  She paints pictures of different landscapes in the city of Cusco.  At this moment, she is in need of a loan to buy materials for her work, such as brushes, paints, and other items.
local_use: to buy materials for her work, for example brushes, paints, and other items.

description:
Vilma was born in Cusco Department in the south of Perú.  At present, Vilma is 73 years old.  She’s a widow and has four children.  Vilma sells food (breakfast, lunch and dinner).  She’s been in this business for the last 40 years and does very well.  On this occasion Vilma needs the loan to buy ingredients like for example bags of rice, bottles of oil and other things.

The “Virgen D. las Nieves” communal bank meets monthly in the city of Cusco (Perú).  Cusco is known for being a very touristy and commercial area as well as for its traditional “Inti Raymi” festival and also because one of the Seven Wonders of the World, Machupicchu, is located here.
local_use: to buy ingredients like bags of rice, bottles of oil and other things.

description:
Higidia, 56, is a member of the “VIRGEN D. LA O” communal bank located in Yucay district, Urubamba province, Cusco department. She is married and has four children. She is a craftsperson and also engages in farming during planting and harvest time. She works selling all kinds of crafts like: exotic stones, quartz, jewelry, weavings, embroidery, etc. She is asking for funds to buy merchandise for her business, like colored thread, quartz and silver wires. She takes this opportunity to thank all those who participate in this dream through this medium and pledges to repay in a timely fashion.

Translated from Spanish by Michael Bujazan, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy merchandise for her business (colored thread, silver wire, quartz)

description:
Don Maximiliano lives in Delicias de Concepción in the Department of Morazán.  He works in transportation with his vehicle, with which he makes trips on request for his customers.  He is 59 years old and lives with his child and his wife.  He has always worked in transportation and in masonry.  In this business there are no fixed hours as it depends on the trips and their distance.

Maximiliano is currently seeking a loan to make improvements to the vehicle.  Conducting maintenance and changing tires and engine gaskets will help keep the truck in excellent condition, ready to make any trip without major delays.  His only risk is that the mechanic founds another issue.

His dream is to have an up-to-date vehicle such as a minibus, which would speed up trips for his clients.  He also dreams of having sufficient money to give his child an education.
local_use: Vehicle repair

description:
Kaija is a 45-year-old father of four children living in Kagadi, Uganda.

For three years he has been operating a retail shop where he normally sells food. His major challenges are customers not paying on time and price fluctuations. He dreams of having his children educated and buying a car.

He would like to diversify his business to include a supermarket. Kaija wants a loan to buy groundnuts, maize and beans for sale.
local_use: to buy groundnuts, maize and beans for sale.

description:
Qurbon is 49 years old. He is married and has 5 children. Their ages are between 3 and 16 years old. Qurbon is very hardworking and kind-natured. He has a lot of friends and all of them love him very much.

Qurbon has been busy with farming for 27 years. He grows different kind of crops. He has been in this line of work since he was a boy, so all of his experience has been dedicated to producing crops. His products are sold at the local market in the city. His elder son and daughter help him with the business.

In order to provide his crops with the needed attention, Qurbon is currently requesting a loan in the amount of 1600 USD so that he can buy fertilizer and continue improving his crop production. He hopes to generate more income and take advantage of the high prices being commanded on an international level so that he can maintain a better standard of living and help his children continue their education.
local_use: to buy mineral fertilizers.

description:
The “Killa” community bank has been around for three years.  It is made up of hard-working and entrepreneurial people who are always looking for opportunities to get ahead in life and, through their daily efforts, they work to provide their children with a better future.  The bank meets every month in the city of Cusco.  Most of the bank's members live in the city of Cusco (Peru).

During this meeting we meet Lily who lives in the beautiful city of Cusco and has three children.  She is a housewife and a mother who is noted as being a responsible, kind and hard-working person.  Because of these qualities, her friends invited her to become a member of their community bank.  Lily was born in the city of Langui, in Canas province, in Cusco department.  She is a teacher but, in her spare time, she makes sweaters from alpaca wool.  She has a small workshop in her home with the basic tools she needs.  She has been in this business for 20 years now and her business is doing very well.  On this occasion, she needs a loan to buy more materials such as yarn and thread.

Lily is 50 years old.  She is a person who has a great desire to improve herself and have a successful business as she would like to provide her family with the best.
local_use: to buy more materials such as yarn and thread

description:
Claudio belongs to the “PACHA ILLAIRY” community bank which is located in Ocongate district, in Quispicanchis province, in the department of Cusco.

Claudio is 35 years old.  He lives with his partner and has 3 children.  He was born in Ocongate.  Claudio works as a master builder and also farms.  He has a small plot of land which he works together with a friend.  He is in charge of providing the land while his friends puts in the seeds.  Together they pay the council for irrigation rights and buy fertilizer for the land.  On this occasion, Claudio would like the loan to invest in the purchase of fertilizer and plowing the land to prepare it for sowing.  He is requesting the loan to buy fertilizer and to pay the workers who will prepare the land.

He is grateful for the loan and appreciates it.  He pledges to make his repayments in a timely manner.
local_use: To buy fertilizer and to pay workers who will prepare his land for sowing

description: Kunduz is 52 years old, married, and has in her care 4 children all of whom have reached the age of majority. Kunduz is a very hard-working person and has over 18 years of entrepreneurial experience. She makes preserves by purchasing fresh vegetables and pickling them. Kunduz has her regular customers such as owners of restaurants and diners. She takes care of her business on her own as her husband works as a driver and is unable to assist her financially. Kunduz is requesting a loan of 3000 somoni to purchase vegetables for pickling. She is counting on you and your kindness.
local_use: to purchase more fresh vegetables for pickling

description:
Mrs. Carla F. Montaño works making jackets, sweaters, aprons, overalls, etc. She has a young baby and works alongside her husband. This young partner has sacrificed a lot to outfit her workshop and doesn’t work with other finance institutions, only Kiva partner Emprender. In the future, they plan on growing as a small business and having more machines to attend to more clients.

Translated from Spanish by Laura Westin, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Buy a sewing machine

description: Judit is still working as a teacher and still selling notions like brushes, mirrors, buttons and needles among other items with her daughter.  She supports her children through these businesses and she wants to expand the business so is asking for a loan to buy buttons, needles, thread and mirrors at wholesale.  She is happy about the loan and commits to make her installment payments.
local_use: to buy buttons, needles, thread and mirrors at wholesale.

description:
Magaly Salvadora V. is an outstanding and modest individual who sells food products for daily consumption such as eggs, beans, rice, corn, and other products. She also sells canned goods. Thanks to God, Magaly says her business has done very well. With her previous loan, she was able to earn a little bit more income due to an increase in her sales.

She is requesting this loan to buy food products so that she can generate slightly more revenue and offer a greater variety of merchandise to her customers. Her dream is to have a larger location so that she can increase her income and move her family forward with the support that FAPE and Kiva has provided.
local_use: Purchase groceries to sell

description:
Maria Salome is a hardworking woman. Her business is selling fritanga (a fried meat dish), which she started six years ago with her savings and loans from Afodenic. She is 44 years old and lives in Villa Reconciliación. This is her fifth loan, which she will invest in the purchase of daily inputs like meat, basic grains, vegetables and others to be able to sell a variety of dishes to her customers. In the future, she would like to improve the infrastructure of her business so she can improve the service to her customers.

Translated from Spanish by Trisha Bury, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Purchase meats, basic grains and vegetables to prepare delicious dishes

description:
Zenayda, 46, has three children: Hector, 27, who works for EMPA, Alexander, 25, who works at UNAN, both of whom contribute to household expenses, and Jader, 8, who is in elementary school. Zenayda has worked for Juigalpa's mayor's office for the last 22 years as caretaker at Juigalpa's municipal cemetery. Her husband, who is employed as a stretcher-bearer at a hospital, is responsible for household expenses. She is asking for her 9th loan and hopes to continue to have Kiva's support to build a bedroom for one of her sons, who has recently married and has a baby that is under a year old; she would like to provide him with more parivacy for the family he has just formed. Her previous loans allowed her to improve her family's living conditions in that she used the last one to reroof the house and to build the walls for her kitchen. Her greatest wish it to continue to improve her home so that her family will have more comfort since this is the main asset she plans to leave them.

Translated from Spanish by Michael Bujazan, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To build a room.

description:
Don Carmelo Z. is a small farmer in the district of El Banco in town of El Rama. He is married Sra. Justina Flores and they have four children. Santos (age 42), Abelardo (age 40) and Francisca (age 30) are all married and have their own families. Darvis (age 28) is the youngest child and the only who still lives at home. He helps his father work the land and look after the farm.

Don Carmelo is requesting his fourth loan so that he can plant rice and sell it within three months. This will help him generate revenue to improve the living standards for himself and his family. He has the necessary experience since he has been working the land for more than 40 years. He also grows corn, bananas, beans, and tubers. In addition, Santos raises livestock and currently has a few small animals that provide daily income to sustain his family. He is known as an individual who is hardworking, honest, and responsible in all of his commitments.

Translated from Spanish by Ronan Reodica, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Acquire inputs for planting rice

description:
Mrs. Juana C. is 48 years old and lives in La Concepción with her husband. Their children are married and live independently. Juana's husband, like her, works in agriculture. Her plans for her family are to improve farming conditions to increase their income and finish building their home. With this loan, she will invest in agricultural inputs for fertilizing her crops to reap a good harvest and sell her produce at a better price.

Translated from Spanish by Trisha Bury, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Purchase agricultural inputs to fertilize crops

description:
The member belongs to the communal bank “HATUN RUMIYOC”. The bank is located in the district of Cusco, in the province of Cusco and department of Cusco.

The member is Sr. Alexander. He is 29 years old and single. The member divides his time between daily activities and his taxi service business. He owns a car which he uses as a taxi. The member works from 6:00 a.m. until 9:00 p.m. The member wants to get ahead by means of this work. The member wants to improve his taxi service which he offers to the public in general. The member is asking for a loan to pay for the maintenance of his car and buy spare parts.

The member is happy for the loan and agrees to make the repayments.
local_use: to pay for the maintenance on his car and buy spare parts.

description:
Manuel lives with his wife and daughter.  He’s married and owns a pharmacy where he sells all types of medicine.  He inherited the business from his grandmother.  He does not have a fixed schedule to tend to customers and thanks be to God, it’s been a profitable business.

He is asking for a loan to buy different types of medicine like antibiotics, analgesics and vitamins in various presentations like injections, syrups and tablets.  This purchase will help him have a larger variety of medicine to offer customers.

Manuel’s objective is to diversity his pharmacy stock managing to strengthen it and improve customer service as well as family income.
local_use: to buy medicines.

description:
Rolando, 38, is a member of the “SAN JOSE DE URUBAMBA” communal bank; he lives in Urubamba, Cusco department. He lives with his significant other and their two children. He is originally from Puno. He and his spouse have a small store which he runs. It is sort of a grocery store but more widely stocked. He is asking for funds to increase the stock in his store. He values and appreciates the loan granted and pledges to repay in a timely fashion.

Translated from Spanish by Michael Bujazan, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy stock items for his store.

description:
T. Kholiboy is a 54-year-old farmer who lives with his wife and three children. He has two milk cows and sells dairy products to the local and capital traders. Kholiboy has 25 years of experience in raising cattle and selling dairy products.

The milk products are in very high demand in his village. Kholiboy has many orders from traders for these products, but his cows do not give enough milk to keep up with these orders. Therefore, he decided to apply for $600 in order to purchase an additional cow and fodder.

Kholiboy is very grateful to everyone who is helping him to improve his living through this loan.

More about Tajikistan and IMON International

Tajikistan is known for its rich history, which includes a key post along the Silk Road and the end of Alexander the Great's rule. It has also produced great thinkers, philosophers, scientists and poets, including Rudaki, Avicenna, Ferdowsi, Omar Khayyam, Jomi, and Rumi. The country is home to epic mountain passes, communities that still speak the ancient Sogdian language, and a civilization that dates back to the fourth millennium BC. Even today, it is a complex mixture of the Islamic faith, Soviet culture, New West culture and Central Asian traditions.

But Tajikistan is also the poorest of the former Soviet republics. The civil war, which ignited soon after its independence from the U.S.S.R., further damaged the already weak economy. In addition, 93 percent of the country is mountainous and only 7 percent of the land is arable. These conditions have resulted in high levels of unemployment and have forced hundreds of thousands to seek work in other countries, mainly Russia. While the people of Tajikistan are working to improve its agricultural production and manufacturing sector, nearly two-thirds of the population still live in abject poverty.

IMON's History

Since December 2007, IMON International has worked closely with Kiva and Kiva lenders to ensure that poor and low-income clients represent a viable business proposition. To learn more about IMON International's work, please visit www.imon.tj.

He would like to request a loan of 9,000 TJS to purchase dried fruits and fertilizer.

description: Mahmudjon is married to a wonderful woman named Muharama. They have 4  children. Mahmudjon and Muharama must comfort their children with all the necessary conditions. local_use: to buy seed, mineral recourses, and to pay for the services of an agricultural machine.

description:
Karolina del Socorro Suárez is 24 years old and lives with her parents in the Benjamín Zeledón neighborhood located in the municipality of Ticuantepe. She is a single mother and has two children under her care; one is seven years old, and the other is an eleven-month-old baby. She hopes to improve her family’s living conditions and to be one day build her own house. Since she was 18 years old, Karolina has worked in agriculture; the biggest difficulty that she faces is a lack of financing. She began working in agriculture with help from her father. With this loan she will purchase fertilizer and supplies to apply to her crop to have a good yield.

local_use: purchase fertilizer and supplies

description:
Zoenabo is the leader of the Lagmentaaba group. She is married and has three children. The eldest child is eight years old and the youngest is one, and  one of the children is in school. Zoenabo has four people to support.

Zoenabo is a weaver, and has been working in this profession for four years. She buys her supplies at the market in Cissin. Her customers include both women and men, and friends.

She would like to buy 1 ball of yarn for weaving, 6kg of dye, 1 barrel of water and some wood.

She uses her income to pay for her children's schooling, and also saves some money. She hopes to open a weaving workshop.
local_use: to buy 1 ball of yarn for weaving, 6kg of dye, 1 barrel of water and some wood.

description: Señor Miguel is a small farmer.  He lives with his wife and children in the Ticuantepe area.  His plans for the future are to be able to improve his living conditions.  Don Miguel has been growing pineapples for several years.  The biggest challenge he faces is not having enough capital to invest in fertilizers and supplies to maintain his crops properly.  He is grateful to Afodenic and Kiva for the confidence they place in him so that he can get ahead and some day become a large scale farmer.
local_use: purchase fertilizers and supplies.

description:
Sri is 39 years old and married with two children, Yulianti and Daniel.  She is pictured in the photo above wearing the black shirt.  Yulianti is 13 years old and is in the 7th grade.  Daniel is 12 years old and is in 6th grade.  Her husband works as a driver.  

Sri has been selling dishes from her food stall for the last year.  The business runs smoothly and has been going quite well because there is not a lot of competition in her area.  The income helps ensure that the children's needs for school such as fees and uniforms can be met.

This is Sri's second loan with VisionFund Indonesia. She will use this loan to increase the ingredients at her food stall by purchasing items such as pop ice, coffee, noodles, and rice.  This will help her have more variety in her stall to hopefully draw more customers.  She hopes that their family will continue to have enough money to pay for their children's education so that when they grow up they can have a better life.

The other group members will use their loans to help their businesses which include selling vegetables, selling cakes, selling household appliances on credit, and selling slippers, umbrellas, and shoes on credit.
local_use: to pay for more food such as pop ice, coffee, noodles, and rice to sell at her food stall.

description:
Gerardo is 30 years old and lives with his parents and his sister.  He has a business selling food products such as biscuits, juice, soda, candy and more.
He is currently requesting a loan to increase his merchandise, buying more of the aforementioned, since they are the products he has been selling for 6 years. With this acquisition he hopes to strengthen and grow the business.  His aspiration is to grow, improve conditions and quality of life.
local_use: To buy biscuits, juice, soda, candy, and more.

Lending services have helped her buy a new vending facility in a different part of the city, reach sustainability in her business, and given her confidence for the future. Khuriniso needs a loan of 4,000 Somoni to re-stock her inventory and purchase shoes wholesale for the summer season. She believes that the sphere of market trade where she works is a promising niche and will continue to grow and develop in the future.
