description:
Roberto is a young man working driving a seven-passenger minibus providing public transportation services as part of the Pampahasi transportation syndicate.  Roberto lives with his mother and younger brother.  Roberto takes care of all household expenses like electricity and water.  

Roberto is very well known in the zone and by his fellow workers as a responsible, correct person since he, as the older brother, sees to his younger brother and is concerned that he completes his schooling. One of his greatest wishes is that his younger brother completes high school and later on a career.

On this occasion he’s asking for a loan to buy building materials because the roof on one of his mother’s house’s rooms is leaking and he wants to repair it before the rainy season starts.
local_use: to buy building materials.

description:
Walther Isidoro is part of a communal bank consisting of 19 members in Cruz Pata, a town 45 minutes from Cusco.  The group is called Sacro.  He is from Huancayo and lives in Cruz Pata.  He is 48 years old and is married with 5 daughters.

Walther has a bakery where he makes baked goods like cakes and apple pies.  He sells his goods to stores and to tourists. Walther has many regular clients who continue to buy from him. He will use this loan to buy flour and other materials needed by his bakery.

Walther appreciates and thanks you for the loan and promises to pay the monthly payments on time.
local_use: To buy flour and other raw materials needed for his bakery

description:
Señor Juan José C. A. is an adult male of 71 years. He is married and his wife is dedicated to working on the family farm. They have 9 children of legal age who are independent and also work in agriculture, thanks to the teaching given by their father who directed them so that they are worthy of the work. Juan has 42 years of experience in raising pineapple. Among their needs and/or projects for the future is to carry out a study of their land, since various factors have caused variety of problems that prevent good production. It is for this reason that he requests a loan for the purchase of agricultural materials that will permit good maintenance of his crop. Above all in the future he hopes to be able to improve their family economy little by little, and in this way to pass on to their children a good source of income for their lives.

Translated from Spanish by Barbara (B) Brown, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy agricultural materials for his pineapple crop

description:
José David is 38 years old.  He owns a basic grains store where he sells coffee, corn, rice and beans.  He lives with his wife and two children aged 8 and 10.  He has been running this business for two years, offering his neighbors and customers all kinds of basic grains which are so necessary in every household.

He is requesting ta loan to invest in his business since he would like to buy grains in large quantities and the only way to achieve this is by obtaining a loan.  This will help his business and offer his customers a better service.

With regard to the loan, he hopes his investment will pay off, that his business will be stable and that it provides him with the necessary income to have a comfortable life with his family.
local_use: To buy coffee, beans, corn and rice

Vicentina appreciates and is infinitely thankful for the loan that was granted, which will allow her to grow her business and improve her quality of life. She pledges to make each of her payments according to the established schedule.

local_use: to buy plaster at wholesale to sell at retail

She has a shop where she sells school books from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. and she also sells beauty products such as perfume, face creams and lipstick. Through these businesses she is helping her children get ahead and she would like to expand and improve both of them. She is requesting a loan to purchase books as well as perfume, face cream and lipstick, wholesale.

Kelly is happy about the loan and is committed to making her payments on time.
local_use: to buy books wholesale as well as perfume, face cream and lipstick.

Dancile B. is 36. She is married and the mother of 6 children of whom four are girls. The oldest girl is 13 and studies in 7th grade. The youngest is a boy of 11 months. Dancile hopes that her children will finish their studies successfully and that they will be leaders. She has done so much for them so she hopes one day to be driven around town in their car and treated like a queen. In her everyday life, she runs up against challenges relative to feeding the family, paying school fees, and paying for medicine for her eyes. The money she earns is enough to support them thanks to the business she began in the year 2000. Since then, Dancile has been the owner of a kiosk in Gihosha where she sells groceries and various other items. The most lucrative are dried beans, palm oil, and sugar. She also grows beans, maize, sweet potatoes, and manioc. She will use the loan to buy products to sell in her little store.

local_use: purchasing groceries to sell in her little store

description:
Betty K. is a businesswoman who trades in cosmetics at Gbongo Market in Bo. Betty is married and has three children. All the children are in primary school. She assists her husband greatly in taking care of the home, especially with the schooling of the children.

Betty has a very good credit history in one of the solidarity groups. She needs a loan of 4,000,000 Sierra Leone Leones to help her stock her shop as she has more customers this season. She thanks you for supporting her.
local_use: To buy cosmetics for resale

description:
Damaris is 47 years old and lives with her husband and three children in the Fray Casiano, Puntarenas zone, a poor neighborhood with many limitations.  She’s been doing arts and crafts for 10 years and presents herself as being someone with a great desire to succeed.  She constantly trains to offer her clients high quality products.  She embroiders purses, appliance covers, bath items, and quality decorations for birthday parties and other events, such as first communions and baptisms.  She’s widely known within the zone, for being dedicated to this work and she is not short of customers throughout the year.

She began by buying a small quantity of materials with her husband’s help.  She started training herself and improving her techniques and ended up diversifying her production, increasing her number of customers, and increasing her income.  The objective of this loan is to buy supplies and repair a sewing machine to be able to offer better quality products.

She works throughout most of the day.  Her oldest daughter studies at university and her younger children attend school.  Her day begins with her preparing their lunches for school.  Because of the large number of orders, she works late into the night.  She has to work by hand, but once the sewing machine is fixed, she will be able to speed up and increase her production, and have more time to spend with her family.

The main limiting factor has been lack of money, but this opportunity for a loan will allow her to have the capital she needs to buy supplies, increase her production, and make her dream of fixing up her house come true.
local_use: to buy art supplies.

description:
Simón is married; his children are students and his wife works in retail.  They have been able together to move ahead in life to provide their family with a better standard of living.  

His plans are to improve the infrastructure of his home.  His business consists of selling pig-meat, firewood, and other food-related products. With the loan, he will buy merchandise such as pigs (of the Creole breed), firewood, charcoal, kerosene, and other things.  This will get him better earnings for investing in his home.

He is grateful to the financial institution for the support in developing his business.
local_use: to buy merchandise.

description:
Clotilde is 22 and single. She is part of the Once de Mayo-Huancarani Communal Bank of the Arariwa Association. Clotilde works in her grocery store in the Huancarari market on Sundays. She sells food. Monday through Friday she works for PRONEI (National Program of Early Education) as a teacher. A year ago Clotilde opened a store in her house where she sells handicrafts. Her father makes the handicrafts, and Clotilde sells them. Some of the things he makes are woolen sweaters and pants. Her father has been in the handicraft business for 14 years. It has gone very well for him thanks to the effort he puts into his work. Clotilde needs a loan for 1,500 PEN to buy food like rice, sugar, noodles, soft drinks, and milk. Clotilde is grateful for the opportunity of the loan, and she promises to pay it on time.

Translated from Spanish by Ginny Kalish, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Buy rice, sugar, noodles, soft drinks, and milk

M. Sohibjon is 41 years old, married, and has two children. He gets up early every morning in order to feed the animals and look after them. His knowledge and skills allow him to make his business successful and generate a stable and considerable income for his large family. Sohibjon has a large and friendly family who are always trying to help each other.
Today, knowing that prices for animals are not so high now, but will increase for sure, Sohibjon is planning to enlarge his stock and purchase cattle. With this purpose in mind, he is requesting $1000 USD. You could become an important part of Sohibjon's family's life. He deeply appreciates the trust and support you are giving him.

description:
Don José has been farming for several years, specializing in growing cassava. The main challenge he has faced is to the total loss of products as a result of the heavy rains that have affected a large part of the country. His plants have deteriorated and have not been able to develop. Thanks to his harvest of beans, José has been able to submit his payments on time and maintain his loan.

description:
This associate continues working in the grocery store business and also continues dedicating herself to the business of handicrafts.  She sells caps, sweaters and pants.  Through these businesses the associate gets her kids ahead.  Her dream is to grow the business selling handicrafts and groceries.  She is asking for credit in order to purchase sweaters, gloves and pants and also to buy products to stock the grocery store like rice, sugar, milk and oil.  

She is happy for the loan and promises to complete all of the loan payments.
local_use: To purchase sweaters, gloves and pants and also to buy products to supply a grocery store like rice, sugar, milk and oil.

description: Marhabo is married and has children, daughters-in-law and grandchildren.  Her husband works as a taxi driver.  Marhabo is a multidisciplinary entrepreneur.  She is involved in fattening up livestock, growing tomatoes and selling unprocessed rice.  She has a large family, and it is not always possible to provide abundance for them.  Marhabo wants to obtain a loan to build a house and improve her family's well-being.  She hopes that her loan will be approved.
local_use: to build a house

description:
This is 35-year-old Memuna. She is married, and has 4 children aged 17 yrs, 12 yrs, 9 yrs and 6 yrs. In 1998, Memuna established her food stuff business. While she was with her mother, Memuna became interested in business because her mother was a small-scale trader. When she got married she decided to start her own business to help her husband support their family. Working 6 days a week and 12 hours a day, she earns about Le 900,000 every month from this business. 

She would like a loan in the amount of Le 4,500,000. Memuna requires a loan in order to buy maggi, onions and rice for her business. She hopes that this loan will enable her to increase her monthly profits by approximately Le 350,000. In the future, Memuna plans to educate her children to university level. Memunatu is honest and hardworking. She thanks you for your support.
local_use: To buy maggi, onions and rice for her business

description:
Maria has been a merchant for 11 years, having established a general store in which she continues to introduce a great variety of products, hoping for better sales. At the outset, she did this with money she had saved.

Maria is the mother of 3 children and she has had to pay for their studies, since she can't count on assistance from their father. It is difficult but one has to learn how to forge ahead for the family.

Maria has received various loans with Afodenic, a great satisfaction for her, since she has achieved equilibrium in sales and has acquired steady customers.

Today, with this new loan, Maria will invest in new products to continue augmenting sales – items such as basic grains, Coca Cola products, sweets, chicken, meat, and dairy products among others.
local_use: invest in products that increase sales, buying basic grains, dairy products, meat, and chicken -- items most in demand by customers.

description: Katia is single and she has no children. She lives with her mom, although she is independent.  She has her own source of income. She makes traditional clothing and other garments. She also embroiders clothing in a shop she has rented. She has a good client base, especially because she has contracts with the schools that use uniforms and outfits for various festivities. The loan will be used as working capital to purchase inventory for her business. She is very grateful with the organization for the support provided.
local_use: To purchase fabrics to make uniforms.

description:
Aditza is a very hard-working woman; she has two children. She is very low-income but very eager to work. Several years ago she set up a clothing sales business; she sells t-shirts, nightgowns, women’s and men’s underwear door-to-door. Her husband is a security guard and even though his salary is low the work is permanent. Her house is small and still made of very old boards; her floor is dirt. She hasn’t made any home improvements because she has lacked funds to do so because what she borrows she prefers to invest in her business in order to earn income to help her family. She hopes in the future to be able to make home improvements. She will use this funding to buy: boxer shorts, bikinis, ankle socks, men’s undershirts, etc.

Translated from Spanish by Michael Bujazan, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy stock merchandise.

description:
Julia, 28, is a member of the “Cristo Asención de Rumichaca” communal bank which is located in Urubamba District belonging to Urubamba Province, Cusco Department.

She’s single and has a son.  She alternates her daily chores with selling ceviche, which is a dish made from fish with lemon and peppers served with sweet potato, in Urubamba’s market from 9am until 4pm.  She wants to expand the business and is asking for a loan to buy ingredients to make ceviche like lemons, sweet potatoes and peppers.

She is happy with the loan and commits to make her installment payments.
local_use: to buy ingredients to make ceviche.

description:
Mrs. Leakhena T., age 33, and her husband, Mr. Yeun Yem, age 35, have been married since 1998 and have two daughters. One of them attends school and other one is still young. The family lives in a small village of National Road Number 2 about 20 kilometers from Phnom Penh.

More about Tajikistan and IMON International

Tajikistan is one of the poorer of the 15 former Soviet republics, with a GDP per capita of less than $600. The civil war, which took place soon after its independence from the U.S.S.R., severely damaged the already weak economic infrastructure and caused a sharp decline in agricultural production and the manufacturing sector. In addition, 93% of the country is mountainous and only 7% of the land is arable. All of these factors have resulted in a severe lack of jobs and have forced hundreds of thousands to leave Tajikistan to find work in other countries, mostly in Russia. While Tajikistan has experienced some economic growth since the end of the Civil War, nearly two-thirds of the population still lives in abject poverty.

IMON International's mission is to promote sustainable economic development and improved quality of life in Tajikistan by insuring reliable access to financial services for the economically active members of the population. IMON International has 8 branch offices throughout Tajikistan, and its entrepreneurs work in many parts of the country's economic sector, including trade, manufacturing, agriculture, and services. As of October 2008, IMON International had 27,802 active clients and a total portfolio of $28,405,549. Approximately 44% of these clients are women and 65% are from rural areas. To learn more about IMON International's work, please visit: www.imon.tj.

description:
Tit, pictured here, is 34 years old. He lives with his wife, Saman, in a village about seventeen kilometers from Phnom Penh City. They have been married since 2000 and have two young children, a son and a daughter. Tit is a construction worker and his wife sells meat balls and sluch, a shaved ice dessert. In addition, they are also rice farmers. 

Tit is requesting a 600 USD loan to purchase seed, fertilizer, and pesticide to maintain his farm.
local_use: to purchase seed, fertilizer, and pesticide

description:
21 year old Rosa is mother to two children of 5 and 1 years of age and she lives with her husband. She runs a business from her home were she offers her customers basic groceries. She has been doing this for 2 years and, to date, hasn't had problems with her clientele. She is currently requesting a loan to buy fresh chicken, cheese, meat, sausages, eggs, and other products that her customers buy on a daily basis. This will help her to increase her inventory and get better sales. 
Her wish is to strengthen her business and give her family a better quality of life.
local_use: to buy fresh chicken, cheese, meats, sausages, and eggs.

description:
Willian sells cashews and lives in his own home with his wife and two children, ages 8 and 5. William has sold cashews for 5 years, and he learned from his parents, who have over 15 years of experience. 

He is requesting the loan to purchase raw cashews to process, then go out and sell. This loan will give him the resources he needs to continue with his business and maintain his customers. 

Willian’s aspiration is to grow his business and in the future be able to buy a vehicle which would improve the quality of life of his family.
local_use: purchase raw cashews

description:
Sr. Pedro José Hernández O. is 51 years old and lives in the area called La Borgoña, which is located in the town of Ticuantepe. Together with his life companion, he works as a trader in the market in order to provide for the household expenses. They have two children who are students and help with the farm work during their free time. The plans for his family include improving their living conditions and supporting his children in their education.

Don Pedro has been farming for 26 years. He started in this line of work because he was a beneficiary of the ATN (legislation that supports land reform) and was able to obtain his own property, which he has utilized this entire time. Thanks to AFODENIC, Don Pedro is now on his eighth loan. Because of the technical assistance provided to him, he was able to improve his production. He will use the funds to purchase supplies and fertilizers. In recent months, his crops have been affected by pests.

Translated from Spanish by Ronan Reodica, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Purchase fertilizers & farming supplies

description:
Mrs. Bonifacia R. is 39 years old, married, and has 4 children: 2 of whom study and the other 2 work. Ever since she was a young girl she learned how to raise animals. She has worked for 24 years selling dairy products and cheese in Chixoles, the village where she lives. Her husband delivers the products on his bicycle. They also work selling livestock. She is known by her customers and identifies with them as she is a kind person. She begins work very early to arrive on time to distribute her products. She thanks God that she is already well-known and her clientele keeps increasing. For this reason she is asking for a loan to buy a milk cow since her current cow does not produce enough to fill the orders. She has proven herself to be a very responsible woman and she is pleased to help her children keep studying so that they have better opportunities than she has had. She says she is happy because she and her husband strive each day to improve the life of their family.

Translated from Spanish by Emily Meinecke, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy livestock

description:
Mrs. Armenza is married and together with her husband they are owners of a local store that offers consumer products at low prices for their clients, which allows them to run this constant and regular local market. The husband gets the merchandise very early so that the wife is in charge of selling it to the clients. Her dream is to have shelves that will allow her to display more of her business and strengthen her inventory, which is why she is requesting this loan.

Translated from Spanish by Jay Osborne, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Buy merchandise for her local store

description:
Octavia continues participating with Asociación Arariwa’s micro finance unit’s “San Isidro de Compone” communal bank in the city of Cusco.  Octavia still sells corn and provides transportation services.  Octavia did very well with the previous loan and this is why she wants another one because it helps her very much with her business’ capital.

On this occasion Octavia needs the loan to buy corn and to service the car.  Octavia is grateful for the opportunity provided through this means and commits to make her payments according to the payment schedule.
local_use: to buy corn and to service the car.

description: She continues in her business making yoghurt, cheese and sweets.  She makes them and then sells them in various street markets.  She works from 8am until 6pm and has been in business five years.  Her dream is to have a locale where she can sell her dairy products.  She’s asking for a loan to buy milk and sugar that she uses to prepare the yoghurt, cheese and sweets.  She’s happy about the loan and commits to make her installment payments.
local_use: to buy milk and sugar to make the yoghurt, cheeses and sweets.

description:
Nuriddin is a hardworking person, and he makes an effort to give his 4 beloved children the best. He decided to stay in his homeland so that he could develop it, and now he carries out his everyday chores with a lot of love and affection as he feeds his animals. With experience gained over 8 years in the purchase and sale of cattle, he has been able to bring stability to his family. Nuriddin now would like to purchase cattle that can create more income for his large family. For this reason he requests $1,450 USD. Nuriddin thanks you very much for your love of the prodigal.

More about Tajikistan and IMON International

Tajikistan is perhaps best known for its rich history and diverse culture, which is a complex mixture of the Islamic faith, Soviet influence, New West culture, and Central Asian traditions. It served as a key post along the Silk Road and marked the end of Alexander the Great's extensive rule. It was the birthplace of the great Persian poet Rudaki and famous Islamic philosopher Ibn Sina. And it is home to epic mountain passes, communities that still speak the ancient Sogdian language, and a civilization that dates back to the 4th millennium BC.

But Tajikistan is also the poorest of the former Soviet republics. The civil war, which ignited soon after its independence from the U.S.S.R., further damaged the already weak economy. In addition, 93% of the country is mountainous and only 7% of the land is arable. These conditions have resulted in high levels of unemployment and have forced hundreds of thousands to seek work in other countries, mainly Russia. While the people of Tajikistan are working to improve its agricultural production and manufacturing sector, nearly two-thirds of the population still live in abject poverty.

IMON’s History

Since December 2007, IMON International has worked closely with Kiva and Kiva lenders to ensure that poor and low-income clients represent a viable business proposition. Funds raised through Kiva have already been distributed to thousands of IMON International's clients and will continue to provide thousands more with permanent access to the varied financial services they need. To learn more about IMON International's work, please visit: www.imon.tj
local_use: To purchase cattle to expand the business

description:
Hoshimjon is a kind, active and hard-working young man. He is not married yet.  He has been fattening up small livestock for resale for more than 5 years.  He buys livestock, fattens it up for 2 to 3 months, and then resells it at a good price.  His brother helps him with his business.
Hoshimjon is requesting a loan to buy small livestock in order to expand his business.
local_use: to buy livestock.

description:
Maria Floritcelda is 31 years old, married and has four children. She makes a living making huipiles [traditional blouses worn by Maya women]. She also has two people that help her in making the huipiles because she already has orders to deliver. 

She started making a living this way because she saw that she needed to help her husband with the household expenses because her husband is a pastor in the evangelical church. As they have four children, they want to let them study so that in the future they will have a better life. The business also gives her the opportunity to help others, to give them a job. This is why she needs another loan, to buy raw materials to continue with her business. 

She thanks FAPE and Kiva for the help they offer.
local_use: to buy raw materials for making traditional weavings.

description:
Munisa S. is 46 years old. She started her own business two years ago in order to support her husband with the family's expenses. She is a market vendor in Istaravshan town. 

Munisa purchases sweets from a local confectioner and sells them in the local market as a wholesale. Munisa, being very polite and talkative by nature, has a lot of customers, which allows her to sell her goods immediately. The inventory she has for sale is of very good quality and selection. 

Munisa is seeking to keep her business sustainable and has requested a loan of $600 USD to increase the inventory she has for sale. One of her plans for the future is to open a vending facility in order to expand her business. We believe this current loan will enhance the potential of her business and help Munisa reach all of her aspirations.

local_use: Enlarging the range of goods and purchasing a private store with the increased revenue

description:
Ms. ABIBATA is the representative of the group MANDE 2. She is doing well. She is married and the mother of three children. The oldest is 15 years old, and the youngest is 7. They all go to school. She has three persons to support.

Ms. ABIBATA has been selling vegetables for two years. She gets her supplies from the Pissy market. Her customers include men and women. She is very happy with how nicely her past loan went. 

She wants to purchase a sack of okra, a sack of cabbage, a sack of eggplant, and other vegetables.

She saves her profits in order to expand her stall. She also has ambitions to open a warehouse for vegetables and to send her children to school.
local_use: to purchase a sack of okra, a sack of cabbage, a sack of eggplant, and other vegetables

description:
The communal bank is called “PRO DESARROLLO” and is located in the town of Pisac belonging to Calca Province, Cusco Department.

Julia, 36, is the member.  She’s married and has three children who are 15, 13 and 9 years of age.  She is a retailer.  She sells emollients and school breakfasts independently.  She buys supplies and medicinal herbs and every day prepares various natural boiled herbs called “emolientes” which actually are infusions or native teas used to alleviate various health problems, everything from a cough to liver and kidney problems and others.  She needs the loan to buy supplies for her business.

She is grateful and expresses that she will meet her repayment obligations in a disciplined way.
local_use: to buy supplies.

description:
Sokhon, in the photo, is 50 years old and she and her husband Pao have been married since 1996. They have four children--two sons and two daughters--who are attending grades 3, 5, 7 and 8. The family is living in a Phnom Penh suburb. 

Sokhon and her husband are rice and lotus farmers. In addition, their business is also in fish farming. 

Sokhon is requesting her first Kiva loan in the amount of US $300 to buy seeds, fertilizer and pesticides to maintain her rice and lotus farm.
local_use: To buy seeds, fertilizer and pesticides to maintain her rice and lotus farm.

description:
Sonia, 33, is a member of Asociación Arariwa's “VIRGEN ASUNTA DE RARCCHI” communal bank. She has two sons: Fernando, 5, and Jhon Andre, 5 months. They live in Rarcchí, which is in Urubamba province, Cusco department. Rarcchí is 45 minutes away from Cusco. Sonia buys vegetables like onions, corn and potatoes in Rarcchí and then takes them to Cusco where she distributes them to merchants in the "Virgen Asunta" market. She also raises small farm animals like chickens, pigs, and guinea-pigs. Sonia is a hard-working, enterprising mother who needs financing to buy more pigs. She has been in this line of work for several years and she has done well thanks to the effort she puts into her work. She is grateful for the opportunity given to her by this means and pledges to repay in a timely manner.

Translated from Spanish by Michael Bujazan, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy pigs.

description: Sandra is from Villa Verde in Cochabamba.  She has a grocery store located at her address.  Sandra took out this loan to increase capital buying merchandise to stock her store.  Her store is large and located right on the avenue.  In time, she’d like to get her store to the point where she can stock all kinds of merchandise to satisfy her customers.  She is a hard working person who knows that with dedication, will and work she can get ahead.  She’s grateful to the institution for the support provided.
local_use: to buy stock grocery items for her store.

description:
Doña Cándida is 54 years old and resides in the city of San Miguel with her children, David (age 28) and Carmen (age 18). Both of her children work and help with the household expenses.

Doña Cándida sells tortillas and manages her business from her home. She and her daughter Carmen begin selling at 10am and continue until 2pm. They both operate the business. Cándida is currently requesting a loan to buy corn, the main ingredient used for preparing tortillas to sell. She plans to buy in bulk so that she can get the best price for a quintal of corn (1 quintal = 46kg). This will help her save on her expenses, which will help build sufficient capital over time.

Her goals include improving her business each day and increasing her earnings.
local_use: To purchase corn for preparing tortillas.

description:
The member belongs to the "Las Palmeras" community bank. The bank is located in the district of Huanchac, belonging to the province of Cusco and department of Cusco.

The member is Delia who appears attached to the group photo. She is 44 years old and lives with her partner. The member has two children and she is a nurse, by profession. She is a very hard-working woman and, parallel to her job in a very well known hospital, she provides special nursing and related service. The member, at this time, is requiring the loan to invest in the purchase of materials to redecorate the facade of her own house. The member wishes to be able to improve her house and, at this time, to buy materials to invest in the improvement of her house, especially the facade. The member will buy materials like cement, paint, plaster to redo the facade. 

The other members are dedicated to activities like, for example, attending a grocery shop, selling "chicha" (a drink), taxi service, lodging work, crafts, and selling cell phones. The member is happy for the loan and promises to make the repayments.
local_use: to buy materials like cement, paint, plaster to redecorate the facade.

description: Gafurjon, who is married with five children, has been in cattle business for six years. He buys cattle at the local markets, fattens the animals over a period of six months and sells them at the same market at a higher price. In addition to this business, Gafurjon grows crops, which he also uses to feed the cattle. Gafurjon is applying for a loan to purchase three heads of livestock; this would allow him to expand his business. Gafurjon hopes for your help and kindness.
local_use: To buy cattle

description:
S. Saidahmad, 31, is married with three children. He has a great passion for dairy farming and has been in this business for six years together with his wife.

Saidahmad would like to expand his business by adding more cattle to the ones he has. This is because he recently acquired orders from outside town to supply milk. He is requesting $600. With the additional income, Saidahmad will be better able to meet his family's financial obligations, and especially to provide for the education of his children.

description:
N. Iftikhor is 22 years old. He is not married yet. Iftikhor has very large family. So that, to support his parents Iftikhor has been running his own business for 2 years. He is selling the perfumery like perfume for women and men, air fresheners, tooth pastes and brushes. Today Iftikhor requests 7500 Somoni as he is planning to expand his business and increase the capital and after receiving of large income He would like to thank all supporting him and promises to pay the loan in 12 months.

local_use: Purchasing of new goods for increasing the range of goods

description:
Tutiniso has worked with selling children's clothing and shoes for more than ten years. She acquires her products outside the country and tries to expand her business. She is divorced, and does not have children, but trading children's clothes and shoes brings her joy. She is happy when children leave happy, having purchased necessary clothing. Then Tutiniso switched to women's clothing trade to achive higher profit margins. 

Tutiniso wants to receive a loan in the amount of 3000 US dollars for the purchase of new inventory for the New Year's celebration. She wants to expand her inventory and supplement her product range to make profits from trade on the New Year's celebration and gift giving season. She hopes to get help and thanks for the support.
local_use: to buy merchandise supplementing the current product range of women's clothing

description:
Mrs. Sovanny Y., 36, and her husband, Mr. Vannak Phom, 38, who live along National Road Number one about fifteen kilometers from Phnom Penh, were married in 1990 and have three children: one son and two daughters. All of the children are in school. 

Sovanny stays at home to take care of her children and her house. Her husband has been driving for one company in Phnom Penh for four years. The couple is in the process of building their new house but still have some of it left to finish. So Sovanny is applying for her first loan of $1,000 to finish her house.
local_use: To finish building her house

description:
Julia belongs to the Los Solidarios Communal Bank. She is located in the Urubamba province in the Cusco department. That is one hour from the city of Cusco. She is 36, in a common law marriage, and has two children. They are five and two. She has been alternating her activities between the household and handicrafts since 1996. She makes beautiful handmaD. decorations and clay utensils. She is requesting a loan to help with the construction of her own house. She is grateful for the opportunity of the loan, and she promises to make her payments on time.

Translated from Spanish by Ginny Kalish, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Help with the construction of her own home

description: Sharif is a smart and goal-oriented person.  He is involved in growing agricultural crops.  He grows wheat and corn.  Sharif owns two hectares of land for sowing and planted wheat and corn there this year.  He is also involved in fattening up livestock.  He received an income from processing apricots and made over a ton of dried apricots this year.  This is a family business, and everyone participates in the apricot drying process during summer.  Sharif used his resulting profit to buy a dairy cow.  He is requesting a loan in the sum of $1500 for the purchase of mineral fertilizers and fuel and lubricant materials.
local_use: to buy mineral fertilizers and fuel and lubricant materials

description:
Mr. Leng C. (in the photo), is 60 years old and his wife Mrs. Pheun Phoung, 59 years old, have been married since 1971 and have five sons and one daughter. The family lives in a small village across Mekong River about 17 Kilometers from Phnom Penh. The couple are old, but they are still strong workers.  

Leng is a plow builder and raises cows at home. His wife is a farmer. Leng is asking for his first loan in the amount of 500 USD to purchase additional cows to raise.
local_use: To purchase cows to raise.

description:
Man, who is pictured here, is a fisherman. His wife, Aimmeynas, sells the fish that her husband catches in their village. They have been married since 1980 and have three sons and two daughters. Two of their children are married and live outside the family home and the others are in school.

Man is applying for another loan of 800 USD to buy additional fishing nets to continue his fishing business.
local_use: to buy nets for his fishing business

description:
Catalina, 58, was born in Pucyura district. Currently, Catalina lives in the city of Cusco with her husband and 5 children. Pucyura is located 30 minutes from the city of Cusco. Catalina sells children’s clothing. She has a sales stand in the El Molino shopping center in Cusco. She can be found there seven days a week from 9am until 8pm. Catalina tells us that six years ago she was an itinerant merchant along Ejército Avenue in Cusco but now she has a stand in the shopping center. She also raises small farm animals like sheep, guinea pigs and chickens that she buys newborn at Inquilpata farmers market to fatten up and later sell at markets in Izcuchaca and Cusco. She has been in this business for three years now and does well thanks to the effort she puts into it. Eugenia expects to get 1000 new soles in her next loan that she’d like to use to buy sheep. The “Señor de Ccoyllority Cachimayo” (Lord of Ccoyllority Cachimayo) has been in operation for three and a half years; Eugenia has been a member for three years and does well. The members of this communal bank are devoted to Taytacha Ccoyllority (Lord of the Shining Snow) and this is why they named their communal bank thus.

Translated from Spanish by Michael Bujazan, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To buy sheep.

description: Timotea’s a member of the “Las Triunfadoras” (The Victorious Ones) communal bank in Andahuaylillas District in Quispicanchis Province in Cusco, Peru.  She’s continues with the business of buying and selling cattle.  She buys calves, fattens them up and then sells them.  On this occasion, Timotea needs the loan to buy two bullocks to raise to subsequently sell in her community’s market.  Timotea is very grateful to Kiva for allowing her to stay in business and by means of her work provide support for her home.
local_use: to buy two bullocks.

description: Armando is a man with a strong desire to make headway with his own business, a sewing shop he started two years ago. He is married with two children, and he works tenaciously to secure a better future for them. He started out buying sewing machines with money he saved from a previous job, but he lacked the funds to invest in fabrics, so he took out a loan to cover the expenses for fabric, thread and embroidery, and started working a lot to make money. This is his second loan, and his vision is more advanced since he has been able to obtain fixed customers who will pay for his products. He plans to invest in more fabrics of different colors to make different styles of T-shirts that he can sell at a good price.
local_use: Purchase varied fabrics to increase production of T-shirts.

description:
Pakarasio, aged 48, is a Ugandan male and a father of 5 children living in Kagadi, Uganda. He wants a loan to buy maize and bean produce for resale. He is a produce dealer and has been in this business for four years having started with farming. He is challenged by lack of transport and fluctuating prices of his produce. His dreams are to buy a car to enable him to transport his produce to the market and to educate his five children.
He is a member of a group where by policy each member guarantees the other in accessing a loan.
local_use: To buy maize and bean produce for resale

description:
Moisés needs capital to invest in growing corn and beans, that's why he is requesting a new loan to buy fertilizer and herbicides, to have a better cultivation and to increase production. This will allow him to get a better harvest for sale and for feeding his family.

The previous loan helped him to buy agricultural supplies for growing corn and beans, and thus he also improved his earnings and he has been able to help his family in his home.
local_use: to buy fertilizer and herbicides.

description:
This is a 32-year-old businesswoman.  She is single and has two children aged four and seven. In 2007, she established her drinks and provisions business. When she dropped out of school, she started up a business to help her provide livelihood for her children. Working seven days a week and 12 hours a day, she earns about Le 600,000 every month from this business. 

She would like a loan in the amount of Le 3,000,000. She requires a loan in order to purchase more drinks and provisions such as milk, mayonnaise, sugar. sardines, etc. for her business inventory. She hopes that this loan will enable her to increase her monthly profits by approximately Le 200,000. In the future she plans to educate her children to the highest level. She thanks you for your support.
local_use: To buy more milk, mayonnaise, sugar and sardines for her business inventory.

description:
Juan is requesting a loan because he wants to stock his business with fresh produce such as tomatoes, onions, chilis, potatoes and avocados, among other items that are necessary for his business and to bring in new customers.

The effect of his previous loan was positive. He increased his income and was able to keep a good flow of work that enabled him to cover his family's needs.
local_use: to purchase tomatoes, onions, chilis, potatoes and avocados.

description:
Cantalicia works in cosmetic sales. She lives with her husband and two children, who are 20 and 16 years old. She learned the cosmetics sales business through some friends, and she has been in the business for 6 years. She works from 2 pm to 5 pm.

She is applying for a loan to purchase cosmetics such as make-up, lipsticks, blush, eye shadow, and eye liner. This loan will help her improve the inventory that she offers to customers, with new styles and colors of makeup. Her only difficulty is that she sells on credit, and her customers don't pay their debts on time.

Cantalicia's intention is to work hard to raise her family, supporting her children and giving them a good opportunity to study so that they can aim ever higher.
local_use: to buy products to sell: make-up, lipstick, blush, eye shadow, and eye liner

description:
Germán wants to buy metal sheeting and cement for his house so has decided on a new loan since the previous one helped him get farm supplies.  These investments he makes help him strengthen the business and at present to improve his house.  He wants to provide his family with better comfort and security this way.

Germán is grateful because he was late with some of the previous loan payments so he was hesitant to request again but thank God he was given another opportunity and he’s hoping this time not to have any misfortunes and to be able to pay punctually.
local_use: to buy metal sheeting and cement.

description:
The associate is a member of the Communal Bank “ATIPAY”. The bank is located in the district of Cusco, both part of the province and department of Cusco.

The associate is Gabriela. She is single 35-year-old. She alternates her daily activities with work. She’s a dentist and works in her office from 8am to 7pm every day. By way of this job, she’d like to get ahead. Her dream is to expand her office. The associate is requesting a loan to buy chairs for her dentist’s office. 

The associate is happy with her loan and promises to make her loan payments.
local_use: buy chairs for her dentist's office.

description:
Noé, 36 years old, lives in San Miguel.  He has an electrical shop.  He lives in his own house with his wife and one-year-old daughter.  He works in his house, where he has his shop, making balconies, railings, and doors.  Right now he needs to buy metal tubes and sheets for the development of his work.  He will buy these materials using a loan that will pay for the cost.

This investment will help him to be able to count on the resources necessary to carry out the work he takes on, improving the service and quality he provides to his customers.

His dream is to some day be able to expand the shop and create his own business in electronics.
local_use: to purchase metal tubes and sheets.

description:
Mrs. Ya C. (in the photo), 52 and her husband, Mr. Samnang Kroes, 64, have been married since 1978 and have six children: four sons and two daughters. Two of them are married and live outside the family home, another two work for a garment factory, one is a chef, and other one is a construction worker. The family lives in a small village in the suburbs of Phnom Penh.  

Ya stays at home. The main source of income is from her children’s salaries. But, it’s very difficult for them to get to work. They must commute to work, which is very far from their home, and they have to take a motor taxi, which is very expensive. 

Therefore, Ya is asking for her first loan of $1,000 to purchase a motorcycle for her children to drive to work.

description:
Desman is a 26 year-old married man with three children, living in a semi permanent house in Fort Portal, Uganda.  He is solely charged with the responsibility of looking after the family and his dream is to own a permanent house.

After dropping out of school due to lack of funds, he decided to venture into farming and he is happy with the way business is growing.  Desman needs the loan to clear land for planting cow peas.  His dream is to buy a motorcycle for transportation purposes
local_use: To clear land for planting cow peas.

description:
Mrs. Chamroeun H., 47, is widow with two daughters. All of them have a full-time employment. Besides of her children, she also has her nephew is living with her. Chamroeun lives in a small village along national road number two about 12 kilometers from Phnom Penh City.

Chamroeun has been a cleaner since 1998. She works for a garment factory. She travels to work by her bicycle very often. But, she now wants to purchase a motorbike; it will be more easily for her to manage to work. Hence Chamroeun is applying for a loan of $1,000 to make the purchases.
local_use: To purchase a motorbike for commuting to drive to work.

description:
Part of the Santa Rosita de Lima communal bank in the district of Wanchaq in the province of Cusco, Grety is 34 and is married with one son. Alongside her daily chores she runs a business buying and selling clothes. She has spent years in this business, which is doing well thanks to the effort she puts in. She travels to Lima to buy her goods and then sells them to her customers, many of whom are family and friends. Grety is aresponsible member of the communal bank and eager to continue working for her family. She is requesting the loan to buy coats for her business.

The other members of the group are engaged in carpentry, buying and selling clothing, running a grocery store, selling furniture, and selling phone cards. 

Grety is grateful to have this access to credit and agrees to comply with the repayments.
local_use: To buy coats for her business

description:
Mrs. Pech P., 51, and her husband, Mr. Heng Lach, 50, are farmers. They grow many kinds of vegetables such as cauliflowers, bitter gourd and eggplant on their farmland in the village. This couple hopes to increase the volume of their products, so Pech is asking for her first loan of $700 to pay for plowing fees and to buy fertilizer and pesticide to use on her farm.

Pech and her husband (both are in the photo), live along National Road No. 1, about 17 kilometers from Phnom Penh. They were married in 1979 and have eight children: four sons and four daughters. Unfortunately, one of their sons has died. Four children are married and live outside the family home and one son assists his parents with their farming business.
local_use: To pay for plowing fees and to buy fertilizer and pesticides for her farm

description:
DUO AMOR D. DIOS

Mirna is single and her business is weaving products on a loom.  She also weaves belts by hand.  She needs this loan so that she can buy raw materials for making more products.  She says that she has an order right now and this is why she needs the loan.

Rosenda is married and has four children.  She also weaves products on a loom and also needs a loan to buy raw materials (threads) so that she can make her products and offer different colors and styles.
local_use: to buy raw materials for weaving products

description:
Pertiwi is 34 years old and married with four children. She is wearing a green shirt in the photo. Two of her children are of school age and are currently enrolled. The other two are ages one and four. She has owned a general store for five years. She will use this loan to expand her inventory in her store by purchasing more rice, oil, eggs, etc. She hopes that the expanded inventory will increase the profitability, allowing her to have more income to hopefully pay for all of her children's tuition through college.

Some of the other group members will use their loans to sell snacks and clothing on credit.
local_use: to pay for rice, oil, eggs, and other daily-use items  to increase shop inventory.

description:
Chantal is a merchant, 26 years old, who lives in the town of Gihamagara in Gitega Province. She has been selling cassava flour and palm oil for six years. She is also a farmer. She went to school through the 6th grade. She is married to Zeduc, who also does commerce in beans. Together they have three children, of whom one is in primary school. 

The Kiva loan of 300,000 Fbu is going to enable Chantal to increase her capital to buy a lot of palm oil and cassava flour to resell in order to make a large profit. 

Chantal is a member of the community group “TWUNGUKE II”.
local_use: to increase capital to buy a lot of palm oil and cassava flour to resell in order to make a large profit

description:
Jane is 45 years old and operates a textile business in Kagadi, Uganda. She has run this business for 10 years now. She started as a shop attendant where she saved her monthly earnings and set up her business. Her business is affected by price fluctuations and inflation. She hopes to expand her business into new trading centers.

Jane is a member of Balikyegomba Kikonge, a village group where members guarantee each other in accessing loans. She wants the loan to buy clothes to sell.
local_use: to buy clothes to sell.

description:
Matronne, age 45, is a merchant. She lives in Rutonde, Gitega Province, and she's been selling food products (avocados) for three years. She's also a cultivator. She attended elementary school up to the second year. She's divorced and the mother of four children, out of whom two attend school. 

Her share of the Kiva loan amounts to 100'000 BIF, and will enable her to bolster her working capital and buy lots of avocados, in order to turn a healthy profit. She's a member of the community group DUSABE
local_use: to buy and resell a large quantity of avocados

description:
Magda is a modest, enterprising woman. Her children are a student and a future professional. She has had a business selling a variety of cosmetics, since she stopped working for a private company, and up to now she has been maintaining her clientele. 

The previous loan was of great benefit to her family, as she has gradually improved their standard of living through the profits she has made.

With this loan she will buy products such as lipstick, eye shadow, eyebrow and lip pencils, as well as ladies' men's and children's perfume. She will also buy a variety of make-up and other products ordered by her customers, since they are the best gifts for the Christmas holiday season.

That is why she needs to increase her inventory and bring in new kinds of products.

She is grateful to the financial institution for supporting the development of her business, and her family's well-being, as they make a better future.
local_use: To buy merchandise.

description: Gerónimo is 20 years old. He is not married but he is in a relationship. The couple has a six month old baby. He is a farmer. His plot is located in Villa Esperanza. This loan is the second with the institution. Gerónimo will use this loan to purchase seeds for planting corn and to harvest corn. His reason for requesting the loan is to increase his working capital. Gerónimo will use the benefits to improve the performance of planting and harvesting products. Gerónimo is a young and hard working person who wants to move forward in order to improve the quality of life for his whole family. He feels very grateful to the institution for the opportunity offered to him.
local_use: plant potatoes and harvest corn.

description:
This member's name is  Daniel. He belongs to the “Ricchary Runa” communal bank in the city of Cuzco - Perú, He is still doing his work with a moving service, work he has been doing for a long time. With it, he has been able to support his family and give his children an education. That is why, at this time, he will invest in maintenance of his work tools, which in this case is his vehicle. He will buy replacement parts, accessories, and do complete maintenance.

Daniel is very grateful to KIVA for allowing him to support himself and develop his activity and for supporting him with the financial growth and strength of his family.
local_use: to maintain his car and buy some accessories that it lacks.

description:
This member belongs to the “SOLIDARIDAD-CACHIMAYO” communal bank, which is located in the district of Cachimayo, in the province of Urubamba and department of Cusco.

The member, Visitación, is 60 years old, married and has 7 children, all of whom are adults. She works raising young animals, like chickens, and pigs which she buys, raises and sells. She also has a pair of cows and now she wants to begin buying cattle to riase, reproduce and in the end, sell.

Visitación is a very charismatic and hardworking woman. She wants to continue doing this work, with the dream of buying cows in order to breed them and sell their offspring. She wants to leave her children with the example that old age does not prevent one’s dreams from coming true. She dreamed of having a large number of heads of cattle, which means having a minimum of 10 at her house, raising them, feeding them, breeding them and that was her dream. She is currently requesting the loan to invest in female calves.

Visitación is grateful for the support provided her and is committed to making her payments on time
local_use: to buy female calves.

description: Brayan needs to invest in his business and so is again requesting a loan to buy jeans, shirts and underwear, thereby expanding the styles and colors of his merchandise.. This increases the possibility of improving his income and his family’s living conditions. He expects this investment to yield good results since sales increase in December
local_use: to buy jeans, shirts and underwear.

description:
G. Bakhtier is 38 years old. He is married and has four adorable children of school age. Bakhtier’s wife is not working. She keeps house and takes care of their children. Bakhtier has a very large family. In addition to his wife and kids, he is supporting his parents and sister. To be able to do this, Bakhtier is running a business. He sells perfumery for women and men, deodorants, air fresheners, shaving cream, and more. All the goods are supplied from Almaty, Kazakhstan. Today, Bakhtier is requesting $1500 US dollars, as he is planning to expand his business and increase his capital. Bakhtier would like to thank all supporting him and promises to pay the loan in time. Your support will really help him. Be an important part of the growth of Bakhtier’s business.

More about Tajikistan and IMON International

Tajikistan is perhaps best known for its rich history and diverse culture, which is a complex mixture of the Islamic faith, Soviet influence, New West culture, and Central Asian traditions. It served as a key post along the Silk Road and marked the end of Alexander the Great's extensive rule. It was the birthplace of the great Persian poet Rudaki and famous Islamic philosopher Ibn Sina. And it is home to epic mountain passes, communities that still speak the ancient Sogdian language, and a civilization that dates back to the 4th millennium BC.

But Tajikistan is also the poorest of the former Soviet republics. The civil war, which ignited soon after its independence from the U.S.S.R., further damaged the already weak economy. In addition, 93% of the country is mountainous and only 7% of the land is arable. These conditions have resulted in high levels of unemployment and have forced hundreds of thousands to seek work in other countries, mainly Russia. While the people of Tajikistan are working to improve its agricultural production and manufacturing sector, nearly two-thirds of the population still live in abject poverty.

IMON’s History

Since December 2007, IMON International has worked closely with Kiva and Kiva lenders to ensure that poor and low-income clients represent a viable business proposition. Funds raised through Kiva have already been distributed to thousands of IMON International's clients and will continue to provide thousands more with permanent access to the varied financial services they need. Vilma is always tending to her store. These days, she is interested in a new loan that will allow her to purchase more items to offer more variety in her store, non-perishable items such as noodles, rice, beans, and detergents, as well as bread, snacks, and cookies. Leonila, 35, lives in San Miguel with a sister and a 17-year-old son.  She runs a boutique.  She started out as a street vendor but later got help from her mother to set up a fixed business.  This business was born three years ago.

Rogelio lives in the company of his four children who re 25, 20, 18 and 17-years-old.  Everything depends economically on him.  Rogelio runs a corn mill.  He works every day from five in the morning until noon.  His advantage is that he has no competition in the zone.

Neang (pictured above), 57, is a widow without children. She is a tailor and she is hired to put together fabric swatches. She lives in the area surrounding Phnom Penh, the capital city of Cambodia.

local_use: To rebuild the kitchen where she cooks because it’s old and breaks.

Lucio lives with his wife and 20-year-old daughter.  He saws lumber.  He learned this occupation from his father and for many years he’s continued with this work.  His work schedule is flexible.

local_use: to buy a drill and lumber to saw.

She is requesting this loan to purchase uniforms for the musical band. She is happy to have this loan and promises to honour the payments of the quotas.
local_use: The member is requesting this loan to purchase uniforms for the musical band.

description:
Joseph wants a loan to buy sugar, soap and salt. He is a Ugandan male, aged 43 years, who hails from the Kyenjojo district. He is a retailer and a father of 4 children, aged five to sixteen years old. He lives together with his wife and children. 

Joseph has been in this business, operating the retail shop, for seven years. With the proceeds of his retail sales, he has been able to pay school fees for his children. Limited capital limits his business plan and in the future he wants to start up a wholesale shop.
local_use: to buy sugar, soap and salt to sell.

description:
Mrs. Leslie is 46 years old. She is single and has grown-up children who are independent. She has a law degree but is not using it fully. She dedicates the majority of her time to manage a small store she has in her house in Cuapa Chontales. She is asking for her third loan to buy merchandise and invest in her store. She sells clothes, cosmetics, and other products her customers order. She is very grateful for the financing AFODENIC has provided since it's allowed her to grow her business little by little. Now she is a beneficiary of Kiva, which supports people who want to better themselves.

Translated from Spanish by Lydia Brantley, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Clothing and cosmetic store

description:
Mr. Ly K. and his wife, Mrs. Phanny Un (pictured), have been married for five years. They have eight children: five sons and three daughters. Five of them attend school, while the other three are still very young. The family lives in a small village off of National Road number Two, about fifteen kilometers from Phnom Penh. 

Ly has been driving a Tuk Tuk in Phnom Penh for more than four years. His wife used to sell Phak Lov (a meal cooked with pork) in front of a garment factory, but she left that business, and now runs a new business selling fish. 

Ly’s Tuk Tuk has broken down; it’s upset his business and made it difficult for him to continue earning money. Hence he is applying for a loan of US $200 to make the necessary repairs.
local_use: To repair his Tuk Tuk

description:
Haydee is a member of the “Juntos de la Mano” (“Holding Hands”) Village Bank. She is 36 years old and lives with her common-law husband and their two children, who are 12 and 6 years old. Haydee sells chicken and fish in the market in Anta, a small town about forty minutes outside of the city of Cusco. She has been in this business for the past eight years. The meat is brought in on trucks from Cusco to Anta, an improvement from previous years, when Haydee had to personally travel to Cusco to buy meat. She works seven days a week from 6am to 7pm, and sells about 800 soles’ worth of meat per day from her stand, of which 8%-10% is profit.

Haydee is requesting a loan of 1000 soles to buy fish and seafood for Holy Week, a major holiday in predominately Catholic Peru. She has pledged to repay her Kiva loan on time and in full. Haydee’s dream for the future is to buy a plot of land on which to build a house for her family.
local_use: Buy fish and seafood.

This is 33-year-oldld Abdul. He is married and has 2 children, aged 8 and 6 years.  He has 2 additional dependents who live with him for schooling.  

In 2006, Abdul established his business selling Top-Ups (cell phone service reloads) and all kinds of mobile  phone accessories, as well as movies, etc. He began his business because he was earning a very low salary and needed an extra source of income to support his family. Working 7 days a week and 10 hours a day, he earns about Le 900,000 from this business. 

Abdul would like a loan in the amount of Le 3,000,000 to buy different brands of mobile phones and their accessories. In the future, Abdul plans to open other centers that will be managed by his wife. He thanks you for your support
local_use: buy mobile phones and accessories

He plants potatoes every season and then sells them at local markets. He also raises cattle. He would like to expand his business and increase his working capital. He wants to use the profits so he can marry off his son and have a wedding.  Abduvali is seeking a loan for 2100USD to buy cattle and fuel.  He hopes the loans will support him.
