The associate belongs to the "THREE MARIAS" communal bank. The associate lives in the district of Santiago in the province of Cusco, department of Cusco. The associate is Señora Veronica. She is 34 years of age and lives in a shared home. She has 1 son. The associate is studying tourism in the higher institute. She has worked in a travel agency for 5 years and she is learning a lot. She wants to open her own travel and tourism agency. The associate requests a loan to open an account to buy a computer. The associate very much appreciates the loan offered since this permits her to grow her business and to improve her quality of life. She promises to make the payments according to the specified schedule.

Translated from Spanish by Barbara (B) Brown, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: To open an account to buy a computer for her work in tourism

description:
This member belongs to the “RICHARY ANTEÑA” community bank which is located in Anta district, in Anta province, in Cusco department.

This member is Rosini.  She continues working in her business selling tractor (heavy machinery) parts.  She also continues selling iced treats as an itinerant vendor.  She sells the iced treats to her customers who request them.  Rosini is a determined and responsible person who has a great desire to continue making progress for the sake of her family.

Rosini is requesting this loan to buy supplies for making iced treats such as sugar, fruit and preservatives.  She is happy to be receiving her loan and pledges to make her repayments on time.
local_use: to buy supplies for making iced treats such as sugar, fruit and preservatives

description: Akmal is 27 years old, single.  He has a dealer center, located in the town center.  He has been involved in this business for three years and has work experience.  It is always crowded in his dealer center because there are many government offices and other sites near his center.  His work is always in demand.  Akmal wants to obtain a loan in the sum of $3000 to purchase a computer and expand his business.  Akmal relies on your support and thanks you in advance for your help.
local_use: to purchase a computer and expand his business

description:
José, 42, is married and has four children.  He’s been doing agricultural work since he was little because he was the oldest brother and had to help his father with the work.  At the age of 19 he got married and continued working alongside his father but when his children were born he started to work for himself.  

In order to buy his farm supplies, he has to travel to the city which is 15 kilometers from home and then he has to pay transport costs to bring them home.  From home he takes them by cart to the place where he has his crops which is a kilometer from his house.

The loan he’s asking Fundación Campo for is to buy fertilizer and manure and to pay labor costs for his corn crop.  He hopes the investment will improve corn production and his standard of living and that his children are able to attend university.
local_use: to buy fertilizer, manure and to pay labor costs.

description:
Edwin is a hard-working young man and a dreamer who wishes to improve himself.  He is 19 years old and lives in Arambala, in Morazán department.  He raises tilapia.  Edwin is single and lives with his parents.  He studies in the mornings and in the afternoons he works with his father raising tilapia and doing farm work.

Edwin has been doing farming and livestock work since he was a little boy and he has been raising tilapia for one year.  He also grows vegetables, corn and beans.  His father is his main support.  At the moment, Edwin would like to build a pond to increase his tilapia production area since the pond he has now is already too small.  He would like to take advantage and build another.  This loan will also help him to improve the place where he looks after his fish and will allow him to improve his income so that he can help his family.

Edwin dreams of finishing his secondary education and starting a university course so that he can continue helping his family and, in the future, be able to own his own home.
local_use: To build a pond to raise tilapia (fish)

description:
Andrea's main business activity is selling spare parts, sandpaper and sheets for power saws.  She makes her sales in the busiest market in the city of El Alto on Thursdays and Sundays.  She also makes aprons for cholitas (women who wear traditional clothing).  She sells these products at the same time as she sells her other items. 

Andrea is an existing client who has a good payment record.  She will invest her loan in paying workers to build a retaining wall at her home.  She lives in Tacagua district, in her own home.  Her husband is a rural teacher and he helps her to cover their household expenses.  Andrea has one 16-year-old son in her care who is attending high school and also helps her in some of her activities.  Andrea is a very hard-working person who feels happy and grateful to the institution for the support they have provided.
local_use: to pay workmen to build a retaining wall

description:
Sonia, 48, was born in Monteagudo-Chuquisaca. Many years ago she came from  Santa Cruz looking for new opportunities and this is where she now lives with her husband.   She has two adult daughters.

Sonia rents tables and chairs for social events and also decorates salons.  This is the only business that supports her financially.  She will use the loan to buy cloth to decorate tables and chairs.

This client is very grateful to the institution for their confidence in her.
local_use: to buy material for decorating

description:
Sophea, 29, is a driver. He also supplements his income with another business – buying cows and oxen and selling them to a middleman who comes to buy them at his house. His wife, Srey Oun plants small mango trees and sells them from home.  The couple lives in a village off National Road Number Two, about twenty kilometers south of Phnom Penh.   They have been married since 2008 and just had a young daughter. 

Sophea is asking for a loan of $1,000 to purchase more cows and oxen for sale.
local_use: purchase more cows and oxen

description: Dolores is still working in her business: she runs a restaurant and tends to it every day. As always, she gets up very early to do so. In the future, she wants to fit out her restaurant and make it bigger so that she can buy more tables and chairs and have more customers. She now wants to invest in the purchase of kitchen utensils wholesale. She wants to buy bags of rice, sugar for the drinks, potatoes by the kilo, pasta in boxes, a large barrel of oil, condiments, and spices. She wants to make this investment in order to have more income. She is requesting this loan for the purchase of kitchen supplies.
local_use: to invest in the purchase of kitchen supplies.

description:
Leydi is a hard-working woman who has worked in sales for more than six years selling cosmetics and clothing. She began with little capital but desired to help support her family. Her husband is a mechanic and together they support their two small children.

Afodenic has helped strengthen her business with loans that it provides. Fifty percent of her products are sold on credit and she collects from her clients every other week. She will use this loan to begin construction of a room to have more space and she will use the money to buy construction materials. She is happy to be able to meet her goal.
local_use: To add on a room in her home

description:
A group of neighbors and friends formed the community bank "Sr. de Huanca de Coya", in the district of Coya, Calca province, in the administrative division of Cusco. This communal bank is made up of people who are constantly looking for opportunities to succeed, and through their daily efforts they will provide a better future for their children. The bank is organized as follows - Graciela is the president, Mario is the secretary, Rosa is the treasurer and  Cristina is the attorney.

Some of the members have businesses such as selling crafts, small animal husbandry, buying and selling cattle, raising cattle and selling food, while others provide shuttle services, or work as bricklayers and civil servants.
 
Graciela is 46 years old, married, and has three children as a result of this union. Graciela is in the food business and has a small restaurant serving breakfast, lunch and various regional dishes. She has had her business for 15 years and is doing very well thanks to the effort she puts into it. This time, Graciela requires a loan for the maintenance of her premises and to repair the doors and tables.

The members appreciate the opportunity offered to them, and pledge to comply with the payment of their dues within the prescribed period.

Cusco is located in the district and province of Cusco, Cusco department, in the heart of the ancient city of the Incas. It is known as a tourist area due to its archaeological sites in the historic center, for its landscapes and for being a lovely city in the Southern Region of the country. Cusco is known for its traditional Inti Raymi festival, and it is home to one of the seven wonders of the world, "Machupicchu".
local_use: to carry out maintenance of the restaurant premises, and repair the doors and tables.

description:
The communal bank is called “PRO DESARROLLO” and is located in the town of Pisac belonging to Calca Province, Cusco Department.

Alicia, 29, is the member.  She has a spouse and two children who are 9 and 6 years of age.  She runs a restaurant with her aunt but she also alternates this activity with running a grocery store.  She is new to the communal bank; her aunt invited her to be part of this group and the other members accepted her because she’s a responsible, hard working woman.

She wants the loan to buy basic need items for her store at wholesale and also for the restaurant since they both work in partnership and have to invest half in it.  She wants the loan to invest in her businesses.

She is grateful and expresses that she will meet her repayment obligations in a disciplined way.
local_use: to buy stock items for her store and invest in her restaurant.

description:
Mr. Phun V., 42 and his wife, Mrs. Bunthorn Chea, 39, live along National Road Number One, about 17 kilometers from Phnom Penh. They have been married since 1992 and have three children – one son and two daughters. One of their children is a garment factory worker and the other two children study in a local school. The couple is shown in the photo.
Mr. Phun V. is a fisherman and does construction work. He is requesting a loan of $800 to purchase a motorbike for his daughter to get to work and to build a restroom for his family to use.
local_use: To purchase a motorbike for his daughter to get work and build a restroom for his family

description: This is 37-year-old Isatu. She is married and has two children aged thirteen and seven, plus one additional dependent who lives with her because she is her younger sister. In 2006, Isatu established a plastic bowl business. She began her business because she wanted to be independent. Working seven days a week and ten hours a day, she earns about 1,162,200 SLL every month from this business. She would like a loan of 4,000,000 SLL to buy more business stock. Isatu hopes that this loan will enable her to increase her monthly profits by approximately  230,000 SLL. In the future, she plans to build a house and educate her children. She thanks you for your support.
local_use: To buy more plastic bowls for her business

description:
Wendpagnagde Florence is the representative of the LA PAIX group. She is single and has no children. She has two people to support.

She has been selling ready-made clothing and loincloths for five years now. She gets her supplies from the big market in the city of Ouagadougou. Her customers are men, women, and children.

She wants to buy five loincloths and six dozen sets of ready-made clothes for children.

She uses her profits to increase her supply. She would like to get supplies from outside of Burkina Faso, from countries such as Togo and the Republic of Côte d'Ivoire.
local_use: to buy five loincloths and six dozen sets of ready-made clothing for children

description: Rahimchon is a goal-oriented and conscientious person.  He is married and is a father of three children.  He tries to ensure that his children grow up to become educated and good people, and that they could work in good companies and opened their own businesses.  Rahimchon is involved in repairing and selling cars.  He buys cars first-hand and then sells them at a more profitable price.  He repairs and paints cars himself, and this allows him to reduce car repair expenses.  His brothers help him.  He started his business one year ago with small car repairs and now owns a private repair shop in the local town.  Rahimchon wants to obtain a loan in the sum of $3000 for the purchase of a car.  He thanks everyone who supports him in advance.
local_use: to purchase a car

description:
Saroeun (in the photo), age 42, purchases, raises, and sells cows. His wife, Samet, age 47, sells Cambodian sweets at home. They have been married since 1990 and they have three sons and one daughter. All of their children are in school. 

Saroeun wants to expand his business by buying additional cows to raise. Hence, he is asking for a loan of $500 to have enough capital.
local_use: To purchase cows for resale later on.

description:
Valerio was born on December 9, 1976, in Chuquisaca. He is married, and his wife, Natividad, is also from Chuquisaca. They have two school-aged children. For the past 16 years, Valerio has had fields in Pakay where he works growing yuca, corn and sweet potatoes. In his off hours, he works as a taxi driver on the Santa Rita / Pakay route. He takes all of his harvest to Torno to sell. With the funds from the loan, he will hire laborers to prepare the fields for planting, and he will also buy seeds. He is a responsible and very hard-working person, and he is very grateful to Emprender and Kiva for the confidence placed in him in granting the loan.

Translated from Spanish by Patricia Linderman, Kiva Volunteer
local_use: Preparing his fields for planting

description:
Angela, very much a worker in a tough job, has been helping her family for 11 years. She washes and irons clothes afternoons until 4:00 when she finishes, plus weekends. What she achieves is to provide improvements in food for her family. She can count on help from her husband, who works in security services.

Angela's objective is to improve her house, which they have been repairing, thanks to financing from Afodenic during 4 loan cycles. Now, this new loan will be used to plaster walls and finish closing the room they began with the last loan and failed to finish due to lack of construction materials.

Angela will buy materials such as cement blocks, sand, cement, and sponges, and then start the construction. She is content because each day, her house is in better condition.
local_use: buy construction materials to plaster walls and finish a room in her house.

description:
Gelgi works in her house where she has worked in her tailoring business or more than sixteen years. Previously she worked part time when she was employed as a security guard.  In order to give more attention to her children she decided to dedicate one hundred percent of her time to tailoring, making casual clothing and suits. 

Afodenic has granted her loans to invest in her business. She also receives funds from her brother that works as a welder on his property. 

With this new loan she will purchase fifty yards of fabrics and embroidery to make dresses, shirts, pants, and shorts. She expects to fill the orders that have been placed.
local_use: To purchase fabrics and embroidery to fill orders that have been placed.

description:
Nelly Maritza belongs to the 'Santa Rosita de Ayllupampa' community bank which is located in Urubamba district, in Urubamba province, in Cusco department.

Nelly is 25 years old.  She lives with her partner and has 1 child.  She divides her time between her daily activities and her businesses selling candy and raising animals such as guinea pigs.  Nelly has a small cart where she sells different candy such as lollipops, cookies, soda and chewing gum.  She raises her animals in Urubamba province.  She would like to expand and improve her two small businesses.

Nelly is requesting a loan to buy candy wholesale.  She would also like to buy feed for her guinea pigs.  She is happy to be receiving this loan and pledges to make her repayments on time.
local_use: to buy candy wholesale and to buy feed for her guinea pigs

description:
Mrs. Nancy is 55 years old and has three children.  She runs a grocery store and sells essential goods such as rice, sugar, milk, oil and other products.  Her work hours are from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.  Through this business she has been able to support her children.  She wants to expand her store and is requesting a loan to buy products wholesale, such as rice, sugar, milk and oil.

She is very grateful for the support and committed to paying back the loan on time.
local_use: To buy products wholesale, such as rice, sugar, milk and oil for her grocery store.

description:
A. Makhsud, aged 36, is married with 4 children. He earns his living through farming, specifically planting potatoes, carrots, and onions. Makhsud seeks room for expanding the business and creating an opportunity for his market, especially during the times he is waiting to harvest. He needs an alternative that can help him save for his children's higher education. Makhsud requests a loan of 2000 Somoni that he will spend for purchasing seeds and fertilizer for his crop.

More about Tajikistan and IMON International

Tajikistan is known for its rich history, which includes a key post along the Silk Road and the end of Alexander the Great's rule. It has also produced great thinkers, philosophers, scientists and poets, including Rudaki, Avicenna, Ferdowsi, Omar Khayyam, Jomi, and Rumi. The country is home to communities that still speak the ancient Sogdian language, epic mountain passes, and a civilization that dates back to the 4th millennium BC. And, even today, it is a complex mixture of the Islamic faith, Soviet culture, New West culture and Central Asian traditions.

But Tajikistan is also the poorest of the former Soviet republics. The civil war, which ignited soon after its independence from the U.S.S.R., further damaged the already weak economy. In addition, 93% of the country is mountainous and only 7% of the land is arable. These conditions have resulted in high levels of unemployment and have forced hundreds of thousands to seek work in other countries, mainly Russia. While the people of Tajikistan are working to improve its agricultural production and manufacturing sector, nearly two-thirds of the population still live in abject poverty.

IMON's History

Since December 2007, IMON International has worked closely with Kiva and Kiva lenders to ensure that poor and low income clients represent a viable business proposition. Funds raised through Kiva have already been distributed to thousands of IMON International's clients and will continue to provide thousands more with permanent access to the varied financial services they need. To learn more about IMON International's work, please visit: www.imon.tj
local_use: Purchasing seeds and fertilizer

description:
The member belongs to the community bank "Ollantay D. Wayracpuncu". This bank is located in the Urumbamba province and the department of Cusco.
The member is Elva. She is married and 71 years old. She has 5 children, and her children are already independent and all are married and live in their own homes. The member works in the livestock traD.. She has dairy cows and she sells her produce to the schools. She is married to Augusto, who is also a member of the bank. She has had this business for many years, but has been selling milk to the schools and to PRONA (a government program that provides milk to school children) for three years. The member wants to buy horses and she needs the money to be able to invest in buying them. She is requesting the money to buy horses.
The member is very grateful for the loan and promises to complete the repayments in a disciplined way.
local_use: La socia solicita el préstamo para invertir en la compra de caballos.

description: Abdul K. is a father of  four children, married to a woman who is a farmer.  All of his children are in primary school.  Abdul owns a store where he sells rice and other agricultural products.  He has had several other businesses until a couple of years ago when he started selling rice.  His wife, though a farmer, usually helps Abdul in the store, and its profits are used to care for his family.  Abdul is seeking a loan get more stock for his shop, thereby expanding his capital and income.
local_use: to buy rice for his store

description: Maria is requesting a loan to invest in her small business selling groceries, fish and shellfish.  She decided to request this financing so that she can make her business stronger and have cash available.  Maria will purchase fish, shrimp, oysters and other shellfish to offer to her customers.  Her situation has improved with these loans, and the money from the new loan will allow her to purchase fresh products to offer to her customers and increase her sales.
local_use: to purchase fresh fish, as well as shrimps and oysters to sell.
